apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_CRP_SHIPPING_SOS_DETERMINE
apis.Title: Determine Shipping Sources of Supplies
apis.ShortText: An interface to perform shipping source of supply determination
apis.Description:
The **ShippingSourceOfSupplyDeterminationIn** web service can be used within E-commerce scenarios to enhance E-Shops with delivery information like delivery duration. Furthermore it delivers with the sending location and sending supply planning area the needed input data for other web services such as the **ProductAvailabilityDeterminationIn** which provides inventory and availability information within the sending location.

The web service **ShippingSourceOfSupplyDeterminationIn** determines the shipping sources of supply (sending location, sending supply planning area, shipping duration and goods issue duration) for a given seller company, the address (country/region/postal code) of the ship-to location and a list of products.

It considers only internal sources of supply that are sources related to locations which belong to the seller company. External sources related to purchasing contracts of suppliers or related to locations which belong to other companies than the seller company are not considered.

This web service has the operation **Determine** to determine the shipping sources of supply.

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_TIMX_EVENT_MAINTAIN_IB
apis.Title: Manage Employee Time Events
apis.ShortText: An interface to maintain employee time events.
apis.Description:
This service is used by the External Time Recording System (ETRS) to upload time events into the SAP ByDesign system. This is an asynchronous message storing the received time events in business object Employee Time Event.

The time recording system has the responsibility to collect time events from the time recording terminal and periodically upload the time events to the SAP ByDesign system using the service Employee Time Event Bundle Create Request. The scheduling of this upload is in the responsibility of ETRS.

The terminal shall not upload time events for employees not participating in external time recording.

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_PDN_REPL_REQ_IN
apis.Title: Product Design Replication A2A
apis.ShortText: An interface to replicate a product design.
apis.Description:
The web service interface **Product Design Replication Request** enables you to connect external CAD applications to your SAP Business ByDesign system, and through the engineering design, to automatically create and update product designs in your system.

The web service interface **Product Design Replication Request** is relevant if your company wants to create and update Product Designs from external CAD applications.

The web service interface **Product Design Replication Request** offers the operations **ReplicateProductDesign** and **ReplicateProductDesignBulk**.

The Product Design can be created or updated by the asynchronous service Product Design Replication Request. In most cases, there will be a corresponding object in the engineering system. In the service definition and in this document the corresponding object of the engineering system is called Engineering Design. In concrete systems, this object would be called differently, for example, engineering BOM, assembly, part, or item.

The logical communication takes place between the objects Engineering Design and Product Design. In SAP Business ByDesign Materials can be assigned to Product Designs and Product Designs can be converted into Production Bills of Material Variants. Production Bills of Material Variants are not created directly using the inbound interface but require additional steps on the SAP Business ByDesign side.

An Engineering Design cannot be assigned to more than one Product Design. In addition, one Product Design can refer to only one Engineering Design.

If an Engineering Design is not assigned to a Product Design. This means, that the Engineering Design has not been replicated in SAP Business ByDesign. The second Engineering Design is assigned to a Product Design in SAP Business ByDesign. This assignment cannot be changed afterwards and the Engineering Design cannot be assigned to another Product Design. The last Product Design has no reference to an Engineering Design, meaning this Product Design has been created manually in SAP Business ByDesign.

Besides the mapping between an Engineering Design and a Product Design, there is also the mapping between an Engineering Design Version and a Product Design Version. In existing engineering systems Engineering Design Version may represent a version, a revision or another entity. Once a Product Design Version has been assigned to an Engineering Design Version via the CAD-integration interface, the assignment can’t be changed any longer.

Each Product Design must have at least one version in order to be displayed in the UI. Similar to the mapping between Engineering Design and Product Design, a version of an Engineering Design can be assigned at maximum to one version of a Product Design and vice versa.

Not all versions of an engineering design need to be replicated to SAP Business ByDesign. On the other hand it is possible to manually create a version for a Product Design that refers to an Engineering Design.

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_PRC_MANAGE_SPS_IN
apis.Title: Manage Sales Price Specifications
apis.ShortText: An interface to create or update sales price specification, for example, surcharges, discounts or freights from a source system or file.
apis.Description:
The Web service interface **Manage Sales Price Specification In** enables you to connect external applications to your SAP Business ByDesign system and to create and edit sales price specifications in your system.

The Web service interface **Manage Sales Price Specification In** offers the operations **Maintain Bundle** and **Check Maintain Bundle**.

Here is an example of a simple Web service request:
```
<n0:SalesPriceSpecificationBundleMaintainRequest_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <BasicMessageHeader>
 <ID>SPS1</ID>
 </BasicMessageHeader>
 <SalesPriceSpecification ActionCode="04">
 <ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>SPS1</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>
 <TypeCode>7PR8</TypeCode>
 <Description languageCode="EN">Freight</Description>
 <StartDate>2013-01-01</StartDate>
 <EndDate>2013-12-31</EndDate>
 <Amount currencyCode="EUR">5</Amount>
 <ProcessingTypeCode>AG</ProcessingTypeCode> 
 <IncotermsClassificationCode>CFR</IncotermsClassificationCode> 
 <IncotermsTransferLocationName>Hamburg</IncotermsTransferLocationName> 
 <ScaleLine>
 <FirstDimensionScaleAxisStep>
 <ScaleAxisBaseCode>3</ScaleAxisBaseCode>
	<IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>1</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode> 
 <Amount currencyCode="EUR">0</Amount>
 </FirstDimensionScaleAxisStep>
 <Amount currencyCode="EUR">5</Amount>
 </ScaleLine>
 <ScaleLine>
 <FirstDimensionScaleAxisStep>
 <ScaleAxisBaseCode>3</ScaleAxisBaseCode>
	<IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>1</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode> 
 <Amount currencyCode="EUR">100</Amount>
 </FirstDimensionScaleAxisStep>
 <Amount currencyCode="EUR">0</Amount>
 </ScaleLine>
 </SalesPriceSpecification>
</n0:SalesPriceSpecificationBundleMaintainRequest_sync>
```
 

It would create a single price specification (freight) valid throughout 2013 for sales orders with incoterms CFR Hamburg. A fixed freight of 5 EUR will be applied. No freight will be charged for sales orders with a net value above 100 EUR.

The notification usually contains payment-specific information, such as the amount and date, and the parties involved in the payment. It also contains the reasons for the payment, typically reference to invoices. The payment amounts could be specified per invoice level and even explain differences between the expected and actual payment amounts.

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_FIA_MANAGE_PLAN_RELEASE_IN
apis.Title: Financial Plan Release Create
apis.ShortText: An interface to maintain financial plan release data from an external system.
apis.Description:
The web service interface "Manage Financial Plan Release Data In" enables you to connect an external application to your system, and to create, update or delete financial plan releases in your system. For a financial plan release to be created, a default financial plan for the same combination of company, set of books, and fiscal year must exist in the system. When a financial plan release for this combination is created, the system derives the default financial plan and associates the plan release to the default plan. The system also checks that for every unique combination of the key characteristics such as G/L account, Budget Category, Cost Center, Project Task, Profit Center, Fund and Function, the total amount in plan release does not exceed the amount in plan. Relevant error message gets raised if the plan release amount exceeds.

The Web service interface Manage Financial Plan Release Data In offers the operation Maintain As Bundle.

Here is a sample of a simple web service request:
```
<ns1:FinancialPlanReleaseDataBundleMaintainRequest_sync xmlns:ns1="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <BasicMessageHeader>
 <ID>WS_MSG_ID_0</ID>
 </BasicMessageHeader>
 <FinancialPlanReleaseData>
 <ID>Release_01</ID>
 <SetOfBooksID>PS01</SetOfBooksID>
 <Description>First new Plan Release version</Description>
 <DefaultIndicator>true</DefaultIndicator>
 <ResponsibleEmployeeID>11</ResponsibleEmployeeID>
 <ReleaseData>
 <CompanyID>PS10000</CompanyID>
 <ChartOfAccountsItemCode>500300</ChartOfAccountsItemCode>
 <CostCentreID>PS20000</CostCentreID>
 <FundID>TRAVEL_FUND</FundID>
 <FunctionID>DEMO_FUNC</FunctionID>
 <PeriodAmount actionCode="01">
 <FiscalYearAccountingPeriodID>2021001</FiscalYearAccountingPeriodID>
 <Amount currencyCode="USD">1000</Amount>
 </PeriodAmount>
 <BudgetCategoryID>TRAVEL</BudgetCategoryID>
 </ReleaseData>
 </FinancialPlanReleaseData> 
</ns1: FinancialPlanReleaseDataBundleMaintainRequest_sync >
```

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_MANAGE_MATERIAL_IN
apis.Title: Manage Materials
apis.ShortText: An interface to migrate material master data from a source system or file.
apis.Description:
The web service interface **Manage Material In** enables you to connect external applications to your SAP Business ByDesign system and to create and edit materials in your system. The web service interface **Manage Material In** is relevant if your company wants to access and manage material data from external applications.

The web service interface **Manage Material In** offers the operations **MaintainBundle_V1** and **CheckMaintainBundle_V1**.

Example of a simple web service request:

The following request provides a basic **MaintainBundle_V1** operation where a new material is created by specifying the attribute action code as "01" of **Material** node element. The new material above is created by specifying the Material ID as InternalID, Product Category as ProductCategoryID, Base UoM as BaseMeasureUnitCode and description of the material in english by specifying the language code as "EN".
```
<n0:MaterialBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1 xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <BasicMessageHeader>
 <ID>1234567890ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF</ID>
 </BasicMessageHeader>
 <Material actionCode="01">
 <InternalID>P100702</InternalID>
 <ProductCategoryID>180</ProductCategoryID>
 <BaseMeasureUnitCode>EA</BaseMeasureUnitCode>
 <Description actionCode="01">
 <Description languageCode="EN">Wooden Pallet</Description>
 </Description>
 </Material>
</n0:MaterialBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>
```
 

Respone of the above request:

The response below provides the Material ID as InternalID and UUID of the material in case the material is created successfully.
```
<nm:MaterialBundleMaintainConfirmation_sync_V1 xmlns:nm="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global" xmlns:prx="urn:sap.com:proxy:ASL:/1SAI/TAEFC78A8519B7531E7D098:804">
 <Material>
 <ReferenceObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID/>
 <ChangeStateID>20121222115503.1402520</ChangeStateID>
 <InternalID>P100702</InternalID>
 <UUID>00163e02-86fa-1ed2-9385-cd6806c81f95</UUID>
 </Material>
 <Log/>
</nm:MaterialBundleMaintainConfirmation_sync_V1>
```
 

Example of material updation:

The following request updates the previously created material with Material ID P100702 by specifying the action code as "02". The new Product Category as 20 and BaseUom as act and material description in english is updated while a new description in german is created for the above material. An error is thrown in case the material doesn't have the description in the language for which the update is called or it already has the description in the language for which the creation is called.
```
<n0:MaterialBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1 xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <Material actionCode="02">
 <InternalID>P100702</InternalID>
 <ProductCategoryID>20</ProductCategoryID>
 <BaseMeasureUnitCode>act</BaseMeasureUnitCode>
 <Description actionCode="02">
 <Description languageCode="EN">Description in English</Description>
 </Description>
 <Description actionCode="01">
 <Description languageCode="DE">Beschreibung in Deutsch</Description>
 </Description>
 </Material>
</n0:MaterialBundleMaintainRequest_sync_V1>
```
 

Response:

Response for the update request is same as for the creation request specifying the Change State Id, Internal ID and UUID of the updated material.
```
<nm:MaterialBundleMaintainConfirmation_sync_V1 xmlns:nm="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global" xmlns:prx="urn:sap.com:proxy:ASL:/1SAI/TAEFC78A8519B7531E7D098:804">
 <Material>
 <ReferenceObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID/>
 <ChangeStateID>20121222115503.1402520</ChangeStateID>
 <InternalID>P100702</InternalID>
 <UUID>00163e02-86fa-1ed2-9385-cd6806c81f95</UUID>
 </Material>
 <Log/>
</nm:MaterialBundleMaintainConfirmation_sync_V1>
```

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_A1FIA_MANAGE_MATVD_IN
apis.Title: Manage Material Valuations
apis.ShortText: An interface to replicate material valuation data from a source system or file.
apis.Description:
The web service interface **Manage Material Valuation Data In** enables you to connect external applications to your SAP Business ByDesign system and to create and edit materials valuation data in your system.

The web service interface **Manage Material Valuation Data In** offers the operation **MaintainBundle** and **CheckMaintainBundle**.

* The following request provides an example for a basic **MaintainBundle** operation where a valuation price of type standard cost is updated at permanent establishment level. The attribute action code is specified as "06" (no action) for node **MaterialValuationData** as there already exists an instance of material valuation data, which is identified by Material ID as "P100702" and Company ID as "1000". The section **ValuationPrice** specifies the valuation price of type standard cost that shall be updated by providing action code as "02", permanent establishment as "P1100", start date of validity period as "2013-01-01", end date of validity period as "2013-12-31", price type code as "2", set of books as "7000" and finally the valuation price itself as 115.75 USD relating to a price unit of 1 ea. 

 
```
<n0:MaterialValuationDataBundleMaintainRequest_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <BasicMessageHeader>
 <ID>1</ID>
 </BasicMessageHeader>
 <MaterialValuationData actionCode="06" valuationPriceListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="false">
 <ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>1</ObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>
 <MaterialInternalID>P100702</MaterialInternalID>
 <CompanyID>1000</CompanyID>
 <ValuationPrice actionCode="02">
 <PermanentEstablishmentID>P1100</PermanentEstablishmentID>
 <ValidityDatePeriod>
 <StartDate>2013-01-01</StartDate>
 <EndDate>2013-12-31</EndDate>
 </ValidityDatePeriod>
 <PriceTypeCode>2</PriceTypeCode>
 <SetOfBooksID>7000</SetOfBooksID>
 <LocalCurrencyValuationPrice>
 <Amount currencyCode="USD">115.75</Amount>
 <BaseQuantity unitCode="EA">1</BaseQuantity>
 <BaseQuantityTypeCode>EA</BaseQuantityTypeCode>
 </LocalCurrencyValuationPrice>
 </ValuationPrice>
 </MaterialValuationData>
</n0:MaterialValuationDataBundleMaintainRequest_sync>
```
 

The response for the above mentioned request provides the Material ID (specified as **MaterialInternalID**) and the Company ID (specified as **CompanyID**) of the material valuation data. In case errors are occured they are listed in the log section.
```
<nm:MaterialValuationDataBundleMaintainConfirmation_sync xmlns:nm="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global" xmlns:prx="urn:sap.com:proxy:QSC:/1SAI/TAE8DAFDDE4CC4BB635D2F8:804">
<MaterialValuationData>
 <ReferenceObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>1</ReferenceObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>
 <ChangeStateID>20130618105700.3336650</ChangeStateID>
 <MaterialInternalID>P100702</MaterialInternalID>
 <CompanyID>1000</CompanyID>
</MaterialValuationData>
<Log/>
</nm:MaterialValuationDataBundleMaintainConfirmation_sync>
```
 

* The following request provides an example for a **MaintainBundle** operation where valuation data of a material is updated at consignment level. The webservice creates the product valuation level for the mentioned consignee ID if it does not exist in the system. The attribute action code is specified as "06" (no action) for node **MaterialValuationData** as there already exists an instance of material valuation data, which is identified by Material ID as "P100703" and Company ID as "2000". The section **ValuationPrice** specifies the valuation price of type standard cost that shall be updated by providing action code as "02", permanent establishment as "P1100", product valuation level ID with consignee ID as "PC9785", product valuation level type as either "3" or "Consignee", start date of validity period as "2021-01-01", end date of validity period as "2021-12-31", price type code as "2", set of books as "7000" and finally the valuation price itself as 100 USD relating to a price unit of 1 ea. The section **AccountDeterminationSpecification** specifies the account determination material valuation data group code as "3010" that shall be updated by providing action code as "02", permanent establishment as "P1100", product valuation level ID with consignee ID as "PC9785", product valuation level type as either "3" or "Consignee". The section **InventoryValuationSpecification** specifies the perpetual inventory valuation procedure code as "1" that shall be updated by providing action code as "02", permanent establishment as "P1100", product valuation level ID with consignee ID as "PC9785", product valuation level type as either "3" or "Consignee".

```

apis.Description:
The web service **Manage Incoming Cheque In** enables you to connect external applications to your solution and to incoming cheques in your system.

The notification usually contains cheque-specific information, such as the amount and the cheque-id, and the parties involved in the payment. It can also contain the reasons for the cheque payment, typically reference to invoices. These can be put as a note.

The web service interface **Manage Incoming Cheque In** offers the operations **MaintainBundle** and **CheckMaintainBundle**.

Here is a very simple example:
```
<n0:IncomingChequeBundleMaintain xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <BasicMessageHeader>
 <UUID>12345678-90AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF</UUID>

 <IncomingCheque ActionCode="01">
 <PayerChequeID>Test</PayerChequeID>
 <PayeeCompanyID>MC10000</PayeeCompanyID>
 <PaymentAmount currencyCode="EUR">100</PaymentAmount>
 <Note languageCode="EN">This is an exemplary test cheque.</Note>
 </IncomingCheque>
</n0:IncomingChequeBundleMaintain>
```

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_MANAGE_MARK_CONS_IN
apis.Title: Manage Marketing Consent
apis.ShortText: An interface to change marketing consent data for business partner.
apis.Description:
The web service interface **Manage Marketing Consent In** enables you to connect external applications to your SAP Business ByDesign system and to create and edit marketing channel and its permission in your system. The web service interface **Manage Marketing Consent In** is relevant if your company wants to access and manage marketing consent data from external applications.

The web service interface **Manage Marketing Consent In** offers the operations **MaintainBundle** and **CheckMaintainBundle**.

__Example of a simple web service request:__

The following request provides a basic **MaintainBundle** operation which updates Marketing Consent data. For a business partner there always exists a set of marketing consent data. Thus, creation of marketing consent data for a business partner is not necessary and the action code for marketing consent is always "02". When a new business partner is created there is a set of initial marketing consent data.

In the following marketing consent data for a business partner can be initially maintained containing permission for communication channels. This means that the general contact permission is allowed (code value 1), permission channels for Email(INT) and telephone(TEL) will be created:
```
<n0:MarketingConsentBundleMaintainRequest_Sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <BasicMessageHeader>
 <ID>1234567890ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF</ID>
 </BasicMessageHeader>
 <MarketingConsent MarketingConsentChannelPermissionListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true" ActionCode="02">
 <BusinessPartnerInternalID>10000123</BusinessPartnerInternalID>
 <MarketingConsentGeneralContactPermission>1</MarketingConsentGeneralContactPermission>
 <MarketingConsentChannelPermission ActionCode="01">
 <MarketingConsentCommunicationChannelTypeCode>INT</MarketingConsentCommunicationChannelTypeCode>
 <MarketingConsentContactAllowedCode>1</MarketingConsentContactAllowedCode>
 <Details>Created via Web service from external application ABC</Details>
 </MarketingConsentChannelPermission>
 <MarketingConsentChannelPermission ActionCode="01">
 <MarketingConsentCommunicationChannelTypeCode>TEL</MarketingConsentCommunicationChannelTypeCode>
 <MarketingConsentContactAllowedCode>2</MarketingConsentContactAllowedCode>
 <Details>Created via Web service from external application ABC</Details>
 </MarketingConsentChannelPermission>
 </MarketingConsent>
</n0:MarketingConsentBundleMaintainRequest_Sync> 
```
 

Response of the above request:

The response below provides the business partner UUID and ID as InternalID in case the marketing consent data is updated successfully.
```
<n0:MarketingConsentBundleMaintainConfirmation xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global" xmlns:prx="urn:sap.com:proxy:ACL:/1SAI/TAS556AD5BE6B43F9AC7541:804">
 <MarketingConsent>
 <ReferenceObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID> 20180301173048.3340430</ReferenceObjectNodeSenderTechnicalID>
 <ChangeStateID></ChangeStateID>
 <BusinessPartnerUUID>00163e07-3d66-1ed8-86e0-3832a6dc26a0</BusinessPartnerUUID>
 <BusinessPartnerInternalID>10000123</BusinessPartnerInternalID>
 </MarketingConsent>
 <Log/>
</n0:MarketingConsentBundleMaintainConfirmation>
```
 

The following request updates General Contact permission for a business partner and changes permission for each channel:
```
<n0:MarketingConsentBundleMaintainRequest_Sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <BasicMessageHeader>
 </BasicMessageHeader>
 <MarketingConsent MarketingConsentChannelPermissionListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="true" ActionCode="02">
 <BusinessPartnerInternalID>10000123</BusinessPartnerInternalID>
 <MarketingConsentGeneralContactPermission>2</MarketingConsentGeneralContactPermission>
 <MarketingConsentChannelPermission ActionCode="02">
 <MarketingConsentCommunicationChannelTypeCode>INT</MarketingConsentCommunicationChannelTypeCode>
 <MarketingConsentContactAllowedCode>2</MarketingConsentContactAllowedCode>
 <Details>Created via Web service from external application ABC</Details>
 </MarketingConsentChannelPermission>
 <MarketingConsentChannelPermission ActionCode="01">
 <MarketingConsentCommunicationChannelTypeCode>TEL</MarketingConsentCommunicationChannelTypeCode>
 <MarketingConsentContactAllowedCode>3</MarketingConsentContactAllowedCode>
 <Details>Created via Web service from external application ABC</Details>
 </MarketingConsentChannelPermission>
 </MarketingConsent>
</n0:MarketingConsentBundleMaintainRequest_Sync>
```
 

In order to change only one communication channel, delete one channel and/or add further channels in one request the MarketingConsentChannelPermissionListCompleteTransmissionIndicator has to be set to **false**. The following request sets the general contact permission to disallowed (2), deletes the communication channel for Email (INT), sets contact permission for telephonee (TEL) to allowed (1) and creates further communication channel FAX.

 <MarketingConsent MarketingConsentChannelPermissionListCompleteTransmissionIndicator="false" ActionCode="02">
 <BusinessPartnerInternalID>10000123</BusinessPartnerInternalID>
 <MarketingConsentGeneralContactPermission>2</MarketingConsentGeneralContactPermission>
 <MarketingConsentChannelPermission ActionCode="05">
 <MarketingConsentCommunicationChannelTypeCode>INT</MarketingConsentCommunicationChannelTypeCode>
 <MarketingConsentContactAllowedCode>2</MarketingConsentContactAllowedCode>
 <Details>Created via Web service from external application ABC</Details>

 <MarketingConsentContactAllowedCode>1</MarketingConsentContactAllowedCode>
 <Details>Created via Web service from external application ABC</Details>
 </MarketingConsentChannelPermission>

 </MarketingConsent>
</n0:MarketingConsentBundleMaintainRequest_Sync>
```

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_FOP_MANAGE_BANK_STMNT_IN
apis.Title: Manage Bank Statements
apis.ShortText: An interface to manage banking transactions by customers through Bank Statements.
apis.Description:
The web service interface __Manage Bank Statements__ enables you to connect external applications to SAP Business ByDesign to create and edit Bank Statements in your system.

This web service offers the operations __MaintainBundle__ and __CheckMaintainBundle__.

__MaintainBundle__ will save the changes at the end of its process if no error occurs, while __CheckMaintainBundle__ will not save the changes.

Here is an example of a simple web service request which uses the __MaintainBundle__ operation to create a new Bank Statement with the following information:

* Action code as "01" for the __Bank Statement__ node element, 
* Statement ID as 1, 
* Company as MC10000, 
* House bank account as 110000062588, 
* Credit amount as 1 USD, 
* Item amount as 1, 
* Item ID as 1, 
* Business partner as MC2000, 
* Payment transaction category as incoming bank transfer, 
* Payment amount as 1 USD. 

 
```
<n0:BankStatementBundleMaintainRequest_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <BankStatement ActionCode="01">
 <BankStatementExternalProviderID>1</BankStatementExternalProviderID>
 <CompanyID>MC10000</CompanyID>
 <HouseBankAccount>
 <ID>110000062588</ID>
 </HouseBankAccount>
 <DocumentDescription>TEST</DocumentDescription>
 <StatementDate>2020-09-17</StatementDate>
 <ValidityYear>2020</ValidityYear>
 <PostingDate>2020-09-17</PostingDate>
 <OpeningBalanceAmount currencyCode="USD">1289630.38</OpeningBalanceAmount>
 <ClosingBalanceAmount currencyCode="USD">1289631.38</ClosingBalanceAmount>
 <CreditTotalAmount currencyCode="USD">1</CreditTotalAmount>
 <DebitTotalAmount currencyCode="USD">0</DebitTotalAmount>
 <ItemsTotalNumberValue>1</ItemsTotalNumberValue>
 <Item ActionCode="01">
 <ItemID>1</ItemID>
 <BusinessPartnerInternalID>MC2000</BusinessPartnerInternalID>
 <BusinessProcessVariantTypeCode>48</BusinessProcessVariantTypeCode>
 <PaymentTransactionCategoryCode>15</PaymentTransactionCategoryCode>
 <PostedAmount currencyCode="USD">1</PostedAmount>
 <BankValueDate>2020-09-17</BankValueDate>
 <BankPostingDate>2020-09-17</BankPostingDate>
 </Item>
 <ItemListCompleteTransmissionIndicator>true</ItemListCompleteTransmissionIndicator>
 </BankStatement>
</n0:BankStatementBundleMaintainRequest_sync>
```

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_QUERY_ACCOUNT_OPEN_AMNT_IN
apis.Title: Query Account Open Amounts
apis.ShortText: An interface to query open amounts, such as the current spending limit amount per company, and account combination for each account where the financial data for the company is maintained.
apis.Description:
The web service interface Query Account Open Amounts In enables you to connect external applications to your solution, and to query and read open amounts, such as the current spending limit per company and account. The account and company combination is returned when in the account the company is maintained in the financial data.

The web service interface Query Account Open Amounts In is relevant if your company wants to evaluate the credit worthiness of an account. The credit worthiness comprises of the credit limit, open items (receivables only), open sales and service orders, and doubtful debtor indicator and credit limit maintained indicator as the risk status of the customer.

The web service interface Query Account Open Amounts In offers the operation Find Account Open Amounts.

Here is an example of a simple web service request, which seeks for company "123" all accounts with an ID matching "A*", returning at maximum 100 instances:
```
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:glob="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <soapenv:Header/>
 <soapenv:Body>
 <glob:AccountsOpenAmountsQueryRequest_sync>
 <AccountOpenAmountsSelection>
 <CompanyID>
 <InclusionExclusionCode>I</InclusionExclusionCode>
 <IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>1</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>
 <LowerBoundaryIdentifier>123</LowerBoundaryIdentifier>
 </CompanyID>
 <AccountID>
 <InclusionExclusionCode>I</InclusionExclusionCode>
 <IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>1</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>
 <LowerBoundaryIdentifier>A*</LowerBoundaryIdentifier>
 </AccountID>
 </AccountOpenAmountsSelection>
 <ProcessingConditions>
 <QueryHitsMaximumNumberValue>100/QueryHitsMaximumNumberValue>
 <QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator>false</QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator>
 <LastReturnedObjectID></LastReturnedObjectID>
 </ProcessingConditions>
 </glob:AccountsOpenAmountsQueryRequest_sync>
 </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>
```

The web service interface 'Create Purchase Request Manually' offers the operations CheckMaintainBundle and MaintainBundle.

 </Description>

 <EndDate>2013-12-31</EndDate>
 <CurrencyCode>EUR</CurrencyCode>
 <SalesOrgID>MC42200</SalesOrgID>
 <DistributionChannelCode>01</DistributionChannelCode>
 <CustomerGroupCode>02</CustomerGroupCode>
 <PriceSpecification>
 <TypeCode>7PR1</TypeCode>
 <Amount currencyCode="EUR">200.00</Amount>
 <BaseQuantity unitCode="EA">1</BaseQuantity>
 <BaseQuantityTypeCode>EA</BaseQuantityTypeCode>

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_TIMX_WRKLIST_SYNC_ACTION_IN
apis.Title: Employee Worklist Action In
apis.ShortText: An interface for synchronizing the worklist
apis.Description:
The worklist of the timesheet shows the items that the employee will be working on, during any period of time. These items may be manually added by the employee, or be updated when there is a change in the project assignment of the employee.

This update of the worklist is currently a manual synchronization activity, which gets carried out only when the employee launches the timesheet. This becomes an issue when a customer wishes to use the worklist items for recording time via an external time recording application.

The service addresses exactly this problem – it can be called by the external application in order to update the worklist with any changes that could have come in as a result of changes in project assignment. The service can be called prior to querying the worklist for the existing set of items, this way an updated list will be sent to the application invoking the query on the worklist items.

The service may also be tied to a manual action on the external application, so that the user can call for a synchronization of the worklist items on demand.

The web service interface offers the operations SynchronizeWorklist

here is an example.
```
<n0:EmployeeWorklistSynchronizeActionRequest_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <BasicMessageHeader>
 <ID>Token 4</ID>
 <UUID>12345678-90AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF</UUID>
 <ReferenceID>Token 10</ReferenceID>
 <ReferenceUUID>12345678-90AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF</ReferenceUUID>
 </BasicMessageHeader>
 <EmployeeWorklist>
 <EmployeeUUID >12345678-90AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF</UUID>
 <EmployeeID>EmployeeID</EmployeeID>
 <ChangeStateID></ChangeStateID>
 </EmployeeWorklist>
 </n0:EmployeeWorklistSynchronizeActionRequest_sync>
```

apis.Title: Manage Direct Debit Mandate
apis.ShortText: An interface to manage the direct debit mandates of customers.
apis.Description:
The web service interface **Manage Direct Debit Mandate** offers the operations **MaintainBundle** and **CheckMaintainBundle**.

**MaintainBundle** will execute a save at the end of its process if no errors occur, where as **CheckMaintainBundle** will not persist the changes made.

The operation **MaintainBundle** allows you to adjust the following fields:

* DebtorIdentificationCode 
* Description 
* SingleUseIndicator 
* BlockedIndicator 
* MandateType 
* ValidityPeriod 
* SignatureDate 
* SignatureCity 
* AlternativePayer 

 

It also allows you to change the status of the mandate and to add attachments.

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_MANAGE_TRP_ACCOUNT_IN
apis.Title: Manage Trade Receivables Payables Accounts
apis.ShortText: An interface to manage the financial data of customer and supplier accounts master data
apis.Description:
The web service interface **Manage Trade Receivables Payables Account In** enables you to update the Financial Data of a supplier or customer account master data.

The Financial Data of an account can be used to denote if a business partner that has a supplier and customer account can be blocked for netting. It can also be used to put a block on dunning processes for said account. It can also be used to enable the doubtful debtors indicator or to specify the dunning procedure code.

The web service interface offers the operations **MaintainBundle** and **CheckMaintainBundle**, the latter of which does not execute a save.

If fields within the request message are maintained, then the update will be carried out according to these. If a field is left out, no update will be carried out for said field.

If the **DoubtfulDebtorIndicator** passed is true, then the parameter

**DunningBlockingReasonCode** needs to be provided. If the **DoubtfulDebtorIndicator** passed is true and the **DunningBlockingExpirationDate** is not provided, it will be defaulted to 9999.12.31

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_ANA_UPLOAD
apis.Title: Maintain Analytical Information
apis.ShortText: Inbound service interface to maintain analytical information in cloud data sources.
apis.Description:
The following section describes the structure of the service.

Service: /sap/bc/srt/scs/sap/analyticsdatauploadin

Example Structure
```
<(><<)>n0:AnalyticsDataUploadRequest
xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <BusinessDocumentBasicMessageHeader>
 <UUID>12345678-90AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF</UUID>
 <BusinessDocumentBasicMessageHeader>
 <AnalyticsDataUploadRequestContent>
 <MDAVName>PRODUCT</MDAVName>
 <AnalyticsImportMethod>MERGE</AnalyticsImportMethod>
 <Data>PROD_INT_ID; 
 SampleProduct;</Data>
 <AnalyticsDataUploadRequestContent>
</n0:AnalyticsDataUploadRequest>
```
 

The mandatory elements must be filled with the following information.

MDAVName: ID of the data source

AnalyticsImportMethod: MERGE or OVERWRITE or DELETE

•MERGE

Modifies existing data records (with same key) and inserts data records with new key.

•OVERWRITE

Deletes all existing data records and inserts new data records.

•DELETE

Deletes the existing data records.

Data:

The first line contains the field IDs to be loaded and defines the order. All other lines contain the data. Use semi-colons ( ; ) for value separation and carriage return for row separation.

Example

<DATA>

REGION;PRODUCT;KF1;

US;MC1000;9456;

DE;MC2000;1255;

DE;MC2200;3654;

</DATA>

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_MANAGE_LRCR_IN

apis.ShortText: An interface to create Labor Resource Cost Rates based on migration data.
apis.Description:
The **II_MANAGE_LRCR_IN** web service interface contains an operation that receives the data for Cost Centre, Job, Cost Rate, and so on, from the user, and creates labor resources based on the data.

SuccessFactors Workforce SCIM API provides a System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM) 2.0 REST API for managing resources (users and groups). Consumers of this REST API should be familiar with System for Cross-domain Identity Management Protocol before managing their own resources. Our API has a rate limit of 20 calls per second per user account. If a user makes more than 20 calls per second, then the API may not be able to respond in a timely manner and the service may be degraded or unavailable. For more information, see [RFC 7643](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc7644).

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_QUERY_BUPA_HIERARCHY_IN
apis.Title: Query Business Partner Hierarchy
apis.ShortText: An interface to query business partner hierarchy master data.
apis.Description:
The web service interface **Query Business Partner Hierarchy In** enables you to connect external applications to your solution and to query and read business partner hierarchies in your system. The web service interface **Query Business Partner Hierarchy In** is relevant if your company wants to access and manage business partner hierarchy data from external applications.

The web service interface **Query Business Partner Hierarchy In** offers the operation **Find By Identification**.

Here is an example of a simple web service request, which seeks for all business partner hierarchies with an ID matching "A*", returning at maximum 50 business partner hierarchy instances:
```
<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:glob="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <soapenv:Header/>
 <soapenv:Body>
 <glob:BusinessPartnerHierarchyByIdentificationQuery_sync>
 <BusinessPartnerHierarchySelectionByIdentification>
 <SelectionByID>
 <InclusionExclusionCode>I</InclusionExclusionCode>
 <IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>1</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>
 <LowerBoundaryHierarchyID>A*</LowerBoundaryHierarchyID>
 </SelectionByID>
 </BusinessPartnerHierarchySelectionByIdentification>
 <ProcessingConditions>
 <QueryHitsMaximumNumberValue>50</QueryHitsMaximumNumberValue>
 <QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator>false</QueryHitsUnlimitedIndicator>
 <LastReturnedObjectID></LastReturnedObjectID>
 </ProcessingConditions>
 </glob:BusinessPartnerHierarchyByIdentificationQuery_sync>
 </soapenv:Body>
</soapenv:Envelope>
```

apis.Name: sap-s4com-MeasurementDocument-v1
apis.Title: Measurement Document
apis.ShortText: Data Product Measurement Document
apis.Description:
A measurement document is a record that captures the performance or condition of equipment or functional locations for the purpose of condition-based maintenance in plant maintenance.

**Business Context**:

apis.Name: sap-s4com-MaintenanceOrderConfirmation-v1
apis.Title: Maintenance Order Confirmation
apis.ShortText: Data Product Maintenance Order Confirmation
apis.Description:
A maintenance order confirmation is a record that captures the processing status, progress of work, time spent, and used components of the operations of a maintenance order in plant maintenance.

**Business Context**: The data product potentially contains personal data that is intended to be used for planning asset maintenance activities.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-MeasuringPoint-v1
apis.Title: Measuring Point
apis.ShortText: Data Product Measuring Point
apis.Description:
A measuring point is a record that captures the physical and/or logical location at which a specified condition is measured in plant maintenance. Measuring points are assigned to technical objects.

**Business Context**:

apis.Name: sap-s4com-MaintenanceOrder-v1
apis.Title: Maintenance Order
apis.ShortText: Data Product Maintenance Order
apis.Description:
A maintenance order is an instruction to a work center to perform a maintenance activity on a maintenance object.

**Business Context**: The data product potentially contains personal data that is intended to be used for managing asset maintenance activities.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-MaintenanceNotification-v1
apis.Title: Maintenance Notification
apis.ShortText: Data Product Maintenance Notification
apis.Description:
A maintenance notification is a notification by which the maintenance department is informed about an abnormal or exceptional situation in technical objects in Plant Maintenance area. It records information related to maintenance such as malfunction details, malfunction date, time, breakdown, and so on.

**Business Context**: The data product potentially contains personal data that is intended to be used for managing the ownership and responsibility for asset maintenance.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-FunctionalLocation-v1
apis.Title: Functional Location
apis.ShortText: Data Product Functional Location
apis.Description:
A functional location is an organizational unit within Logistics that structures the maintenance objects of a company according to functional, process-related, or spatial criteria. A functional location represents the place at which a maintenance task is to be performed.
Typical examples of functional location are:

* Pumping station
* Hall
* Drive unit

**Business Context**: The data product potentially contains personal data that is intended to be used for establishing the ownership, responsibility, suppliers for a functional location in asset and service processes.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-MaintenancePlan-v1
apis.Title: Maintenance Plan
apis.ShortText: Data Product Maintenance Plan
apis.Description:
A maintenance plan is a description of the maintenance and inspection tasks to be performed for maintenance objects in Plant Maintenance. It contains the dates and scope of the tasks.


**Business Context**: The data product potentially contains personal data that is intended to be used for planning asset maintenance activities.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-MaintenanceTaskList-v1
apis.Title: Maintenance Task List
apis.ShortText: Data Product Maintenance Task List
apis.Description:
A maintenance task list is a sequence of individual maintenance activities which must be performed for a maintenance object in Plant Maintenance.

**Business Context**: The data product potentially contains personal data that is intended to be used for planning asset maintenance activities.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-Equipment-v1
apis.Title: Equipment
apis.ShortText: Data Product Equipment
apis.Description:
A piece of equipment is an individual physical object (machine, device, or tool) to be maintained as an autonomous unit.

**Business Context**: The data product potentially contains personal data that is intended to be used for establishing the ownership, responsibility, suppliers for an equipment in asset and service processes.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-MaintenanceMgmtConfignData-v1
apis.Title: Maintenance Management Configuration Data
apis.ShortText: Data Product Maintenance Management Configuration Data
apis.Description:
Maintenance Management Configuration Data is a collection of information which are configured by the customers and SAP defined code list values for the maintenance processes

**Business Context**:

Address Configuration Data with all the SOTs

apis.Name: sap-s4com-Address-v1

apis.Description:
An address provides the necessary details for locating and contacting an organization, person, or workplace, including the addressee's name, postal address, and communication information

**Business Context**: The data product contains address data that is potentially linked to a data subject and is used in business processes related to that person.

apis.Name: sap-s4pce-PRAWellCompletion-v1
apis.Title: Production Revenue Accounting Well Completion
apis.ShortText: Data Product Production Revenue Accounting Well Completion
apis.Description:
A production revenue accounting (PRA) well completion is a zone including one or more reservoirs of oil or natural gas that is prepared after drilling a well. This object stimulates commercial production in the wellbore through phases such as casing, cementing, and perforating, and multiple well completions may exist within a single wellbore.

**Business Context**: The data product provides master data information for the oil and gas producing zone, to which all related production, accounting and compliance reporting information is associated with, for the upstream oil and gas exploration business.
In addition, the data product contains personal data regarding business users that is intended to be used for administrative information.

apis.Name: sap-s4pce-PRARevenueAccountingDocument-v1
apis.Title: Production Revenue Accounting Revenue Accounting Document
apis.ShortText: Data Product Production Revenue Accounting Revenue Accounting Document
apis.Description:
A production revenue accounting (PRA) revenue accounting document is a record of a company code's financial transactions. The object covers line items that represent individual transactions posted to an account and information relevant for oil and gas accounting, such as owner, net or gross volume, disbursement decimal, tax, deduction, reimbursement, along with the net debit or credit amount, and updates transactions in financial ledgers of the accounts to which they were posted.

**Business Context**: The data product contains potential personal data intended to be used for providing the accounting information for the oil and gas delivery network for the associated working and royalty interest owners.

apis.Name: SBPA_Unified_API
apis.Title: Unified API
apis.ShortText: Processes discovery, management, execution and monitoring
apis.Description:
Unified APIs provide a set of APIs that allow an application to interface with SAP Build Process Automation through the entire lifecycle of processes, including discovery, management, execution, and monitoring in a consistent manner. There will still be operations that are offered through skill runtime-specific APIs, for example, changing the context of a workflow process.

Unified discovery provides insights into triggers available in SAP Build Process Automation. The API is split into several endpoints, one per trigger type. Each API endpoint provides discovery and start execution for a trigger instance. Note, that in the context of these runtime APIs, we always talk about trigger instances. The APIs work for trigger instances created during the deployment, as well as for those created post-deployment.

apis.Name: SPA_Workflow_Runtime
apis.Title: Workflow
apis.ShortText: Manage workflows and tasks in SAP Build Process Automation.
apis.Description:
This API uses the workflow capability of SAP Build Process Automation. With the API, you can, for example, start new workflow instances and work with tasks.

Note: These APIs are designed for loosely coupled clients. This means:

- If SAP Build Process Automation adds fields to responses, the API version number does not increase. Your client must ignore new fields.
- The order of fields in responses and of entries in arrays may change. This applies unless the API provides an explicit means to specify the desired order.

apis.Name: SPA_Workflow_Inbox
apis.Title: Inbox
apis.ShortText: Retrieve the workflow tasks assigned to the current user
apis.Description:
This API provides the functionality for building "own inbox" capabilities on top of SAP Build Process Automation.
It is based on the task consumption model (TCM) as documented in SAP Note [2304317](https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2304317/E).

Only users who have the ProcessAutomationParticipant role assigned are able to use the Inbox API.

SAP Build Process Automation currently supports only a subset of the Task Consumption Model capabilities. Only the functionality included in this document is available.

apis.Name: ReferenceService
apis.Title: Reference Service
apis.ShortText: Manage references in a project
apis.Description:
This API allows you to manage references between various business objects in SAP Project and Resource Management. All operations require the _User_ role and are executed in the context of the logged in user.

It also allows managing representation of objects in other applications which is referred to as 'Related Objects'.

Managing references between the below combination of business objects are supported:

  1. Issue, Task
  2. Issue, Document
  3. Task, Document
  4. Task, Task
  5. Issue, Document Link
  6. Task, Document Link
  7. Work Package, Task
  8. Work Package, Issue
  9. Related Object, Issue
  10. Related Object, Task
  11. Related Object, Document
  12. Related Object, Document Link
  13. Related Object, Digital Twin Object
  14. Issue, Digital Twin Object
  15. Task, Digital Twin Object
  16. Digital Twin Object, Document Link
  17. Project, Related Object
  18. Digital Twin, Related Object

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-WorkforceSkillsData-v1
apis.Title: Workforce Skills Data
apis.ShortText: Provides data about growth portfolio and workforce capability that can be used to assess workforce skills.
apis.Description: This data product enables you to perform comprehensive analysis and strategic planning. It consists of a fact table with dimensions and measures designed to evaluate workforce skills, to identify skill gaps and enhance employee capabilities and drive organizational growth.

apis.Name: WebAPI
apis.Title: Web API Interface for Exchanging EDI Energy Web API Messages
apis.ShortText: Generic Web API interface for exchanging EDI Energy Web API messages between an external service provider and SAP Market Communication for Utilities (MACO)
apis.Description:
Generic Web API interface for exchanging EDI@Energy Web API messages between an external service provider and SAP Market Communication for Utilities (MACO).

- Currently supported EDI@Energy Web APIs: 
  - [EDI@Energy API-Webdienste zur Ermittlung der MaLo-ID der Marktlokation](https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis-docs/edi-energy/MaLoIdent_2024-07-03/v1.0.0)

- Currently not supported EDI@Energy Web APIs: 
  - [EDI@Energy API-Webdienste zur prozessualen Abwicklung von Steuerungshandlungen in Verbindung mit intelligenten Messsystemen (iMS) - Universalbestellprozess](https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis-docs/edi-energy/Steuerungshandlung_2023-10-24/1.0.0)

The external Web API service provider is responsible for the following.
- Directory service handling:
  - [Verzeichnisdienst Web-API](https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis/edi_energy/Verzeichnisdienst_Web-API_2024_10_01/1.0.0)
  - [Verzeichnisdienst WebSocket-API](https://app.swaggerhub.com/apis/edi_energy/verzeichnisdienst_websocket-api_2024_10_01/1.0.0)
- TLS encryption and digital signing using SM-PKI keys in the communication to market partners

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-CareerDevelopmentLearningData-v1
apis.Title: Career Development Learning Data
apis.ShortText: Provides data that facilitates analysis of development and career goals with learning data through metrics like Number of Learning Activities and Time Open for learning activities.
apis.Description: This data product lets you analyze the available measures across dimensions like Learning Activity Type, Learning Activity Status, and Learning Count. It provides targeted insights about learning progress and engagement within the development goals.

apis.Name: AS4
apis.Title: Integration with AS4 Service Providers
apis.ShortText: Enables you to define an integration interface for sending or receiving messages with SAP Market Communication for Utilities using the AS4 (protocol of Applicability Statement 4).
apis.Description: Lets you define the connection details for integrating AS4 service providers for the market message transfer

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-DataProductConfig-v1
apis.Title: HCMDataConfiguration
apis.ShortText: Provides information about the configuration saved using the Manage Analytics Data Product admin tool.
apis.Description: This data product includes settings that have been updated through the "Manage Analytics Data Product" admin tool. It has been developed solely for technical purposes and is not required for any data modelling usage.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-GoalRating-v1
apis.Title: Goal Rating
apis.ShortText: Provides data about the global performance goal ratings, categorized as Exceeded, Achieved, and Not Achieved.
apis.Description: This data product is the main source for the overall ratings of performance goals. It uses custom mapping logic to standardize various local ratings into these global values, which facilitates clear comparison and reporting of performance outcomes.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-ApplicationStatus-v1
apis.Title: Application Status
apis.ShortText: Provides data about application status and recruiting status.
apis.Description: This data product has been modelled as a dimension. It enables flexible analysis across key recruiting measures such as Applicants, Total Applications, EOP Applications, Application Events, Applications for Closed Requisitions, Interviewed Applicants, and both internal and external hires. By incorporating this dimension, you can gain deeper insights into the recruitment process and application lifecycle.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-GoalsData-v1
apis.Title: Goals Data
apis.ShortText: Provides data about the performance goals of all employees, including goal status, completion rates, ratings, and goal achievement levels (achieved, not achieved, and exceeded).
apis.Description: This data product supports thorough analysis of employee goals, providing insights into goal metrics across various dimensions including alignment path, creator, rating type, goal plan, status, type, category, and due date. Using this data product, you can enhance your organization's goal-setting processes and improve goal achievement across the workforce.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-PerformanceData-v1
apis.Title: Performance Data
apis.ShortText: Provides data about the performance of employees in an organization for detailed appraisal analytics.
apis.Description: This data product facilitates employee performance analysis by providing metrics such as the number of employees reviewed or not reviewed, the overall performance ratings, the skill-based performance, and the year-over-year review differences. You can further analyze these insights using dimensions like performance rating, previous review rating, review difference, performance form template, and performance form status.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-LearningEventHistory-v1
apis.Title: Data Product for Learning Event History
apis.ShortText: Provides comprehensive insights into employee training and development in your organization.
apis.Description: This data product allows you to track measures such as Number of Employees Trained, Learning Events, Continuing Professional Education Hours, and Training Hours. You can analyze these metrics across multiple dimensions, including course, course type, course category, and delivery method.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-LocationHierarchy-v1
apis.Title: Location Hierarchy
apis.ShortText: Provides data about Country, State, City, and Corporate Address in a hierarchical sequence.
apis.Description: This data product offers location data with latitude and longitude details that can help create insightful Geo Maps in SAP Analytics Cloud. It enables hierarchical analysis of location data and supports geographical mapping.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-GoalStatus-v1
apis.Title: Goal Status
apis.ShortText: Provides data about the status of all the goals in your organization.
apis.Description: This data product lets you analyze measures based on goal status. It organizes goals into categories like On Track, At Risk, Behind, Not Started, Postponed, Cancelled, Unclear, and Completed. Custom mapping is used to convert different local ratings into these standard categories, making it easier to track performance and progress across various goal states.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-CareerDevelopmentPlanningData-v1
apis.Title: Career Development Planning Data
apis.ShortText: Provides data about development and career goals, including metrics like goal count, due goals, expected time to complete goals, and employees with and without development goals.
apis.Description: This data product facilitates analysis of career development planning across dimensions such as Goal Privacy Type, Development Goal Purpose, and Goal Status. It supports comprehensive tracking and management of employee development initiatives.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-DaystoFill-v1
apis.Title: DaystoFill
apis.ShortText: Provides event-based data with one record per requisition recorded against the fill date, and one record per requisition recorded against the hire date.
apis.Description: This data product tracks the number of calendar days from when a hiring requisition is raised until a successful applicant accepts the job offer and starts work, segmented by key dimensions such as status, recruiter, and location. It enables businesses to pinpoint delays in the hiring process and optimize recruitment workflows. Monitoring these timelines helps reduce vacancies and speed up onboarding.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-OrganizationalUnitHierarchy-v1
apis.Title: Organizational Unit Hierarchy
apis.ShortText: Provides data about business units, divisions, and departments such that it reflects the organizational structure.
apis.Description: This data product offers a hierarchical breakdown of organizational units for structured data analysis.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-HighPotentialEmployee-v1
apis.Title: High Potential Employee
apis.ShortText: Provides data that facilitates the analysis of succession management measures across the high potential pool.
apis.Description: This data product uses custom mapping logic to map source ratings into standardized high potential categories such as High Potential and Not a High Potential. It helps with targeted talent development and succession planning initiatives.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-SuccessionData-v1
apis.Title: Succession Data
apis.ShortText: Provides data that supports succession management analysis by providing key metrics such as Number of Nominations, Successors, Succession Positions, and Incumbents.
apis.Description: This data product lets users to analyse data using critical dimensions like High Potential, Successor, Succession Readiness, Highest Succession Readiness, Critical Position, Critical Person, Talent Pool, Bench Strength, Risk of Loss, Impact of Loss, and Future Leader. This facilitates comprehensive insights into talent pipelines and succession strategies within the organization.

apis.Description: Data Archiving Service of Market Messages enables you to archive market messages for future reference or analysis purposes when API archiving configuration is selected. The data will be archived on the message level. You can set up the archives flexibly where and how you want.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-Requisition-v1

apis.ShortText: Provides time-based data for requisitions. Each requisition has records valid from when the requisition is opened to when it is closed.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-CrossWorkforceData-v1
apis.Title: Data Product for Cross Workforce Data
apis.ShortText: A unified, cross-domain data product combining key metrics from Core Workforce, Skills, Learning, Performance, Goals etc., to provide holistic employee analytics.
apis.Description:
The Integrated Workforce Insights Data Product enables comprehensive analysis across SuccessFactors modules by bringing together data from Core Workforce, Skills, Learning, Performance, Goals etc., enabling HR analysts and business stakeholders to generate meaningful insights into employee development, productivity, and engagement.
By correlating performance metrics with learning progress, goal achievement, skills development, and workforce demographics, this data product supports strategic initiatives such as talent management, succession planning, and workforce optimization.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-timemanagement-Absence-v1
apis.Title: Absence Request
apis.ShortText: This data product provides information about the types of employee absence and its occurrences.
apis.Description: The Absence Data Product provides information about an employee’s absences. This includes the absence request itself, which is a record of an absence occurrence for an employee. It has attributes such as start date and end date, start time and end time, approval status, and various quantities like quantity in days, hours, or weeks. The data product also includes the absence type, which is a logical grouping of absence requests. It is used to specify the group characteristics, for example, whether an absence request represents a vacation or sick leave. It also restricts the allowed values for attributes of the absence request.

apis.Name: sap-s4pce-FundedProgram-v1
apis.Title: Funded Program
apis.ShortText: Data Product Funded Program
apis.Description: A funded program is an account assignment object for operational programs with a defined time frame within a public organization. A funded program can range from simple activities to complex projects and can cross organization’s fiscal years, funding sources, and organizational units. Funded programs enable the record of budget, control of postings, and monitor the performance of internal projects.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-Segment-v1
apis.Title: Segment
apis.ShortText: Data Product Segment
apis.Description: Division of a company for which you can create financial statements for external reporting.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-CostCenterActivityType-v1
apis.Title: Cost Center Activity Type
apis.ShortText: Data Product Cost Center Activity Type
apis.Description:
A cost center activity type is a unit in a controlling area that classifies the activities performed in a cost center.

Activities are measured and recorded in units, such as machine hours, consulting hours, or units produced.

You can assign cost center activity types to one or multiple cost centers.

The allocation of the activities performed and price calculation are based on the respective cost rate ('*AccountingCostRate*') settings.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-EntryViewJournalEntry-v1
apis.Title: Entry View Journal Entry
apis.ShortText: Data Product Entry View Journal Entry
apis.Description: A journal entry in the entry view is a record in the accounting subledger. It is processed by accounting and represents an individual transaction posted to an account.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-FunctionalArea-v1
apis.Title: Functional Area
apis.ShortText: Data Product Functional Area
apis.Description: A functional area is an account assignment object that is used to map the functional structure (such as public safety, town planning and so on), and specifically the expenditures of an organization (FM area). A functional area describes how the funds are used.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-JournalEntryHeader-v1
apis.Title: Journal Entry Header
apis.ShortText: Data Product Journal Entry Header
apis.Description: A  journal entry is an accounting record for a business transaction, showing the accounts to be debited and credited and a description of the transaction.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-ControllingArea-v1
apis.Title: Controlling Area
apis.ShortText: Data Product Controlling Area
apis.Description: A Controlling Area is an organizational unit within a company, used to represent a closed system for cost accounting purposes

apis.Name: sap-s4com-OperatingConcern-v1
apis.Title: Operating Concern
apis.ShortText: Data Product Operating Concern
apis.Description: An operating concern is a unit within a company for which separate financial statements and profitability analysis can be performed. It enables the tracking and analysis of the profitability of different business segments, products, or customers.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-CostCenter-v1
apis.Title: Cost Center
apis.ShortText: Data Product Cost Center
apis.Description:
A cost center is an organizational unit that represents the location where costs are incurred.

Cost centers are used for the assignment of overhead costs to organizational activities based on the utilization of the relevant areas, as well as for differentiated management of costs arising in your organization.

Each cost center is assigned a category, depending on its type, such as Marketing (*9*), Production (*F*), Development (*E*), and other types.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-FiscalYear-v1
apis.Title: Fiscal Year
apis.ShortText: Data Product Fiscal Year
apis.Description:
A fiscal year is a time period (usually 12 months) for which a company creates its financial statements. The fiscal year can match the calendar year or can be different from the calendar year.

**Business Context**:

apis.Name: sap-s4com-CompanyCode-v1
apis.Title: Company Code
apis.ShortText: Data Product Company Code
apis.Description: A company code is the smallest organizational unit of external accounting for which a complete, self-contained set of accounts can be created.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-CostOriginGroup-v1
apis.Title: Cost Origin Group
apis.ShortText: Data Product Cost Origin Group
apis.Description:
A Cost Origin Group is an organizational unit, and a grouping mechanism, used to subdivide costs. It breaks down material and overhead costs into subdivisions within a general ledger account. When calculating material and overhead costs, they are assigned to a general ledger account. The combination of the origin group and general ledger account helps define calculation bases for determining overhead rates for specific material groups. It also defines cost components in product costing for particular material groups, and creates rules for activating work in process for each material group.
The following are possible values: 
01: Open
02: Released

apis.Name: sap-s4com-BusinessArea-v1
apis.Title: Business Area
apis.ShortText: Data Product Business Area
apis.Description:
Organizational unit of external accounting that corresponds to a specific business segment or area of responsibility in a company. Movements in value entered in Financial Accounting are assigned to business areas.

**Business Context**:

apis.Name: sap-s4com-SalesTaxCode-v1
apis.Title: Sales Tax Code
apis.ShortText: Data Product Sales Tax Code
apis.Description:
The Sales Tax Code is a coded representation on sales taxes to be considered for tax reporting to the tax authorities.
Tax codes are unique per country.
Typical examples for Sales Tax - Germany are:
A1: 19% output tax
A5: EC country taxable/tax-exempt output tax
E1: 19% acquisition tax on EC delivery of goods

apis.Name: sap-s4com-JournalEntryItemCodes-v1
apis.Title: Journal Entry Item Codes
apis.ShortText: Data Product Journal Entry Item Codes
apis.Description:
JournalEntryItemCodes is a collection of information configured by customers, as well as SAP-defined code list values for journal entry item.

**Business Context**:

apis.Name: sap-s4com-ProfitCenter-v1
apis.Title: Profit Center
apis.ShortText: Data Product Profit Center
apis.Description:
A profit center is an organizational unit in accounting that reflects a management-oriented structure of the organization for the purpose of internal control.

This organizational unit represents an area of a company for which a separate period-based profit is determined and used for profit-oriented analysis and management of the area´s activities.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-CostAnalysisResource-v1
apis.Title: Cost Analysis Resource
apis.ShortText: Data Product Cost Analysis Resource
apis.Description: A cost analysis resource is a categorization of internally and externally supplied goods and services for the purposes of cost analysis

apis.Name: sap-s4com-TaxJurisdiction-v1
apis.Title: Tax Jurisdiction
apis.ShortText: Data Product Tax Jurisdiction
apis.Description: A tax jurisdiction is a coded representation identifying the the locality for determining the tax rates in the USA. It defines to which tax authorities you must pay your taxes. It is always the city to which the goods are supplied.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-GeneralLedgerAccount-v1
apis.Title: General Ledger Account
apis.ShortText: Data Product General Ledger Account
apis.Description:
A general ledger account represents G/L Account Master Data in the Chart of Accounts area which contain information about the G/L account that are valid for all company codes. The chart of accounts area also contains data that control how a G/L account is created in the company code-specific area.

Examples:
(1) Information if the G/L Account is a Profit&Loss Account
(2) Description of the G/L Account

**Business Context**: General Ledger Account is concerned with processing and reporting all postings relevant to external financial accounting. Due to the nature of the Universal Journal, the process also includes elements of internal accounting (Controlling).
As part of these activities, General Ledger Account line items are processed, which potentially contains personal data.
The DP is intended to be used for financial accounting, ensuring accurate, auditable, and compliant financial reporting.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-FinancialPlanningEntryItem-v1
apis.Title: Financial Planning Entry Item
apis.ShortText: Data Product Financial Planning Entry Item
apis.Description:
A Financial Planning Entry Item is a record of financial plan data that relates to a company, a fiscal year, a GL account and potentially many other dimensions like cost center, product, customer etc.

**Business Context**:

apis.Name: sap-s4pce-FundsCenter-v1
apis.Title: Funds Center
apis.ShortText: Data Product Funds Center
apis.Description: A funds center is an account assignment object to represent the structural grouping into departments, areas of responsibility, projects, and so on.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-BillableControl-v1
apis.Title: Billable Control
apis.ShortText: Data Product Billable Control
apis.Description: The billable control code defines whether costs are billed and how they are processed in Accounting for Time and Material Billing and Revenue Recognition.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-SalesTaxType-v1
apis.Title: Sales Tax Type
apis.ShortText: Data Product Sales Tax Type
apis.Description: A Sales Tax Type is a coded representation defining whether a sales tax is input tax or output tax. Possible values are A = Output Tax, V = Input Tax.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-ControllingObject-v1
apis.Title: Controlling Object

apis.Name: sap-s4pce-CommitmentItem-v1
apis.Title: Commitment Item

apis.Description: A commitment item is an account assignment object in Funds Management. A commitment item is used to represent the functional grouping of expenditures or revenues, within a financial management area (FM area).

apis.Name: sap-s4com-US_TaxSourcing-v1
apis.Title: USA _ Tax Sourcing
apis.ShortText: Data Product USA _ Tax Sourcing
apis.Description:
A tax sourcing is a coded representation that specifies whether tax is determined based on origin (origin-based) or on destination (destination-based).

**Business Context**:

apis.Name: sap-s4com-Ledger-v1
apis.Title: Ledger
apis.ShortText: Data Product Ledger
apis.Description: A ledger is a central collection of accounting data for accounting and reporting purposes that contains the journal entries for business transactions. Multiple ledgers can be used in parallel, for example, to enable closing in accordance with different accounting principles.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-StatisticalKeyFigure-v1
apis.Title: Statistical KeyFigure
apis.ShortText: Data Product Statistical KeyFigure
apis.Description:
A statistical key figure is a number that provides information about non-monetary data relating to organizational units. 
This object can be used to track measurable characteristics of organizational units, such as cost centers and profit centers, in addition to monetary data from accounting.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-InternalOrder-v1
apis.Title: Internal Order
apis.ShortText: Data Product Internal Order
apis.Description: An instrument to collect and monitor costs and, in some instances, the revenues of an organizational unit.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-CostingValuationVariant-v1
apis.Title: Costing Valuation Variant
apis.ShortText: Data Product Costing Valuation Variant
apis.Description:
A costing valuation variant is as an organizational unit that defines the prices selected to value materials, internal activities, subcontracting, and external processing within a product cost estimate's quantity structure. It also specifies which costing sheets calculate the overhead. Different valuation strategies are stored as strategy sequences with assigned priorities.
The following are possible values:
01: Open
02: Released

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-onboarding-Process-v1

apis.ShortText: Provides data about Onboarding and Offboarding processes.
apis.Description: This data product provides information about the onboarding process of different user groups such as new hires, internal hires, international hires, and rehires. It also includes details about their hiring, external new hire to employee conversion, onboarding cancellation (no-shows), offboarding and so on.

apis.Description:
The Business Partner Service APIs are served to enable users to perform read operations over Business Partner entities.

 Note: To use these APIs, you need to obtain OAuth2 credentials (client ID and secret) for each request using a Service Broker in the same SAP BTP Subaccount in which you have instanced the application.

apis.Title: Cropping System Service
apis.ShortText: Maintain Cropping System cluster
apis.Description: You can use this service to maintain cropping systems, cropping system elements, and cropping system types.

apis.Name: SIA_CropAndVariety
apis.Title: Crop and Variety Service
apis.ShortText: Maintain Crops and Varieties.
apis.Description: The Crop and Variety Service APIs are served to enable the maintenance of Crops and Varieties. Note: To use this API, you need a user and password which must be assigned to the corresponding technical role. For more information, please refer to the business documentation.

apis.Name: SIA_RecommendationV2
apis.Title: Recommendation Service
apis.ShortText: Maintain Recommendations and Recommended Tasks.
apis.Description: The Recommendation Service API allows users to manage Recommendations and Recommended Tasks, including creating, retrieving, modifying and deleting them. It also supports actions like copying and adjusting recommendations before approval. Recommendations have statuses like Open, Approved, or Rejected, controlling the actions users can take. The API enforces validation rules for creating recommendations, such as requiring a valid farm identifier and ensuring dates are in the future. Optional fields like field and crop zone can also be specified. These rules help ensure recommendations are accurate and actionable.

apis.Description:
