apis.Name: SIA_Perennials
apis.Title: Perennials Service
apis.ShortText: Maintain Perennials and retrieve Crop, Variety, Area, Field, Farm, and Crop Zones related to these entities.
apis.Description: Perennials are multi-year crops, i.e. plants that have a life span of more than one year. Those plants and the fields and areas they are cultivated on shall also be captured with the platform. </br>

apis.Name: SIA_Task
apis.Title: Task Service
apis.ShortText: Maintain Tasks and Task Types.
apis.Description:
The Task Service API enables comprehensive management of Tasks, Task Types, and Task Records. Tasks and Task Types define the structure and categorization of tasks, while Task Records represent the actual execution of a task. The API supports creating, retrieving, modifying, deleting, and copying Task, allowing users to easily track and manage task execution.

Additionally, the API provides localization capabilities, enabling retrieval of localized task data based on the request's locale.

To use these APIs, OAuth2 credentials (client ID and secret) are required, which can be obtained via a Service Broker within the same SAP BTP Subaccount where the application instance is hosted.

apis.Name: CorporateAPI
apis.Title: Corporate Gateway
apis.ShortText: The Corporate Gateway allows corporate customers to exchange messages with SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity

apis.Name: Calendar_API
apis.Title: Calendar Service
apis.ShortText: Allows you to work with calendar events in SAP Analytics Cloud
apis.Description: The Calendar Service is an open API that allows you to interact with calendar events in SAP Analytics Cloud. The APIs are available from SAP Analytics Cloud version 2023.25.

apis.Name: INFERENCE_OBSERVABILITY_API
apis.Title: Inference Observability
apis.ShortText: The Inference Observability API provides endpoints for managing inference data, feedback, labels, and deletion requests.
apis.Description: The Inference Observability API can be used to manage inference records that are stored by the inference observability service. The records can be created by adding suitable headers to the orchestration service or llm access service inference requests. You can add additional feedback to these records, add labels for better identification, and retrieve the records for further processing such as in optimization and evaluation of the model performance.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-recruiting-Interview-v1
apis.Title: Interview - Data Insights
apis.ShortText: Interview data gives HR insights on assessments and scheduling, with continuous updates ensuring an up-to-date view for better decisions.
apis.Description: Interview data offers valuable insights for HR and business operations. Recruiting delivers the following primary data products:  Interview Assessments: Includes feedback, ratings, comments, and other evaluation details. Interview Slots: Captures scheduled times, interviewer and candidate information, and status updates. We ingest both historical and ongoing interview assessment and slot data from Recruiting into our BDC. This process ensures a comprehensive and up-to-date view of interview activities and performance, supporting informed decision-making and continuous improvement across HR functions

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-recruiting-RecruitingConfiguration-v1
apis.Title: Recruiting Configuration Data
apis.ShortText: Provides configuration and reference data for Recruiting, including labels and values for key enums used across recruiting processes
apis.Description: The Recruiting Configuration data product delivers a comprehensive set of reference labels and configuration values that define standard enumerations used in SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-recruiting-Candidate-v1
apis.Title: Candidate
apis.ShortText: This data product provides information about the candidate entity details.
apis.Description: This data product provides information about the candidate details including the Profile Information,Contact Details, Background elements, Skills, Tags, Referral Info, any any comments

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-recruiting-Offer-v1
apis.Title: Offer - Analytics and Trends
apis.ShortText: Offer data helps HR track offer details, negotiations, and approvals, while metrics like acceptance rate and time to offer drive recruiting effectiveness.
apis.Description: Offer data provides key insights for HR and business decision-making. Recruiting delivers core offer details, compensation, negotiation history, approvals, and custom fields as primary data products. Additional metrics—such as offer acceptance rate, rejection reasons, approval workflow bottlenecks, and time to offer—help assess offer competitiveness and recruiting efficiency.

apis.Name: ComplianceControlManageServiceV1
apis.Title: GRC Compliance Control Manage Service
apis.ShortText: OData interface to create and update GRC compliance controls
apis.Description: This OData V4 service provides write access to compliance data in the GRC Control service. Use it to create controls through the public API.

apis.Name: SAPEmarsysProductCatalog
apis.Title: SAP Emarsys Product Catalog
apis.ShortText: Manage product catalog items with localized information and availability.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-LearningClasses-v1
apis.Title: Learning Classes
apis.ShortText: Provides data about scheduled instances of courses, including start and end times, and associated resources such as instructors and classrooms.
apis.Description: This data product includes measures like number of instructors, scheduled courses, available seats, and class cancellations.  Use cases for this data product include evaluating class capacity utilization, identifying scheduling bottlenecks, and optimizing instructor and resource deployment for improved training experiences.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-ProgramAssignments-v1
apis.Title: Program Assignments
apis.ShortText: Tracks learning program assignments to users or groups, helping analyze program distribution, engagement, and coverage.
apis.Description: This fact table records the assignment of learning programs, which are collections of related learning items, to users or groups. Measures include the number of programs assigned, total program assignments, and related item assignments. It enables analysis of program distribution, engagement levels, and program coverage.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-CurriculumItemAssignment-v1
apis.Title: Curriculum Item Assignment
apis.ShortText: Provides data about curriculum assignment based on specific learning items.
apis.Description: This data product details the assignment of specific learning items, such as courses or programs, within a curriculum to users or groups. It provides measures like the number of curricula-related item assignments, and it helps tailoring learning plans based on item engagement.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-RecruitmentOfferData-v1
apis.Title: Recruitment Offer Data
apis.ShortText: Provides comprehensive data about job offers, including the total number of offers made, accepted, and declined within a specified reporting period.
apis.Description: This data product helps you derive detailed insights about the offer process, the candidate sourcing, and the current status of the offers made. You can use this data product to analyze offer acceptance rates and sourcing effectiveness, and to support strategic recruitment decision-making.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-OnboardingTaskData-v1
apis.Title: Onboarding Task Data
apis.ShortText: Provides data about all the individual tasks related to the onboarding and the offboarding events.
apis.Description: This data product tracks whether the Onboarding and the Offboarding tasks are initiated, completed, or open. It measures the total time taken to complete each task. The data product provides granular visibility into task performance, delays, and the overall task completion timeline. These measures help you monitor task efficiency, identify bottlenecks, and improve the overall onboarding and offboarding experiences for employees and alumni.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-DaysBetweenApplicationStatusesData-v1
apis.Title: Days Between Application Statuses Data
apis.ShortText: Provides data about durations between key stages in the applicant lifecycle.
apis.Description: This data products helps track the number of days between application submission to interview or offer, by calculating the number of days between custom, configurable dates or statues. Additionally, it includes specific measures like time to interview scheduling, time to interview and time to offer that can help your organization optimize hiring workflows and reduce cycle times.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-AbsenceTypeAndCategory-v1
apis.Title: Absence Type And Category
apis.ShortText: Provides data about predefined absence codes for various types of employee absences and captures custom absence categories for organization-specific or unforeseen absence reasons.
apis.Description: This data product serves as a centralized reference for absence classifications within the organization. Each record in the table captures details such as the absence code, description, and category type, facilitating consistent categorization and easy reporting. The flexible design of this data product supports standardization and enables customization to meet unique organizational needs.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-CurriculumAssignments-v1
apis.Title: Curriculum Assignments
apis.ShortText: Provides data about the curricula assignments to users and-or user groups.
apis.Description: This data product has a table that records the assignment of curricula to users or user groups, capturing the way the learning pathways are distributed within an organization. It supports measures like the total number of curricula assigned and the count of assignment events. Use cases for this data product include tracking curriculum and assessing the coverage of training programs.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-CourseAssignments-v1
apis.Title: Course Assignments
apis.ShortText: The CourseAssignment fact table tracks course assignments, completions, overdue tasks, and mandatory trainings, helping monitor learning progress, compliance, and training gaps.
apis.Description: The CourseAssignment fact table provides information on the distribution of learning courses to users or groups, including measures like total course assignments, overdue tasks, completion status, and mandatory designations. It supports monitoring course delivery, identifying overdue or pending courses, and evaluating compliance with mandatory training requirements. Use cases involve managing mandatory trainings, improving course completion rates, and identifying learning gaps to enhance overall training effectiveness.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-RecruitmentInterviewData-v1
apis.Title: Recruitment Interview Data
apis.ShortText: Provides data about interview activities, including the total number of scheduled interviews.
apis.Description: This data product includes metrics on the total number scheduled interviews. It supports the assessment of interview processes.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-OnboardingProcessData-v1
apis.Title: Onboarding Process Data
apis.ShortText: Provides a comprehensive overview of all onboarding and offboarding processes within the organization.
apis.Description: This data product tracks key metrics such as the initiation and completion of onboarding and offboarding processes, the number of processes open at any given time, and the total duration taken for each process. It captures detailed attributes including onboarding status, type of onboardee, onboarding source, and reasons for onboarding cancellations. These insights support analysis of process efficiency, source effectiveness, and cancellation reasons, enabling HR teams to optimize onboarding and offboarding workflows

apis.Name: DocumentAPI
apis.Title: Document API
apis.ShortText: Documents provide additional details with various forms such as design, instructions, logos and images
apis.Description: This API allows you to manage documents and assign/unassign documents to other objects such as models, announcements, equipment, locations, systems, etc. The API allows you to edit attributes of multiple documents centrally so that the changes apply to all associated business objects.

apis.Name: sap-bdc-sf-analytics-LearningEnrollment-v1
apis.Title: Learning Enrollment
apis.ShortText: Provides data about user participation in scheduled training classes, capturing enrolment and withdrawal activities.
apis.Description: This data product helps you track user participation in scheduled training classes. Key measures include registration counts, waitlisted registrations, and cancellations. It supports analysis of enrolment patterns, class popularity, and participation rates. Use cases for this data product include enhancing registration processes and improving scheduling to increase learner engagement and to reduce dropout rates.

apis.Name: WorkOrdersAPI
apis.Title: Work Orders API
apis.ShortText: A work order facilitates maintenance and service of associated equipment.
apis.Description: The Work Orders API enables creation, retrieval, update, and management of work orders used for maintenance of equipment and related assets. It supports tracking the full lifecycle of maintenance activities from initiation to completion, ensuring efficient service operations and asset management.

apis.Name: CompanyProfileAPI
apis.Title: Company Profile
apis.ShortText: This provides organization details, its locations, invitees, and subsidiaries
apis.Description: Company profile allows you to get information about a company, its locations, invitees, and subsidiaries. This API also allows you to perform the following methods on the user of an organization: Create, Update, Get, and Inactivate.

apis.Name: FunctionAPI
apis.Title: Functions API
apis.ShortText: Functions are used to define the functionalities of the assigned objects and to describe how they are intended to operate
apis.Description: You use this feature to define specifications on how the assigned objects are intended to operate.

apis.Name: ModelAPI
apis.Title: Model
apis.ShortText: A model is an abstract representation that defines all maintenance and specification information related to a product
apis.Description: A model is an abstract representation from the manufacturer that defines all maintenance and specification information related to a new or existing product. A physical equipment is an instance of a model. A model is based on a template and allows users to add values to the definitions used in the underlying template.

apis.ShortText: A failure mode is a probable failure that could occur to piece of equipment
apis.Description: A failure mode is the manner in which the item or operation potentially fails to meet or deliver the intended function and associated requirements.

apis.ShortText: Enables to manage composition of equipment whom having function to perform
apis.Description:
Enable you to manage a composition of equipment together which have a certain function to perform.
System Topology enables you to create Industrial network topology, defining ports and interfaces and connections between them
Purpose The purpose of these APIs is to configure equipment with ports and interfaces and create connections between the ports of equipment.

apis.ShortText: Customize sales within the Infusionsoft suite

apis.Name: NetworkAuthorizationAPI
apis.Title: Network Authorization API
apis.ShortText: Network authorization provides business partners access to business objects
apis.Description: Network authorization allows creation of authorization groups for business partners and provides them with access to business objects. You can grant permissions such as read or write access to business objects within the group.

apis.Name: TemplateAPI
apis.Title: Template API
apis.ShortText: A template is a format created by SAP Business Network Asset Collaboration to maintain metadata
apis.Description: A template is a format created by SAP Business Network Asset Collaboration (for example, manufacturer, operator, or service provider) to maintain metadata, that is, attributes and attribute groups, related to a model, equipment, location, system, spare part, functional location or document. A template inherits metadata from its parent objects, for example, parent subclass templates or other parent templates, and can have additional attribute groups and attributes.

apis.Name: ManageAnnouncementsAPI
apis.Title: Announcement API
apis.ShortText: An announcement is a communication from equipment manufactures to equipment owners and operators
apis.Description: We can perform various operations on an announcement such as creating an announcement, viewing an announcement, updating an announcement, deleting an announcement, and assigning documents, models, items of equipment and locations (of type Availability) to an announcement.

apis.Name: ImprovementRequestAPI
apis.Title: Improvement Request API
apis.ShortText: Improvement request triggers a workflow  to get equipment process and maintenance related recommendations
apis.Description: While using a piece of equipment, you could face issues with regard to its process or maintenance. To get suggestions or a solution, you can create an improvement request. By creating this request, you involve the relevant stakeholders who can collaborate and provide you with a suggestion or even a solution. If stakeholders within your organization can resolve your request, create an internal improvement request. If you want to involve stakeholders outside your organization, create an external improvement request.

apis.Name: SparePartsAPI
apis.Title: Spare Parts API
apis.ShortText: The Spare parts are additional components in inventory that can be used when needed.
apis.Description: Spare parts are components that are kept in your inventory as spare. Typically, these components are not fitted into your item of equipment, but can be fitted into the item of equipment when needed.
apis.ChangeLog: [{"date":"2024-11-24","notes":"Spare part APIs are deprecated. Model APIs to be used after spare part and model merge.","state":"Deprecated","version":"1.0"}]

apis.Name: CALM_SR
apis.Title: SAP Cloud ALM Service Request API
apis.ShortText: Service request management in the SAP Support Backbone.
apis.Description:
The **SAP Cloud ALM Service Request API** enables customers and partners to access and manage service requests within the SAP Support Backbone. 
As an extension of the **SAP Cloud ALM ITSM API**, this service focuses specifically on the fulfillment of technical service requests and catalog items, complementing the incident management capabilities of ITSM.

This API provides a unified, programmatic entry point to SAP's support backend. It allows you to retrieve Service Requests independently of where they were originally created, whether via SAP for Me, SAP Solution Manager, or other built-in support channels.

*Please note: The current release of this API provides read-only access to service request data. Capabilities to create or update service requests are planned for future releases.*

apis.Name: Monitoring_API
apis.Title: Monitoring Export Service
apis.ShortText: Allows you to export monitoring data for models in CSV format.
apis.Description:
The Monitoring Export Service is an open API that enables the export of various monitoring views from SAP Analytics Cloud.
 We provide performance and system model data, with similar parameters to the activities endpoint. The export logic supports following views:ERROR_LOG,LICENSE,CONCURRENT_LICENSE,RESOURCE,RESOURCE_RECENT_ACCESS,SAC_USERS,USER_ADOPTION,LIVE_USERS,SESSION,SAC_STATISTICS_MDS_QUERY_PERF,SAC_PERFORMANCE_E2E,DM_SCHEDULE,VERSION_STATISTICS_VIEW,PLANNING_DATA_ACTIONS.
In order to retrieve data, you can use the following GET calls:

/api/v1/monitoring
/api/v1/monitoring/performance
The first call is for system models, the second call is for performance models.

You can use either call to retrieve data.

The following view names can also be added to the URL:
error(s) - ERROR_LOG
license(s) - LICENSE
license(s)Concurrent - CONCURRENT_LICENSE
resource(s) - RESOURCE
resource(s)RecentAccess - RESOURCE_RECENT_ACCESS
user(s) - SAC_USERS
userAdoption - USER_ADOPTION
user(s)Live - LIVE_USERS
userSessions - SESSION
backend - SAC_STATISTICS_MDS_QUERY_PERF
client - SAC_PERFORMANCE_E2E
dataManagement - DM_SCHEDULE
planningVersion(s) - VERSION_STATISTICS_VIEW
planningDataAction(s) - PLANNING_DATA_ACTIONS

apis.Name: reservations_API
apis.Title: Reservations
apis.ShortText: Manages reservations of products
apis.Description:
Manage reservations. A product that has reached the checkout phase in a web shop is reserved 
for the customer who is buying the product (the owner of the shopping cart).
Reserved products are considered unavailable for subsequent availability checks.
This ensures that the product isn't promised to another customer. 
Temporary reservations expire, which means after a given period of time they're deleted
if the reserved products weren't bought. Temporary reservations are transformed into
nonexpiring reservations once the order is processed by the backend (for example an SAP S/4HANA system).
This API also supports reservation of sales kits.

apis.ShortText: Data Product Payment Terms
apis.Description:
Payment terms is a coded representation of terms of payment composed of cash discount percentages and payment periods.
It is used in sales orders, purchase orders, and invoices. Terms of payment provide information for:
•Cash management
•Dunning procedures
•Payment transactions

Typical examples are: 
2% cash discount 14 days, net due 30 days
Net due 14 days
Net due 30 days

apis.Name: sap-s4com-TreasuryLedgerPosition-v1
apis.Title: Treasury Ledger Position
apis.ShortText: Data Product Treasury Ledger Position
apis.Description: A treasury ledger position is an entity that carries the values of your financial instruments according to accounting principles. It is used to break down the balance sheet accounts in the treasury subledger. For a financial instrument, there is a treasury ledger position in each valuation area. The creation and change of treasury ledger positions is triggered by business transactions and done by flows.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-WithholdingTaxCode-v1
apis.Title: Withholding Tax Code
apis.ShortText: Data Product Withholding Tax Code
apis.Description:
A Withholding Tax Code is a country specific coded representation of an income tax which is withhold by the payer of the income. Typical examples are taxes on wages, salaries, dividends or interest payments.

**Business Context**:

apis.Name: sap-s4com-DunningBlockingReason-v1
apis.Title: Dunning Blocking Reason
apis.ShortText: Data Product Dunning Blocking Reason
apis.Description: Dunning Block Reason defines the reason code for a dunning block of a receivable. Typical values can be defined for example as Disputed, Promised to Pay, To be clarified with Sales Department, Blocked by invoice verification.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-WithholdingTaxItem-v1
apis.Title: Withholding Tax Item
apis.ShortText: Data Product Withholding Tax Item
apis.Description: A withholding tax item represents the taxes that are withheld in a transaction. Withholding tax is calculated during when an invoice is created, or a payment is taking place. So, each withholding tax item is usually associated with the account payable or account receivable line items in an accounting document. Each withholding tax item contains information like the withholding tax type, tax code, the tax amount, etc.

apis.ShortText: It can be used to check user has a risk

apis.Name: sap-s4com-FinancialTransaction-v1
apis.Title: Financial Transaction
apis.ShortText: Data Product Financial Transaction
apis.Description: A financial transaction is a financial contract that includes all attributes managed in Treasury and Risk Management, such as term structure, price information and cash flow, and the entire lifecycle from opening, settlement to closing. It is concluded to invest or borrow money or mitigate financial risks, such as foreign exchange risks or interest rate risks.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-PaymentMethod-v1

apis.ShortText: Data Product Payment Method
apis.Description: A payment method is a coded representation how a payment shall be made. Example payment methods include Check, Bill of Exchange, Bank Transfer, etc.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-SecuritiesAccount-v1
apis.Title: Securities Account
apis.ShortText: Data Product Securities Account
apis.Description: A securities account is a unit used for position management and valuation. A securities account is required for all financial transactions that require position management. Typically, a securities account in the SAP system relates to an actual securities account at a bank.

apis.Name: sap-s4-ProjectDemand-v1
apis.Title: Project Demand
apis.ShortText: Data Product Project Demand
apis.Description:
The object hosts information with regards to project demands.
A project demand is a need at a certain time and location that is related to a project or a WBS element.
A project demand is neither a separate node in the project structure, nor a separate cost object, but a detail for a WBS element. By defining project demands, you can plan the human resources, external services, and materials required for a project or a WBS element.

apis.Name: sap-s4-ProjectBillingElement-v1
apis.Title: Project Billing Element
apis.ShortText: Data Product Project Billing Element
apis.Description: A project billing element is the object that aggregates billing which forms the basis for billing projects. A project billing element can be associated with a Billing Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element or any cost aggregating object like a grant. The project billing element aggregates the time and expenses posted against the project billing element or its sub elements.

apis.Name: sap-s4-ProjectBillingRequest-v1
apis.Title: Project Billing Request
apis.ShortText: Data Product Project Billing Request
apis.Description: A project billing request is a request to create a billing document request based on the amounts resulting from time postings and expenses in a project. The user can review time and expense postings that are billed to the customer, which includes writing-off costs and postponing revenue to the next billing cycle.

apis.Name: sap-s4-EnterpriseProject-v1
apis.Title: Enterprise Project
apis.ShortText: Data Product Enterprise Project
apis.Description:
An enterprise project is a business operation undertaken to achieve a unique outcome. It is based on a set of conditions, such as the targets to be met, the organizational structure, and financial, staffing, and time constraints. 
Enterprise projects can be structured, for example, by creating a cost or work breakdown with demands, milestones, and billing elements. They can be related to other business operations, such as procurement and sales processes.

apis.Name: sap-s4-ProjectBillingElmntConfignData-v1
apis.Title: Project Billing Element Configuration Data
apis.ShortText: Data Product Project Billing Element Configuration Data
apis.Description: A project billing element configuration data is a collection of information that is configured by customers, along with SAP-defined code list values, for a project billing element.

apis.Name: sap-s4-EnterpriseProjectConfignData-v1
apis.Title: Enterprise Project Configuration Data
apis.ShortText: Data Product Enterprise Project Configuration Data
apis.Description: Enterprise project configuration data are a collection of configuration activities conducted by SAP customers and SAP defined code list values for an enterprise project.

apis.Name: sap-s4-ProjectBillingReqConfignData-v1
apis.Title: Project Billing Request Configuration Data
apis.ShortText: Data Product Project Billing Request Configuration Data
apis.Description: A project billing request configuration data is a collection of information that is configured by customers, along with SAP-defined code list values, for a project billing request.

apis.Name: sap-s4-ProjectServiceOrganization-v1
apis.Title: Project Service Organization
apis.ShortText: Data Product Project Service Organization
apis.Description:
A project service organization is an organizational unit that delivers services in a project and is responsible for executing and delivering a project.
In professional services the project service organization is used to set up an internal project or a customer project. Project service organizations are defined in the "Manage Service Organizations" App alongside the following attributes:
- Sales organization: Indicates that the organization is responsible only for the delivery of projects.
- Delivery organization: Indicates that the organization can provide the resources needed to deliver project services.
- Cost center: determines cost rates in projects and  staffs resources.

apis.Name: sap-s4-ProjectDemandConfigurationData-v1
apis.Title: Project Demand Configuration Data
apis.ShortText: Data Product Project Demand Configuration Data
apis.Description: Project demand configuration data is a collection of information containing code list values for the project demand configured by customers and by SAP.

apis.Name: sap-sf-PLTRBPManagement-v1
apis.Title: SAP SuccessFactors Role-Based Permission Management API
apis.ShortText: Manage role-based permissions in SuccessFactors, including permission roles, role assignments, and permission groups
apis.Description: SAP SuccessFactors Role-Based Permission Management API enables you to restrict and grant user permissions across your system through permission roles, role assignments, and permission groups. This helps ensure users have the appropriate permissions to access and manage specific applications. Our API has a rate limit of 120 calls per minute. Requests exceeding this limit will be rejected.

apis.Name: sap-sf-ProxyManagement-v1

apis.ShortText: Use the APIs to create, update, retrieve, and delete proxy assignments in SAP SuccessFactors.
apis.Description: Use the APIs to create, update, retrieve, and delete proxy assignments in SAP SuccessFactors. You need Proxy Management permission to access these APIs.

apis.Name: URL_API
apis.Title: Open Story & Application URL
apis.ShortText: Allows you to access an SAP Analytics Cloud story or application and apply filters on it.
apis.Description: The “URL API” allows you to access analytic applications in a Browser. It can be used to apply a given initial value for script variables which are exposed as URL Parameters by the analytic application. You must have a tenant URL and SAP Analytics Cloud user credentials to use this. This URL API is for browser use only.

apis.Name: CALM_IAM
apis.Title: SAP Cloud ALM Issues
apis.ShortText: Allows updating the status, priority, and due date of Issues and Actions from an external system.
apis.Description:
The Issues and Action OData API enables you to manage Issues and Actions in SAP Cloud ALM.

You require the following authorization scopes to access the API:

  • calm-api.iam.write: to update Issue and Action entities.

apis.Name: SM_P1_USER_MANAGEMENT
apis.Title: Standard Model - User Management
apis.ShortText: Retrieves and updates user profile information
apis.Description:
The User Management API provides access to user account information.

It supports registering new users and retrieving and updating details of existing users. User accounts are required for access and team assignment within SAP Profitability and Performance Management Cloud Standard Model.

apis.Description:

This API is implemented based on OData version 2 specification.

apis.Name: sap-int-eic-message-store-v1
apis.Title: Message Stores
apis.ShortText: Access message store entries, JMS resources and data store entries.
apis.Description:
Message store enables you get data for processed messages. You can access the stored message and analyze it at a later point in time. An integration flow stores messages in a message store through the Persist step for 90 days.  
Additionally, you can get information on the JMS resources available on your Edge Integration Cell runtime as well as on those actually used by your integration flows.  
This API is implemented based on OData version 2 specification.

apis.Name: AuditlogSearchAPIv2
apis.Title: Audit Log Search
apis.ShortText: Search and retrieve audit logs across both NG and Legacy data streams with batch search, advanced filtering, and multi-tenant support.
apis.Description:
The Audit Log Search API V2 enables secure, programmatic batch search and retrieval of audit logs across both NG and Legacy data streams in a single request. It supports advanced filtering by time, user, event type, and tenant source. One search is created for the NG stream and one per subaccount tenant source for the Legacy stream. Results for each search are delivered asynchronously and can be polled independently for complete audit log coverage.

Note: This API version automatically searches both NG and Legacy data streams, providing complete audit log coverage. If you only need to search the NG stream, use the V1 API version instead. Choose the API version that matches your specific use case.

apis.Description: The LLM Batch Service enables asynchronous, large-scale processing of LLM requests through SAP AI Core. Instead of making individual inference calls, users can submit a batch of requests as a JSONL file stored in an object store, and the service processes them in the background. The batch job will be completed in a 24h time window and the results will be stored in the provided object store.

apis.Name: QuoteAsset
apis.Title: Quote Assets
apis.ShortText: Used to externally add subscription contract assets to quotes in SAP Configure Price Quote.
apis.Description: You can use the endpoint of the QuoteAsset API to add subscription contract assets to a quote in SAP Configure Price Quote externally. This API is part of the Subscription Contract Renewal feature and integrates with SAP Billing and Revenue Innovation Management (BRIM) in SAP S/4HANA. When subscription contracts are replicated from SAP BRIM, a renewal opportunity with corresponding opportunity items is created in SAP Sales Cloud. Sales representatives review the renewal opportunity and initiate quote creation in SAP CPQ. Using this endpoint, you can add subscription contract assets from SAP BRIM to the Assets section of a quote by providing external contract identifiers. If a Change Process Group is specified and applicable, the contract items are automatically added as quote items to the Products section. Otherwise, they remain in the Assets section for manual management by a sales representative. The endpoint supports partial success: if some contracts fail validation, successfully retrieved contracts are still added to the quote, and errors are returned in the response for the caller to handle. The SAP BRIM integration must be enabled and connected for this endpoint to function. This feature works exclusively with the SAP CPQ Quote 2.0 engine.

apis.Name: procurement_eventstatus
apis.Title: Integration monitoring API for Procurement
apis.ShortText: Allows customers to import or export master and transaction data to and from their ERP system.
apis.Description:
The data integration options available in SAP Ariba allows customers to import or export master and transaction data, to and from their ERP system. Data can be imported or exported by running individual or batch data import or export tasks from the user interface, or by scheduling the import or export using the SAP Ariba Integration Toolkit (ITK). The Integration monitoring API for Procurement allows customers to develop client applications that call the Integration monitoring API URL, which will return the status of a particular integration event (a data import or export task). This is useful for customers to automate their batch import or export jobs to or from their SAP Ariba solution. Buyer organizations can use the Integration monitoring API to monitor the status of import and export integration events. The API returns the current running status of the specified event, or, if the event is not currently running, the system returns details of the last run status of the specific event. It can also be configured to return the execution history of the integration event.

The Integration monitoring API is applicable to:
* SAP, PeopleSoft, and generic ERP systems
* Individual import and export file channel integration events
* Batch import integration events
* Transaction and master data.

apis.Name: procurement_eventstatus_v2
apis.Title: Integration monitoring API for Procurement
apis.ShortText: Monitor the status of SAP Ariba integration events for procurement
apis.Description:
The data integration options available in SAP Ariba allows customers to import or export master and transaction data, to and from their ERP system. Data can be imported by running individual or batch data import tasks from the user interface, or by scheduling the import using the SAP Ariba Integration Toolkit (ITK). The Integration monitoring API for Procurement allows customers to develop client applications that call the Integration monitoring API URL, which will return the status of a particular integration event (a data import task). This is useful for customers to automate their batch import jobs to or from their SAP Ariba solution. Buyer organizations can use the Integration monitoring API to monitor the status of import integration events. The API returns the current running status of the specified event, or, if the event is not currently running, the system returns details of the last run status of the specific event. It can also be configured to return the execution history of the integration event.

The Integration monitoring API is applicable to:
* SAP, PeopleSoft, and generic ERP systems
* Individual import and export file channel integration events
* Batch import integration events
* Transaction and master data.
apis.ChangeLog: [{"date":"15 Aug 2020","notes":"Version 2.0.0 of Integration monitoring API for Procurement is now published","state":"Active","version":"2.0.0"}]

apis.ShortText: Submit jobs to the Analytical Reporting API (asynchronous usage).
apis.Description:
The Analytical reporting APIs enable you  to create a client application that extracts reportable data from reporting facts and dimensions such as you would select in the user interface when creating an analytical report. For example, you could use these APIs to extract and report on the analytical data that you need to import to a customer's warehouse or create dashboards for trend assessment.

apis.Name: billingDocument_v1
apis.Title: Billing Documents
apis.ShortText: Import billing document items to SAP Sustainability solutions.
apis.Description:
# General Import Billing Documents from ERP source systems to target solutions of the SAP Sustainability portfolio running on SAP BTP.
In sales and distribution, billing documents record the billing-relevant details of sales transactions. They usually form the basis for customer invoices. Each item within a billing document contains the information related to a single product.
This API enables you to start a replication run, import the data, and finish the replication run.
# About the Operations ## Replication Runs The replication run operations allow the source system to manage replication runs: start, cancel, finish, and so on.
The _/startReplication_ endpoint initiates a new replication run and generates a _replicationRunId_, which is required for all subsequent operations. The _replicationRunId_ uniquely identifies the scope of a replication run: the source system, the object to be replicated, and the target solution.
## Data Import The import operations allow the source system to send the object data to the target solution. Endpoints are available for each object entity that is required in the sustainability management processes of the target solution.
The request body must contain the _replicationRunId_ and an _elements_ array with all the items or object records to be imported. The API validates the syntax and payload. This validation ensures that mandatory fields are present and that each field value adheres to the correct data type and length. The maximum number of records that can be processed per request is 25,000.
# Prerequisites Before you use the API, make the following configuration:
1. In the SAP BTP cockpit, subscribe to the _sustainability data integration service_ in your subaccount for the SAP Sustainability solution. You need to create a service instance with an _integration_ plan, and then create a service key to get credentials for the API.
2. In the SAP Sustainability solution, define the settings for push replication:
1. Define source systems with a unique identifier and of type _SAP Sustainability Solutions APIs_.
2. When you create replications for all the objects you want to import using the API, assign the relevant source system, give the replication a unique name, and activate the _Push Replication_ option.
# How to Run a Replication 1. In the _Replication Runs_ operations, use the _/startReplication_ endpoint to initiate the replication run. In the request body, provide the _object_, _sourceSystemId_, and _targetSolution_. The API returns a _replicationRunId_, which is required for the next steps.
2. In the _Data Import_ operations, use the corresponding endpoint for the object entity to import data. In the request body, provide the _replicationRunId_ and the data items under _elements_. Each item in the _elements_ array represents a unique object record to be imported.
3. In the _Replication Runs_ actions, use the _/finishReplication_ endpoint to end the replication run. In the request body, provide the _replicationRunId_.

# General Import Configuration Data from ERP source systems to target solutions of the SAP Sustainability portfolio running on SAP BTP.
In ERP systems, configuration data covers information that administrators can adapt and extend to meet the business requirements of their company. It mainly involves standardized code-lists, such as currencies, units of measure, or countries/regions.
This API enables you to start a replication run, import the data, and finish the replication run.
# About the Operations ## Replication Runs The replication run operations allow the source system to manage replication runs: start, cancel, finish, and so on.
The _/startReplication_ endpoint initiates a new replication run and generates a _replicationRunId_, which is required for all subsequent operations. The _replicationRunId_ uniquely identifies the scope of a replication run: the source system, the object to be replicated, and the target solution.
## Data Import The import operations allow the source system to send the object data to the target solution. Endpoints are available for each object entity that is required in the sustainability management processes of the target solution.
The request body must contain the _replicationRunId_ and an _elements_ array with all the items or object records to be imported. The API validates the syntax and payload. This validation ensures that mandatory fields are present and that each field value adheres to the correct data type and length. The maximum number of records that can be processed per request is 25,000.
# Prerequisites Before you use the API, make the following configuration:
1. In the SAP BTP cockpit, subscribe to the _sustainability data integration service_ in your subaccount for the SAP Sustainability solution. You need to create a service instance with an _integration_ plan, and then create a service key to get credentials for the API.
2. In the SAP Sustainability solution, define the settings for push replication:
1. Define source systems with a unique identifier and of type _SAP Sustainability Solutions APIs_.
2. When you create replications for all the objects you want to import using the API, assign the relevant source system, give the replication a unique name, and activate the _Push Replication_ option.
# How to Run a Replication 1. In the _Replication Runs_ operations, use the _/startReplication_ endpoint to initiate the replication run. In the request body, provide the _object_, _sourceSystemId_, and _targetSolution_. The API returns a _replicationRunId_, which is required for the next steps.
2. In the _Data Import_ operations, use the corresponding endpoint for the object entity to import data. In the request body, provide the _replicationRunId_ and the data items under _elements_. Each item in the _elements_ array represents a unique object record to be imported.
3. In the _Replication Runs_ actions, use the _/finishReplication_ endpoint to end the replication run. In the request body, provide the _replicationRunId_.

apis.Name: analytics_reporting_jobresult
apis.Title: Analytical Reporting - Job Results API
apis.ShortText: View the results of jobs previously submitted(asynchronous usage).
apis.Description:
The Analytical reporting APIs enable you  to create a client application that extracts reportable data from reporting facts and dimensions such as you would select in the user interface when creating an analytical report. For example, you could use these APIs to extract and report on the analytical data that you need to import to a customer's warehouse or create dashboards for trend assessment.

The Job results API for analytics allows you to request output from asynchronous jobs posted using the Job submission API for analytics. Requested output is batched into ZIP files containing 5000 records per file, and these can be downloaded one at a time. The maximum number of records returned is 50,000, or 10 files containing 5000 records per file. Files created in response to an asynchronous API query expire after 48 hours. As a best practice, we recommend the asynchronous usage when you update analytical data to your data warehouse.

apis.Name: nfe_event
apis.Title: Electronic Nota Fiscal (NFe) Event
apis.ShortText: Determines the actions related to electronic fiscal documents that enables you to communicate with Brazilian tax authorities.
apis.Description:
Determines the actions related to electronic fiscal documents that enable you to communicate with Brazilian tax authorities. This API has the following features:
- Send a cancellation request to Brazilian tax authorities when you have an electronic fiscal document that needs to be cancelled, moreover notify your recipients about it.
- Create an Electronic Correction Letter (CC-e) in order to adjust any incorrect information in your NF-e, after the SEFAZ (tax authority) authorization, and inform the Brazilian government and your recipients that your such document had to be rectified.
- Enable you to skip a document number, or a series, that is not going to be used anymore, and inform Brazilian tax authorities of your action followed by a reason for that. This feature applies if you're no longer using this document number, or if you had an error during the issuing of your electronic fiscal document.
- Post an electronic fiscal document under contingency mode (SVC) when you cannot send it to the tax authorities under normal circumstances, for example, when there's an interruption in the SEFAZ server.
- Store and keep the XML files of all electronic fiscal documents that you have issued, and their events.
- Automatically send an e-mail to your business partner when you run events and your request is approved by SEFAZ.
- Resend the same e-mail to your business partner, if necessary.
- Enable you to select a checkbox that compares the structure and fields of your NF-e with the XSD provided by SEFAZ. As a result, validate your XML schema when you send an event request for authorization. Note that this feature is available through an activation.
- Verify if your application is online or not.

apis.Name: nfe_admin
apis.Title: Electronic Nota Fiscal (NFe) Admin
apis.ShortText: Connects to your digital certificate and enables you to digitally sign an NF-e.
apis.Description:
Connects you to the digital certificate that is provided to each company, to enable you to issue your electronic fiscal documents. You are only allowed to issue electronic documents if you have such certificate, in order to digitally sign them. This API has the following features:
- Upload and delete a certificate in the HANA security store. Note that you can customize this feature as needed. For example, you can set different rules for each CNPJ, number of electronic fiscal documents per batch, etc.
- Include new batch closing rules in the table and have it returned consequently. Note that you can customize this feature as needed. For example, you can set different rules for each CNPJ, number of electronic fiscal documents per batch, etc.
- Get the batch closing rules previously defined in your source system and saved in SAP Document and Reporting Compliance Outbound Invoicing Option for Brazil.
- Delete a batch closing rule that was previously defined, according to your business transactions.
- Verify if your application is online or not.

apis.Name: ItemFootprintsAPIV2
apis.Title: Item Footprints - V2
apis.ShortText: Retrieves the item footprints for analytics.
apis.Description:
# General The API lets you access calculated item footprint data for in-depth analysis. Use the analytics results to evaluate, analyze, and optimize resources to reduce footprints. ## Item Footprints The API retrieves key information, such as the Total Footprint and Footprint per Unit, for various items like Product, Energy Source, and Facility over a defined period. This enables you to efficiently evaluate environmental impacts. Additionally, it provides details of the physical quantities, amounts, and units of measure used in the calculations. ## Item Footprint Transactions The API provides comprehensive details on various input and output transactions related to Product, Resource, and Energy footprints over a defined period. It also retrieves details about business transaction types, consumption quantities, amounts, and units of measure used in the calculations.
The attribute Flow Direction is mandatory while retrieving data and needs a value of 'IN' or 'OUT'. ## Item Footprint Breakdown The API provides comprehensive details about item footprint breakdown for a specific impact category over a defined period. It also retrieves details about impact categories, cost centers, footprint breakdown components, and units of measure used in the calculations. Item types, such as Business Activity and Waste Generated in Operations, are associated with locations. If cost centers are assigned to these locations, the API retrieves the ID of the assigned cost center. ## Item Footprint Transaction Breakdown The API provides comprehensive details about item footprint transaction breakdown for specific impact categories over a defined period. It retrieves details about input and output transactions related to product footprints, including business transaction types, consumption quantities, amounts, and units of measure used in the calculations. The API offers a granular breakdown of the footprint components within each impact category. It specifies the amounts and units of measure for each component.
The attribute Flow Direction is mandatory while retrieving data and needs a value of 'IN' or 'OUT'.

apis.Description:
A country is a coded representation of the country/region key that contains information which is also used to validate entries such as the length of the postal code or bank account number. Usually, the two-character ISO code in accordance with ISO 3166, which is delivered by SAP as a default is used. It could also be the vehicle license plate country/region code or a typical country/region key. For example, in Germany the Federal Statistical Office key. The definition of the country/region keys in the SAP system does not necessarily have to match political or state units. It must be noted that the the country/region key does not have to correspond to the ISO code in all installations.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-BillOfMaterialConfignData-v1
apis.Title: Bill Of Material Configuration Data
apis.ShortText: Data Product Bill Of Material Configuration Data
apis.Description: Bill of Material Configuration Data contains data as well as coded representations that are used for the configuration of bills of material (BOMs). The data contains information which is configured by the customer as well as SAP-defined code list values for bill of material processes. The following SAP object types and code lists are provided: Bill of Material Item Category with the following possible values: C: Compatible Unit D: Document item E: Enhanced Limit I: PM structure element K: Class item L: Stock item M: Intra material N: Non-stock item P: Preliminary Item R: Variable-size item S: Non-Plant Item T: Text item Bill of Material Status with the following possible values: 01: Active 02: Inactive 03: Active with history reqmt Bill of Material Variant Usage with the following possible values: 1: Production 2: Engineering/Design 3: Universal 4: Plant Maintenance 5: Sales and Distribution 6: Costing 7: Empties 8: Stability Study B: Sales Bundles (IS-HT-SW)C:Configuration Control J: JIT production line supply M: External Munitions Display P: Predictive MRP S: Service Management U: IUID Embedded Items Bill of Material Version Status with the following possible values: 01: In Process 99: Released 90: Obsolete

apis.Description: The treatment order workflow that requires an approval must be defined to invoke this API by providing the necessary workflow details such as workflow instance id and workflow task id. This API creates an entry in the Approval Details and Approval Logs section of Treatment Order. Accordingly, the related Approval action buttons are displayed. The approver who has relevant authorization roles, can approve or reject the entry.

apis.Name: VisualInspectionOdata_APIs
apis.Title: Fetch Visual Inspection Details
apis.ShortText: Allows you to retrieve details of Visual Inspection Results.
apis.Description: This API package enables the retrieval of stored Visual Inspection results, providing access to image references, indicator values, Visual Inspection views, and user feedback regarding the AI-generated results. It is designed for accessing and reviewing Visual Inspection data, which aids in monitoring and maintenance of the Technical Objects.

apis.Name: SAPCPQStatuses
apis.Title: Statuses
apis.ShortText: Easily manage workflow statuses in SAP Configure Price Quote.
apis.Description: In this API, you can find the endpoints that let you manage workflow statuses in SAP Configure Price Quote administration. Using the dedicated endpoints that are part of this API, you can create, update, and delete the workflow statuses. You can retrieve a specific status based on its ID, and you can get a list of all available statuses based on a filter criteria. Additionally, using the respective endpoints, you can get, create and update the translated status names.

apis.Name: AggregatesOdata_EIOT_APIs
apis.Title: Time Series Aggregate
apis.ShortText: Allows you to retrieve aggregate data over specified time intervals.
apis.Description: The Time Series Aggregate API lets you query aggregate values over time-series data. It supports various aggregation levels, including SECOND, MINUTE, HOUR, DAY, and MONTH, allowing you to retrieve aggregate data over specified time intervals. Refer the [document](https://help.sap.com/docs/sap-apm/8c95dca44fda4d56a17f6494f421758d/94f438bcfb6040bfa698058100a2d974.html?version=Cloud) for more details on supported aggregate functions and level .

apis.Name: SAPCPQWorkflow
apis.Title: Workflow
apis.ShortText: Used to manage the workflow in SAP Configure Price Quote externally.
apis.Description: With the Workflow API, you can work with the workflow-related options in SAP Configure Price Quote from an external system the same way you would manage them inside the application. For example, you can use this API to retrieve all actions from the workflow, or to retrieve a specific action using the quoteTypeId, StartStatusId and EndStatusId. Using the same information, you can also update a specific action in the workflow or use the ID of an action to delete it. You can also create or update actions in bulk, as well as delete all the workflow actions for a specified quote type.

apis.Name: SAPCPQApprovalRules
apis.Title: Approval Rules
apis.ShortText: Used to externally manage approval rules in SAP Configure Price Quote.
apis.Description: You can use the endpoints of the ApprovalRules API to work with approval rules in SAP Configure Price Quote externally. For example, you can get all the approval rules from the system, or create a new approval rule. Additionally, you can use the ID of an approval rule to get that rule, delete, or update it. Approval rules can also be created or updated in bulk. Using a dictionary ID, you can get specific approval rule translation details. You can also update translations for approval rules, either individually or in bulk. Moreover, you can use the dedicated endpoints of this API to get all delegated approvers, or to update a specific delegated approver using their ID. You can get all dynamic approval rules or one specific rule using its ID, as well as create a new dynamic approval rule, or delete an existing one. In addition, you can update a specific dynamic approval rule, or create or update multiple dynamic approval rules in bulk.

apis.Name: VisualInspection_APIs
apis.Title: Manage Visual Inspection Results
apis.ShortText: Allows you to create Visual Inspection Results.
apis.Description: This API endpoint facilitates the transmission of Visual Inspection data, including images, derived indicators, and associated technical object IDs, to the Visual Inspection system. It serves to record and store inspection outcomes,  which aids in monitoring and maintenance of the Technical Objects.

apis.Name: FileUploader_APIs
apis.Title: File Uploader
apis.ShortText: Allows you to create time series data via file upload.
apis.Description: The Time Series File Uploader API enables you to create time series data by uploading a .parquet file. It also tracks the file's lifecycle, including stages such as received, scanned, and processed. Refer to the [document](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_APM/468c925d1276476680b47d94548174a1/a2b4d1a5c84f409f9fb2ae4d49287d27.html) to obtain a service key and construct the host URL.

apis.Name: Timeseries_EIOT_APIs
apis.Title: Manage Time Series Data
apis.ShortText: Allows you to create and read time series data that is obtained from Embedded IoT.
apis.Description: The time series APIs enable you to use time series data when creating your own analysis tools and other extensions. By using these APIs, you can, for example, read measurement data for your asset. Refer to the [document](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_APM/468c925d1276476680b47d94548174a1/a2b4d1a5c84f409f9fb2ae4d49287d27.html) to obtain a service key and construct the host URL.

apis.Name: EmbeddedIoTMetadataSync_APIs
apis.Title: Manage Embedded IoT Metadata Sync
apis.ShortText: Allows you to trigger connectivity of a Technical Object to Embedded IoT on-demand and lets you read the connectivity status for a set of Technical Objects.
apis.Description: The Embedded IoT Metadata Sync Service enables the management of Technical Objects connectivity to Embedded IoT in SAP Asset Performance Management. The Connectivity API package enables on-demand triggering of connectivity of a Technical Object to Embedded IoT  and lets you read the connectivity status for a set of Technical Objects.

apis.Name: Indicator_Related_EIoT_APIs
apis.Title: Manage Indicators
apis.ShortText: Allows you to manage indicators and the related entities.
apis.Description: Create and manage indicators to perform condition monitoring, maintenance demand generation, and analytics. The mandatory attributes such as Position, Category, and Characteristics combination for the indicators shall be unique for a given technical object in SAP Asset Performance Management System. Refer the [document](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_APM/468c925d1276476680b47d94548174a1/a2b4d1a5c84f409f9fb2ae4d49287d27.html) to obtain a service key and construct the host URL.

apis.Name: SAPCPQItemActions
apis.Title: Item Actions
apis.ShortText: Used for externally managing item actions and the item actions workflow.
apis.Description: The Item Actions API can be used for retrieving and managing item actions in SAP Configure Price Quote and for managing the item actions that are assigned to specific quote types (user-side tabs that include My Quotes, Waiting for Approval, and Other Quotes). This API allows you to externally manage these options the same way you would manage them on the user interface in the Item Actions and Item Actions Workflow sections of the SAP CPQ Setup. For example, you can use it to retrieve all item actions that match the filters that you specify, or to retrieve a specific item action using its ID. Similarly, you can use it to update the translation for a specific item action. In addition, you can use it to retrieve all item actions that are assigned in the workflow for a specific quote type (user-side tab) or to assign item actions to a specific quote status.

apis.Name: Rules_EIoT_APIs
apis.Title: Manage Rule Runs
apis.ShortText: Allows you to initiate rule runs and retrieve rule run results.
apis.Description: Use the API to start monitoring or derivation rule runs for condition-based monitoring. You can run rules for all or selected technical objects within a data set. The Manage Rule Runs APIs enable you to view rule execution results, including errors, rule details, activation status, execution logs, and the involved technical objects. Please refer to the following [document](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_APM/2602f93216bb4530ba169c75be619edf/a2b4d1a5c84f409f9fb2ae4d49287d27.html?locale=en-US&version=Cloud) to obtain a service key and construct the host URL.

apis.Name: SAPCPQWorkflowPermissions
apis.Title: Workflow Permissions
apis.ShortText: Used for externally managing workflow permissions in SAP Configure Price Quote.
apis.Description: Using the WorkflowPermissions API, you can externally control which user types in SAP Configure Price Quote are given permissions to execute specific actions. You can use this API to retrieve all workflow permissions that match the filters that you specify using OData filtering. In addition, you can use it to replace the user types that are granted permission for using an action with a new set of user types. It is only possible to replace the existing user types with new ones using this endpoint, meaning that you can’t use it to update the name of the user type or the action. You can also use this API to delete the workflow permissions that are assigned to a user type for an action, using the specific ID of the action and the user type in question.

apis.Name: SAPCPQNotifications
apis.Title: Notifications
apis.ShortText: Allows you to externally retrieve, create, delete and update email notifications in SAP Configure Price Quote based on the notification ID.
apis.Description: Using the endpoints available in the Notifications API, you can retrieve a list of notifications based on the defined filter. You can create a new notification or update an existing notification. It is also possible to create or update the content of a notification based on the notification ID. Additionally, if you wish to delete a notification, you can do so by using the dedicated endpoint in this API.

apis.Name: FileUploaderOdata_APIs
apis.Title: File Status
apis.ShortText: Allows you to retrieve file status
apis.Description:
Timeseries File Status API enables you to retrieve status of a file by accepting a fileID from user.The API returns the current file status (and potentially other metadata), providing insights into where the file is in the process, such as

* File status (e.g., **Received**, **Scanned**, **Queued For Ingestion**, **In Process**, **Processed**, **Processing Failed**)
* Any errors encountered
* Timestamps for key events (e.g., upload time, processed time)
* File metadata (e.g., fileId, name, file size, number of records, etc.)

apis.Name: SAPCPQAction
apis.Title: Action
apis.ShortText: Manage actions and custom actions in SAP Configure Price Quote externally.
apis.Description: The Action API allows you to work with standard and custom actions in SAP Configure Price Quote from another system. For example, you can use the dedicated endpoints of this API to retrieve all actions in the system, or to retrieve, update, or delete an action using its ID. You can also update the translations for a specified action using the action ID. In addition, you can get action translation data using the action ID and the dictionary ID or get the images for an action using the action image type. Furthermore, you can insert or update action details or action translation details in bulk using the dedicated endpoints. In regard to custom actions, you can use this API to create a new custom action, delete a specific custom action using its ID, or get the custom action script version using its version ID. You can also get the custom action script version history list by providing an action ID.

apis.Name: PublicSnapshotOdata_APIs
apis.Title: Indicator Snapshot
apis.ShortText: Allows you to retrieve the latest values of multiple indicators associated with one or more technical objects
apis.Description:
Indicator Snapshot API enables you to retrieve the latest values for multiple indicators associated with one or more technical objects. It retrieves the latest non-null IoT time series data based on a combination of technicalObjectNumber, technicalObjectType, SSID, positionID, categoryName, and characteristicsInternalId.
  You can query a maximum of 15 indicators in a single request, either for a single technical object or across multiple technical objects.

apis.Name: sap-s4com-Company-v1
apis.Title: Company
apis.ShortText: Data Product Company
apis.Description: A Company is a financially and legally independent, geographically unbound organizational center registered under business law.

apis.Name: CE_PROJECTDEMANDCATEGORY_0001
apis.Title: Project Demand Category and Type - Read
apis.ShortText: Read project demand categories and types using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read project demand categories and types along with their descriptions. You can use this service, for example, to retrieve supported values for the corresponding fields in the **Project Demand** entity of the **Project Demand** API, or to make the descriptions of the categories and types available for your custom application.

apis.Name: DETECTIONMETHOD_0001
apis.Title: Detection Method - Read
apis.ShortText: Read detection methods using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This API enables you to read the details of a detection method such as detection profile, detection method group, detection method, assignment of a detection method to a detection group, assignment of a detection profile to a detection group, and assignment of a notification type to a detection profile.

Detection method is an activity or a method by which a failure is discovered. This information is important and helps in evaluating the effect of maintenance. 

If the input in the request is not as expected then the system displays appropriate error or warning messages in the response.

apis.Name: DeviationServiceAPI
apis.Title: Deviation Service
apis.ShortText: Handle the deviation of self-billing documents from SAP Self-Billing Cockpit

apis.Name: COMMISSIONEDOUTSTANDINGCOLLECT
apis.Title: Collection Agency - Confirmation
apis.ShortText: Transfer data from an external system to Contract Accounting (FI-CA) using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service enables the transfer of the status report for the submitted collection items from the external collection agency. The service receives the following information from collection agencies:
 - Information about the assignment of collection items to external collection cases or court cases
 - Status information on the progress of the collection of submitted items
 - Payment information
 - Information about canceled payments

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_WAREHOUSESTOCKTRANSFERPARTIALR-v1
apis.Title: Stock Transfer Partial Receipt Cancel Advice – from Warehouse (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Cancel a previously posted partial goods receipt with this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You use this API to cancel previously posted partial goods receipts. This service can only cancel one single partial goods receipt at a time. To cancel multiple partial goods receipt postings, this service must be called for each individual posting. As a response to this request, a Warehouse Stock Transfer Partial Receipt Cancel Confirmation message is sent to a third-party logistics warehouse management system.

apis.Name: CreditDebitMemoCreationConfirmationAPI
apis.Title: Credit/Debit Memo – Receive Confirmation of Creation for Self-Billing
apis.ShortText: Receive confirmation messages for creating credit or debit memos to implement self-billing with invoice creation.

apis.Name: API_DEL_DOC_WITH_CREDIT_BLOCK
apis.Title: Delivery Document with Credit Block - Read, Check, Release, Reject (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Read, check, release, and reject credit blocked delivery documents using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains entities for credit blocked delivery document and reject reason. Once the delivery document has been checked, released, or rejected, a success message containing the document number is sent in the response. Once the credit blocked delivery document has been retrieved, the data is sent in the response. If there are any issues when reading, checking, releasing, or rejecting the credit blocked delivery document, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: SbinvTransmissionReceiverAPI
apis.Title: Self-Billing Document – Receive for Invoice Creation
apis.ShortText: Receive transmissions containing self-billing documents from the buyer to implement self-billing with invoice creation.

apis.Name: SacSbinvDocumentAPI
apis.Title: Self-Billing Document with Invoice Creation
apis.ShortText: Read information about a Self-Billing document with invoice creation

apis.Name: SLSPRCGCONDITIONFIELD_0001
apis.Title: Field Catalog for Pricing in Sales – Read
apis.ShortText: Read a list of supported fields that can be used to represent sales-price-relevant business attributes by using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Consumers of this inbound service can read a list of fields that are included in the field catalog for pricing in sales by sending OData requests.

apis.Name: PROOFOFDELIVERYREQUEST_IN
apis.Title: Proof of Delivery - Update (B2B, asynchronous, inbound)
apis.ShortText: Update Proofs of Delivery (PoDs) in an outbound delivery using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service has fields that allow you to provide proof of delivery of the items in a specific outbound delivery. You can enter multiple quantities for a given item. The service compares the proof of delivery quantities with the delivery quantities and calculates any differences. Alternatively, you can enter differences manually. You can also enter a reason for any differences, or if the field is empty the service automatically determines a reason. You can monitor messages transferred by this service using the SAP Application Interface Framework (AIF) monitoring.

apis.Name: QUERYBUSINESSUSERIN
apis.Title: Business User - Read
apis.ShortText: Read business users from your external data source such as an identity management system using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service contains a business user node, which contains the search parameters, and a query processing conditions node, which contains the business data of the service. The response includes the number of users based on the given criteria and the number of found data sets of business users. If errors occur, the log contains information about the severity code, the message number and message texts.

apis.Name: SacSbwapDocumentAPI
apis.Title: Self-Billing Document with Automatic Posting
apis.ShortText: Read information about a Self-Billing document with automatic posting

apis.Name: PlantSyncAPI
apis.Title: Plant – Receive
apis.ShortText: Receive plant master data from the integrated system using this asynchronous inbound service.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNCHARTOFACCOUNTS_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Chart of Accounts - Read
apis.ShortText: Read consolidation chart of accounts using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation chart of accounts is a systemic grouping of financial statement items that belong together and are used for group reporting and consolidation. For example, the predefined consolidation chart of accounts is Y1.

apis.Name: CO_PROFIT_CENTRE_GROUP_HIERARC
apis.Title: Profit Center Group Hierarchy - Send
apis.ShortText: Replicate master data of a profit center group hierarchy from one system to other systems using this outbound service
apis.Description: The service contains profit center group, profit center group text, relationship, profit center assignment, and profit center interval nodes.

apis.Name: BillingUpdateAPI
apis.Title: Billing Document – Receive Confirmation of Fields Updated for Self-Billing
apis.ShortText: Receive confirmation messages for updating reference numbers in billing documents by using this asynchronous inbound service.

apis.Name: UoMReplicationAPI
apis.Title: Unit of Measurement – Receive
apis.ShortText: Receive units of measurement from the integrated system using this asynchronous inbound service.

apis.Name: API_LEGAL_CONTENT_TYPE_SRV
apis.Title: Legal Document Content Types - Read
apis.ShortText: Use this API to read content types of legal documents
apis.Description: This synchronous inbound service is based on the OData protocol and helps you to read the content types through an API call. Content types describe the purpose of the document, for example 'Amendment' or 'Master Agreement'. This service contains legal document content type and content type text nodes. Using this service, you can read the content type maintained in the configuration.

apis.Name: TransmissionReceiverAPI
apis.Title: Self-Billing Document – Receive for Automatic Posting
apis.ShortText: Receive transmissions containing self-billing documents from the buyer to implement automatic posting.

apis.Name: _SCMTMS_TRANSPORTATIONORDERGEN
apis.Title: Freight Order – Replicate (Inbound)
apis.ShortText: Replicate freight orders using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This asynchronous inbound service enables you to replicate freight orders from a client system to an SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system in an application-to-application (A2A) scenario. In the decentral TM system, the freight orders are created on the basis of transferred freight units, which can be replicated using service Freight Unit - Replicate.

apis.Name: API_PRODUCT_ALLOC_SEQUENCE_SRV
apis.Title: Product Allocation Sequence
apis.ShortText: Use this synchronous inbound service to read header data and read, edit and delete assignments for a specific product allocation sequence
apis.Description: You can use this service to read header data for a specific product allocation sequence (including its description) as well as read, edit and delete any assigned product and product-location assignments.

apis.Name: PricingSimulateAPI
apis.Title: Billing Document – Receive Simulated Prices
apis.ShortText: Receive simulated prices for billing document items in the integrated system by using this asynchronous inbound service.

apis.Name: InvoiceCreationConfirmationAPI
apis.Title: Self-Billing Invoice – Receive Creation Confirmation
apis.ShortText: Receive confirmation messages for creating final invoices.

apis.Name: DataExportAPI
apis.Title: Document Export Service
apis.ShortText: To export self-billing documents from the SAP Self-Billing Cockpit

apis.Name: BillingCreateAPI
apis.Title: Credit/Debit Memo – Receive Confirmation of Creation with Invoice Reference
apis.ShortText: Receive confirmation messages for creating credit memos and debit memos by using this asynchronous inbound service.

apis.Name: AIDocumentProcessingAPI
apis.Title: AI-assisted Document Processing
apis.ShortText: To process self-billing documents using AI-assisted extraction in the SAP Self-Billing Cockpit

apis.Name: CE_PRODANALYTICALCOMPOSITION_0001
apis.Title: Product Analytical Composition
apis.ShortText: Create and update analytical compositions for products and read analytical composition data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This service writes data that is provided by an external application to the analytical composition in the Product Compliance solution. It uses the provided data to create or update a version of the analytical composition of a product. In addition, the service can also read data of the analytical composition and provides this data to an external application.

You can apply any of the filters provided or retrieve all existing data.

apis.Name: sap-s4pce-CollectionsCodes-v1
apis.Title: Collections Codes
apis.ShortText: Data Product Collections Codes
apis.Description: Codes related to Collections Management

apis.Name: sap-s4pce-CollectionsCustomerContact-v1
apis.Title: Collections Customer Contact
apis.ShortText: Data Product Collections Customer Contact
apis.Description: A collections customer contact is a documentation of the outcome of a customer contact in SAP Collections Management. It it used to bundle all relevant information and objects created during this contact.

apis.Name: sap-s4pce-CollectionsWorklistItem-v1
apis.Title: Collections Worklist Item
apis.ShortText: Data Product Collections Worklist Item
apis.Description: A collections worklist item is an item that represents an open receivable to be collected by the processor of a collection worklist in Collections Management.

apis.Name: sap-s4pce-CollectionsResubmission-v1
apis.Title: Collections Resubmission
apis.ShortText: Data Product Collections Resubmission
apis.Description: A collections resubmission is a record of the need of a follow up for a customer on a defined date. It is used for creating an entry for a customer on the collections worklist on the defined date.

apis.Name: sap-s4pce-PromiseToPay-v1
apis.Title: Promise To Pay
apis.ShortText: Data Product Promise To Pay
apis.Description: A promise to pay is a commitment from a customer to pay an invoice in the future. It is used for aligning payment deadlines between the debitor and creditor, and can be used for future analysis and evaluation of a customer relationship.

apis.Name: sap-s4pce-DisputeCase-v1
apis.Title: Dispute Case
apis.ShortText: Data Product Dispute Case
apis.Description: A dispute case is a document that describes and supports the resolution process for receivables-related disputes with a business partner. A dispute case is used for solving any receivable-related issues, in particular when underpayments take place. Objects in a dispute case can be open receivables, cleared receivables or customer accounts.

apis.Name: ComplianceDataReplicationServiceV1
apis.Title: GRC Compliance Data Replication Service
