apis.ShortText: OData interface for GRC Compliance Data Replication Service

apis.Name: FlexsoAPI
apis.Title: Financial and Project Reporting
apis.ShortText: Streamline project and financial planning processes

apis.Name: GetAclPropertyApi
apis.Title: Get Access Control List
apis.ShortText: Provides the access control lists of an object
apis.Description: It returns  the Access Control List(ACL) currently applied to the speciﬁed object. This service allows the requestor to specify that the result be expressed using only the CMIS deﬁned permissions. Without this restriction, the response may include, or be solely expressed in repository speciﬁc permissions.

apis.Name: CreateSecondaryTypeApi
apis.Title: Create Secondary Type
apis.ShortText: Creates a set of properties for existing objects
apis.Description: A secondary type deﬁnes a set of properties that can be dynamically added to and removed from objects. That is, an object can get and lose additional properties that are not deﬁned by its primary type during its lifetime. Multiple secondary types can be applied to the same object at the same time.

apis.Name: GetTypeChildrenApi
apis.Title: Get Type Children
apis.ShortText: Provides description of the types that are immediate children of the specified type Id, or the base types if no type Id is provided
apis.Description: It returns the list of object-types defined for the repository that are children of the specified type based on type Id, repository Id provided

apis.Name: RemoveAclPropertyApi
apis.Title: Remove Access Control Entries
apis.ShortText: Remove Access Control Entry to or from the Access Control List of an object.
apis.Description: It removes Ace to or from the access control list of an object. A list of Ace's that must be removed from the newly-created document object, either using the access control list from folder Id if specified, or being ignored if no folder Id is specified.

apis.Name: DeleteTreeApi
apis.Title: Delete Tree
apis.ShortText: Deletes the specified folder object and all of its children and descendant-objects.
apis.Description: It deletes the specified folder and all the descendant-objects of the folder. A repository may attempt to delete child- and descendant-objects of the speciﬁed folder in any order. Any child- or descendant-object that the repository cannot delete must persist in a valid state in the CMIS domain model.

apis.Name: CreateShareApi
apis.Title: Create Share in a Collaboration Enabled Repository
apis.ShortText: Creates sap share type object in a collaboration enabled repository.
apis.Description: It creates a folder of sap:share type under the specified repository. It uses a sharing (Collaboration enabled) repository

apis.Name: GetObjectApi
apis.Title: Get Object
apis.ShortText: Provides the information for the object.
apis.Description: It provides the information for the specified object where the object can be of folder, link, document type.

apis.Name: CreateDocumentApi
apis.Title: Create Document
apis.ShortText: Creates a document in the specified location inside repository.
apis.Description: It creates a document object of the speciﬁed type (given by the cmis:objectTypeId property) in the (optionally) speciﬁed location.

apis.Name: CreateDocumentFromSourceApi
apis.Title: Create Document from Source
apis.ShortText: Copies document from source folder to the targeted folder
apis.Description: It creates copy of document from the source folder into a targeted folder without changing any properties of the document.

apis.Name: CheckOutDocumentApi
apis.Title: Check Out Document
apis.ShortText: Check Out the document having unique object Id
apis.Description: It creates a private working copy (PWC) of the document. A PWC is created by invoking Check Out on a versioned document object. A repository may allow any document object in a version series to be checked out, or may only allow the latest version to be checked out.

apis.Name: DeletePermanentlyApi
apis.Title: Permanently Remove the Object
apis.ShortText: Deletes object permanently from the recycle bin.
apis.Description: This API serves as a delete operation in the recycle bin, enabling the permanent deletion of objects from the recycle bin. The 'objectId' may refer to either a document or a folder.

apis.Name: GetZipContentStream
apis.Title: ZIP Content Download
apis.ShortText: Gets the Zip file already created for download
apis.Description: Downloads the ZIP that has been created using ZIP Content Creation API for a Folder/ Multiple files on the server for the same session

apis.Name: GetTypeDefinitionApi
apis.Title: Get Type Definition
apis.ShortText: Provides the definition of the specified object-type.
apis.Description: It provides us the definition of a specified object type on providing the type Id of object-type specified in repository

apis.Name: GetDeletedChildrenApi
apis.Title: Get Deleted Children
apis.ShortText: Provides deleted child objects for the specified folder.
apis.Description: It returns the list of child objects deleted from the specified folder. This is one of the recycle bin APIs that provides information about the immediate children deleted from a specified folder. When the folder objectId is not mentioned, the root is considered by default.

apis.Name: UpdateFolder_Document_LinkApi
apis.Title: Update Folder, Document, Link Object
apis.ShortText: Update properties of a folder, document and link
apis.Description: Updates properties and secondary types of the specified object. All properties passed to updateProperties be updated to their new values. Properties that are passed without a value will be set to their default value or un-set if no default value is defined. All others property values remain untouched.

apis.Name: GetAllowableActionsApi
apis.Title: Get Allowable Actions
apis.ShortText: Provides us the list of allowable actions for an object.
apis.Description: It returns the list of allowable actions for an object. It is used to retrieve the allowable actions for the object(s) described in the service response.

apis.Name: CancelCheckOutDocumentApi
apis.Title: Cancel Check Out Document
apis.ShortText: Cancel the check out of the specified Private Working Copy(PWC)
apis.Description: Reverses the eﬀect of a check-out (check out). Removes the Private Working Copy of the checked-out document, allowing other documents in the version series to be checked out again.

apis.Name: CreateFavoriteApi
apis.Title: Create Favorite
apis.ShortText: Creates a link object for the specified object inside favorites repository.
apis.Description: Creates favorite link object for the specified object if favorites repository is configured. With this call, the server creates a user folder in favorites repositories, creates a sap:link file to the object and applies user ACL.

apis.Name: GenerateThumbnailApi
apis.Title: Generate Thumbnail
apis.ShortText: Thumbnail support for older repositories.
apis.Description: This API helps in generating thumbnail for a given document id.

apis.Name: GetFolderTreeApi
apis.Title: Get Folder Tree
apis.ShortText: Provides the set of descendant folder objects contained in the specified folder.
apis.Description: It returns the set of descendant folder objects contained in the speciﬁed folder. This operation does not support paging. The order in which results are returned is repository-speciﬁc.

apis.Name: MassUploadApi
apis.Title: Zip Extract and Upload
apis.ShortText: Creates a folder in the specified location of a repository with zip name and all the files and folders present inside the zip gets uploaded.
apis.Description: It creates a folder with the zip name and all the contents inside the zip, folder or document are created inside it. The maximum size that can be uploaded is 4GB and the maximum entries in zip can be 10000.

apis.Name: RestoreObjectApi
apis.Title: Restore Object
apis.ShortText: Restores deleted object for the specified objectId.
apis.Description: It restores the deleted object. This is one of the recycle bin APIs that recovers deleted objects. The objectId can be of a document or a folder.

apis.Name: UpdatePropertiesApi
apis.Title: Update Properties
apis.ShortText: Used in updating properties of object present inside repository.
apis.Description: Updates properties and secondary types of the specified object. All properties passed to updateProperties be updated to their new values. Properties that are passed without a value will be set to their default value or un-set if no default value is defined. All others property values remain untouched.

apis.Name: CreateFolderApi
apis.Title: Create Folder
apis.ShortText: Creates a folder in the specified location of a repository.
apis.Description: It creates a folder object of the speciﬁed type in the speciﬁed location. It should not have repetitive folder names and properties that must be applied to the newly created folder should be present

apis.Name: ServiceApi
apis.Title: Fetch Repository
apis.ShortText: Returns a list of Content Management Interoperability Services(CMIS) repositories available for the instance
apis.Description: Provides detailed information of all the Content Management Interoperability Services(CMIS) repositories linked to an instance with all the necessary information for connecting to them

apis.Name: Alert_EIOT_APIs
apis.Title: Manage Alerts
apis.ShortText: Allows you to manage Alerts
apis.Description: The API enables you to manage the Alerts in SAP Asset Performance Management. Alerts help you with any potential failure that may occur or has already occurred for the Technical Object and helps to identify potential actions to be taken for the incoming alerts. Refer the [document](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_APM/468c925d1276476680b47d94548174a1/a2b4d1a5c84f409f9fb2ae4d49287d27.html) to learn about obtaining a service key and understanding the API quota limitations.

apis.Name: CO_FNDEI_REGION_RL
apis.Title: Region - Replicate (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Replicate regions using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description:
This service enables you to replicate regions from an SAP S/4HANA system to an external system. It is based on the SOAP protocol where sent messages are monitored using Application Interface Framework (AIF).

The service contains MessageHeader, ListCompleteTransmissionIndicator, TransmissionStartDateTime, and Region nodes. The Region node contains the list of regions replicated from the SAP S/4HANA system. The information is sent as an XML message to the target system using the Data Replication Framework (DRF).

apis.Name: API_MAINTENANCEORDER
apis.Title: Maintenance Order - Read
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete maintenance order data synchronously using this inbound service
apis.Description:
This service enables you to create, read, updated and delete maintenance order data. It contains order header, operation, component, object list item, operation relationship, long text and settlement rule nodes. The service is based on the OData V2 protocol, and can be consumed in external systems, Fiori applications and on other user interfaces.

If there are any issues when retrieving the maintenance order data, the system displays appropriate warning or error messages in the response.

apis.Name: CO_SDBIL_ESR_BDCR_SBI_CONF_OUT
apis.Title: Self Billing Invoice - Send Creation Confirmation
apis.ShortText: Send confirmations of newly created self-billing invoices to SAP Self-Billing Cockpit by using this outbound, asynchronous SOAP service
apis.Description:
These confirmations act as responses to the invoice creation requests received by the inbound service *Self-Billing Invoice - Creation*. In addition, the service reports back many attributes of the newly created invoice at header and item level, including pricing elements. If invoice creation has led to multiple split invoices, the service also indicates the documents affected by the split, and provides a list of the fields and values that caused the split.

This service is intended solely for the integration between SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP Self-Billing Cockpit and should not be used for any other purposes.

apis.Name: CE_SRCGPROJLFCYCSTS_0001
apis.Title: Sourcing Project Lifecycle Status – Read
apis.ShortText: Read the lifecycle statuses using this inbound synchronous service

apis.Name: API_JOINTVENTURE_0001
apis.Title: Joint Venture
apis.ShortText: Maintain joint ventures using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains Joint Venture, Description, Equity Group, Equity Type, and Equity Share nodes. The information is sent in the request as a payload, which is used in creating or updating a joint venture, including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations. If there are any issues when the joint venture is created or updated, the system displays error messages in the response. The service does not allow deletion of any of joint ventures, descriptions, equity group, equity type or equity share.

apis.Name: CABILLINGREQUEST_0001
apis.Title: Convergent Invoicing Billing Request
apis.ShortText: Manage Credit/Debit Memos (billing requests) in Convergent Invoicing using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Read entire billing requests or only parts of the data, using the provided filters. Create new billing request with billing request items. Add new billing request items to existing billing requests, using deep insert requests. Update or delete the billing request header or its items. Actions can be used to change the status of a billing request.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNUNITDATACOLLECTION_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Unit Data Collection
apis.ShortText: Read consolidation unit data collection selection attribute values in SAP S/4HANA Cloud for group reporting using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A data collection selection attribute value can be assigned optionally to a consolidation unit to allow its classification, for example for the purpose of data collection. It can also be used in selections and validations.

apis.Name: WORKCENTERPOOLEDCAPACITY_0001
apis.Title: Pooled Capacity
apis.ShortText: Manage pooled capacities using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service is based on OData V4 protocol and can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces. It enables you to create, read and update pooled capacity. The service contains pooled capacity header, pooled capacity description, pooled capacity interval and pooled capacity shift details.

apis.Name: SERVICEDOCUMENTPRIORITY_0001
apis.Title: Service Transaction Priority - Read
apis.ShortText: Read Service Transaction Priority using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This API enables you to retrieve the customizing entries for service transaction priority like 1, 2, 3, and so on and provides its corresponding language text.

apis.Name: SETTLMTDOCTYPE_0001
apis.Title: Settlement Document Type - Read
apis.ShortText: This synchronous inbound service enables you to consume existing Settlement Document Types and relevant information in SAP S/4HANA Cloud that can be used by external applications with an API Call
apis.Description:
You retrieve the following data using this OData based service:

You can read the Settlement Document Types and related information.

You can navigate to the Header Text Object Type Assignment for a Settlement Document Type and read the assigned Text Determination Procedure and all the possible Text Object Types linked to it on header level.

You can navigate to the Item Text Object Type Assignment for a Settlement Document Type and read the assigned Text Determination Procedure and all the possible Text Object Types linked to it on item level.

apis.Name: BANKSTATEMENTPOST_IN
apis.Title: Bank Statement - Post
apis.ShortText: Post bank statements using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains header and item nodes. The information is sent in the request as a payload. All information is used when creating a bank statement, including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations. This service is based on the SOAP protocol and can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces. Once the bank statement has been created, the bank statement number is sent in the response. If there are any issues when the bank statement is created, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: API_GTI_UPDATE_CUSTOMER_TYPE_SRV
apis.Title: Golden Tax Interface Customer Type ‒ Read, Update
apis.ShortText: Update customer type for Golden Tax Interface (GTI) for China using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service contains the customer type information for GTI. It is used to update the customer type so that the corresponding invoice types can be issued for customers.

apis.Name: API_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV_0002
apis.Title: Outbound Delivery (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Process outbound deliveries using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create, read, update and delete outbound deliveries. It can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CNSLDTNMATERIALGROUP_0001-v1
apis.Title: Consolidation Material Group
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation material groups using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation material group is a material group that can be used for financial consolidation in group reporting. It can either be a material group that’s been defined in an area other than group reporting, or it can be a material group that’s been specifically defined for exclusive use in group reporting. It is a grouping of materials, products, and services according to their characteristics.

apis.Name: API_CONSOLIDATIONUNIT
apis.Title: Consolidation Unit
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation units using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation unit is the smallest entity of the corporate group structure that can be used as the basis for performing a consolidation. Consolidation units belong to the master data of group reporting.

apis.Name: CE_SOURCINGSUPPLIERLIST_0001
apis.Title: Supplier List for Sourcing - Read
apis.ShortText: Read supplier list for sourcing in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system using this synchronous service

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_PROFITCENTER_0001-v1
apis.Title: Profit Center
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, and delete profit centers using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create, read, update, and delete profit center master data. This service is based on the OData protocol and can be consumed in SAP Fiori apps and other user interfaces.

apis.Name: SUPPLIERITEM_0001
apis.Title: Supplier Item - Create, Read, Update
apis.ShortText: Create, read and update supplier item using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You can use this service to create, read and update supplier item. The service is based on the OData protocol and can be consumed by external systems.

apis.Name: CO_KEY_MAP_RPLCTRQ
apis.Title: Key Mapping - Send Confirmation to Client
apis.ShortText: Send key mapping replication status using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The KeyMappingBulkReplicateConfirmation_Out SOAP service interface enables you send confirmation about key mapping replication to the client system.

apis.Name: FKCCNVCHRGPRVDRCONTRBULK_IN
apis.Title: Provider Contract – Bulk Maintain
apis.ShortText: Transfer provider contract data from an external system to Contract Accounting (FI-CA) using this asynchronous inbound bulk service
apis.Description: With this service, you can create provider contracts. Updates of existing provider contracts are also supported.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CO_LEIDW_WHS_FINAL_REC_CONF-v1
apis.Title: Stock Transfer Final Receipt Advice Confirmation – to Warehouse (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Use this asynchronous outbound service to send final confirmation to a third-party logistics warehouse management system after an inbound delivery has been finalized
apis.Description: This confirmation message is sent after the corresponding Warehouse Stock Transfer Final Receipt Advice request has been received using the inbound service **Stock Transfer Final Receipt Advice – from Warehouse (B2B)**.

apis.Name: CE_WASTETRANSPDOCS_0001
apis.Title: Waste Transportation Documents
apis.ShortText: Retrieve and update existing waste transportation documents using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to display Waste Transportation Documents and information on associated Products and Partners. The Partner and Product data stems from the waste business partners and waste materials linked to the Waste Transportation Document respectively. You can also update some properties of Partners and Documents which is further explained in the business documentation. This synchronous inbound service is based on the OData version 4 protocol and can be consumed by external systems.

apis.Name: INHOUSEREPAIR_0001
apis.Title: In-House Repair
apis.ShortText: Manage in-house repairs using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to initiate the in-house repair process from an external system. You can create in-house repairs and add repair objects. You can also read and update in-house repairs.

apis.Name: CONDITIONCONTRACT_0001
apis.Title: Condition Contract
apis.ShortText: Consume transactional data of Condition Contracts using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service enables you to retrieve and process transactional data of Condition Contracts. You can do the following:

Read, create, and update Condition Contracts.

Lock and release Condition Contracts, as well as lock and release them for settlement. In addition you can also delete Condition Contracts logically.

Determine the accruals amounts for a specific Condition Contract and group them based on several aspects.

Determine the settlement amounts for a specific Condition Contract and group them based on several aspects.

Read and create new entries in the business volume selection criteria of the Condition Contract, as well as update and delete the entries.

Read and create new entries in the settlement calendar of the Condition Contract, as well as update and delete the entries.

Read the status of the Condition Contract.

Read and create new condition records, as well as update and delete them, set a condition record as invalid, and revoke the invalidity.

Read and change the validity of the condition records.

Read and create new condition record scales in a condition record, as well as delete them.

Read and create new condition record texts in a condition record, as well as update and delete them.

apis.Name: API_COMPANYCODE_SRV
apis.Title: Company Code - Read
apis.ShortText: Read company code master data using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to retrieve company codes and their properties like name, country and currency.

apis.Name: CO_FKK_CA_FACTORINGCLEARING_O
apis.Title: Factoring - Clearing Data
apis.ShortText: Transfer factoring data from Contract Accounting (FI-CA) to an external system
apis.Description:
This asynchronous service enables you to transfer data to the factor's system.

Using this outbound service, you can forward clearing and clearing resets for sold receivables to the factor so that the appropriate transfer postings can be executed.

apis.Name: CE_DANGEROUSGDSCLASSFCTN_0001
apis.Title: Dangerous Goods Classification
apis.ShortText: Read dangerous goods classification data and calculate points for the ADR/RID quantity exemption for products using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This service can read data of the dangerous goods classification data including labeling information from the Product Compliance solution. In addition, it can calculate points for the exemption for quantities carried per transport unit according to ADR/RID 1.1.3.6 for the entire transport order and for each item included in a transport order. The service provides the dangerous goods classification data including labeling information and the calculated quantity exemption points to external applications to support the creation of transport documents with dangerous goods data and transportation planning.

You can apply any of the filters provided or read all existing data.

apis.Name: API_RESPYM_TEAM_CONFIG_SRV_0001
apis.Title: Responsibility Management Team Configurations - Read
apis.ShortText: Read details about team configurations in Responsibility Management using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You can read team categories, team types, responsibility attributes, functions assigned to team categories, and responsibility attributes and functions assigned to team types. Each of these entities supports filtering of their properties and the properties of their associations. If you have any problems trying to read these entities because of authorizations or the given filter criteria, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: _SCMTMS_CO_CPX_TPNOR_CNC
apis.Title: Freight Order – Cancel
apis.ShortText: Cancel freight orders that were subcontracted to carriers by using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This outbound service allows you to cancel freight orders that were sent to carriers in the freight subcontracting process. As a shipper, you can cancel a freight order if it is not required to be executed by the carrier anymore. The service contains a transportation document node, and this node contains the freight order ID. Once the message is sent, the freight order lifecycle status is updated and shows that it has been cancelled by the shipper.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_MERCHANDISECATEGORY_0002-v2
apis.Title: Merchandise Category (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create and maintain merchandise category data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This service enables you to create, read, update, and delete merchandise category data.
It includes assignment of characteristic to merchandise category, assignment of merchandise category to merchandise category hierarchy node, and characteristic value restriction.

apis.Name: FKCMANAGECONTRACTACCOUNT
apis.Title: Contract Account – Manage
apis.ShortText: Transfer Contract Account data from an external system to Contract Accounting (FI-CA) with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: With this service, you can create and retrieve contract accounts. Additionally, you can send updates of already existing contract accounts.

apis.Name: MRPCHANGEREQUESTREJECTION_0001
apis.Title: MRP Change Request Rejection – Read
apis.ShortText: Read change request rejections using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This synchronous inbound service enables external systems to read the rejection codes for change requests that are currently configured, along with their descriptions. Change request rejections can be assigned to responses to change requests to give additional information about why a change request was rejected. This service supports only the GET operation.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CNSLDTNFINANCIALMANAGEMENTAREA_0001-v1
apis.Title: Consolidation Financial Management Area
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation financial management areas using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation financial management area is a financial management area that can be used for financial consolidation in group reporting. It can either be a financial management area that’s been defined in an area other than group reporting, or it can be a financial management area that’s been specifically defined for exclusive use in group reporting.

apis.Name: CE_CA_RSM_TEAM_MANAGE_0001
apis.Title: Responsibility Management Teams
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, and delete team details in Responsibility Management using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service allows you to create team details like header, owner, member, member function, attributes, and hierarchy of parent and child teams. You can perform read, update, and delete operations on team details. You can also perform other operations like prepone team header start date and unassign team owner and team member function. The service returns an appropriate success or error response while performing these operations.

apis.Name: CE_LEGALCONTEXT_0001
apis.Title: Legal Context - Read
apis.ShortText: Read legal contexts using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Legal contexts are templates for legal transactions that predefines how a legal transaction must be processed; what information must be provided; which parties are involved and so on. The service contains legal context and legal context text nodes. The information sent in the request pay load is used while working with a legal context, including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations. Once the legal context is available, the legal context ID is sent in the response. If there are any issues in this process, the system displays error messages in the response. For more information, refer to the business documentation of this API.

apis.Name: CE_PURCHASINGORGANIZATION_0001
apis.Title: Purchasing Organization - Read
apis.ShortText: Read purchasing organizations through an API call from a source system outside SAP S/4HANA Cloud
apis.Description: This service enables you to read the purchasing organizations in SAP S/4HANA Cloud from a source system outside SAP S/4HANA Cloud. It gets the details of the purchasing organizations in the system, such as purchasing organization ID, name, and company code.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_WAREHOUSESTOCKTRANSFERFINALREC-v1
apis.Title: Stock Transfer Final Receipt Advice – from Warehouse (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Complete the processing of all partial goods receipt postings and update the inbound delivery data using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You use this API to update delivery quantity, gross weight, volume, and other relevant delivery data after all partial goods receipt postings for an inbound delivery have been completed. The inbound delivery then reflects the values processed in a third-party logistics warehouse management system. After this request has been successfully processed, the goods movement status at the item and header level is set to "Completed", and no further partial goods receipt postings are allowed. As a response to this request, a Warehouse Stock Transfer Final Receipt Advice Confirmation message is sent to a third-party logistics warehouse management system.

apis.Name: SETTLMTDOC_0001
apis.Title: Settlement Document
apis.ShortText: Consume Settlement Documents in SAP S/4HANA Cloud that can be used by external applications with an API call of this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
You can use this OData-based service to do the following:

Read the Settlement Documents on header and item level.

Release Settlement Documents that were blocked to accounting and where the application status was not set.

Reverse Settlement Documents.

Read the relevant pricing elements for the Settlement Document header and item level.

Complete Settlement Documents.

Revoke the completion of Settlement Documents.

Read the relevant partners for the Settlement Document header and item level.

apis.Name: API_EQUIPMENT
apis.Title: Equipment
apis.ShortText: Create, update, and read equipment using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This service contains equipment, long text, partner function, warranty, class, characteristic, and characteristic value nodes. The information is sent in the request as a payload.

The request payload contains all information required to create or update an equipment. All the information in the payload is used to create or update an equipment including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations. Once the equipment has been created, the equipment number is sent in the response with the data included in the equipment.

If the input in the request is not as expected when you create or update an equipment, the system displays appropriate error or warning messages in the response.

apis.Name: CE_FREIGHTUNIT_0001
apis.Title: Freight Unit (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Update and cancel freight units using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A freight unit is a set of goods that are transported together across the entire transportation chain. Freight units come from documents like sales orders, sales scheduling agreements, purchase orders, or stock transport orders. During planning, freight units are assigned to transportation orders.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_SALESORDERWITHOUTCHARGE_0001-v1
apis.Title: Sales Order Without Charge (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create, read, and update sales orders without charge with this OData V4 API
apis.Description:
In every API call, you can make use of the following operations:
 - You can read entire sales orders without charge or only parts of the data, using the provided filters.
 - You can create sales orders without charge. You can use deep insert requests, that is, you create a header plus at least one of the following entities: header partner, header text, item, item partner, and item text.
 - For existing sales orders without charge, you can create the following sub-entities on their own: header partner, header text, item, item partner, and item text.
 - For existing sales orders without charge, you can update the following entities (that is, you can change the content of their properties): header, header partner, header text, item, item partner, and item text.
 - For existing sales orders without charge, you can delete the following entities: header partner, header text, item, item partner, and item text.

For every operation, you can call the API in a synchronous or asynchronous mode. In an asynchronous mode, you can fetch the response from a separate URL later.

apis.Name: JOURNALENTRYBULKLEDGERCREATION
apis.Title: Journal Entry by Ledger - Post (Asynchronous)
apis.ShortText: Post journal entries asynchronously by ledger from external systems to your system using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to upload multiple journal entry documents in one payload with ledger group information on header level for each to create accounting documents in the system. The service supports one journal entry header and multiple general ledger items for each journal entry. Resulting messages will be sent back via outbound service.

apis.Name: CE_DIRECTACTIVITYALLOCATION_0001
apis.Title: Accounting Activity Allocation – Read, Create
apis.ShortText: Read, create, and reverse accounting activity allocations using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read, create, and reverse accounting activity allocations.

apis.Name: API_BILL_OF_MATERIAL_SRV_0002
apis.Title: Bills of Material
apis.ShortText: Maintain bills of material using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service enables you to read, create, update, and delete bills of material with and without version. The service is based on the OData protocol and can be consumed in SAP Fiori apps and on other user interfaces.

The service contains either no header, one header, or multiple headers for the specified material and none or more items for each header.

apis.Name: CO_SDBIL_ESR_BD_CONF_OUT
apis.Title: Billing Document - Send Creation Confirmation
apis.ShortText: Send confirmations for newly created billing documents by using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: For each request to create billing documents that is received through the inbound service *Billing Document - Create*, this outbound service response confirms the successful creation of billing documents. If the system was unable to create specific billing documents or billing items, the service provides information about why creation failed.

apis.Name: CABILLABLEITEM_0001
apis.Title: Convergent Invoicing Billable Item
apis.ShortText: Create and read Billable Items in Convergent Invoicing using this inbound service
apis.Description:
This API enables you to:
 - create billable items in Convergent Invoicing.
 - read billable items in Convergent Invoicing. You can read entire billable items or only parts of the data, using the provided filters.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_GHSLABELINGASSESSMENT_0001-v1
apis.Title: GHS Labeling Assessment
apis.ShortText: Read, create, update, delete, release, set to historical, and create a new version of labeling assessments based on the Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals (GHS) for unpackaged products, raw materials, and substances
apis.Description: Information on the Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals (GHS) is included in a safety data sheet. For example, the classification of a product is used in section 2 of the safety data sheet for the EU, and the classification of its contained hazardous ingredients is used in section 3, if applicable. The requirements are based on the UN Purple Book and vary by country and region. This service can create and release new versions of GHS labeling assessments for unpackaged products, raw materials, and substances for further use by external systems.

apis.Name: CO_LEIDW_WAREHOUSE_STOCK_TRANS
apis.Title: Warehouse Stock Transfer Shipment Advice – Send to Warehouse (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Inform a third-party logistics provider that a shipment of product is being sent to the remote warehouse with this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This service enables a supplier to inform a third-party logistics provider that a shipment of product is being sent to the remote warehouse. This message is sent to a third-party logistics provider.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_PRODCMPLNCPHRSENABLEDFIELD_0001-v1
apis.Title: Phrase Enabled Field
apis.ShortText: Read phrase-enabled field data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This service can read the data of phrase-enabled fields, including assigned phrases and their translated texts. This service doesn't allow changes to the phrases or translations.

You can apply any of the filters provided or read all existing data.

#

apis.Name: PRODUCTSUBSTITUTIONCTRL_0001
apis.Title: Product Substitution Control
apis.ShortText: Manage product substitution controls using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create control and control descriptions. Additionally, product substitution groups can be assigned to a Product Substitution Control.

apis.Name: CO_MDG_BP_RPLCTCO
apis.Title: Business Partner - Send Confirmation from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to Client
apis.ShortText: Send Business Partner data replication status using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The BusinessPartnerSUITEBulkReplicateConfirmation_Out SOAP service enables you to send the status of Business Partner data replication from SAP S/4HANA Cloud system to client system.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_PURCHASEORDERREQUEST_IN_V2-v1
apis.Title: Create, update, cancel, or close replicated purchase orders
apis.ShortText: DefinitionCreate, update, cancel, or close replicated purchase orders using this asynchronous inbound SOAP service
apis.Description: This SOAP service enables you to replicate purchase orders from an external system. This service is specifically useful if you are using SAP Ariba Buying with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition as the backend system.

apis.Name: API_BUS_SITN_MSTRDATA_SRV
apis.Title: Business Situation Type - Read
apis.ShortText: Read master data from the standard framework for Situation Handling using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This API is based on the OData protocol. It provides the data belonging to situation templates, situation types, actions, data context, and the texts in all available languages in the payload’s response. For example, you can use this API data to link to master data from the standard framework in an external app. Only use the version 2 of this API. Do not use version 1 as this version will be deprecated.

apis.Name: API_JOURNALENTRYITEMBASIC_SRV
apis.Title: Journal Entry Item - Read
apis.ShortText: Read journal entry items from the Universal Entries Line Item table and the referenced company code, cost center, and profit center information in detail using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains journal entry items and master data of the referenced company code, cost center, profit center. This API call is based on the OData protocol, and can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces

apis.Name: API_MANAGE_WF_AVAILABILITY
apis.Title: Workforce Daily Availability
apis.ShortText: Manage Daily Availability data for Workforce using this inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create, read, update, and delete the (CRUD) daily availability information into the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system from your external HR system when you are not using the SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central system.

apis.Name: MANAGEUSERDEFINEDCRITERIA_0001
apis.Title: Manage User-Defined Criteria
apis.ShortText: Create, edit, delete and read the user-defined criteria for supplier evaluation in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system using this inbound service
apis.Description: This inbound service enables consumers to create, update, read, and delete the user-defined criteria for supplier evaluation in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system. This service is based on the OData protocol, and can be consumed by apps and other interfaces.

apis.Name: CO_NGC_SOAP_CHARCBULKREPREQOUT
apis.Title: Characteristic Data for Classification - Replicate (Asynchronous, Outbound)
apis.ShortText: Replicate classification characteristics from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to client
apis.Description: Classification characteristics can be used as additional properties of objects. This service enables you to send classification characteristics to client systems using DRF.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CO_WAREHOUSE_ORDER_TASK-v1
apis.Title: Warehouse Order and Task - Send to External System (A2A)
apis.ShortText: Send open warehouse orders and warehouse tasks to an external system with this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: You can use this API to send open warehouse orders and warehouse tasks to an external system, such as an Automated Storage and Retrieval System (AS/RS), or a third-party Material Flow System (MFS). The external system then processes the warehouse tasks.

apis.Name: CE_PRAREVENUEACCTDOCUMENT_0001
apis.Title: PRA Revenue Accounting Document - Post/Simulate/Read
apis.ShortText: Production and Revenue Accounting Document inbound service allows read, simulation and posting of Revenue Accounting Document
apis.Description:
You can read the Revenue Accounting Document Header, Items, Tax, Marketing and Tax information related to Revenue Accounting Document.

You can simulate and Posting Revenue Accounting Document

apis.Name: API_RAWSUBSTANCE
apis.Title: Raw Substance - Read
apis.ShortText: Read raw substance header data and composition using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service contains data belonging to the raw substance header, such as creation date and header status, as well as other important information, for example material assignments, language-dependent and independent descriptions, estimated price, total solids, and density. You can also read a raw substance's standard composition, as well as diet, religious, GMO information.

apis.Name: API_SALES_ORDER_SRV
apis.Title: Sales Order (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, and delete sales orders with this synchronous OData API
apis.Description:
In every API call, you can make use of the following operations:
 - You can read entire sales orders or only parts of the data, using the provided filters.
 - You can create sales orders. You can use deep insert requests, that is, you create a header plus at least one of the following entities: header partner, header partner address, header pricing element, header billing plan, header billing plan item, header text, payment plan, header related object, item, item partner, item partner address, item pricing element, item billing plan, item billing plan item, item text, and item related object. 
If the header already exists, you can create the following sub-entities on their own: header partner, header pricing element, header text, payment plan, header related object, item partner, item pricing element, item text, and item related object.
 - For existing sales orders, you can create new items. You can use deep insert requests, that is, you create an item plus at least one of the following entities: item partner, item partner address, item pricing element, item billing plan, item billing plan item, item text, and item related object. If the item already exists, you can create the following sub-entities on their own: item partner, item pricing element, item text, item related object, and item schedule line.
 - For existing sales orders, you can update the following entities (that is, you can change the content of their properties): header, header partner, header partner address, header pricing element, header billing plan, header billing plan item, header text, payment plan, item, item partner, item partner address, item pricing element, item billing plan, item billing plan item, item text, and item schedule line.
 - For existing sales orders, you can delete the following entities: header, header partner, header pricing element, header billing plan item, header text, payment plan, header related object, item, item partner, item pricing element, item billing plan item, item text, item related object, and item schedule line.
 - You can accept or deny approval requests for sales orders that cannot be processed without the consent of an approver.

apis.Name: CO_CRMS4_SRVC_NOTIFY_REQUEST
apis.Title: Service Confirmation - Notification Processing (Asynchronous)
apis.ShortText: Inform an external system about the presence of a service confirmation using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: Your SAP S/4HANA Cloud system triggers a notification to inform the external system about the presence of a service confirmation. To receive the notification, an endpoint for this service must be implemented in the external system.

apis.Name: API_TRSYPOSFLOW_SRV
apis.Title: Treasury Position Flow – Read
apis.ShortText: Read treasury position flows using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You can use this inbound service to read treasury position flows. The treasury position is the most detailed level in which you can break down the balance sheet accounts in the Treasury and Risk Management ledger. The treasury position flows are generated by the operative or derived business transactions to update the position components of the treasury positions. The service provides you with detailed information about each selected treasury position flow, such as amount, currency, dates, differentiation criteria of the affected treasury position, business transaction, and update type.

apis.Name: ECC_OUTBOUNDDELIVERYCWRRC
apis.Title: Outbound Delivery with Reference to a Sales Order – Create (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create an outbound delivery with reference to a customer order with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create an outbound delivery with reference to a customer order. Once the outbound delivery has been created, the outbound delivery number is sent in the response. If there are any issues during the creation of the outbound delivery, error messages will be displayed in the response. It can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces.

apis.Name: CHARCBULKRPLCTREQ_IN
apis.Title: Characteristic Data for Classification - Replicate (Asynchronous, Inbound)
apis.ShortText: Replicate classification characteristics from client to SAP S/4HANA Cloud
apis.Description: Classification characteristics can be used as additional properties of objects. This service enables you to create, update or delete classification characteristics in the system.

apis.Name: RECONTRACTTYPE_0001
apis.Title: Real Estate Contract Type
apis.ShortText: Read Real Estate Contract Types using this inbound service
apis.Description: The Service allows users to read the Real Estate Contract Type separately. Create, Update and Delete operations are not supported for this service. It focuses solely on additional read functionalities.

apis.Name: API_FINPLANNINGDATA_SRV
apis.Title: Financial Planning Data - Write
apis.ShortText: Write financial plan data to Plan Data Line Items table from one system to another using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service exports financial plan data between systems. This API call is based on the OData protocol, and can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces

apis.Name: PLANTEXCLUSION_0001
apis.Title: Plant Substitution Exclusion
apis.ShortText: Manage exclusion of substitute plants in plant substitutions using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create plant exclusions based on various factors like time range validities, sales organization-specific and distribution channel-specific. Additionally, predefined groups can be applied on these plant exclusions.

apis.Name: QUALITYTASK_0001
apis.Title: Quality Task
apis.ShortText: Read, create, or update data of a quality task with task origin defect using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You can read the quality task header and long texts of kind detailed description and processor notes. You can create new or update existing instances with task origin defect. The usage of follow-up actions together with a task code is currently not supported via the API.

apis.Name: CHARCBULKRPLCTCONF_IN
apis.Title: Characteristic Data for Classification - Confirmation (Asynchronous, Inbound)
apis.ShortText: Replicate classification characteristic confirmations from client to SAP S/4HANA Cloud
apis.Description: Classification characteristics can be used as additional properties of objects. This service enables you to receive confirmation messages after classification characteristic processing.

apis.Name: API_MAINTENANCEBOM
apis.Title: Maintenance Bill of Material
apis.ShortText: Create, update and delete the Maintenance Bill of Material using the asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create, update, or delete the bill of material header and item. It is based on the OData protocol and can be consumed in SAP Fiori apps and on other user interfaces. The service contains header and item nodes for the bill of material. When performing an operation, the necessary information is sent in the request as a payload. All information used when creating a maintenance BOM is checked for restricted values and authorizations.

apis.Name: REINTEGRATIONOBJECT_0001
apis.Title: Real Estate Integration Object
apis.ShortText: Manage Real Estate Integration Objects using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains the Integration Object root as well as several subnodes in order to provide further assignments. Such child objects are for example Object Relations, Contract Assignments, Cost Object Assignments, Conditions, Fixed Asset Assignments and more. All entities support CRUD operations and can therefore be created, read, updated as well as deleted. If there are any issues during processing, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: CO_CRMS4_SRVC_CONF_BLK_REQUEST
apis.Title: Service Confirmation (Bulk) - Confirm Processing (Asynchronous)
apis.ShortText: Communicate with an external system when a service confirmation is created or changed using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: A confirmation is sent when service confirmations have been processed using the inbound asynchronous SOAP service *ServiceConfirmationBulkRequest_In*. The confirmation is not sent when service confirmations are processed in your SAP S/4HANA Cloud system.

apis.Name: CO_KEY_MAP_RPLCTCO
apis.Title: Key Mapping - Receive Confirmation from Client
apis.ShortText: Receive key mapping replication status using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The KeyMappingBulkReplicateConfirmation_In SOAP service interface enables you to get confirmation about key mapping from the client systems.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CNSLDTNFINANCIALDATASOURCE_0001-v1
apis.Title: Consolidation Financial Data Source
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation financial data sources using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation financial data source is a financial data source that can be used for financial consolidation in group reporting. It can either be a financial data source that’s been defined in an area other than group reporting, or it can be a financial data source that’s been specifically defined for exclusive use in group reporting.

apis.Name: CO_PPINT_MRPCHANGE_REQUEST_CON
apis.Title: MRP Change Request Confirmation - Send
apis.ShortText: Send a multiple number of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) change request confirmations using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to send MRP change request confirmations from an SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system to an external supplier system. The MRP change request confirmations are sent when the sending is triggered by the app “Schedule sending of MRP Change Requests” and if they meet the filter criteria for distribution defined in the communication arrangement.

apis.Name: CE_VARCNFCHARCGROUP_0001
apis.Title: Variant Configuration Characteristic Group
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete variant configuration characteristic groups with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
For each characteristic group, you can maintain language-dependent texts and assign/unassign characteristics to it.

Currently, time dependent versioning is not supported yet.

apis.Name: VARCONFIGURATIONPROFILE_0001
apis.Title: Variant Configuration Profile
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete variant configuration profile data for products on a specific date with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Variant configuration profiles are used to assign dependencies to configurable products and to define configuration parameters for the products. Variant configuration profiles are prerequisites for configuring a product using variant configuration. All actions support change numbers.

apis.Name: CO_FNDEI_MATERIALGROUP_RL
apis.Title: Material Group – Replicate (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Replicate material groups using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description:
This service enables you to replicate material groups from an SAP S/4HANA system to an external system. It is based on the SOAP protocol where sent messages are monitored using Application Interface Framework (AIF).

The service contains MessageHeader, ListCompleteTransmissionIndicator, TransmissionStartDateTime, and MaterialGroup nodes. The MaterialGroup node contains the list of material groups replicated from the SAP S/4HANA system. The information is sent as an XML message to the target system using the Data Replication Framework (DRF).

apis.Name: CE_MERCHANDISECATEGORY_0001
apis.Title: Merchandise Category (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create and maintain merchandise category data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This service enables you to create, read, update, and delete merchandise category data. It includes merchandise 
category description, assignment of characteristic to merchandise category, assignment of merchandise category to merchandise category hierarchy node, and characteristic value restriction

apis.Name: CE_POS_FINANCIAL_TRANS_CREATE_REQ_IN
apis.Title: POS Financial Transactions - Create
apis.ShortText: Use this asynchronous inbound service to replicate POS financial transactions in SAP S/4HANA Cloud system
apis.Description:
This service enables you to transfer financial transactions related POS data to SAP S/4HANA Cloud system such as:
 - Transfer of posting between different accounts within the store. For example, between the small change safe and cash registers.
 - Settlement of customer outstanding invoices in a store.
 - Payment of supplier invoice using the cash reserved in a store.
 - Transfer of other pay-in and pay-out transactions including postage costs taken from the till (cash register) and payments to temporary staff.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CNSLDTNSEGMENTHIERARCHY_0001-v1
apis.Title: Consolidation Segment Hierarchy
apis.ShortText: Read consolidation segment hierarchies using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation segment hierarchy is a structure of segments in consolidation. The service provides general information about the hierarchy, like the validity timeframe, as well as structural information about the defined nodes and their consolidation segment leaf assignments.

apis.Name: CE_PRAINTERNALMARKETING_0001
apis.Title: PRA Internal Marketing Rate
apis.ShortText: Production and Revenue Accounting Internal Marketing Rate is an inbound service which allows maintenance of internal marketing rate at well completion or measurement point level
apis.Description: This service allows create, update, delete and read of Internal Marketing Rate header and transaction records.

apis.Name: WAREHOUSERESOURCE_0001
apis.Title: Warehouse Resource (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Integrate external applications with warehouse resources with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
In every API call, you can make use of the following operations:
 - You can retrieve warehouse resources. Apply any of the filters provided or retrieve all existing data.
 - You can create and delete warehouse resources.
 - You can update existing warehouse resources (log on, log off).
 - You can retrieve the sequence of queues that is assigned to the resource group of a warehouse resource.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_STOCKTRANSPORTORDER_0001-v1
apis.Title: Stock Transport Order
apis.ShortText: Create, update, or delete stock transport orders using this synchronous service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create stock transport orders through an API call from a source service outside the SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system. Furthermore, the service enables you to read, update or delete stock transport orders. This service is based on the OData V4 protocol.

apis.Name: API_INBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV
apis.Title: Inbound Delivery (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Process inbound deliveries using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create, read, update and delete inbound deliveries. It can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces.

apis.Name: CO_FNDEI_INCOTERMS_RL
apis.Title: Incoterms – Replicate (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Replicate incoterms using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description:
This service enables you to replicate incoterms from an SAP S/4HANA system to an external system. It is based on the SOAP protocol where sent messages are monitored using Application Interface Framework (AIF).

The service contains MessageHeader, ListCompleteTransmissionIndicator, TransmissionStartDateTime, and Incoterms nodes. The Incoterms node contains the list of incoterms replicated from the SAP S/4HANA system. The information is sent as an XML message to the target system using the Data Replication Framework (DRF).

apis.Name: CADOCUMENTMANAGE_0001
apis.Title: Contract Accounting Document – Manage
apis.ShortText: Retrieve and update documents in Contract Accounting (FI-CA) using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
Retrieve a list of documents. Read data on document header, document business partner line items and document general ledger line items.

Update document header and document business partner line items. Create and delete business locks on existing business partner line items.

apis.Name: ECC_OUTBOUNDDELIVERYCNCRC
apis.Title: Outbound Delivery – Cancel (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Cancel an outbound delivery with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to cancel an outbound delivery. Once the outbound delivery has been deleted, the information about the deletion is sent in the response. If there are any issues during the deletion of the delivery, error messages will be displayed in the response. It can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces.

apis.Name: API_SERVICE_ORDER_TEMPLATE_SRV
apis.Title: Service Order Template
apis.ShortText: Manage Service Order Template provided in a payload using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
You can use this service to integrate external applications with Service Order Template processing in Service in SAP S/4HANA Cloud. In each API call, you can use the following operations:
 - Retrieve Service Order Template.
 - Create Service Order Template. Note: You must use “deep insert” requests (a header plus the following entities: Header details, Header text, Service Items and Person responsible).
 - Create an item reference object, item object list and an item text for existing Service Order Template items.
 - Update the header, header text, item and item text of existing Service Order Template.
 - Delete the item, item reference object, item object list and item text of existing Service Order Template.

apis.Name: API_PURGPRCGCONDITIONRECORD_SRV
apis.Title: Condition Record for Pricing in Purchasing
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, and delete condition records for pricing in Purchasing using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Consumers of this inbound service can create, read, update, and delete condition records inside your system by using OData requests. The service contains entities for condition record, validity of condition record, pricing scale, and condition supplement.

apis.Name: API_BANKDETAIL_SRV
apis.Title: Bank - Read
apis.ShortText: Enable external applications to read bank master data from your SAP S/4HANA Cloud system using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains bank country, bank key, bank name, SWIFT code, bank group, bank number, region, street name, city, and branch.

apis.Name: CE_CO_SDSLS_ESR_SALES_QTAN_REPL
apis.Title: Sales Quotation - Replicate (A2A)
apis.ShortText: Replicate sales quotations in bulk to external systems with this asynchronous outbound SOAP service
apis.Description:
A sales quotation consists of a header and one or more items. The header contains data that is relevant for all items. You can apply any of the filters provided or replicate all existing data. With a correct setup of the communication arrangement, a replication is triggered when a sales quotation is created, changed, or deleted in your system.

The replication logic is handled by the data replication framework (DRF).

apis.Name: API_PURCHASEREQ_PROCESS_SRV
apis.Title: Purchase Requisition
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete purchase requisitions through an API call from a source system outside SAP S/4HANA Cloud
apis.Description: This service helps you to create, read, update and delete purchase requisitions through an API call from a source system outside SAP S/4HANA Cloud. The service contains header, item, account assignment, delivery address, and item text nodes. The information is sent in the request as a payload. The information is used when creating, reading or updating a purchase requisition, with appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations.

apis.Name: WARRANTYCLAIM_0001
apis.Title: Warranty Claim
apis.ShortText: Create, read, and update warranty claims with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create, update, read warranty claim. Note that you must use association request (claim header plus claim version entities) to create warranty claim , warranty claim version as well. The service allows to update and read claim versions and for claim items it can do create, update, read and delete operations. You can read entire warranty claim header, claim versions, claim items or only parts of the data, using the provided filters.

apis.Name: PRODUCT_0001
apis.Title: Product
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update of the master data for products using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service supports following operations: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE. You can create, read, update, and delete product master data at the entity level.

apis.Name: SLSPRCGACCESSSEQUENCE_0001
apis.Title: Access Sequence for Pricing in Sales – Read
apis.ShortText: Read access sequences that the system uses to find valid condition records for pricing in sales
apis.Description: Consumer of this inbound service can read the access sequences inside your system by sending OData requests.

apis.Name: API_SUPPLIER_ACTIVITY_SRV
apis.Title: Procurement-Related Activity
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete procurement-related activities using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create, read, update and delete procurement-related activities through an API call.

apis.Name: CE_ABOPRUN_0001
apis.Title: Advanced Backorder Processing Run
apis.ShortText: Manage confirmation of individual sales documents and stock transfer relevant requirements using this inbound service
apis.Description: An advanced backorder processing run checks product availability when the demand or supply situation has changed in the order fulfilment process and need to check if previously calculated confirmations for requirements in business documents are still realistic.

apis.Name: CA_BEH_SUBSCRIPTION_SRV
apis.Title: Business Events Subscription
apis.ShortText: Maintain business events subscriptions using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This service enables the caller to create a subscription for business events for a given subscriber. A subscription is required to activate the events so they are delivered to the event queue where they can be read. The information sent in the request as a payload is used to maintain a business events subscription, make the appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations. Once an event subscription is maintained, the system displays a success or failure message in the response.

#

apis.Name: CE_WHSEFIXEDBINASSIGNMENT_0001
apis.Title: Warehouse Fixed Bin Assignment (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Integrate external applications with fixed bin assignments with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
In every API call, you can make use of the following operations:
 - You can retrieve fixed bin assignments. Apply any of the filters provided or retrieve all existing data.
 - You can create fixed bin assignments.
 - You can update existing fixed bin assignments.
 - You can delete fixed bin assignments.

#

apis.Name: API_SLSPRICINGCONDITIONRECORD_SRV
apis.Title: Condition Record for Pricing in Sales
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, and delete condition records for pricing in Sales using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Consumers of this inbound service can create, read, update, and delete condition records inside condition record, validity of condition record, pricing scale, and condition supplement.

apis.Name: API_PARTNERCOMPANY_SRV
apis.Title: Trading Partner - Read
apis.ShortText: Read trading partner master data using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to retrieve trading partners and their texts.

apis.Name: CE_SRCGPROJITEMDEMANDCONFCODE_0001
apis.Title: Sourcing Project Demand Confirmation Code – Read
apis.ShortText: Read the available demand confirmation codes using this inbound synchronous service

apis.Name: API_BUFFER_PROFILE_SRV
apis.Title: Buffer Profile - Read
apis.ShortText: Read buffer profile data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains header and item entities. For read operations, filter information must be sent according to the OData protocol. All filter information is utilized when retrieving buffer profile. The buffer profile assigned to plant and the buffer profile details are sent in the response. If any issues arise when buffer profiles are retrieved, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: API_CN_BANK_RECONCILIAITON_SRV
apis.Title: Bank Reconciliation Statement - Read, Reconcile (Synchronous)
apis.ShortText: Generate bank reconciliation statement for China using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains bank reconciliation items, bank reconciliation statements, journal entry items and bank statement items. The bank reconciliation items provide the G/L account balance, bank account balance and reconciliation status of all house bank accounts. The “StartReconcile” operation can start automatic reconciliation and generate bank reconciliation statement in the backend. If there are any issues when the bank reconciliation statement is created, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: CE_CO_PPINT_WORK_CTR_GROUPS_OUT
apis.Title: WorkCenter Group - Replicate
apis.ShortText: Replicate work center groups using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to replicate work center groups from SAP S/4HANA Cloud system to external systems. A work center group is a grouping of work centers according to capacity requirements planning criteria. Work center group is used in capacity planning to cumulate available capacity and capacity requirements. By assigning multiple work centers under one work center group, one can immediately view the capacity demands and remaining capacities of the work centers aggregated to a work center group. A work center group may contain further group(s) within it.

apis.Name: API_SALES_CONTRACT_SRV
apis.Title: Sales Contract (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, and delete sales contracts using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains header and item entities, as well as their sub-entities for partners and pricing elements. Once the sales contract has been created, the sales contract number is sent in the response with the data included in the sales contract. If there are any issues when creating, retrieving, updating, or deleting the sales contract, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: CE_CONSOLIDATIONUNITTASKRUN_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Unit Task Run
apis.ShortText: Read and manage consolidation task execution for consolidation units in group reporting using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to read, block, unblock, reset and execute a consolidation task that is run for a consolidation unit. These actions are possible in the context of a consolidation chart of accounts, consolidation version, fiscal year, and period.

apis.Name: FKCMANAGEPROVIDERCONTRACT
apis.Title: Provider Contract – Manage
apis.ShortText: Transfer provider contract data from an external system to Contract Accounting (FI-CA) using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: With this service, you can create and retrieve provider contracts. Updates of existing provider contracts are also supported.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_COMPLIANCEREQUIREMENTVERSION_0001-v1
apis.Title: Compliance Requirement Version - Read
apis.ShortText: Read compliance requirement version data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service can read the data of compliance requirement versions, including IDs of the compliance requirement and its version, the name of the version, its effective date, application component, domain, compliance pattern, and activation status. You can apply any of the filters provided or read all existing data.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_PHYSICALINVENTORYDOCUMENT_0001-v1
apis.Title: Physical Inventory Document
apis.ShortText: Use this synchronous inbound service to read and create physical inventory documents
apis.Description: You can count items and post differences on both document and item level. The service can be consumed by external systems.

apis.Name: API_INBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV_0002
apis.Title: Inbound Delivery (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Process inbound deliveries using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create, read, update and delete inbound deliveries. It can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_MEMORECORD_0001-v1
apis.Title: Memo Record
apis.ShortText: Manage memo records using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service can be consumed by external applications to manage memo records in cash management. Memo records are used to record planned or expected cash flows for purposes such as cash positioning, planning, and cash flow reconciliation. A memo record contains information such as the transaction date, amount, bank account ID, and account assignment information like profit center, fund, grant, and so on. With this service, you can perform actions such as create, update, activate and deactivate memo records, and mark memo records for deletion.

apis.Name: CO_PPINT_WORK_CENTER_INFO_OUT
apis.Title: Work Center - Replicate
apis.ShortText: Replicate work centers using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to replicate work centers from SAP S/4HANA Cloud system to external systems. Work centers belong to the most important master data in the production planning and control system. Work centers are used in task list operations and work orders.

apis.Name: API_SERVICE_QUOTATION_SRV_0002
apis.Title: Service Quotation (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Manage service quotations with the data provided in a payload using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
You can use this service to integrate external applications with service quotation processing in Service in SAP S/4HANA Cloud. In each API call, you can use the following operations:
 - Retrieve service quotations.
 - Create service quotations. Note: You must use “deep insert” requests (a header plus the following entities: header person responsible, header pricing element, header reference object, header text, and item).
 - Create new items for existing service quotations.
 - Create an item reference object, item pricing element, and an item text for existing service quotations items.
 - Update the header, header person responsible, header pricing element, header text, item, item pricing element, and item text of existing service quotations.
 - Delete the header person responsible, header reference object, header pricing element, header text, item, item reference object, item pricing element, and item text of existing service quotations.

apis.Name: PRODTIMEDPDNTSTCK_0001
apis.Title: Time Dependent Stock Levels
apis.ShortText: Create and adjust time dependent stock levels for products with this inbound synchronous service
apis.Description: You can create, read and update the time dependent stock levels such as max stock, reorder point and safety stock. You can also split and merge the stock validity intervals.

apis.Name: PLANNEDORDER_0001
apis.Title: Planned Order
apis.ShortText: Manage planned orders using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains planned order header, planned order capacity and planned order components. The information is sent in the request as a payload. You can read, create, change and delete components of orders and also use this service to schedule planned order operations.

apis.Name: CE_MANAGELOCATION_0001
apis.Title: Location
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, and delete locations in SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service enables you to create, read, update, and delete locations through an API call. You can perform these activities from a source system outside SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system.
The service is based on the OData protocol.

apis.Name: CE_CHANGERECORDHISTORY_IWSV_0001
apis.Title: Change Record - History
apis.ShortText: Reads all change record history in the system
apis.Description: This service allows you to read all change record history. The operation can be used to find, for example, which change records attributes have been modified.

apis.Name: API_COSTCENTERACTIVITYTYPE_SRV
apis.Title: Activity Type - Read (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Read master data of cost center activity types using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read cost center activity type master data in an API call. It is based on the OData protocol and can be consumed in SAP Fiori apps and other user interfaces.

apis.Name: CO_PPKAB_ESR_JITCALL_NOTIF_OUT
apis.Title: Kanban Summarized JIT Call Outbound Notification
apis.ShortText: Notify suppliers about new Kanban Summarized JIT Calls using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The replenishment with Kanban Summarized JIT Calls is used to retrieve materials from a supplier out of the Kanban process. The call for replenishment can happen via the here described outbound SOAP service to the supplier system. The transferred message contains for example the needed material, the quantity, and the requirement date and time.

apis.Name: STATISTICALKEYFIGPOSTINGREQUES
apis.Title: Statistical Key Figure - Post
apis.ShortText: Post statistical key figures from external systems to an S/4HANA Cloud system using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains statistical key figure document header and item nodes.

apis.Name: API_PROD_ORDER_CONFIRMATION_2_SRV
apis.Title: Production Order Confirmation
apis.ShortText: Create, read, and cancel confirmations for production orders using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
You can create time ticket and time event confirmations as well as confirmations on order level, read them, and cancel the confirmations on time ticket, time event, or order level. Before creating a confirmation, you can fetch the proposed data for quantities, work activities, dates and times, personnel data, and goods movements depending on the type of confirmation.

Note: The following operations are available on the API Reference tab but are not supported by this API:
 - POST /ProdnOrdConf2(ConfirmationGroup='{ConfirmationGroup}',ConfirmationCount='{ConfirmationCount}',/to_ProdnOrdConfMatlDocItm
 - POST /ProdnOrdConfMatlDocItm(ConfirmationGroup='{ConfirmationGroup}',ConfirmationCount='{ConfirmationCount}',MaterialDocument='{MaterialDocument}',MaterialDocumentItem='{MaterialDocumentItem}',MaterialDocumentYear='{MaterialDocumentYear}',/to_ProdnOrderConfBatchCharc

apis.Name: API_PAYMENT_METHOD_VALIDATION_SRV
apis.Title: Payment Method – Validate
apis.ShortText: Validate payment methods from SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service makes the following checks: First, whether the payment method used in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central has been mapped with that used in SAP S/4HANA Cloud. The mapping is defined in the configuration step Map Payment Methods Used in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central under Finance -> Accounts Payable -> Automatic Payments in Configure Your Solution, which is part of the Manage Your Solution app. Second, whether values for the following fields exist when requested: IBAN, SWIFT code, Bank account number, Bank key.
