Whether any of these fields are requested is defined in the configuration step Set Up Payment Methods per Country for Payment Transactions under Finance -> Accounts Payable -> Automatic Payments in Configure Your Solution. Third, whether the country for the employee or the country for the bank of the employee in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central can be foreign. This setting is defined in the configuration step Set Up Payment Methods per Company Code for Payment Transactions under Finance -> Accounts Payable -> Automatic Payments in Configure Your Solution. If there are any issues during the validation, the system displays warning messages in the response.

apis.Name: _SCMB_CO_CPX_LOC_BULK_REPL_REQ
apis.Title: Location – Replicate
apis.ShortText: Replicate locations using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This asynchronous outbound service enables you to replicate location from an SAP S/4HANA Cloud system to a client system in an application-to-application (A2A) scenario. This service replicates business partner-related locations, shipping point-related locations, plant related locations, and distribution center-related locations.

apis.Name: SERVICECONFIRMATIONREQUEST_IN
apis.Title: Service Confirmation - Create, Change (Asynchronous)
apis.ShortText: Create or change service confirmations using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains header, item, status, business partner, organizational management, reference object, and text nodes. The information is sent in the request as a payload. All information is used when creating a service confirmation, including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations. Once the service confirmation has been created, the service confirmation ID is sent in the response with the data included in the service confirmation. If there are any issues when the service confirmation is created, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: CO_FKK_CA_FACTOROFFERBULK_OUT
apis.Title: Factoring - Offer Data
apis.ShortText: Transfer factoring data from Contract Accounting (FI-CA) to an external system
apis.Description:
This asynchronous service enables you to transfer data to the factor's system.

Using this outbound service, you can forward the data of the receivables sold to the factor.

apis.Name: REVENUEACCOUNTINGCONTRACTBYORD
apis.Title: Revenue Accounting Contract - Process Order Items
apis.ShortText: Create and update revenue accounting contracts in Contract-Based Revenue Recognition based on incoming operational documents (order items) using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to integrate non-SAP systems with Contract-Based Revenue Recognition. Operational documents (order items) received from a non-SAP system are processed and trigger the creation or update of revenue accounting contracts and performance obligations in Contract-Based Revenue Recognition. Apart from the header node, the message contains the Order Item node, an optional Profitability Supplement node, and a Condition Item node. These nodes transport operational data, data for profitability analysis, and cost and price condition item data respectively.

apis.Name: API_CREDIT_MEMO_REQUEST_SRV
apis.Title: Credit Memo Request (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, and delete credit memo requests with this synchronous OData API
apis.Description:
In every API call, you can make use of the following operations:
 - You can read entire credit memo requests or only parts of the data, using the provided filters.
 - You can create credit memo requests with or without reference to a preceding document. Note that you must use “deep insert” requests (a header plus the following entities: header partner, header pricing element, item, item partner, and item pricing element). You cannot create a credit memo request without including any related entities.
 - For existing credit memo requests, you can create new items. Note that you must use “deep insert” requests (with the following entities: item partner and item pricing element). You cannot create an item without including any related entities.
 - For existing credit memo requests or credit memo request items, you can add additional business partners at header and item levels.
 - For existing credit memo requests, you can update the following entities (that is, you can change the content of their properties): the header, header partner, header pricing element, item, item partner, and item pricing element.
 - For existing credit memo requests, you can delete the header, header partner, header pricing element, item, item partner, and item pricing element.
 - You can accept or deny approval requests for credit memo requests that cannot be processed without the consent of an approver.

apis.Name: CO_FKC_DOC_BLK_CREATE_CONF_OUT
apis.Title: FI-CA Document – Return Status of Bulk Creation to Client System
apis.ShortText: Transfer confirmation data from Contract Accounting (FI-CA) to an external system using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: With this service, you can create a bulk confirmation outbound message for the ***FI-CA Document – Return Status of Bulk Creation to Client System*** service.

apis.Name: API_LEGAL_CATEGORY_SRV
apis.Title: Legal Categories - Read
apis.ShortText: Read legal categories using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Category is one of the objects used to categorize Contexts, Legal Transactions, Templates and Text Blocks. This service contains legal categories and legal category text nodes. Using this service, you can read the legal categories created in the Categories application.

apis.Name: CE_CO_LEIDW_WAREHOUSE_STOCK_TRAN1
apis.Title: Warehouse Stock Transfer Receipt Advice Cancel Confirm – To Warehouse (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Send a Warehouse Stock Transfer Receipt Advice Cancellation Confirmation with this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description:
The system returns this message to the decentralized Warehouse Management System (WMS) in response to a preceding Warehouse Stock Transfer Receipt Advice Cancel Request – From Warehouse (B2B) message for the Warehouse Stock Transfer Receipt Advice. This message updates the decentralized WMS with the execution result of the Warehouse Stock Transfer Receipt Advice Cancel Request – From Warehouse (B2B) message.

It returns the delivery number of the updated Warehouse Stock Transfer Receipt Advice with the actual goods movement posting date and a success message or an error log to the calling system. This message is sent to the decentralized WMS system.

apis.Name: CE_PURCHASEREQUISITION_0001
apis.Title: Purchase Requisition
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete purchase requisitions using this service from a source system outside SAP S/4HANA Cloud
apis.Description: The service contains header, item, account assignment, delivery address, and item text nodes. The information is sent in the request as a payload. The information is used when creating, reading or updating a purchase requisition, with appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations.

apis.Name: CADUNNING_0001
apis.Title: Contract Accounting Dunning - Read
apis.ShortText: Retrieve a list of Contract Accounting (FI-CA) dunning history items using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Read dunning history items for a business partner and read corresponding dunned items with this service.

apis.Name: CE_ENTPROJELMNTDLVBRLTYPE_0001
apis.Title: Enterprise Project - Read Deliverable Type
apis.ShortText: Read the type of project element deliverables using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read the type of project element deliverables along with corresponding descriptions. You can use this service, for example, to retrieve supported values for the corresponding field in the Project Element Deliverable entity of the Enterprise Project service, or to make the descriptions of the deliverable type values available for your custom application.

apis.Name: ENTPROJECTPRIORITYCODE_0001
apis.Title: Enterprise Project - Read Project Priority
apis.ShortText: Read the project priority code list for enterprise projects using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read the project priority code list for enterprise projects. You can use it to make the code list values available for the corresponding Enterprise Project service.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CO_LEIDW_WHS_PART_REC_ADV_CONF-v1
apis.Title: Stock Transfer Partial Receipt Advice Confirmation – to Warehouse (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Use this asynchronous outbound service to send confirmation to a third-party logistics warehouse management system after a single partial goods receipt has been processed
apis.Description: This confirmation message is sent to a third-party logistics warehouse management system after the corresponding Warehouse Stock Transfer Partial Receipt Advice request has been received using the inbound service **Stock Transfer Partial Receipt Advice – from Warehouse (B2B)**.

apis.Name: CO_MMIM_MATSTOCK_REPLICATION
apis.Title: Material Stock - Replicate
apis.ShortText: Use this asynchronous outbound service to replicate material stock quantity information
apis.Description:
This communication scenario enables you to replicate material stock quantity information to an external system such as SAP Hybris Commerce.

The message can contain multiple records that fulfill the given filter criteria, one for each stock type.

The records contain the stock identifying fields of Inventory Management, along with quantity and unit of measure.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNPLANT_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Plant
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation plants using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation plant is a plant that can be used for financial consolidation in group reporting. It can either be a plant that’s been defined in an area other than group reporting, or it can be a plant that’s been specifically defined for exclusive use in group reporting.

apis.Name: OP_REINTEGRATIONOBJECT_0001
apis.Title: Real Estate Integration Object
apis.ShortText: Manage Real Estate Integration Objects using this inbound service

apis.Name: EQUIPMENTSTRUCLIST_0001
apis.Title: Equipment Hierarchy – Read
apis.ShortText: Read hierarchy of an equipment using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This service allows you to read the hierarchy of an equipment along with a list of subequipment that is installed on the superior equipment.

The request contains all the information that is necessary to read an equipment hierarchy. If the input in the request is not as expected, the system displays appropriate error or warning messages in the response.

apis.Name: CO_FNDEI_CURRENCY_RL
apis.Title: Currency – Replicate (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Replicate currencies using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description:
This service enables you to replicate currencies from an SAP S/4HANA system to an external system. It is based on the SOAP protocol where sent messages are monitored using Application Interface Framework (AIF).

The service contains MessageHeader, ListComplete TransmissionIndicator, TransmissionStartDateTime, and Currency nodes. The Currency node contains the list of currencies replicated from the SAP S/4HANA system. The information is sent as an XML message to the target system using the Data Replication Framework (DRF).

apis.Name: CO_MMCM_ESR_PURG_PRICING_COND
apis.Title: Condition Record for Pricing in Purchasing - Replicate
apis.ShortText: Replicate condition records for pricing that are used in Purchasing using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The service contains nodes that respectively represent condition records, validity of condition record, pricing scales, and condition supplements. The data replication is handled by Data Replication Framework (DRF).

apis.Name: PRODUCTSUBSTITUTIONGROUP_0001
apis.Title: Product Substitution Group
apis.ShortText: Manage product substitution groups using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create groups, which can be used in Product Substitution and Product Exclusion. Additionally, status and group descriptions can be maintained.

apis.Name: WAREHOUSEOUTBDELIVERYORDER_0001
apis.Title: Warehouse Outbound Delivery Order - Read, Update (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Integrate external applications with warehouse outbound delivery orders with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
In every API call, you can make use of the following operations:
 - You can retrieve header information for warehouse outbound delivery orders.
 - You can retrieve item information for warehouse outbound delivery orders, including serial numbers.
 - You can change the carrier ID for a warehouse outbound delivery order at header level.
 - You can change the staging bay for a warehouse outbound delivery order, as well as the product quantity, at item level.
 - You can adjust the delivery quantity down to 0 if picking hasn't started, or down to the partial quantity that has already been picked.
 - You can print a loading list for a delivery.
 - You can post goods issue.
 - You can reverse goods issue.
 - You can set the status Ready for Shipping for a delivery.
 - You can reverse the status Ready for Shipping for a delivery.

apis.Name: PRODUCTEXCLUSION_0001
apis.Title: Product Exclusion
apis.ShortText: Manage exclusion of substitute products in product substitutions using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create product exclusions based on various factors like time range validities, plant-specific, and application-specific. Additionally, predefined groups can be applied on these product exclusions.

apis.Name: API_SEGMENT_SRV
apis.Title: Segment - Read
apis.ShortText: Read segment master data using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to retrieve segments and their names in the respective language.

apis.Name: CO_PPINT_MFG_MASTER_RECIPE_V2
apis.Title: Master Recipe - Replicate
apis.ShortText: Use this asynchronous outbound service to replicate master recipes from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to external systems
apis.Description:
Master recipes are used for planning the manufacture of products. It is used as a reference for process orders and in calculating the costs of products.

Master recipe is a description of the operations or phases (steps in a process) that must be carried out in a certain order to manufacture a product.

apis.Name: CE_SUPPLIERQUOTATION_0001
apis.Title: Supplier Quotation
apis.ShortText: Read, update, delete and create supplier quotations with reference to a request for quotation from an external system
apis.Description: This service enables you to read, update, delete and create supplier quotations with reference to a request for quotation from an external system in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system. The service contains header and item. The information is sent in the request as a payload.

apis.Name: CO_SDBIL_ESR_SBSCR_BDR_OUT
apis.Title: Subscription Billing Document Request - Send Creation Confirmation
apis.ShortText: Send confirmations for newly created subscription billing document requests by using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description:
For each request to create subscription billing document requests that your system receives through the inbound service *Subscription Billing Document Request - Create,* this outbound service sends a response to SAP Subscription Billing that confirms whether creation was successful. If your system was unable to create specific documents or items, the service provides information about why creation failed.

This service is intended solely for the integration between SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP Subscription Billing, and should not be used for any other purposes.

apis.Name: CO_TAX_FORCE_UPDATE
apis.Title: External Tax - Force Update Tax Documents
apis.ShortText: Update data in the external system using this synchronous outbound service
apis.Description: Force updates are successful updates that occur when the tax amounts in the external system and in the accounts posted in the general ledger differ. In such cases, the data in the external system is overwritten by the data sent in the update. The most common reasons for a force update are manual entry of tax data in general ledger documents, credit memos, and currency conversion. Data is force updated via communication scenario SAP_COM_0177. Please note that communication scenario SAP_COM_0177 is specific to the United States.

apis.Name: BUSINESSPARTNERRELATIONSHIPSU1
apis.Title: BP Relationship - Send Confirmation from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to Client
apis.ShortText: Receive Business Partner Relationship data replication status using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The BusinessPartnerRelationshipSUITEBulkReplicateConfirmation_In SOAP service enables you to receive the status of replication of BP relationship records from the client system to SAP S/4HANA Cloud system.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_PAYMENTADVICE_0001-v1
apis.Title: Payment Advice
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, and delete payment advices synchronously using this inbound service
apis.Description: You can use this inbound synchronous service to create, read, update, and delete payment advices related to a customer or a supplier. This service supports a RAP-based collaborative draft feature that allows editing the same draft payment advice by multiple users at the same time. It is based on the OData protocol and can be consumed in SAP Fiori apps and other user interfaces. It can be used with payment advices of any supported type.

apis.Name: ENTPROJECTPROCESSINGSTATUS_0001
apis.Title: Enterprise Project - Read Project Processing Status
apis.ShortText: Read the processing status code list for enterprise projects using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read the processing status code list for enterprise projects. You can use it to make the code list values available for the corresponding Enterprise Project service.

apis.Name: CE_COSTRATE_0001
apis.Title: Cost Rate
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, or delete the cost rates from this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This API enables you to process plan cost rates, actual cost rates, and service cost rates from external systems to your system.

For every type you can read a list of existing cost rates, create a new one, update or delete an existing one. During creation or update, the information is used to create a new cost rate or to update an existing one - including all necessary checks for restricted values and authorizations. 

Created or updated cost rates are included in the response. An existing cost rate that needs to be modified or deleted is identified by the mandatory parameter - AccountingCostRateUUID. If there are any issues, the system displays error messages in the response. 

It supports the following operations:

* Retrieve (GET): It enables you to retrieve plan/service/actual cost rates in an API call. You can apply any of the filters provided or else retrieve all existing data.

* Create (POST): You can create the plan/service/actual cost rates.

* Update (PATCH/MERGE): You can update the plan/service/actual cost rates.

* Delete (DELETE): You can delete the plan/service/actual cost rates.

apis.Name: API_MASTER_RECIPE
apis.Title: Master Recipe
apis.ShortText: Read, update and create master recipe information using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
Master recipes are used for planning the manufacture of products. It is used as a reference for process orders and in calculating the costs of products.

Master recipe is a description of the operations or phases (steps in a process) that must be carried out in a certain order to manufacture a product.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_SERVICEENTRYSHEET_0001-v1
apis.Title: Service Entry Sheet (Lean Services)
apis.ShortText: Create, read, and update service entry sheets from or in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system using this synchronous inbound OData V4 service
apis.Description: This service enables a remote system to read, create and update service entry sheets from or in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system. It also provides service nodes to submit a service entry sheet for approval, withdraw a service entry sheet from approval or revoke approval of an already approved service entry sheet. The information is sent in the request as a payload. All information is used when creating, reading, and updating a service entry sheet, including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations.

apis.Name: API_SALES_ORDER_SIMULATION_SRV
apis.Title: Sales Order - Simulate (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Simulate the creation of a sales order with this synchronous OData API
apis.Description: The API gives you information about pricing, material availability, and the customer's credit limit. The response is provided synchronously. The simulated sales order is not saved.

apis.Name: CE_REOCCUPANCY_0001
apis.Title: Real Estate Occupancy
apis.ShortText: Read information on the occupancy of Real Estate objects using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service provides the possibility to get occupancy related information on Real Estate objects for a specific key date as well as over its entire timeline. The service only supports read operations. If there are any issues during processing, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: CO_TAX_JURI_DETER
apis.Title: External Tax - Determine Tax Jurisdiction Codes
apis.ShortText: Obtain tax jurisdiction code information for an address from your external tax partner using this synchronous outbound service
apis.Description: Your external tax partner sends an up-to-date list of jurisdiction codes to the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system via communication scenario SAP_COM_0177. Please note that communication scenario SAP_COM_0177 is specific to the United States.

apis.Name: API_SUPAVAILYPROTPLAN_0001
apis.Title: Supply Availability Protection Plan
apis.ShortText: Upload planning data for supply protection using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains the supply protection object, the characteristics, the supply protection groups and the time buckets. Once the supply availability protection plan has been created, the response contains the created object with comprehensive information including UUIDs of the objects as well as error messages for the case that the creation was not successful.

apis.Name: API_SD_SA_SOLDTOPARTYDETN
apis.Title: Sold-to Party Assignment of Sales Scheduling Agreement - Read (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Read sold-to party assignments using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service contains one entity only. Once the sold-to party assignment has been retrieved, it is sent in the response. If there are any issues when retrieving the sold-to party assignment, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: CE_SCMTMS_TORBOOKINGCI
apis.Title: Freight Booking – Confirm
apis.ShortText: Confirm a freight booking using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service allows you as a logistics service provider to acknowledge, accept, or reject a freight booking sent by a shipper in the freight subcontracting process. The service contains a transportation booking node, and this node contains the freight booking ID that you acknowledge, accept, or reject. Along with this information, you share other details about the logistics execution with the shipper.

apis.Name: CE_API_RESPYM_TEAM_SRV_0002
apis.Title: Responsibility Management Teams - Read
apis.ShortText: Read details about teams in Responsibility Management using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You can read team headers, team owners, responsibility definitions, team members, and the functions assigned to team members. Each of these entities supports filtering of their properties and the properties of their associations. If you have any problems trying to read these entities because of authorizations or the given filter criteria, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_PRELIMINARYBILLINGDOCUMENT_0001-v1
apis.Title: Preliminary Billing Document
apis.ShortText: Create, read, and update preliminary billing documents, as well as change their status and withdraw them from approval workflows, by using this inbound service
apis.Description:
A preliminary billing document is an optional intermediary document between a billed reference document (for example, a billing document request) and the final billing document (usually a customer invoice). For customers, it serves as tentative breakdown of the estimated amounts that are to be billed later, and can be used as a basis for negotiations. This service, which offers both synchronous and asynchronous processing, makes the data of preliminary billing documents available through its header, item, partner, pricing elements, and text entities. You can extend it with custom fields via key user extensibility. 
 
You can use this service to do the following:
 - Create preliminary billing documents with reference to billable SD documents in the system
 - Read most preliminary billing document fields at header and item level
 - Update specific preliminary billing document fields (such as the billing date, customer payment terms and tax classifications, and more)
 - Manually create new credit or debit items in preliminary billing documents created for professional services
 - Create, update, and delete texts and pricing elements at header and item level
 - Change the status of preliminary billing documents to **Rejected**, **In Progress**, or **Finalized**
 - Withdraw preliminary billing documents that are pending approval from their approval workflow

apis.Name: CE_STORLOCSUBSTITUTION_0002
apis.Title: Storage Location Substitution
apis.ShortText: Manage storage location substitutions using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create plant and time range specific storage location substitution. Additionally, these substitutions can be sequenced, and grouped using predefined groups.

apis.Name: API_FUNCTIONALAREA_SRV
apis.Title: Functional Area - Read
apis.ShortText: Read functional area master data using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains functional area and functional area text nodes.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_PRODUCTCOMPLIANCEUSE_0001-v1
apis.Title: Product Compliance Uses
apis.ShortText: Read, create and release of product compliance uses using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service creates and releases uses data that is provided by an external application into the uses data of a product in the Product Compliance solution as part of SAP S/4HANA Cloud. The uses data of a substance or mixture includes recommended uses, restrictions on use, and ways of application. In addition, the service can also read uses data and provide this data to an external application. You can query each entity to retrieve the corresponding business data.

apis.Name: CE_PRAWELLCOMPLTNPRSSR_0001
apis.Title: PRA WellCompletion Daily Pressure
apis.ShortText: Create, update and delete Well Completion Daily Pressure document using inbound service Production and Revenue Well Completion Daily Pressure
apis.Description:
You can read the Well Completion Daily Pressure Header and measurement items.


Well Completion Daily Pressure documents and Well Completion Daily Pressure measurement item will be created and deleted using this service. Well Completion Daily Pressure measurement item can be updated using this service.

apis.Name: CE_SCMTMS_CO_CPX_TOR_GN_RQ_CO_ASN_OUT
apis.Title: Consignment Order ‒ Send Advanced Shipping Notification
apis.ShortText: Send an advanced shipping notification (ASN) for a consignment order using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This asynchronous outbound service enables a supplier to send an advanced shipping notification (ASN) to an ordering party in a business-to-business (B2B) scenario. Using an ASN, a supplier notifies the ordering party about the pending arrival of goods shipped or about to be shipped. Accordingly, the service contains consignment details such as delivered product, destination, and delivery date.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_COSTCENTERHIERARCHY_0001-v1
apis.Title: Cost Center Hierarchy
apis.ShortText: Read, create, update, and delete cost center hierarchies using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains information about cost center hierarchy header, nodes, and cost center assignments. The changes made through the service are synchronized with the Manage Global Hierarchies app in SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

apis.Name: CE_STATRYRPTCATDEFINITION_0001
apis.Title: Statutory Reporting Category Definition ‒ Read
apis.ShortText: Read statutory categories definitions for Brazil using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service contains entities that represent the actions you can complete with this API. Each entity contained in this service is named after an action of Document and Reporting Compliance Category Definition.
- Category Definition – Read categories for specified report category definition.
- Phase Definition – Read phases for the specified report category definition.
- Activity Definition – Read activities for the specified report category definition.

apis.Name: PROFITCENTREREPLICATIONBULKREQ
apis.Title: Profit Center – Create, Delete
apis.ShortText: Replicate larger amounts of profit center master data from external systems to your SAP S/4HANA Could system
apis.Description:
You can use this service to create and delete profit center master data in bulk through SOAP messages. This is an asynchronous inbound SOAP service that can be used by external systems.

You can find and download the API and WSDL in the communication arrangement for the respective communication scenario in the Communication Arrangements SAP Fiori app. To get confirmation each time the master data is replicated in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system, you must also activate the corresponding confirmation outbound service, Profit Center Inbound Confirmation – Read, in the communication arrangement for the respective communication scenario.

For details, see the business documentation.

apis.Name: CO_MDM_PRD_BULK_REP_CONF_OUT
apis.Title: Product Master - Send Confirmation to Client
apis.ShortText: Send product master data replication status using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The ProductMDMBulkReplicateConfirmation_Out SOAP service consumer enables you to send the confirmation from an SAP S/4HANA Cloud system to the Client system, about the replication of the product master records. It uses the CO_MDM_PRD_BULK_REP_CONF_OUT service interface.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_PRODCMPLNCLOGISTICSDOCUMENT_0002-v2
apis.Title: Product Compliance Logistics Document
apis.ShortText: Read and write product compliance data from remote business documents, such as sales orders, outbound deliveries, and freight orders, using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables the transfer of product-compliance-relevant data from remote business documents to the Product Compliance solution. The Product Compliance solution can perform compliance checks to determine the compliance status for business documents in various processes within the value chain. It also determines compliance information, such as texts to be printed on documents, the compatibility of items according to mixed loading rules, and the evaluation of the 1000-point rules (1.1.3.6) according to ADR and RID. In addition, this service allows external applications to read the compliance information and the results of these checks.

apis.Name: CO_PPINT_MFG_ROUTING_V2
apis.Title: Production Routing - Replicate
apis.ShortText: Use this asynchronous outbound service to replicate production routing from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to external systems
apis.Description: A routing is a description of which operations (process steps) have to be carried out and in which order to produce a material (product). It is used as a template for production orders and run schedules as well as a basis for product costing.

apis.Name: CAINVOICINGDOCUMENT_0001
apis.Title: Convergent Invoicing Invoicing Document - Read
apis.ShortText: Read Invoicing Documents in Convergent Invoicing using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This API enables you to read invoicing documents in Convergent Invoicing. You can read entire invoicing documents or only parts of the data, using the provided filters. In addition, you can also set or remove the print lock of an invoicing document using the corresponding actions.

apis.Name: API_DEFECTCATEGORY_SRV
apis.Title: Defect Category - Read
apis.ShortText: Read defect categories and their language-dependent texts using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service is related to the business object Defect. The defect category determines which main reference objects in Quality Management a defect should have.

apis.Name: LABELFIELDCATALOG_0001
apis.Title: Label Field Catalog ‒ Read
apis.ShortText: Read label field placeholders using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to retrieve label field placeholders from your SAP S/4HANA system and use them in the process of designing label templates in external systems. The service contains all relevant information about a label field placeholder such as ID, version, and the group that it belongs to.

apis.Name: API_PRODVOLCAPTURE
apis.Title: Production Volume Capture - Read, Create
apis.ShortText: Read and create production volume related data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You can use the service to read and create production volumes for wells or combination of well and well completions. The service is based on the OData protocol and can be consumed by external systems.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_ENTPROJBLOCKFUNCTIONCODE_0001-v1
apis.Title: Enterprise Project - Read Blockable Function
apis.ShortText: Read functions that can be blocked for enterprise projects and professional services projects using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read functions that can be blocked for the project definition of enterprise projects as well as for individual project elements of enterprise projects and professional services projects. You can use this service, for example, to make the IDs and descriptions of the supported functions available for your custom application.

apis.Name: CE_CO_MMIM_SOA_MATDOC_CONF_V2
apis.Title: Material Document - Receive Confirmation
apis.ShortText: Receive material document confirmations or error messages using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to receive a SOAP Confirmation via SOAP service 'Material Document - Create'. The SOAP Confirmation contains the successmessage or, in case of an error, the error details of the material document creation. This service is the counterpart of the service 'Material Document - Create' (MaterialDocumentCreateRequest_Async_In).

apis.Name: JOURNALENTRYCREATEREQUESTCONFI
apis.Title: Journal Entry - Post (Synchronous)
apis.ShortText: Post journal entries synchronously from external systems to your system
apis.Description: The service contains journal entry header, general ledger item, debtor item, creditor item, product tax item and withholding tax item.

apis.Name: FUNCNLLOCSTRUCLIST_0001
apis.Title: Functional Location Hierarchy – Read
apis.ShortText: Read hierarchy of a functional location using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This service allows you to read the hierarchy of a functional location along with the equipment installed on the functional location.

The request contains all the information that is necessary to read a functional location hierarchy. If the input in the request is not as expected, the system displays appropriate error or warning messages in the response.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_FINTRANSINTRSTRATEINSTR_0003-v3
apis.Title: Financial Transaction Interest Rate Instrument
apis.ShortText: Read and add data to interest rate instruments using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This inbound OData service enables external systems and other consumers to read and create data in financial transactions for interest rate instruments in your **Treasury and Risk Management** (FIN-FSCM-TRM) system.

Together with the SOAP services *TRADETRMCREATE_IN*, *TRADETRMROLLOVER_IN* and *TRADETRMCHANGE_IN*, it is used by the communication scenario *SAP_COM_0922* to read, create, change or roll over interest rate instrument transactions.

apis.Name: CE_STATUTORYREPORTINGTASK_0001
apis.Title: Statutory Reporting Task
apis.ShortText: Generate statutory reports for Brazil using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service contains entities that represent the actions you can complete with this API. Each entity contained in this service is named after an action of Document and Reporting Compliance Task.
- Task – Manage an Ad hoc task for the specified report.
- Phase – Manage phases for the specified report.
- Activity – Manage the activities for the specified report.
- Run – Manage runs for the specified report.
- RunParameter – Check the Run parameters used for the specified report.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_RETAILPROMOTION_0001-v1
apis.Title: Retail Promotion (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create and manage retail promotion data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create, read, update, and delete retail promotion data such as retail promotion description, article for retail promotion, and plant (store) group for category 1 and 3. You can assign or unassign an article and plant (store) group to a retail promotion

apis.Name: PMRPFLEXIBLECONSTRAINT_0001
apis.Title: Maintain Flexible Constraints for predictive material and resource planning
apis.ShortText: Use this inbound service to manage flexible constraints for materials in predictive material and resource planning (pMRP)
apis.Description:
Constraints are things that limit your production process in some way. For example, if your supplier has a shortage of a key component in your product, you are limited in the number of products you can create. The constraint can be long-term or short-term and could be caused by any number of factors, including, supply shortages, or reduced staffing.

This service enables you to define your own constraints for many different types of material. This means that no matter the reason for the constraint, you can flexibly define which materials are affected, how they are affected, and for how long. The defined constraints are then considered in forecasting simulations.

apis.Name: CE_DNGRSGDSBSCCLASSIFICATION_0001
apis.Title: Dangerous Goods Basic Classification
apis.ShortText: Read and write dangerous goods basic classification data for unpackaged products using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service can read data of the dangerous goods basic classification of an unpackaged products in the Product Compliance solution and provides this data to an external application. In addition, this service writes dangerous goods basic classification data that is provided by an external application into the dangerous goods basic classification of an unpackaged product in the Product Compliance solution.

apis.Name: CE_CONSOLIDATIONTASK_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Task ‒ Read
apis.ShortText: Read consolidation task configuration in group reporting using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to read consolidation task and assignments of consolidation document type. Consolidation task is a coded representation of a step during a monitored consolidation process. Each consolidation task has consolidation document types assigned to be able to make postings.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_PAYFNPAYMENT_0001-v1
apis.Title: Requested Payment ― Read, Create
apis.ShortText: Read and create requested payment data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This service allows the creation and/or retrieval of requested payments by a third-party system.
The requested payment details are transmitted to the system, which then persists the payment data and provides access to the payment data upon request. If there are any issues during the creation of the requested payment, the system displays error messages in the response. The service contains payment amount, payment purpose, payment business status, as well as payment parties such as payer and payee.

apis.Name: API_CHARTOFACCOUNTS_SRV
apis.Title: Chart of Accounts - Read
apis.ShortText: Read chart of accounts master data using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to retrieve chart of accounts and their names in the respective language.

apis.Name: OBJECTPART_0001
apis.Title: Catalog Type Object Parts – Read
apis.ShortText: Read catalog type Object Parts using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service contains catalog groups and codes that belong to catalog type B which is Object Parts. The catalog type Object Parts is used in maintenance notification item level to record the object parts.

apis.Name: MANAGEBUSINESSUSERIN
apis.Title: Business User
apis.ShortText: Update business users from your external data source such as an identity management system using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The HCM integration is active in your system and cannot be deactivated. This synchronous inbound SOAP service enables you to update the business users from your external data source, such as an identity management system.

You need to create either an employee (BUP003) or contingent worker (BBP005) in your system before using this business user API. You can either create an employee or service performer using scope item JB1, Replicate Basic Master Data for Workforce from External HR Systems API.

You can create, update and delete only the User node.

The following attributes of the User node can be updated:
* DateFormatCode
* DecimalFormatCode
* TimeZoneCode
* TimeFormatCode
* LockedIndicator
* Roles
* ValidityPeriod

You receive a confirmation message response for each bundle of business users you sent. If the service request is processed, a confirmation message is sent that contains the crucial information that are provided by the fields PersonExternalID, PersonID, and PersonUUID for each business user of the bundle.

apis.Name: API_DMS_PROCESS_SRV
apis.Title: Document Info Record
apis.ShortText: Maintain document info records using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service contains header data of the document info record (DIR), description, object link information for BOM, product, and change record, classification details for class and characteristics, and value help for document status as nodes.

All the information can be sent as part of the request payload, which is then used to maintain the DIR, including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations. The data associated to the document info record is sent in the response. If there are any issues in the request such as wrong values or insufficient information, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: CE_SRCGPROJAWARDINGSCENARIO_0001
apis.Title: Awarding Scenario
apis.ShortText: Create, update, and delete awarding scenarios using this synchronous inbound service

apis.Name: API_EHS_REPORT_INCIDENT_SRV
apis.Title: Environment, Health and Safety Incident - Create, Read
apis.ShortText: Create and display incidents, near misses, and safety observations related to Environment, Health, and Safety using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service contains the basic information about an incident as the main entity, and persons involved, location, and attachments as dependent entities. For create operations, the information is sent in the request as a payload, except for attachment-related data. You can add attachments to the newly created incident in separate calls. Once the incident has been created, the incident data and global identification are sent in the response. For read operations, filter information can be sent according to the OData protocol. While creating an incident or retrieving incident data, the system performs checks for restricted values and authorization. If there are any issues, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNGROUPSTRUCTURE_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Group Structure
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation group structures using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation group structure is an assignment of consolidation units to a consolidation group depending on the consolidation version and the fiscal year and period. An assignment comprises the definition of first consolidation and divestiture, and the assignment of a consolidation method additionally depending on a fiscal year and period. The definition of a group structure represents a mandatory prerequisite for the consolidation process.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_SALESCONTRACT_0001-v1
apis.Title: Sales Contract (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create, read, and update sales contracts with this inbound service
apis.Description:
This service contains the header entity along with other subentities, including header partners, header pricing elements, header texts, items, item partners, item pricing elements, item texts, as well as price agreements at item level. 

This service offers the create, read, update, and delete operations. In delete operations, you can delete subentities from existing sales contracts. 

In every operation, you can call the API in a synchronous or asynchronous mode.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_API_DISPUTE_MANAGE_0001-v1
apis.Title: Dispute
apis.ShortText: Read, create, update and perform actions on disputes in Debt Collections Management using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You can use this synchronous inbound service to create, read, and update disputes in Debt Collections Management. It is based on the OData V4 protocol and can be consumed by external applications. The service contains the following nodes: Dispute, disputed receivable item, receivable item related to the dispute, resubmission, and note.

apis.Name: API_SALES_DOCUMENT_REASON_SRV
apis.Title: SD Document Order Reason - Read (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Read order reasons for sales and distribution (SD) documents using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains four entities, from which Self-Billing Cockpit consumers can retrieve the order reason ID and description, retro-billing relevance of the order reason, as well as the related item type for self-billing processing.

apis.Name: CE_API_BUS_SITN_MSTRDATA_SRV_0002
apis.Title: Business Situation Type - Read
apis.ShortText: Read master data from the standard framework for Situation Handling using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This API is based on the OData protocol. It provides the data belonging to situation templates, situation types, actions, data context, and the texts in all available languages in the payload’s response. For example, you can use this API data to link to master data from the standard framework in an external app. The version 2 of this API also provides a version property in the entities Schema for Data Context Definition and Schema for Data Context Definition - Text to reflect different versions of the data context definition.

apis.Name: CE_SUPPLIERCONFIRMATION_0001
apis.Title: Supplier Confirmation
apis.ShortText: Create, update, delete, and retrieve supplier confirmations using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service contains header, item, and line nodes. The information is sent in the request as a payload. It can be consumed by external applications to integrate with supplier confirmation processing in SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

Operations in single and batch mode are supported. Single mode operations can be used to create one supplier confirmation at a time.

A new supplier confirmation can be created with the entities header, item, and line.

For existing supplier confirmations, new items and lines can be created and existing ones can be updated.

For existing supplier confirmations, individual items, lines, and entire confirmations can be deleted.

apis.Name: API_SERVICE_CONFIRMATION_SRV
apis.Title: Service Confirmation (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Manage service confirmations with the data provided in a payload using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
You can use this service to integrate external applications with service confirmation processing in SAP S/4HANA Cloud. In each API call, you can use the following operations:
 - Retrieve service confirmations.
 - Create service confirmations. Note: You must use “deep insert” requests (a header plus the following entities: header person responsible, header reference object, header pricing element, header text, and item).
 - Create new items for existing service confirmations.
 - Create an item reference object, item pricing element, and an item text for existing service confirmation items.
 - Update the header, header person responsible, header reference object, header pricing element, header text, item, item reference object, item pricing element, and item text for existing service confirmations.
 - Delete the header person responsible, header reference object, header text, item, item reference object, and item text for existing service confirmations.

This service enables you to add attachments to service confirmation items by making an API call to the service Attachments (API_CV_ATTACHMENT_SRV). You can also use the service Attachments to download and delete attachments from service confirmation items.

apis.Name: CO_SDMD_ESR_SALES_AREA
apis.Title: Sales Area - Replicate
apis.ShortText: Replicate sales areas from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to external systems
apis.Description: The replication logic of this data is handled by the Data Replication Framework (DRF).

apis.Name: RESPACEGRPENABLEUSETYPE_0001
apis.Title: Real Estate Usage Enablement Type
apis.ShortText: Read Real Estate Usage Enablement Type using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service allows users to read the Real Estate Usage Enablement Type separately. Create, Update and Delete operations are not supported for this service. It focuses solely on additional read functionalities.

apis.Name: CO_SDMD_ESR_SALES_ORGANIZATION
apis.Title: Sales Organization - Replicate
apis.ShortText: Replicate sales organizations from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to external systems
apis.Description: The replication logic of this data is handled by the Data Replication Framework (DRF).

apis.Name: CE_SUPPLIERCONFIRMATIONREQUEST_I1
apis.Title: Supplier Confirmation - Create, Update, Delete (Inbound, Asynchronous)
apis.ShortText: Create, update, or delete supplier confirmations using this inbound asynchronous service
apis.Description: The service contains supplier confirmation, supplier confirmation item, and supplier confirmation line nodes. With this service you can, create supplier confirmations with full or partial confirmation, delete supplier confirmations, and update existing supplier confirmations. Also, you can, confirm entire purchase order, and fully or partially confirm one of the items in a purchase order.

apis.Name: API_INTELLIGENTPRODUCTPROPOSAL_SRV
apis.Title: Intelligent Product Proposal - Read
apis.ShortText: Reads product and quantity proposals for sales order items using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: In this API, you can retrieve product and quantity proposals. Apply any of the filters provided or retrieve all existing data.

apis.Name: CE_API_MAINTENANCEORDER_0002
apis.Title: Maintenance Order
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete maintenance order data synchronously using this inbound service
apis.Description:
This service enables you to create, read, updated and delete maintenance order data. It contains order header, operation, component, object list item, operation relationship, long text and settlement rule nodes. The service is based on the OData V2 protocol, and can be consumed in external systems, Fiori applications and on other user interfaces.

If there are any issues when retrieving the maintenance order data, the system displays appropriate warning or error messages in the response.

apis.Name: API_CUSTOMER_RETURNS_DELIVERY_SRV_0002
apis.Title: Customer Returns Delivery (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Process customer returns with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This synchronous inbound service enables you to read, create, update, and delete customer returns deliveries. It can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces.

apis.Name: BILLABLEITEMSCREATEREQUEST_IN
apis.Title: Convergent Invoicing Billable Items - Create Request (Inbound)
apis.ShortText: Create billable items in Convergent Invoicing using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This asynchronous service is used to create billable items in Convergent Invoicing, including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations.

apis.Name: BDSIMULATEPRICINGREQUEST_IN
apis.Title: Billing Document - Simulate Pricing
apis.ShortText: Simulate a redetermination of prices for billing document items in your system by using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
SAP Self-Billing Cockpit uses this service to trigger a simulated redetermination of prices for billing document items that the service consumer has specified in the request message. A simulated redetermination of prices can be required if the supplier and buyer renegotiate pricing conditions some time after the initial invoice is created at the time of sale.

This service is intended solely for the integration between SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP Self-Billing Cockpit and should not be used for any other purposes.

apis.Name: API_BILLING_DOCUMENT_SRV
apis.Title: Billing Document - Read, Cancel, GetPDF
apis.ShortText: Read and cancel billing documents in your system, and fetch PDF versions of billing documents in your system by using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Consumers of this inbound service can read and cancel billing documents inside your system by sending OData requests. In addition, they can request entire billing documents in PDF format. The service makes billing document data available through its header, item, business partner, and pricing element entities.

apis.Name: CE_FREIGHTAGREEMENT_0001
apis.Title: Freight Agreement (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create, retrieve, update, and delete freight agreements using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
You use this API to do the following:
* Create and copy freight agreements
* Update freight agreements, such as modify the calculation sheet and local rate tables
* Release freight agreements so that it can be used by other freight documents
* Delete freight agreements that aren’t used by any freight documents

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_HANDLINGANDSTORAGEASSESSMENT_0001-v1
apis.Title: Handling And Storage Assessment
apis.ShortText: Read or create and release a new version of handling and storage assessment data for unpackaged products and raw materials with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The handling and storage assessment is the assessment of unpackaged products or raw materials against a compliance requirement version for handling and storage. This information is also used for further operations, such as generating a safety data sheet (section 7) for unpackaged products. This service can create and release a new version of a handling and storage assessment or read the handling and storage assessment data and provide it for further use by external systems.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNGROUPJOURNALENTRY_0001
apis.Title: Journal Entry for Group Reporting - Post
apis.ShortText: Post and simulate journal entries in your SAP S/4HANA Cloud for group reporting using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service enables you to manually post journal entries to adjust reported financial data, standardizing entries, and consolidation entries according to group requirements. Based on the version, fiscal year, posting period, and document type, you can specify the following with relevant amounts in local currency or group currency:
 - Relevant consolidation group
 - Consolidation unit
 - Consolidation unit pair
 - Journal entry line items

apis.Name: STORAGELOCATIONSUBSTNCTRL_0001
apis.Title: Storage Location Substitution Control
apis.ShortText: Manage storage location substitution controls using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create control and control descriptions. Additionally, storage location substitution groups can be assigned to a Storage location Substitution Control.

apis.Name: MATCHINGITEMBULKCREATEREQUEST_
apis.Title: Matching Items - Bulk Import
apis.ShortText: Import matching items using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This API enables a client system to post matching items to SAP S/4HANA Cloud system, so that the data can be matched and reconciled in the Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation solution. For information about setting up the API, see SAP Note 2815332.

apis.Name: VARCONFIGNOBJECTDEPENDENCY_0001
apis.Title: Object Dependency
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete basic data, language-specific descriptions and source codes of an object dependency on a specific date with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Object dependencies are used to set and maintain rules in variant configuration. An object dependency can be assigned to BOM items, task list items, characteristics, characteristic values and configuration profiles. All actions support change numbers.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_SLSMATLDETERMINATIONRECORD_0001-v1
apis.Title: Condition Record for Material Determination in Sales (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, and delete condition records for material determination in Sales using this inbound service
apis.Description: You can create, read, update, and delete condition records for material determination from external systems. The service contains entities including the condition record and additional substitute materials. The service supports synchronous and asynchronous processing.

apis.Name: API_PLANNED_ORDERS
apis.Title: Planned Order
apis.ShortText: Manage planned orders using this synchronous inbound OData V2 service
apis.Description: The service contains planned order header, planned order capacity and planned order components. The information is sent in the request as a payload. You can read, create, change and delete components of orders and also use this service to schedule planned order operations.

apis.Name: CO_FKK_COMMSNDOUTSTGCOLUPDRQ
apis.Title: Collection Agency - Submit Bulk Request
apis.ShortText: Transfer data from Contract Accounting (FI-CA) to an external system using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description:
With this service, you can submit items to external collection agencies or you can inform one or more external collection agencies about updates to collection items. The service sends the following information:
 - Information for submitting collection items, including business partner data and correspondence (such as original invoices), as well as grouping information (such as, assignment of interest and charges to the main receivable at the time of submission)
 - Clearing information due to (partial) payments or (partial) write-offs of submitted collection items
 - Information for callback of submitted collection items
 - Business partner updates (debtor)

apis.Name: API_BATCH_SRV
apis.Title: Batch Master Record
apis.ShortText: Use this service to create, change and read batches with classification data
apis.Description: This synchronous inbound API enables you to read, create and change batches. Additionally, it is possible to retrieve and to edit the related classification data. The service is based on the OData protocol, and can be consumed by external systems and user interfaces.

apis.Name: API_MAINTNOTIFICATION
apis.Title: Maintenance Notification
apis.ShortText: Create, update, and read maintenance notification using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This service contains maintenance notification header details, item, item cause, item activity, and partner function. The information is sent in the request as a payload.

The request payload contains all information required to create or update a maintenance notification. All the information in the payload is used to create or update a maintenance notification including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations. Once the maintenance notification has been created, the notification number is sent in the response with the data included.

If the input in the request is not as expected when you create or update a maintenance notification, the system displays appropriate error or warning messages in the response.

apis.Name: CO_FAP_POS_POSITIVE_PAY_OUT
apis.Title: Positive Pay File - Send
apis.ShortText: Send positive pay files using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The service contains header and item nodes. The information is sent in the request as a payload. All information is used for positive pay validation. This service is based on the SOAP protocol and can be consumed on the user interfaces. If there are any issues when the positive pay file is sent, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: API_RECONTRACT_0001
apis.Title: Real Estate Contracts
apis.ShortText: Manage real estate contracts using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains contract header and sub nodes for managing the contract process. These child objects are Business Partner Assignments, Object Assignments, Posting, Rhythm, Adjustment, Renewal, Notice and Organizational Assignment Terms, Conditions, Reminder Rules and Dates, Valuation Rules and Condition Valuation Assignments. The contract header can be read, created and updated, additionally all child objects can be deleted using the service. The contract header numbers (InternalRealEstateNumber and RealEstateContract) must be fetched via read request after creating due to late numbering mechanism. If there are any issues when the contract header or any object is created, updated or deleted, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: API_LEGAL_TRANSACTION_SRV
apis.Title: Legal Transactions
apis.ShortText: Create, read and update legal transactions using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Legal Transactions are business objects that are used to manage the lifecycle of legal content. The service contains legal transactions, categories, category groups, parent categories, dates, entities, external contacts, internal contacts, linked objects, and relationships nodes. The information sent in the request as a payload, is used when creating a legal transaction, including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations. Once the legal transaction has been created, the legal transaction ID is sent in the response with the data included in the legal transaction. If there are any issues when the legal transaction is created, the system displays error messages in the response. Note that we support only deep create for the legal transaction node.

apis.Name: CE_WAREHOUSESTOCKTRANSFERRECEIPT1
apis.Title: Warehouse Stock Transfer Receipt Advice Cancel Request – From Warehouse (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Request the cancellation of a previously performed goods receipt for the Warehouse Stock Transfer Receipt Advice with this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables a third-party decentralized Warehouse Management System (WMS) to request the cancellation of a previously performed goods receipt for the Warehouse Stock Transfer Receipt Advice. This service must be carried out after the decentralized WMS confirms goods movement posting for the Warehouse Stock Transfer Receipt Advice. This message is sent from a third-party decentralized WMS.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CNSLDTNDIVISIONHIERARCHY_0001-v1
apis.Title: Consolidation Division Hierarchy
apis.ShortText: Read consolidation division hierarchies using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation division hierarchy is a structure of divisions in consolidation. The service provides general information about the hierarchy, like the validity timeframe, as well as structural information about the defined nodes and their consolidation division leaf assignments.

apis.Name: VARCONFIGNTABLE_0001
apis.Title: Variant Table
apis.ShortText: Create, delete and read basic data, language-specific descriptions, columns and the value assignment alternative, update basic data and language-specific descriptions of a variant table with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Variant tables are used to store combinations of values for different characteristics. You can use them in selection conditions, procedures, and constraints. You can query each entity to retrieve the corresponding business data.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CONSOLIDATIONGLOBALPARAMETER_0001-v1
apis.Title: Consolidation Global Parameter
apis.ShortText: Read consolidation global parameters using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The consolidation global parameters are a set of user-specific parameters which are applied to applications used for financial consolidation in group reporting.
The following parameters are possible:
•	Consolidation group
•	Consolidation unit
•	Consolidation version
•	Consolidation chart of accounts
•	Fiscal year
•	Fiscal period

apis.Name: API_CABUSPARTPAYMENT_0002
apis.Title: Contract Accounting Business Partner Payment – Manage
apis.ShortText: Retrieve a list of payments in Contract Accounting (FI-CA) and make, release or withdraw payments with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
Retrieve a list of payments and make, release or withdraw payments. Read payment items and corresponding payment headers for a business partner. Payment items are either document items which are cleared by payments, payments on account or released payments. Post or release payments for an invoice or an open document item. A released payment can also be withdrawn until the corresponding items are not cleared.

Only use the version 2 of the service. Do not use version 1 as this version is deprecated.

apis.Name: API_PROFITCENTER_SRV
apis.Title: Profit Center - Read (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Read master data of profit centers using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read profit center master data in an API call. It is based on the OData protocol and can be consumed in SAP Fiori apps and other user interfaces.

apis.Name: API_RESPYM_TEAM_SRV_0001
apis.Title: Responsibility Management Teams - Read
apis.ShortText: Read details about teams in Responsibility Management using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You can read team headers, team owners, responsibility definitions, team members, and the functions assigned to team members. Each of these entities supports filtering of their properties and the properties of their associations. If you have any problems trying to read these entities because of authorizations or the given filter criteria, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CONSOLIDATIONGROUP_0001-v1
apis.Title: Consolidation Group
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation groups using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation group is the organizational entity for which you perform financial consolidation and reporting as part of the corporate closing activities.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNPRODUCT_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Product
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation products using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation product is a product that can be used for financial consolidation in group reporting. It can either be a product that’s been defined in an area other than group reporting, or it can be a product that’s been specifically defined for exclusive use in group reporting.

apis.Name: CO_PPINT_MFGORD_EXECT_REQ_OUT
apis.Title: Manufacturing Order - Send
apis.ShortText: Send manufacturing orders using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to send manufacturing orders to an external manufacturing execution system. The orders are sent when they get released and if they meet the filter criteria for distribution defined in the communication arrangement. You can include detailed information for production as well as for process orders.

apis.Name: API_SALES_SCHEDULING_AGREEMENT
apis.Title: Sales Scheduling Agreement (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, and delete sales scheduling agreements, as well as create correction deliveries using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains header, item, delivery schedule, and schedule line entities, as well as header and item sub-entities for partners and pricing elements. Once the sales scheduling agreement has been created, the sales scheduling agreement number is sent in the response with the data included in the sales scheduling agreement. If there are any issues when creating, retrieving, updating, or deleting the sales scheduling agreement, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: API_EVENT_BASED_REVREC_PROJECT_SRV
apis.Title: Event-Based Revenue Recognition Integration
apis.ShortText: Clear or reevaluate the revenue recognition postings, and change the revenue recognition key for WBS elements (projects) using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service first allows for a clearing of the balance sheet GL accounts, a procedure by which the open items belonging to one or more accounts are indicated as cleared. Second, it allows for using the revalue function, which recalculates the posted revenue recognition values if you have changed, for example, the planned cost. This service also allows changing the revenue recognition key that was originally assigned to a particular WBS element (project) to a new one.

apis.Name: ENTPROJECTPROFILECODE_0001
apis.Title: Enterprise Project - Read Project Profile
apis.ShortText: Read the project profile code list for enterprise projects using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read the project profile code list for enterprise projects. You can use it to make the code list values available for the corresponding Enterprise Project service.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CNSLDTNCOSTCENTERHIERARCHY_0001-v1
apis.Title: Consolidation Cost Center Hierarchy
apis.ShortText: Read consolidation cost center hierarchies using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation cost center hierarchy is a structure of cost centers in consolidation. The service provides general information about the hierarchy, like the validity timeframe, as well as structural information about the defined nodes and their consolidation cost center leaf assignments.

apis.Name: CONSUMPTIONITEMSCREATEREQUEST_
apis.Title: Convergent Invoicing Consumption Items - Create Request (Inbound)
apis.ShortText: Create consumption items in Convergent Invoicing using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This asynchronous service is used to create consumption items in Convergent Invoicing, including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations.

apis.Name: PRODHIERNODES_0001
apis.Title: Product Hierarchy Nodes - Read, Create
apis.ShortText: Read and create versions, nodes, and the related texts of a product hierarchy using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This synchronous inbound OData service enables external systems and other consumers to read currently active version for a given Hierarchy ID, or the version with a specified validity date.

This service also enables external systems and other consumers to create version, nodes, and texts of a product hierarchy.

This information is used in the processes related to sales and distribution.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CURRENCYEXCHANGERATE_0001-v1
apis.Title: Currency Exchange Rate
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete currency exchange rates using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
Create, read, update and delete currency exchange rates using this synchronous inbound service.
This service is based on the OData protocol.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_MATERIALVARIANTROUTING_0001-v1
apis.Title: Get Material Variant Production Routing
apis.ShortText: Read Production Routing of a Material Variant which is derived from Super Routing of Configuration Material using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A routing is a description of the operations (or steps in a process) that are performed to manufacture a product (or material). It is used as a reference for production orders, to run schedules and in calculating the costs of products.

apis.Name: FKCMANAGECADOCUMENT
apis.Title: FI-CA Document – Manage
apis.ShortText: Transfer Contract Accounting data from an external system to Contract Accounting (FI-CA) using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: With this service, you can post and reverse FI-CA documents. Changes to FI-CA documents are not supported by this service.

apis.Name: API_PLND_INDEP_RQMT_SRV
apis.Title: Planned Independent Requirements
apis.ShortText: Read, create, and update planned independent requirements (PIRs) for your demand forecast planning using this synchronous inbound serviceThe PIRs are read, updated and/or created on header and item level
apis.Description:
You can also send batch requests.

Use this API, if you want to work with the *Change PIRs* or*Maintain PIRs* app.
 - **Note**: This service is not yet enabled for OAuth 2.0 authentication.

apis.Name: STORAGELOCATIONSUBSTNGROUP_0001
apis.Title: Storage Location Substitution Group
apis.ShortText: Manage storage location substitution groups using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create groups, which can be used in Storage location Substitution and Storage location Exclusion.Additionally, status and group descriptions can be maintained.

apis.Name: CO_FAA_MD_ESR_CREATE_SUB_CONF
apis.Title: Fixed Asset - Create Sub Asset (Asynchronous) Confirmation
apis.ShortText: Confirm the creation of asset subnumbers using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description:
The service contains the log and the confirmation node.

You use this outbound service when you create asset subnumbers for asset master records with the inbound service Fixed Asset - Create Sub Asset (Asynchronous) (FAA_FIXED_ASSET_CREATE_SUB_WEBI).

After the inbound service is processed, this outbound service sends a confirmation to the external system.

apis.Name: API_FCO_ICO_RESTRICTION
apis.Title: Allowlist Intercompany Postings – Read
apis.ShortText: Read allowlist of sender/receiver company code combinations for intercompany postings using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service returns allowlist of sender/receiver company code combinations for intercompany postings. Filters, sorting, and other OData operations can be used.

apis.Name: CE_CO_LOBM_ESR_BAT_BLK_RN_INF_OUT
apis.Title: Batch - Outbound Integration
apis.ShortText: Replicate batch master records from an SAP S/4HANA Cloud to a client system using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The service uses the CO_LOBM_ESR_BAT_BLK_RN_INF_OUT service interface, which is based on the SOAP protocol. The replication of batch master records is triggered using the data replication framework.

apis.Name: CONTRACTACCOUNT_0001
apis.Title: Contract Account
apis.ShortText: Retrieve contract accounts in Contract Accounting (FI-CA) using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
Retrieve a list of contract accounts. Read contract account header and contract account-business partner relationship.

Retrieve the account balance for a contract account.

apis.Name: CENTRALREQUESTFORQUOTATION_0001
apis.Title: Central Request for Quotation
apis.ShortText: Read, update, create and delete central request for quotation from an external system in SAP S/4HANA Cloud system using this synchronous service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read, update, delete and create central request for quotation from an external system in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system. The service contains header, item, bidder and item distribution. The information is sent in the request as a payload. All information is utilized when creating a central RFQ with appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations.

apis.Name: PRAMAINTDOI_0001
apis.Title: PRA Division of Interest
apis.ShortText: Create Production and Revenue Division of Interest using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service contains Division of Interest, Bearer Group, Bearer, Tax State exemption, Ownership, Owner History, Funds Transfer, Marketing exemption, Sliding scale header, Sliding scale items, Funds transfer header and Funds transfer items nodes.

Once the Bearer Group, Bearer, Tax State exemption, Ownership, Owner History, Funds Transfer, Marketing exemption, Sliding scale header, Sliding scale items and Funds transfer items is created and respective identification numbers are returned.

apis.Name: API_RECIPE
apis.Title: Recipe Header, Formula, and Process
apis.ShortText: Create, read, write and delete recipe header data, descriptions, process and formula items, and read recipe-related classification data using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains information belonging to the recipe header, such as status, validity, and creation date, as well as formula data, including a list of ingredients with their quantities. Details of the recipe process, like process elements, process parameters, and equipment requirements are also available in the service. You can also read all classification data pertaining to a recipe.

apis.Name: CE_CONSOLIDATIONUNITTASKRUN_0002
apis.Title: Consolidation Unit Task Run
apis.ShortText: Read and manage consolidation task execution for consolidation units in group reporting using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to read, block, unblock, reset and execute a consolidation task that is run for a consolidation unit. These actions are possible in the context of a consolidation chart of accounts, consolidation version, fiscal year, and period.

apis.Name: CE_APIRESERVATIONDOCUMENT_0001
apis.Title: Reservation Document (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Use this synchronous inbound service to retrieve, create, update and delete reservation documents
apis.Description: This service contains the header and item nodes for reservation documents. You can create a reservation for a material with some quantity and assign that reserved material to a cost center, sales order, or asset.
