A reservation can also be created for a transfer posting from one plant to another. For an existing reservation, you can change the updatable fields of the items. The service also allows you to delete existing reservation documents. It can be consumed by external systems and user interfaces.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNCONTROLLINGAREA_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Controlling Area
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation controlling areas using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation controlling area is a controlling area that can be used for financial consolidation in group reporting. It can either be a controlling area that’s been defined in an area other than group reporting, or it can be a controlling area that’s been specifically defined for exclusive use in group reporting.

apis.Name: CO_NGC_SOAP_CHARCBULKREPCONOUT
apis.Title: Characteristic Data for Classification - Confirmation (Asynchronous, Outbound)
apis.ShortText: Replicate classification characteristic confirmations from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to client
apis.Description: Classification characteristics can be used as additional properties of objects. This service enables you to send confirmation messages after processing classification characteristics.

apis.Name: CE_QUALITYNOTIFICATION_0001
apis.Title: Quality Notification - Read, Create
apis.ShortText: Read and create quality notifications (using this asynchronous inbound service)
apis.Description: You can read and create data of quality notifications, for example, create a customer complaint or a complaint against a supplier. This includes header, item and task data as well as long texts for header, items and tasks.

apis.Name: API_SUPPLIER_ACTIVITY_TASK_SRV
apis.Title: Procurement-Related Task
apis.ShortText: Read, update and delete procurement-related tasks using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create, update and delete procurement-related tasks through an API call.

apis.Name: REVENUEACCOUNTINGCONTRACTBYFUL
apis.Title: Revenue Accounting Contract - Process Fulfillment Items
apis.ShortText: Update revenue accounting contracts in Contract-Based Revenue Recognition based on incoming operational documents (fulfillment items) using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to integrate non-SAP systems with Contract-Based Revenue Recognition. Operational documents (fulfillment items) received from a non-SAP system are processed and trigger fulfillment processing of revenue accounting contracts and performance obligations in Contract-Based Revenue Recognition. Apart from the header node, the message contains the Fulfillment Item node transporting fulfillment data.

apis.Name: CO_BNSPRFT_CENTER_MASTER_DATA
apis.Title: Profit Center - Send
apis.ShortText: Replicate larger amounts of profit center master data from the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system to external systems
apis.Description: You can use this service to send master data of profit centers in bulk through SOAP messages. Before you can use this service, you must create a communication arrangement for the respective communication scenario. For details, see the business documentation.

apis.Name: CE_SUPPLIERLIST_0002
apis.Title: Preferred Supplier List
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete preferred supplier list from an external system in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system using this synchronous service

apis.Name: CE_API_RESPYM_TEAM_CONFIG_SRV_0002
apis.Title: Responsibility Management Team Configurations - Read
apis.ShortText: Read details about team configurations in Responsibility Management using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You can read team categories, team types, responsibility attributes, functions assigned to team categories, and responsibility attributes and functions assigned to team types. Each of these entities supports filtering of their properties and the properties of their associations. If you have any problems trying to read these entities because of authorizations or the given filter criteria, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: CO_SDMD_ESR_SALES_DIVISION
apis.Title: Sales Division - Replicate
apis.ShortText: Replicate sales divisions from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to external systems
apis.Description: The replication logic of this data is handled by the Data Replication Framework (DRF).

apis.Name: CE_CO_LEIDW_WAREHOUSE_SHIPPING_AD
apis.Title: Warehouse Shipping Advice Cancel Confirm ‒ Send to Warehouse (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Send a Warehouse Shipping Advice Cancellation Confirmation with this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description:
The system returns this message to a decentralized Warehouse Management System (WMS) in response to a preceding Warehouse Shipping Advice Cancel Request – Receive From Warehouse (B2B) message for the Warehouse Shipping Order. This message updates the decentralized WMS with the execution result of the Warehouse Shipping Advice Cancel Request – Receive From Warehouse (B2B) message.

It returns the delivery number of the updated Warehouse Shipping Order with actual goods movement posting date and a success message or an error log to the calling system. This message is sent to a decentralized WMS system.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_PLANT_0001-v1
apis.Title: Plant Configuration
apis.ShortText: Use this synchronous inbound service to read plant configuration information
apis.Description: This service enables you to retrieve plant configuration information using the OData protocol with filter data provided in the payload.

apis.Name: CO_EDI_ORDER_REQUEST_OUT
apis.Title: Purchase Order - Send, Update, Cancel
apis.ShortText: Send purchase orders to your suppliers using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The service contains order, party, payment terms, payment card, text, order item, product, schedule line, and subcontracting component details nodes. The information is sent in the request as a payload. This information helps you to transfer purchase order messages between your SAP S/4HANA Cloud buyer system and an external supplier system.

apis.Name: SLSPRCGCNDNEXCLUSION_0001
apis.Title: Condition Exclusion for Pricing in Sales – Read
apis.ShortText: Read data about condition exclusion for groups of conditions using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to retrieve data including condition exclusion groups, the selected condition types, and the assigned pricing procedures.

apis.Name: CTRSERVICE_0001
apis.Title: CTR Complementary Table Data Maintenance
apis.ShortText: Insert, update, read and delete data of CTR complementary tables using this synchronous inbound service based on OData
apis.Description:
The service can be consumed in Brazilian integration scenarios that require the maintenance of complementary external data to generate legal reports.

Each entity of this service is named after a table without the /tmf/d_prefix. For example, the cnv201fat entity is relative to the /tmf/d_cnv201fat table.

apis.Name: CO_EDI_ORDER_CONF_REQUEST
apis.Title: Sales Order/Customer Return - Confirm Processing (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Confirm the processing of sales orders or customer returns using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The information is sent in the request as a payload. Messages transferred by this service can be monitored using SAP Application Interface Framework (AIF) Monitoring.

apis.Name: CO_MDM_PRD_BULK_REPL_REQ_OUT
apis.Title: Product Master – Replicate to Client
apis.ShortText: Replicate product master records using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This services uses the CO_MDM_PRD_BULK_REPL_REQ_OUT service interface. It is based on the SOAP protocol. The product master replication is triggered via data replication framework.

apis.Name: WAREHOUSESTORAGEBIN_0001
apis.Title: Warehouse Storage Bin (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Retrieve warehouse storage bins with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This allows you to retrieve warehouse storage bins, for example, to use as value help or to assist in the process of bin verification by code while processing warehouse orders. You can also create, update, block, and unblock storage bins.

apis.Name: CE_PRODMATERIALBSDCOMPOSITION_0001
apis.Title: Product Material-Based Composition
apis.ShortText: Create and update material-based compositions for products and read material-based composition data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
This service writes data that is provided by an external application to the material-based composition of a product in the Product Compliance solution. It uses the provided data to create or update a version of the material-based composition of a product. In addition, the service can also read data of the material-based composition and provides this data to an external application.

You can apply any of the filters provided or retrieve all existing data.

apis.Name: CO_CRMS4_SERVICE_ORDER_BULK_CO
apis.Title: Service Order (Bulk) - Confirm Processing (Asynchronous)
apis.ShortText: Communicate with an external system when a service order is created or changed using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: A confirmation is sent when service orders have been processed using the inbound asynchronous SOAP service ServiceOrderBulkRequest_In. The confirmation isn't sent when service orders are processed in your SAP S/4HANA Cloud system.

apis.Name: WORKCENTER_0001
apis.Title: Work Center
apis.ShortText: Manage work centers using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service is based on OData V4 protocol and can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces. It enables you to create, read and update work centers. The service contains work center header, work center description, cost center allocation, pooled capacity assignment, capacity header, capacity description, capacity intervals and capacity shifts.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNFSITEMHIERARCHY_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation FS Item Hierarchy - Read
apis.ShortText: Read consolidation financial statement item hierarchies using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation financial statement item hierarchy is a structure of financial statement items in consolidation. For example, you can have a one hierarchy for the balance sheet and another for the income statement.

apis.Name: API_BUS_SOLUTION_ORDER_SRV
apis.Title: Business Solution Order (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Manage Business Solution Order provided in a payload using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
You can use this service to integrate external applications with Business Solution Order processing. In each API call, you can use the following operations:
 - Retrieve Business Solution Order.
 - Create Business Solution Order. Note: You must use “deep insert” requests (a header plus the following entities: Header details, Header text, Sales Items, Service Items and Service Contract Items).
 - Create new items for existing Business Solution Order.
 - Create an item reference object, item object list, item pricing element, and an item text for existing Business Solution Order items.
 - Update the header, header text, item, item pricing element, and item text of existing Business Solution Orders.
 - Delete the item, item reference object, item object list, item pricing element, and item text of existing Business Solution Orders.

#

apis.Name: API_LOCKBOXPOST_IN
apis.Title: Post Lockbox
apis.ShortText: Create and read lockbox batches synchronously using this inbound OData service for the United States
apis.Description: This service creates lockbox batches, lockbox batch items and clearing information. The lockbox batch root entity and associated entities are sent in the POST request as a payload. After the lockbox batches are created, they are posted immediately and can be processed further using the Manage Lockbox Batches app.

apis.Name: JOURNALENTRYBULKCLEARINGREQUES
apis.Title: Journal Entry - Clearing (Asynchronous)
apis.ShortText: Clear journal entries from SAP S/4HANA Cloud asynchronously using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains journal entry header, general ledger item and creditor/debtor item.

apis.Name: CO_MMPUR_PURREQN_REP_NOTIF_OUT
apis.Title: Purchase Requisition – Send Replication Notification
apis.ShortText: Send notifications from an SAP S/4HANA hub system to an external system using this outbound service
apis.Description: In the Central Procurement scenario, this service enables you to send notifications to an external system when purchase requisitions have been replicated successfully from the hub system to a connected system.

apis.Name: CE_WHSEPHYSICALSTOCKPRODUCTS_0001
apis.Title: Warehouse Physical Stock by Product - Read, Update (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Retrieve physical stock by product with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This allows you to analyze the current situation of physical stock in a warehouse. You can request stock information about products in a warehouse. Optionally, you can also read serial numbers. You can post unplanned goods issue for consumption and scrapping.

apis.Name: STORLOCSUBSTITUTION_0001
apis.Title: Storage Location Substitution
apis.ShortText: Manage storage location substitutions using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create plant and time range specific storage location substitution. Additionally, these substitutions can be sequenced, and grouped using predefined groups.

apis.Name: API_PACKINGINSTRUCTION
apis.Title: Packing Instruction – Read, Create (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Integrate external applications with packing instructions using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
Packing instructions serve as templates for the creation of handling units. With this API, you can carry out the following operations:
 - Create a packing instruction comprising packaging material and material to be packed.
 - Create a packing instruction including packaging material and reference material. The reference material enables you to reuse one packing instruction for several materials.
 - Create a packing instruction including subordinated packing instructions (multi-level packing instructions).
 - Retrieve header information for a packing instruction. You can use filter criteria to retrieve information based on other selection criteria, for example, material numbers.
 - Retrieve component information for a packing instruction, which contains information about the packaging material and the material to be packed in the handling unit.
 - Retrieve texts in different languages for a packing instruction.

apis.Name: WAREHOUSEORDER_0001
apis.Title: Warehouse Order and Task (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Integrate external applications with warehouse orders and warehouse tasks with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
In every API call, you can make use of the following operations:
 - You can retrieve warehouse orders and warehouse tasks with their serial numbers. Apply any of the filters provided or retrieve all existing data.
 - For existing warehouse orders, you can update the corresponding warehouse tasks.
 - You can update existing warehouse tasks (confirm, confirm with exceptions, confirm with serial numbers, confirm batch-neutral warehouse tasks, cancel, reassign warehouse task to warehouse order).
 - You can update existing warehouse orders (assign or unassign warehouse order to warehouse resource, lock, unlock, merge, and split).
 - You can create warehouse tasks (product warehouse tasks, handling unit warehouse tasks, and warehouse tasks for warehouse requests, including inbound deliveries, outbound delivery orders, and production material requests).

#

apis.Name: CO_MMPUR_SES_STATUS_NOTIF_OUT
apis.Title: Service Entry Sheet ‒ Send Status Update Notification (Lean Services)
apis.ShortText: Send the status update notifications from the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system to an external system using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This outbound service enables you to send the status update notifications from the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system to an external system if certain changes that are relevant for the business process have been made to a service entry sheet. It sends notifications upon creation and deletion of the service entry sheets. Furthermore, messages are sent to notify the external consumer about changes of the document status of the service entry sheets. You can use this service only for service entry sheets that were created via the inbound web service for service entry sheet creation (Service Entry Sheet – Create, Delete).

apis.Name: CO_PPINT_MRPCHANGE_REQUEST_OUT
apis.Title: MRP Change Request - Send
apis.ShortText: Send a multiple number of Material Requirements Planning (MRP) change requests using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to send MRP change requests from an SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system to an external supplier system. The MRP change requests are sent when the sending is triggered by the apps “Schedule sending of MRP Change Requests” or “Create MRP Change Requests” and if they meet the filter criteria for distribution defined in the communication arrangement.

apis.Name: CE_PRODUCTSUBSTITUTION_0002
apis.Title: Product Substitution
apis.ShortText: Manage product substitutions using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create plant, application and time range specific product substitution. Additionally, these substitutions can be sequenced, and grouped using predefined groups.

apis.Name: CE_LABELTEMPLATEMETADATA_0001
apis.Title: Label Template Metadata
apis.ShortText: Create, read, and update the metadata of label templates using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create or update existing metadata from your SAP S/4HANA system as a result of the design of label templates in external systems. The service provides relevant information about label template metadata, such as name, version, list of used label field versions (from the OData API: ***Label Field Catalog***).

apis.Name: CENTRALSUPPLIERQUOTATION_0001
apis.Title: Central Supplier Quotation
apis.ShortText: Read, update, create and delete central supplier quotations from an external system in SAP S/4HANA Cloud system using this synchronous service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read, update, delete and create central supplier quotations with reference to a central RFQ from an external system in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system. Once the central supplier quotation has been successfully created and awarded, follow-on purchase order/central purchase contract can be created. The service contains header, item, and item distribution. The information is sent in the request as a payload.

apis.Name: CO_MMPUR_PO_ITEM_HIST_NOTIF
apis.Title: Purchase Order – Notify about Update of Item History
apis.ShortText: Send notifications from an SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system to an external system using this outbound asynchronous service
apis.Description: This service enables you to send notifications from an SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system through an API call. The notifications are sent when changes to the purchase order history of an item have occurred.

apis.Name: ECC_CASHPOINTCLOSINGDOCNO
apis.Title: External Cash Point - Inbound Closing Notification
apis.ShortText: Transfer cash desk closing data to Contract Accounting (FI-CA) using this inbound asynchronous service
apis.Description:
This asynchronous service enables you to transfer a cash desk closing, processed at an external cash desk, to Contract Accounting (FI-CA).

Upon receipt of the closing information a corresponding closing posting is processed.

Any application errors can be displayed using the Message Dashboard.

apis.Name: API_PROCESS_ORDER_2_SRV
apis.Title: Process Order (Version 2)
apis.ShortText: Create, read, and update process orders using a technically improved version of the synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: In addition to create, read, and update process orders, you can also release orders and operations. Besides updating header data of the order including the scheduling type, you can also update some properties of the order components. This service enables you to convert planned orders to process orders, schedule process order operations, and set further statuses for the order such as technically completed, closed, discarded by MES, or released by MES. In addition, you can set the deletion flag, deletion indicator, and delivery completed indicator.

apis.Name: FIXEDASSETCHANGE
apis.Title: Fixed Asset - Change (Asynchronous)
apis.ShortText: Change existing asset master records using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service contains the nodes that are necessary to change an asset master record, including the following nodes: Company code, main asset number, asset subnumber, information about the origin of the asset, account assignment, ledger information, valuation information, time-based valuation information.

If there are any issues when the asset master record is changed, the system displays error messages in the response.

Please note: If you want to activate this inbound service, you also have to activate the corresponding outbound service Fixed Asset - Change (Asynchronous) Confirmation (CO_FAA_MD_ESR_CHANGE_CONF_SPRX).

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_LEGAL_DOCUMENT_0001-v1
apis.Title: Legal Document
apis.ShortText: Create legal documents using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Legal documents are instances of legal content which are tailored to a specific legal transaction. The service contains legal document and legal document stamp nodes. The information sent in the request as a payload is used when creating a legal document, including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations. Once the legal documentis created, the legal document ID is sent in the response with the data included in the legal document. If there are any issues when the legal document is created, the system displays error messages in theresponse.Note that to create or change the content of the legal documentyou needto use the Attachment Service that is also published in the SAP Business Accelerator Hub. For more information, refer to the business documentation of this API.

apis.Name: API_APAR_SEPA_MANDATE_SRV
apis.Title: SEPA Mandate - Manage in Accounts Receivable
apis.ShortText: Transfer data from an external system to Accounts Receivable in SAP S/4HANA Cloud using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create, read, and update SEPA mandates for Accounts Receivable. You can also create and read about the usage of SEPA mandates.

apis.Name: CO_NGC_SOAP_CLASSBULKREPREQOUT
apis.Title: Class Data for Classification - Replicate (Asynchronous, Outbound)
apis.ShortText: Replicate classification classes from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to client
apis.Description: Classification classes allow you to group objects together according to criteria that you define. This service enables you to send classification classes to client systems using DRF.

apis.Name: CE_API_PRODUCTION_ROUTING_0002
apis.Title: Production Routing
apis.ShortText: Read, update and create production routing information using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A routing is a description of the operations (or steps in a process) that are performed to manufacture a product (or material). It is used as a reference for production orders, to run schedules and in calculating the costs of products.

apis.Name: CE_REQUESTFORQUOTATION_0001
apis.Title: Request for Quotation
apis.ShortText: Read, update, delete and create a request for quotation from an external system in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system
apis.Description: This service enables you to read, update, delete and create a request for quotation from an external system in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system. The service contains header, item and bidder. The information is sent in the request as a payload. All information is utilized when creating an RFQ with appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations.

apis.Name: CADISPUTECASE_0001
apis.Title: Contract Accounting Dispute Case – Manage
apis.ShortText: Maintain a dispute case with dispute case objects in Contract Accounting (FI-CA) with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
With this service you can create, read, and update a dispute case. Disputed objects can be added or deleted from a dispute case. A disputed object can be a business partner, contract account, contract or FI-CA document.

In addition, notes and attachments can be added and read.

Using the ***SetDisputeCaseToVoid*** action, a dispute case can be voided.

Using the copy action, an existing dispute case can be used as a template for the creation of a new dispute case.

apis.Name: USAGEDECISIONSELDCODESET_0001
apis.Title: Selected Set of Codes for Usage Decision - Read
apis.ShortText: Read usage decision selected sets including code group and code using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You can read data of selected sets for usage decisions and the codes of the selected sets. You can also read short texts of the selected sets, codes and code groups.

apis.Name: CO_FKK_MDG_CONTRACT_ACCOUNT_B1
apis.Title: Contract Account – Return Status of Bulk Replication to Client System
apis.ShortText: Send a replication confirmation message from Contract Accounting (FI-CA) to an external system using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: With this service, you can create a bulk confirmation outbound message. This message is to confirm a request to the ***Contract Account – Bulk Replicate to Client System*** service.

apis.Name: BILLINGDOCUMENTREQUEST_IN
apis.Title: Billing Document - Create
apis.ShortText: Create billing documents in your system by using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Consumers of this inbound service can create billing documents in your system by sending billable data through SOAP messages. This allows billing data from external systems (for example, from orders and deliveries created in a non-SAP system) to be billed within your system.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNSEGMENT_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Segment
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation segments using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation segment is a segment that can be used for financial consolidation in group reporting. It can either be a segment that’s been defined in an area other than group reporting, or it can be a segment that’s been specifically defined for exclusive use in group reporting.

apis.Name: WHSEPHYSICALINVENTORYDOC_0001
apis.Title: Warehouse Physical Inventory (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Count physical inventory using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
In every API call, you can make use of the following operations:
 - Retrieve physical inventory (PI) items.
 - Count PI items.
 - Change counted PI items.
 - Mark PI items as ***Deleted***.
 - Create physical inventory documents.

You can integrate this API with external applications.

For the counting PI items and changing counted PI items operations, you can only perform these operations using batch requests. Additionally, you must include the entities ***Warehouse Physical Inventory Item ***(<TT>WhsePhysicalInventoryItem</TT>) and ***Warehouse Physical Inventory Count Item*** (<TT>WhsePhysicalInventoryCountItem</TT>) in the batch requests.

apis.Name: A_LGLCNTNTMACCESSLVL_CDS
apis.Title: Legal Document Access Levels - Read
apis.ShortText: Use this API to read access levels for legal documents
apis.Description: This synchronous inbound service is based on the OData protocol and can be consumed in integration scenarios or other user interfaces. Access level is an attribute used for authorization checks in Enterprise Contract Management. This service contains access level and access level text nodes. Using this service, you can read the access levels maintained in its configuration.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNCOUNTRY_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Country/Region
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation countries/regions using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation country/region is a country/region that can be used for financial consolidation in group reporting. It can either be a country/region that’s been defined in an area other than group reporting, or it can be a country/region that’s been specifically defined for exclusive use in group reporting.

apis.Name: CE_SRCGPROJCONTACTCAT_0001
apis.Title: Contact Category for Sourcing Project – Read
apis.ShortText: Read contact categories and their description for sourcing projects using this synchronous inbound service

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_SECURITYCLASS_0002-v2
apis.Title: Security Class
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete security class master data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This inbound OData V4 service enables external systems and other consumers to create, read, update and delete security class master data in Treasury and Risk Management systems (component FIN-FSCM-TRM). This service is part of the communication scenario SAP_COM_0954.

apis.Name: API_EBRR_MANUAL_ACCRUALS_SRV
apis.Title: Manual Contract Accruals – Post (Synchronous)
apis.ShortText: Post manual contract accruals using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to post manual contract accruals that are relevant for revenue recognition processing. The cost or revenue adjustments are not changed by the Revenue Recognition Run. The adjustments are posted to extra accounts. When the stage of the project can be considered as completed, they are canceled by the next closing run. The service will group entries with the same WBS Element, Fiscal Period, Fiscal Year, and Ledger and only posts one document in the system.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_GHSCLASSFCTNASSESSMENT_0001-v1
apis.Title: GHS Classification Assessment
apis.ShortText: Read or create and release a new version of assessments based on the Globally Harmonized System (GHS) for Hazard Classification of Chemicals for unpackaged products, raw materials, and substances with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The information on the Globally Harmonized System (GHS) for Hazard Classification of Chemicals is part of a safety data sheet. For example, the classification of a product is used in section 2 of the safety data sheet for the EU, and the classification of its contained hazardous ingredients is used in section 3, if applicable. The requirements are based on the UN Purple Book and differ between countries and regions. This service can read or create and release new versions of GHS classification assessments for unpackaged products, raw materials, and substances, and provide them for further use by external systems.

apis.Name: API_CUSTOMERGROUP_SRV
apis.Title: Customer Group - Read
apis.ShortText: Read customer group master data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service enables you to retrieve customer group master data. You can read information like a customer group and its name in the respective language.

apis.Name: CO_LOG_MDR_ACCT_ASS_CATEGORY
apis.Title: Account Assignment Categories – Replicate
apis.ShortText: Transfer account assignment categories from an SAP S/4HANA Cloud system to an external system using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to transfer account assignment categories from an SAP S/4HANA Cloud system to an external system through an API call. The replication logic of the transferred data (account assignment categories) is handled by the data replication framework (DRF).

apis.Name: CO_SDMD_ESR_SALES_GROUP
apis.Title: Sales Group - Replicate
apis.ShortText: Replicate sales groups from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to external systems
apis.Description: The replication logic of this data is handled by the Data Replication Framework (DRF).

apis.Name: _CPD_SC_PROJ_ENGMT_CREATE_UPD_SRV
apis.Title: Commercial Project - Create, Update
apis.ShortText: Create and update commercial projects using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service enables you to do the following:
 - Create and manage customer and internal projects
 - Manage work packages and work items
 - Plan resources and expenses in work packages
 - Staff resources to work packages
 - Create, read, and update sales orders for your customer projects

apis.Name: PRAMAINTVENTURE_0001
apis.Title: PRA Joint Venture
apis.ShortText: This service can be consumed by external applications in order to integrate PRA Joint Venture processing in SAP S/4HANA Cloud
apis.Description:
This inbound OData service enables you to create, read, and update data about Joint Venture in Production Revenue Accounting (PRA) Ownership. You can query the entities in this service to retrieve the corresponding data about Joint Venture.

This service is published on the SAP API Business Hub.

apis.Name: BUSINESSPARTNERRELATIONSHIPSUI
apis.Title: Business Partner Relationship - Replicate from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to Client
apis.ShortText: Replicate Business Partner Relationship data using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The BusinessPartnerRelationshipSUITEBulkReplicateRequest_In SOAP service enables you to replicate Business Partner Relationship data from Client to SAP S/4HANA Cloud system.

apis.Name: CO_SDSLS_ESR_SO_BULK_CONF_O_V2
apis.Title: Sales Order - Confirm Processing in Bulk (A2A)
apis.ShortText: Send back automatic confirmations for the processing of sales orders with this asynchronous outbound SOAP service
apis.Description: Prerequisite is that the sales orders were processed using the inbound asynchronous SOAP service **SalesOrderBulkRequest_In**. The confirmation is not sent when sales orders are processed in your SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition system.

apis.Name: EHSAMOUNTEXTERNALSRCE_0001
apis.Title: Environment, Health, and Safety External Source - Read, Collect Amounts
apis.ShortText: Collect environmental data using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read available External Source IDs and send amounts to the system. You can send multiple amounts via a changeset.

apis.Name: CE_PRAMEASUREMENTPOINTVOL_0001
apis.Title: PRA Measurement Point Volume
apis.ShortText: Production and Revenue Measurement Point Volumes is an inbound service which allows create, update, delete and read of Measurement Point Volume Document
apis.Description:
You can read the Measurement Point Volume Document Header and measurement items.

Measurement Point Volume documents and Measurement Point measurement item will be created and deleted using this service. Measurement Point measurement item can be updated using this service.

apis.Name: _SCMTMS_CO_CPX_TPNOR_REQ
apis.Title: Freight Order – Subcontract
apis.ShortText: Send freight orders to a carrier to initiate the subcontracting process by using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This service is used to send freight order details to the carrier organization while carrying out the subcontracting process. The service contains a transportation document node. A transportation document node contains information maintained in a freight order such as carrier details, freight order ID, items, transportation stages, charges, notes and attachments. When you send a freight order to the carrier using this service, the freight order subcontracting status is updated and shows that it has been sent to the carrier.

apis.Name: CO_CRMS4_SRVO_CONF_REQUEST
apis.Title: Service Order - Confirm Processing (Asynchronous)
apis.ShortText: Communicate with an external system when a service order is created or changed using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: Your SAP S/4HANA Cloud system triggers a confirmation to the external system to inform the external system about the creation/change of a service order. To receive this information, an endpoint for this service must be implemented in the external system.

apis.Name: CE_STATRYRPTRPTDEFINITION_0001
apis.Title: Statutory Reporting Report Definition ‒ Read
apis.ShortText: Read statutory report definitions for Brazil using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service contains entities that represent the actions you can complete with this API. Each entity contained in this service is named after an action of Document and Reporting Compliance Report Definition.
- Report Definition – Read reports for specified report definition.
- Report Parameter Definition – Read phases for the specified report definition.
- Document Definition – Read activities for the specified report definition.

apis.Name: CE_PURCHASEORDER_0001
apis.Title: Purchase Order
apis.ShortText: Create, update, or delete purchase orders using this synchronous service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create purchase orders through an API call from a source system outside SAP S/4HANA Cloud. Furthermore, the service enables you to read, update or delete existing purchase orders from the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system. The service is based on the OData protocol.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNORDER_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Order
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation orders using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation order is an order that can be used for financial consolidation in group reporting. It can either be an order that’s been defined in an area other than group reporting, or it can be an order that’s been specifically defined for exclusive use in group reporting.

apis.Name: API_GLACCOUNTINCHARTOFACCOUNTS_SRV
apis.Title: G/L Account - Read
apis.ShortText: Read G/L account master data using this inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to retrieve G/L accounts in chart of accounts and their names in the respective language.

apis.Name: PAYMENTREQUISITIONCN_0001
apis.Title: Payment Requisition (Synchronous)
apis.ShortText: Manage workflow for payment requisition approval for China using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service contains payment requisitions, payment requisition items and payment requisition strategies. You can use this service to read, create, delete, submit, and update these objects. If there are any issues during updating the approval status of payment requisitions, the system display error messages in the response.

apis.Name: MATERIALDOCUMENTCREATEREQUEST1
apis.Title: Material Document - Create
apis.ShortText: Use this asynchronous inbound service to create material documents
apis.Description: The asynchronous SOAP service enables you to create Material Documents in SAP S/4HANA Cloud. To receive an asynchronous confirmation of the Material Document creation, use service CO_MMIM_SOA_MATDOC_CONF.

apis.Name: CREDITWORTHINESSQUERY_IN
apis.Title: Credit Worthiness Information – Read
apis.ShortText: Request information about the creditworthiness of business partners using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The application that wants information on the creditworthiness of a business partner (for example, Accounts Receivable Accounting or Sales and Distribution) sends a query to SAP Credit Management, and SAP Credit Management returns the required information such as the score and recommended credit limit for the business partner. This information influences, for example, the decision in the requesting application as to whether or not to have business dealings with this business partner.

apis.Name: PROFITCENTREGROUPHIERARCHYREP1
apis.Title: Profit Center Group Hierarchy
apis.ShortText: Create, update, and delete profit center groups and change profit center standard hierarchies using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains profit center group, profit center group text, relationship, profit center assignment, and profit center interval nodes.

apis.Name: DOCUMENTEDCREDITDECISIONERPBUS
apis.Title: Documented Credit Decision – Create, Update
apis.ShortText: Update or create a documented credit decision using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A blocked sales document creates a documented credit decision in SAP Credit Management. The data is saved in the Case Management application as a case. It contains the credit data and further optional data that the system has retained as a snapshot at the time the credit decision was made. You can use this for meeting the legal requirements regarding data protection.

apis.Name: API_PHYSICAL_INVENTORY_DOC_SRV
apis.Title: Physical Inventory Documents - Read, Create
apis.ShortText: Use this synchronous inbound service to read and create physical inventory documents
apis.Description: You can count items and post differences on both document and item level. The service can be consumed by external systems.

apis.Name: CO_EDI_DELIVERY_REQUEST_OUT
apis.Title: Outbound Delivery - Notify (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Notify a delivery recipient asynchronously about the planned arrival, pickup, or issue date of a delivery using this outbound service
apis.Description: This outbound service enables you to notify a delivery recipient about the planned arrival, pickup, or issue date of a delivery, including details on handling requirements or contents of the delivery (B2B). On the recipient's side, a corresponding inbound service is available: Inbound Delivery - Create.

apis.Name: CO_COST_CENTRE_GROUP_HIERAR
apis.Title: Cost Center Group Hierarchy - Send
apis.ShortText: Replicate master data of cost center group and hierarchy from one system to other systems using this outbound service
apis.Description: Replication is enabled by the Data Replication Framework (DRF).

apis.Name: CE_PROJDEMANDASSIGNMENTSTATUS_0001
apis.Title: Assignment Status for Project Demands - Read
apis.ShortText: Read assignment statuses for project demands using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to read assignment statuses for project demands for resources along with their descriptions. You can use this service, for example, to retrieve supported values for the corresponding field in the **Resource Demand** entity of the **Project Demand** API, or to make the descriptions of the status values available for your custom application.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CONSOLIDATIONQUESTIONTYPE_0001-v1
apis.Title: Consolidation Question Type
apis.ShortText: Read consolidation question types using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation question type is a coded representation of the type of a consolidation question.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNCUSTOMERGROUP_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Customer Group
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation customer groups using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation customer group is a customer group that can be used for financial consolidation in group reporting. It can either be a customer group that’s been defined in an area other than group reporting, or it can be a customer group that’s been specifically defined for exclusive use in group reporting.

apis.Name: API_CUSTOMER_RETURNS_DELIVERY_SRV
apis.Title: Customer Returns Delivery (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Process customer returns deliveries using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create, read, update and delete customer returns deliveries. It can be consumed in Fiori apps and on other user interfaces.

apis.Name: BDWREFERENCEREQUEST_IN
apis.Title: Billing Document - Create with SD Document Reference
apis.ShortText: Create billing documents with reference to sales and distribution (SD) documents in your system by using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Consumers of this inbound service can create billing documents in your system by sending SOAP messages to trigger the billing of billable SD documents in your system. Common examples of billable SD documents are sales orders, outbound deliveries, and billing document requests.

apis.Name: CE_SOURCINGPROJECTQUOTATION_0001
apis.Title: Supplier Quotation for Sourcing Project
apis.ShortText: Manage supplier quotations using this inbound synchronous service

apis.Name: CreateLinkApi
apis.Title: Create Link
apis.ShortText: Create a link type object in a specified repository
apis.Description: It creates a link type object under a specified repository for which the name and URL for the link should be provided.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CO_EDI_DELIVERY_REQUEST_V2_OUT-v2
apis.Title: Outbound Delivery - Notify (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Notify a delivery recipient asynchronously about the planned arrival, pickup, or issue date of a delivery using this outbound service
apis.Description: This outbound service enables you to notify a delivery recipient about the planned arrival, pickup, or issue date of a delivery, including details on handling requirements or contents of the delivery (B2B). On the recipient's side, a corresponding inbound service is available: Inbound Delivery - Create.

apis.Name: CO_SDMD_ESR_DISTR_CHANNEL
apis.Title: Distribution Channel - Replicate
apis.ShortText: Replicate distribution channels from SAP S/4HANA Cloud to external systems
apis.Description: The replication logic of this data is handled by the Data Replication Framework (DRF).

apis.Name: CABILLINGPLAN_0001
apis.Title: Convergent Invoicing Billing Plan
apis.ShortText: Manage Billing Plans in Convergent Invoicing using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: Read entire billing plans or only parts of the data, using the provided filters. Create new billing plans with billing plan items. Add new billing plan items to existing billing plans, using deep insert requests. Update or delete the billing plan header or its items.

apis.Name: API_CHARCATTRIBUTECATALOG_SRV
apis.Title: Characteristic Attribute Catalog - Read
apis.ShortText: Read catalog data that is used to document the quality inspection results for qualitative characteristics using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The catalog data that is read with this service consists of plant-specific selected sets with their codes that are used to record inspection results for qualitative characteristics, for example, the codes 01 (Smooth) and 02 (Rough) for the characteristic ***Surface***.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNBUSINESSAREA_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Business Area
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation business areas using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation business area is a business area that can be used for financial consolidation in group reporting. It can either be a business area that’s been defined in an area other than group reporting, or it can be a business area that’s been specifically defined for exclusive use in group reporting.

apis.Name: CE_CNSLDTNPRODUCTGROUP_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Product Group
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update and delete consolidation product groups using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: A consolidation product group is a product group that can be used for financial consolidation in group reporting. It can either be a product group that’s been defined in an area other than group reporting, or it can be a product group that’s been specifically defined for exclusive use in group reporting.

apis.Name: API_RFQ_PROCESS_SRV
apis.Title: Request for Quotation
apis.ShortText: Read, create, and update requests for quotations from or in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system using this service
apis.Description: The service contains header, item, and bidder nodes. The information is sent in the request as a payload. All information is utilized when creating an RFQ with appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations. Once the RFQ has been successfully created, the RFQ number is sent in the response with the data included in the RFQ. If any issues arise when the RFQ is created, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: API_COSTCNTRACTIVITYTYPE_CRUD_SRV
apis.Title: Activity Type (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update, and delete cost center activity types using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You can use this inbound synchronous service to create, read, update, and delete master data of activity types used by one or multiple cost centers. It is based on the OData protocol and can be consumed in SAP Fiori apps and other user interfaces.

apis.Name: API_JNTOPGAGRMT_0001
apis.Title: Joint Operating Agreement
apis.ShortText: Maintain Joint Operating Agreement using this inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains Joint Operating Agreement, Description, Equity Group, Penalty Category Recovery Percentage and Partner Share nodes. The information is sent in the request as a payload, which is used in creating or updating a Joint Operating Agreement, including appropriate checks for restricted values and authorizations. If there are any issues when the Joint Operating Agreement is created, updated or deleted, the system displays error messages in the response.

apis.Name: PREDICTIVEJOURNALENTRYMANAGERE
apis.Title: Predictive Journal Entry – Manage (Synchronous)
apis.ShortText: Simulate and create predictive journal entries for predictive accounting and reduce their amounts or reverse them as needed using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service contains the header, line item, debtor line item, and product tax item. The information is sent in the request as a payload. All information is used to manage predictive journal entries in the prediction ledger. During the simulation and creation of predictive journal entries, validation checks such as for company code and G/L account take place. After the predictive journal entry is created, reduced or reversed, the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system sends a response message that contains the document processing status. If any errors occur, they are displayed in the response. Note. Before you can use this API, you need to implement two BAdIs that deactivate the standard simulation/creation and reduction logic in the standard process for managing predictive journal entries.

apis.Name: CO_LEIDW_SPLIT_OUTBOUND_DELIVE
apis.Title: Split Outbound Delivery Confirmation – Send to Warehouse (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Receive Split Outbound Delivery Confirmation using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The system returns this message to a decentralized Warehouse Management System (WMS) in response to a preceding Split Outbound Delivery message. The Split Outbound Delivery Confirmation message updates the decentralized WMS with the results of the Split Outbound Delivery message execution. It returns the delivery number of the new delivery and a success message or an error log to the calling system. This message is sent to the decentralized WMS system.

apis.Name: CO_LOG_MDR_PURCHASING_GROUP
apis.Title: Purchasing Groups – Replicate
apis.ShortText: Transfer purchasing groups from an SAP S/4HANA Cloud system to an external system using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to transfer purchasing groups from an SAP S/4HANA Cloud system to an external system through an API call. The replication logic of the transferred data (purchasing groups) is handled by the data replication framework (DRF).

apis.Name: API_PURCHASECONTRACT_PROCESS_SRV_0002
apis.Title: Purchase Contracts
apis.ShortText: Read, create, and update purchase contracts using this asynchronous inbound API
apis.Description: This service enables you to read, create, and update purchase contracts through an API call from a source system outside SAP S/4HANA Cloud. The service contains header, item, item conditions, account assignment, address, Header notes, Item notes and partner nodes.

apis.Name: CONTRACTACCOUNTBULKREPLICATERE
apis.Title: Contract Account – Bulk Replicate from Client System
apis.ShortText: Transfer contract account data from an external system to Contract Accounting (FI-CA) using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: With this service, you can create and update contract accounts. You can transfer data of multiple contract accounts using bulk requests.

apis.Name: CO_EDI_PAYABLE_PAYMENT_TERMS
apis.Title: Journal Entry - Send Discount Information
apis.ShortText: Send discount information using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to send discount information with the data provided in a payload to a discount management integration system. The service can be used between customers and suppliers to optimize business processes. Exchanging discount information messages directly (point to point) or through an integration platform, for example, SAP Ariba, leads to a higher degree of automation and a reduction of manual activities.

apis.Name: CO_SDBIL_ESR_BD_PRCG_CONF_OUT
apis.Title: Billing Document - Send Confirmation of Simulated Pricing
apis.ShortText: Send confirmations of simulated prices for billing document items in your system by using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description:
For each request to a simulate a redetermination of prices for billing document items in your system that is received through the inbound service *Billing Document - Simulate Pricing*, this outbound service responds with the simulation results.

This service is intended solely for the integration between SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP Self-Billing Cockpit and should not be used for any other purposes.

apis.Name: CE_PRODUCT_0002
apis.Title: Product
apis.ShortText: Create, read, update of the master data for products using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: The service supports following operations: GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE. You can create, read, update, and delete product master data at the entity level.

apis.Name: ECC_CASHPOINTCLOSINGDOCCNCNO
apis.Title: External Cash Point - Inbound Closing Reversal Notification
apis.ShortText: Transfer cash desk closing cancellation data to Contract Accounting (FI-CA) using this inbound asynchronous service
apis.Description:
This asynchronous service enables you to transfer a cancellation of a cash desk closing, processed at an external cash desk, to Contract Accounting (FI-CA).

Upon receipt of the cancellation information the corresponding cash desk closing is reversed.

Any application errors can be displayed using the Message Dashboard.

apis.Name: CE_API_CNSLDTNGRPJRNLITEM_0001
apis.Title: Consolidation Group Journal Entry
apis.ShortText: Provides transaction data for group reporting using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service selects transaction data that is included in SAP S/4HANA Cloud for group reporting, such as reported financial data or consolidated financial data. With this service you can retrieve consolidated data including intercompany elimination and consolidation entries.

apis.Name: SERVICEENTRYSHEETREQUEST_IN
apis.Title: Service Entry Sheet ‒ Create, Delete (Lean Services)
apis.ShortText: Create and delete service entry sheets from the external system in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to create and delete service entry sheets in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system. To achieve this, the external consumer sends the required data to the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system through web service requests. For the creation of the service entry sheet, a purchase order must exist in the external system. All provided XML fields must be filled out correctly, otherwise the system reports an error.

apis.Name: KEYMAPPINGBULKREPLICATEREQUEST
apis.Title: Key Mapping – Replicate to Client
apis.ShortText: Replicate key mapping using this asynchronous outbound service
apis.Description: The KeyMappingBulkReplicateRequest_Out SOAP service interface enables you to replicate key mapping records to the client systems.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_CREDITMEMOREQUEST_0001-v1
apis.Title: Credit Memo Request (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Create, read, and update credit memo requests using this inbound service
apis.Description:
This service, which offers both synchronous and asynchronous processing, makes the data of credit memo requests available through its header, item, partner, pricing element, and text entities. With this service, you can do the following:
 - Create credit memo requests from scratch or by referencing a preceding document.
 - Create credit memo requests with or without subentities. The subentities include the following: header partner, header pricing element, header text, item, item partner, item pricing element, and item text.
 - Read entire credit memo requests or only parts of the data, using the provided filters.
 - Read, update, and delete subentitites for existing credit memo requests.

apis.Name: ECC_PROJBYIDQR
apis.Title: Project - Retrieve Details using Project ID
apis.ShortText: Retrieve project details using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service enables you to search for a project and its related master data details which can be further used in applications and integration scenarios (Example, time recording, cost planning). This service provides important details of a project such as project identification, description, controlling area, company code, plant, profit center and associated dates.

apis.Name: CODING_0001
apis.Title: Catalog Type Coding - Read
apis.ShortText: Read catalog type Coding using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description: This service contains catalog groups and codes that belong to catalog type D which is Coding. The catalog type Coding is used in maintenance notification to record the failure modes.

apis.Name: MMPUR_PURREQUISITIONREQUEST_IN
apis.Title: Purchase Requisition – Create, Update
apis.ShortText: Create and update purchase requisitions using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The update operation can be used to flag line items as “deleted” or “undeleted”. The item category “standard” allows you to use material items (product type group “1”) and lean services (product type group „2 “). Enhanced limit items (item category “E”) are also supported.

The service contains a message header and nodes for the purchase requisition header, attachments at header level, the purchase requisition item, the delivery address, account assignment information, a text collection, and attachments at item level.

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_BILLINGDOCUMENTREQUEST_0001-v1
apis.Title: Billing Document Request
apis.ShortText: Create, read, reject, and delete external billing document requests in your system by using this inbound service
apis.Description:
Billing document requests are intermediary objects that serve to funnel itemized billable data (often originating from outside your system) into the billing process. This service, which offers both synchronous and asynchronous processing, makes the data of billing document requests available through its header, item, and partner entities. You can extend it with custom fields via key user extensibility. 
 
You can use this service to do the following:
 - Create external billing document requests (EBDRs, that is, billing document requests containing data from outside your system) by passing itemized billable data from an external source
 - Read fields of all billing document requests (not just EBDRs) in your system, including partners and texts, at header and item level
 - Change the status of EBDRs to **Rejected**
 - Delete EBDRs that are no longer needed

apis.Name: CALM_ANALYTICS
apis.Title: SAP Cloud ALM Analytics
apis.ShortText: Access to all analytics from SAP Cloud ALM data providers.
apis.Description:
The **SAP Cloud ALM Analytics API** enables you to build dashboards and reports aggregating all types of data managed by SAP Cloud ALM. The SAP Cloud ALM Analytics API comes with **OData** and **Rest** endpoints exposing analytics data. The goals of the SAP Cloud ALM Analytics API are:
  1. Access SAP Cloud ALM analytics through a generic single-entry point.
  2. Mix analytics data from all SAP Cloud ALM components (use-cases) via standard API.
  3. Access time series as well as table data through the same interface.
  4. Consume SAP Cloud ALM analytics from SAP Analytics Cloud or from an OData consumer without coding.
  5. Consume SAP Cloud ALM analytics from third-party frontend applications.
The SAP Cloud ALM Analytics API relies on the following concepts:
  • Providers: Data providers are analytics data sources corresponding to the different objects or scenarios managed in SAP Cloud ALM. They could be Tasks, Projects, Alerts, Integration Monitoring,
  • Dimensions: The Dimensions are the characteristics of SAP Cloud ALM entities. The Dimensions correspond to the different fields of the CALM entities. (e.g.: Name of Projects, Phase Status for CALM tasks).
  • Metrics: Metrics are the quantitative measurements of SAP Cloud ALM analytics data sources. (e.g. total number of tasks, average response time, ...). Different optional aggregation methods can be supported for each metric (e.g. avg, sum, max, min, Last, ...)
**Output Format**. The SAP Cloud ALM analytics API supports two output formats:
  • Series:
    • Time series: A series of data points indexed in time order.
    • Categorical value series: The values of measures are represented on the y-axis, while dimensions provide the axis of the chart.
  • Table: Row-column structured data format representing SAP Cloud ALM dimensions in columns.
**Time Dimensions**. Analytics are constructed on a time dimension containing two attributes:
  • period: The duration of the measurements (e.g. Today, Last 6 Months, ...). This is in general a dynamic rolling-time dimension.
  • Resolution: The scale of the data points. (e.g. hour, month, ...)
**Queries**. Queries are the central mechanism of the SAP Cloud ALM Analytics API to format and retrieve data from SAP Cloud ALM. query is responsible to return either a set of measures (series) or a row-column structured data format (table) for a specific data provider and a given period based on filters and columns identified by selected dimensions of the data sources.

apis.Description:
The Analytical reporting APIs enable you  to create a client application that extracts reportable data from reporting facts and dimensions such as you would select in the user interface when creating an analytical report. For example, you could use these APIs to extract and report on the analytical data that you need to import to a customer's warehouse or create dashboards for trend assessment.

A reporting view template specifies the type of records to report on, the reporting fields to be included in the API response, and selection filters to select relevant records for inclusion.

apis.Name: contract_terms_management
apis.Title: Contract Terms Management API
apis.ShortText: Create and retrieve contract terms documents and compliance contract requests.
apis.Description:
This Contract Terms Management allows a client application to :
- create a contract term in the specified contract workspace and a contract request for the corresponding compliance contract in the specified buyer realm. The API creates the Contract Terms Document in the specified contract workspace and then, calls the Compliance Contract Request API using the Contract Terms Document ID  and the buyer realm name as input. If the Compliance Contract Request Object is successfully created, then the API returns the ACC Contract Request ID to the client; otherwise, it sends an error message to the client.
- retrieve details including contract term ID, contract request ID and contract ID for the specified contract workspace ID. The response contains the contract terms document details like title, owner, status etc and the compliance contract request details like Contract Request ID (CRID), Contract ID (CID), etc. associated with the contract workspace.
- synchronize the contract line item information of a contract workspace with the linked compliance contract by specifying the IDs of the contract workspace and the compliance contract. If the request is successful, the API initiates an asynchronous job and returns the job ID for reference.
apis.ChangeLog: [{"date":"15 Aug 2020","notes":"Version 1.0.0 of Contract Terms Management API is now published","state":"Active","version":"1.0.0"}]

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_TIMX_WRKLIST_SYNC_ACTION_IN
apis.Title: Employee Worklist Action In
apis.ShortText: An interface for synchronizing the worklist
apis.Description:
The worklist of the timesheet shows the items that the employee will be working on, during any period of time. These items may be manually added by the employee, or be updated when there is a change in the project assignment of the employee.

This update of the worklist is currently a manual synchronization activity, which gets carried out only when the employee launches the timesheet. This becomes an issue when a customer wishes to use the worklist items for recording time via an external time recording application.

The service addresses exactly this problem – it can be called by the external application in order to update the worklist with any changes that could have come in as a result of changes in project assignment. The service can be called prior to querying the worklist for the existing set of items, this way an updated list will be sent to the application invoking the query on the worklist items.

The service may also be tied to a manual action on the external application, so that the user can call for a synchronization of the worklist items on demand.

The web service interface offers the operations SynchronizeWorklist

here is an example.
```
<n0:EmployeeWorklistSynchronizeActionRequest_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <BasicMessageHeader>
 <ID>Token 4</ID>
 <UUID>12345678-90AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF</UUID>
 <ReferenceID>Token 10</ReferenceID>
 <ReferenceUUID>12345678-90AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF</ReferenceUUID>
 </BasicMessageHeader>
 <EmployeeWorklist>
 <EmployeeUUID >12345678-90AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF</UUID>
 <EmployeeID>EmployeeID</EmployeeID>
 <ChangeStateID></ChangeStateID>
 </EmployeeWorklist>
 </n0:EmployeeWorklistSynchronizeActionRequest_sync>
```

apis.Name: procurement_eventstatus
apis.Title: Integration monitoring API for Procurement
apis.ShortText: Allows customers to import or export master and transaction data to and from their ERP system.
apis.Description:
The data integration options available in SAP Ariba allows customers to import or export master and transaction data, to and from their ERP system. Data can be imported or exported by running individual or batch data import or export tasks from the user interface, or by scheduling the import or export using the SAP Ariba Integration Toolkit (ITK). The Integration monitoring API for Procurement allows customers to develop client applications that call the Integration monitoring API URL, which will return the status of a particular integration event (a data import or export task). This is useful for customers to automate their batch import or export jobs to or from their SAP Ariba solution. Buyer organizations can use the Integration monitoring API to monitor the status of import and export integration events. The API returns the current running status of the specified event, or, if the event is not currently running, the system returns details of the last run status of the specific event. It can also be configured to return the execution history of the integration event.

The Integration monitoring API is applicable to:
* SAP, PeopleSoft, and generic ERP systems
* Individual import and export file channel integration events
* Batch import integration events
* Transaction and master data.

apis.ShortText: An interface to maintain financial plan data from an external planning system.
apis.Description:

apis.Name: sap-s4-CE_WAREHOUSESTOCKTRANSFERFINALREC-v1
apis.Title: Stock Transfer Final Receipt Advice – from Warehouse (B2B)
apis.ShortText: Complete the processing of all partial goods receipt postings and update the inbound delivery data using this asynchronous inbound service
apis.Description: You use this API to update delivery quantity, gross weight, volume, and other relevant delivery data after all partial goods receipt postings for an inbound delivery have been completed. The inbound delivery then reflects the values processed in a third-party logistics warehouse management system. After this request has been successfully processed, the goods movement status at the item and header level is set to "Completed", and no further partial goods receipt postings are allowed. As a response to this request, a Warehouse Stock Transfer Final Receipt Advice Confirmation message is sent to a third-party logistics warehouse management system.

apis.Name: HANDLINGUNIT_0001
apis.Title: Handling Unit
apis.ShortText: Create, read, delete, and post goods movement for handling units using this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
The service contains handling unit header and item nodes, a serial number node, and a handling unit reference document node.

With this API, you can carry out the following operations:
 - Retrieve information from handling units, for example, read all handling units for a plant, read all products packed in a specific handling unit, or read all serial numbers for handling units. In addition, you can retrieve reference documents for simple and cross-delivery handling units in Warehouse Management storage locations.
 - Create handling units without reference to a document (non-assigned handling units).
 - Pack products or handling units into handling units, or repack or unpack products or handling units, in Warehouse Management storage locations.
 - Post goods movement for handling units. You can move handling units to different storage locations and transfer handling units from an Inventory Management storage location to a Warehouse Management storage bin.
 - Delete handling units. Deleting a handling unit results in unpacking the materials included and deleting the corresponding handling unit itself.
 - Create situations when IoT sensors attached to handling units exceed critical thresholds.

apis.Name: Mobile
apis.Title: Mobile Service
apis.ShortText: Provides basic methods for mobile application handling.
apis.Description: Basic Methods for the Mobile Environment. This is a specialized service designed for mobile ticketing applications that enables customers to manage their event tickets directly on their mobile devices. It provides endpoints for mobile-specific workflows including customer login authentication, retrieving purchased tickets for download either by invoice or all recent tickets from the last three months, listing ticket IDs only, fetching individual ticket data, confirming successful ticket receipt which marks tickets as printed and optionally stores NFC/RFID smartphone UIDs, and forwarding tickets to other customers via mobile number with format validation. The service supports online shop sessions, includes comprehensive error handling with history tracking for login events, and automatically resets ticket download status to allow repeated retrieval until confirmation.

apis.Name: Infodelivery
apis.Title: Infodelivery Service
apis.ShortText: Provides methods for the systematic export of business data, which enables external systems to query data in a structured way
apis.Description: Generate Basis Objects for Basic Setup. It is a comprehensive service for creating and managing the foundational master data and configuration objects in the SAP Event Ticketing system. It provides endpoints for setting up and maintaining the core ticketing infrastructure, including events, venues (houses), block templates (seating sections), price lists, pricing structures, performances, fee groups and charges, seat locking mechanisms, entry points, seat/row aliases, additional currencies, and product variants. The service supports both creation and update operations (upsert pattern), includes specialized functions like seat price assignment, invoice email sending, customer doublet merging, and synchronization requests, with all operations requiring session authentication and extensive validation through dedicated models, while maintaining history tracking for modified entities.

apis.Name: Order
apis.Title: Order Service
apis.ShortText: Provides methods for basic order, invoice, reservation and basket management.
apis.Description: Basket and booking management. This is the most comprehensive service  in the SAP Event Ticketing system, serving as the central hub for basket management, ticket reservation, ordering, and invoice operations. It provides  endpoints covering the complete order lifecycle including ticket reservation methods, basket operations, payment processing, invoice management , reservation/option handling, ticket operations , shipment configuration, chunk/time-slot ticket support, insurance confirmation, and specialized features for subscriptions, bundles, and group bookings. The service integrates history tracking, data validation, and extensive error handling with detailed return codes.

apis.Name: Export
apis.Title: Export Service
apis.ShortText: Provides methods for the systematic export of business data, which enables external systems to query data in a structured way
apis.Description: Export of business data. The service is designed for the systematic export of business data from the SAP Event Ticketing system to external systems. It provides endpoints that follow a consistent list-get-tag pattern for exporting different entity types including invoices (with support for bundles and customer visibility filtering), customers, communication channels, addresses, customer group memberships, and merged customer records. The service uses a pull-based export mechanism where external systems first list available records by ID, retrieve individual or bundled records with complete data, and then tag them as exported to prevent re-export, with all operations requiring valid session authentication and supporting optional system identification for tracking export destinations.

apis.Name: Customer
apis.Title: Customer Service
apis.ShortText: Provides methods for basic customer data management and related data such as addresses, communication channels, or customer affiliations.
apis.Description: Basic customer data management. It is a comprehensive service for managing customer data and related entities in the SAP Event Ticketing system. It provides endpoints for complete customer lifecycle management, including creating, reading, updating, and merging customer records; managing customer addresses, communication channels (email, phone, etc.), and authorization credentials; handling customer groups and memberships; managing custom attributes and their values; controlling marketing consent preferences; and maintaining customer blocking lists. The service validates all inputs through dedicated validation models, requires valid session authentication for all operations, and integrates with legacy merchant system components while supporting features like address validation, duplicate detection, and GDPR-compliant data erasure.

apis.Name: Cache
apis.Title: Cache Service
apis.ShortText: Provides basic methods for cache management.
apis.Description: Basic cache management. The service provides endpoints for storing base64-encoded data with a specified TTL and for retrieving cached data by key, always with valid session authentication. The service enforces size limits (1MB) and expiration constraints on cache entries stored in a dedicated Redis database.

apis.Description: Basic Advertisement management.

apis.Name: Session
apis.Title: Session Service
apis.ShortText: Provides methods for basic session management.
apis.Description: Session management and authentication. This is a service dedicated to comprehensive session lifecycle management and authentication for the SAP Event Ticketing system. It provides endpoints covering session initialization through multiple authentication methods, session validation and termination, session data management, customer login functionality for self-service access. The service supports both standard backend user sessions and online shop customer sessions, includes history tracking for login events, provides one-time token URL generation for secure access, and validates all operations through dedicated validation models.

apis.Name: InfoRequest
apis.Title: InfoRequest Service
apis.ShortText: Provides read-only methods for important business objects and data.
apis.Description: Management of important business objects and data. This is an extensive read-only service that provides comprehensive information retrieval capabilities for all major business objects and data in the SAP Event Ticketing system. It offers endpoints for querying events, performances, artists, venues (houses), price lists, prices, charges, fee groups, companies, SEPA data, performance categories, cities, blocks (seating sections), contingents, box office protocols, capacity data, ticket sales statistics, performance workload, accounting data, chunks, layout representations, reservation limits, performance pools, insurance claims, activation states, and change tracking. The service supports complex filtering options (by date ranges, company, event, performance status, categories), provides both simple and enhanced/matrix data formats for various entities, includes performance bookability checks and sales data aggregation, and requires session authentication for all operations and uses dedicated validation models.
