apis.Description: A template that defines the data to be passed on from a source specification to a target specification. You can retrieve inheritance templates and inheritance template texts with this API.

apis.Name: CompositionItemTypeConfigurationV1
apis.Title: Composition Item Type Configuration
apis.ShortText: Read the configuration of composition item types defined in Specification Management.
apis.Description: Composition item types in Specification Management are linking composition items and composition item groups. This API allows you to get information about the configuration of composition item types.

apis.Name: CompositionItemValueQualifierGroupConfigurationV1
apis.Title: Composition Item Value Qualifier Group Configuration Service
apis.ShortText: Read the configuration of composition item value qualifier group in Specification Management.
apis.Description: In specification management, a composition is a list of ingredients or constituents used to describe what a mixture is made up of. A composition contains composition items. Users can assign composition items to a value qualifier. The choice of value qualifiers available for a composition property is defined by configuring a value qualifier group and assigning that group to the composition property. This service allows users to read the available value qualifier groups for compositions.

apis.Name: PropertyConfigurationV1
apis.Title: Property Configuration
apis.ShortText: Read property configurations defined in Specification Management.
apis.Description: A property records the details of a specification in numeric or textual format. Depending on different business cases, you can define attribute properties, composition properties, and information properties. This API allows you to get information about the configuration of the properties in your system, as well as about their composition settings and attribute settings.

apis.Name: WAREHOUSEINBOUNDDELIVERY_0001
apis.Title: Warehouse Inbound Delivery - Read, Update (A2X)
apis.ShortText: Integrate external applications with warehouse inbound deliveries with this synchronous inbound service
apis.Description:
In every API call, you can make use of the following operations:
 - You can retrieve header information for warehouse inbound deliveries.
 - You can retrieve item information for warehouse inbound deliveries, including serial numbers.
 - You can change the carrier ID for a warehouse inbound delivery at header level.
 - You can change the product quantity and the goods movement bin for a warehouse inbound delivery at item level.
 - You can adjust the delivery item quantity down to 0 if the item was not received, or down to the packed quantity that was received.
 - You can post goods receipt.
 - You can reverse goods receipt.

apis.Name: CALM_SR
apis.Title: SAP Cloud ALM Service Request API
apis.ShortText: Service request management in the SAP Support Backbone.
apis.Description:
The **SAP Cloud ALM Service Request API** enables customers and partners to access and manage service requests within the SAP Support Backbone. 
As an extension of the **SAP Cloud ALM ITSM API**, this service focuses specifically on the fulfillment of technical service requests and catalog items, complementing the incident management capabilities of ITSM.

This API provides a unified, programmatic entry point to SAP's support backend. It allows you to retrieve Service Requests independently of where they were originally created, whether via SAP for Me, SAP Solution Manager, or other built-in support channels.

*Please note: The current release of this API provides read-only access to service request data. Capabilities to create or update service requests are planned for future releases.*

apis.Description: The SAP Cloud ALM Resource Changes API is a webhook to be implemented by third party applications interested in receiving resource change events from selected SAP Cloud ALM resources. The URL implementing this webhook depends on the Third Party application; it needs to be configured in SAP BTP Destination Service of your SAP Cloud ALM subscriber tenant. In order to receive the SAP Cloud ALM resource change events, a generic subscription must be configured in administration UI of SAP Cloud ALM Resource Changes Service. This subscription should reference the BTP destination pointing to your Third Party application webhook. See also SAP Cloud ALM Resource Changes Service documentation.

apis.Name: CALM_LOGS
apis.Title: SAP Cloud ALM Raw Logs
apis.ShortText: Inject or consume SAP Cloud ALM log records using OpenTelemetry format.
apis.Description: **SAP Cloud ALM Raw Data Logs API** helps to integrate with open sources, in-house tools or third-party applications by receiving or sending log records in an open standard format. SAP Cloud ALM Raw Data Logs API lets you consume and inject log records in SAP Cloud ALM using "[OpenTelemetry](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/otlp/)" HTTP protocol. The SAP Cloud ALM Raw Data **Outbound Logs API** is used to **read** logs produced by the different SAP Cloud ALM monitoring uses-cases. The number of log records returned by the API depends on the time period and filter parameters passed to the API. This interface, is accessible in PULL mode. The SAP Cloud ALM Raw Data **Inbound Logs API** is used to **write**, in SAP Cloud ALM, log records from third-party applications. This interface, compatible with OpenTelemetry format, is accessible in PULL mode. You can consult the documentation for more details on how the standard formats supported in input or output by the API are aligned with SAP Cloud ALM data models.

apis.Title: Manage Supplier Invoices
apis.ShortText: An interface to read the data of selected fields of a supplier invoice or to maintain one or more supplier invoices.
apis.Description:
The **Manage Supplier Invoice In** inbound service interface contains an operation that reads the data of selected fields of a supplier invoice and prepares this data for a specific data consumer.

The inbound service interface enables you to create one or more supplier invoices and to read data of selected fields of a supplier invoice.

This interface is relevant if your company wants to read the data of selected fields of a supplier invoice or to upload one or more supplier invoices from external applications.

The **Manage Supplier Invoice In** interface offers the operations **Check_Maintain_Bundle**, **Maintain_Bundle** and **Read_SI**

You can create invoicing documents such as invoices with or without reference, customs invoices, credit memos, and down payment requests in the invoice entry view of the supplier invoicing work center.

Note: In this document, supplier invoice is used as a superordinate term for an invoice, credit memo, down payment request, and customs invoice.

Here is an example of a simple web service request to read a supplier invoice:
```
 
<n0:SupplierInvoiceByIDQuery_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
	<SupplierInvoice>
		<ID schemeID="Token 1" schemeAgencyID="Token 2" schemeAgencySchemeAgencyID="Tok">USSI-61</ID>
		<UUID schemeID="Token 5" schemeAgencyID="Token 6">12345678-90AB-CDEF-0123-456789ABCDEF</UUID>
	</SupplierInvoice>
</n0:SupplierInvoiceByIDQuery_sync>
```

apis.Name: GHGDataFormsAPIV1
apis.Title: GHG Data Forms
apis.ShortText: Maintain GHG data forms for business activities, waste generated in operations, meter readings, and energy bills.
apis.Description:
The GHG Data Forms API allows you to distribute the form-based data collection for the GHG data forms: - Business activities - Waste generated in operations - Meter readings - Energy bills ### Process Description First, you create a GHG data collection for a certain period in the [Manage GHG Data Collections](https://help.sap.com/docs/sustainability-footprint-management/application-help-for-corporate-and-products/using-manage-ghg-data-collections-application) app in the SAP Sustainability Footprint Management solution. Once the GHG data form generation is completed, you can retrieve and update the forms using the GHG Data Forms API.
This process description is based on GHG data forms for business activities. To retrieve and update other GHG data form types, replace `GHGDataFormsBusinessActivities` with the corresponding GHG data form type. 1. You can **retrieve the GHG data forms** based on the corresponding GHG data collection with the resource [`GHGDataCollections`](https://api.sap.com/api/GHGDataFormsAPIV1/path/get_GHGDataCollections). Use the query parameter `$expand=GHGDataFormsBusinessActivities`. 2. You can **retrieve the data from a GHG form** with the resource [`GHGDataFormsBusinessActivities`](https://api.sap.com/api/GHGDataFormsAPIV1/path/get_GHGDataFormsBusinessActivities_footprintInventoryScope___footprintInventoryScope___period___period___location___location___locationType___locationType___). Use the query parameter `$expand=Data`. 3. You can **update** the notes and the data of GHG data forms with the action [`massUpdate`](https://api.sap.com/api/GHGDataFormsAPIV1/path/post_GHGDataCollections_footprintInventoryScope___footprintInventoryScope___period___period____GHGDataFormsService_massUpdate). 4. Once the data collection is completed for a form, the status for this form can be **set to completed (`SC`)** with the action [`massUpdate`](https://api.sap.com/api/GHGDataFormsAPIV1/path/post_GHGDataCollections_footprintInventoryScope___footprintInventoryScope___period___period____GHGDataFormsService_massUpdate). It is also possible to set the status of a GHG data form to **not applicable (`NA`)** with the action [`massUpdate`](https://api.sap.com/api/GHGDataFormsAPIV1/path/post_GHGDataCollections_footprintInventoryScope___footprintInventoryScope___period___period____GHGDataFormsService_massUpdate). It is possible to **Reopen (`IP`)** a completed GHG data form with the action [`massUpdate`](https://api.sap.com/api/GHGDataFormsAPIV1/path/post_GHGDataCollections_footprintInventoryScope___footprintInventoryScope___period___period____GHGDataFormsService_massUpdate). Note that it is not possible to generate or regenerate GHG data forms using the GHG Data Forms API. This can be done in the Manage GHG Data Collections app in the SAP Sustainability Footprint Management solution. ### Getting Started Accessing the GHG Data Forms API is possible with the OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials Flow, with the scope `c21-ghg-data-forms-api`.
To try out the APIs on SAP Business Accelerator Hub, you must first configure an environment on SAP Business Accelerator Hub. #### Prerequisites To configure an environment, you need the ``, ``, `` and `` that you have obtained from your service key. For more information on how to create your service key, see [Creating Service Keys in Cloud Foundry](https://help.sap.com/viewer/09cc82baadc542a688176dce601398de/Cloud/en-US/6fcac08409db4b0f9ad55a6acd4d31c5.html).
The following example shows the service key information displayed in the Cloud Foundry environment: ```json { "endpoints": { "apihost": "/api" }, "uaa": { "clientid": "", "clientsecret": "", "url": "", ... }, ... } ``` #### Authentication Use the ``, ``, and `` to request an access token by sending a `POST` request to the *Token URL* endpoint `/oauth/token` with the Form URL encoded body: `grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=&client_secret=`.
The following example shows the expected *200 OK* response returned by this endpoint: ```json { "access_token": "", "token_type": "bearer", "expires_in": , "scope": "" } ``` To access the GHG Data Forms API, the space-delimited `` needs to contain the scope `.c21-ghg-data-forms-api`. #### Authorization The GHG Data Forms API endpoints are available at the URL `/api/ghgdata/v1/GHGDataFormsService`.
For sending requests to the GHG Data Forms API, pass the `` obtained above as HTTP `Authorization` header: ``` Authorization: Bearer ``` The updated GHG data forms will appear as "Changed By" the Client ID of your application. The Client ID will also appear in the Change History of the updated GHG data forms.
There is no instance-based permission model for the GHG Data Forms API. A client with the required scope can read and update all GHG data forms. ### Draft Handling The GHG Data Forms API allows modifications to GHG data forms even if other users are editing them. That happens in the following way: If an unsaved draft exists, the API responds to `massUpdate` requests for that specific GHG data form with a `409 Conflict` status. To override this draft protection and delete unsaved changes made by other users, you must include the header `X-Preserve-Changes: false` in your request. ### Mass Update Limits There are limits to the number of GHG data forms that you can update in a single request: - Maximum number of forms: 2000 - Maximum number of rows of data, across forms: 5000 ### Rate Limiting To ensure optimal performance and system stability, the API usage per tenant is limited as follows: - POST requests: 2 requests per second Best Practice: This API is designed for bulk operations. You should process multiple records in a single request rather than making separate calls for individual records. This will improve efficiency and reduce resource usage.

apis.Name: SfmPeriodicDataAPIV2
apis.Title: Import Business Transactions (Corporate and Products)
apis.ShortText: Imports business transactions for footprint calculations.
apis.Description:
# General
   Imports the business transaction data (periodic data) from your source system and stores it in SAP Sustainability Footprint Management.
   Both the periodicity (monthly or yearly), the actual period, and the set of companies must be specified. 
## Entity Overview
 For all business transaction entities, the aggregated quantities can be imported to the solution. All of these entities have a **unique semantic key**

 - Plant
 - Service Product or Material
 - Possibly additional master data, depending on the transaction type
 - The Unit of Measure (UoM)

 By convention, **all quantities** have **positive values**. Note that most transaction types have a "mirror" or contrary transaction type. Therefore, instead of negative values, for example, a GoodsReceiptFromSupplier, a GoodsReturnToSupplier would be present.


 Entities with missing or unknown references or code values, or with negative quantities, will be marked as inconsistent in the solution. The footprint calculation does not consider such inconsistent records.
 ## Lifecycle Actions

 To start the import of periodic data, an action `notifyOfStartOfReplication` is offered. The body of the request must contain `{ footprintInventoryScopeIdentifier: <scope identifier>, period: "<yyyy / yyyy-mm>" }`. The `period` should be in ISO format (`yyyy` for a yearly aggregation or `yyyy-mm` for a monthly aggregation). This action returns a `replicationId` which identifies the combination of scope (periodicity and set of companies) and period, and is required as an input for all other actions.

 To restart the replication for a specific periodic data entity, an action `notifyOfPartialRestartOfReplication` is offered. The body of the request must contain `{ replicationId: <replicationId>, periodicDataTypeCode: <entity name> }`. This action deletes all previous records of periodic data for this entity, scope and period.

 To restart the replication for all the periodic data entities for a specific replication ID, an action `notifyOfRestartOfReplication` is offered. The body of the request must contain `{ replicationId: <replicationId>}`. This action deletes all previous records of periodic data for the scope and period.


 After starting (or restarting) a replication, the actual data is replicated to the solution using the Data Import Operations described in the corresponding section below.

 As soon as the source ERP system finishes replicating a periodic data entity type, it calls `notifyOfEndOfReplication` to document the completion of the replication of this type. Note that replication of all instances and log messages for a periodic data type must have been completed before calling the operation. The body of the request must contain `{ replicationId: <replicationId>, periodicDataTypeCode: <entity name> }`. The value `"All"` as an `entity name` allows to set all not-yet-completed entities to completed in one call. This may be useful in cases where a source ERP system does not support all entity types and does not transfer any data for the remaining entity types.

  ## Read Services

 To identify the available `PeriodicDataReplication`, a read-only service is offered which returns the available replications, including a navigation to the `FootprintInventoryScope`.
 In addition, read-only services for `FootprintInventoryScope` and code values are offered.

 ## Data Import Operations

 For the actual data import, mass insert actions are offered. As master data supports both an initial load or creation and delta updates, the related API for master data is a mass _upsert_. On the other hand, periodic data is only created once per period (usually after the period is closed and immutable). Hence, PeriodicData can only be _inserted_, and sending data twice for the same key is not supported.

 Besides the periodic data entities themselves, error logs can be created by `massInsertReplicationLog`. Supported values for `logLevelCode` are I (info), W (warning), E (error), and S (success).

 The ReplicationLog can also be created for `periodicDataTypeCode = "All"`. This can be used to indicate errors that cannot be attributed to a specific entity.
   If `ReplicationLog` with `logLevelCode = "E"` is created, the replication will end with the status `Aborted`.

   In case the `notifyOfEndOfReplication` is called for `masterDataTypeCode = "All"` and the replication is not yet complete for some entities, the ReplicationLog entries for `masterDataTypeCode = "All"` will be added to the ReplicationLog for all remaining entities that are still in progress.

apis.Name: sapdme_production_v2
apis.Title: Production Change
apis.ShortText: Perform production changes to a shop floor control
apis.Description: You use this service to assign a new Bill of Materials (BOM), a routing, or both to one or more Shop Floor Controls (SFCs). By using this endpoint, you can update the SFCs with the appropriate components and operation activities from the new BOM and routing. Additionally, this endpoint supports assigning a new routing to SFCs that have a partial quantity at a specific step. It also enables queueing at a particular routing step for each SFC and queueing at groups in the new routing.

apis.Name: SAPCPQAction
apis.Title: Action
apis.ShortText: Manage actions and custom actions in SAP Configure Price Quote externally.
apis.Description: The Action API allows you to work with standard and custom actions in SAP Configure Price Quote from another system. For example, you can use the dedicated endpoints of this API to retrieve all actions in the system, or to retrieve, update, or delete an action using its ID. You can also update the translations for a specified action using the action ID. In addition, you can get action translation data using the action ID and the dictionary ID or get the images for an action using the action image type. Furthermore, you can insert or update action details or action translation details in bulk using the dedicated endpoints. In regard to custom actions, you can use this API to create a new custom action, delete a specific custom action using its ID, or get the custom action script version using its version ID. You can also get the custom action script version history list by providing an action ID.

apis.Name: RDPreplicationExemptions
apis.Title: Replication of Customer and Company Code Exemptions to External Systems
apis.ShortText: Enables you to replicate customer and company code exemptions from SAP Responsible Design and Production to external systems.
apis.Description: Replication of customer exemptions can be used for the creation of customer and report fraction-based sales and distribution pricing conditions for exemptions. Replication of company code exemptions can be used for the creation of company code-based material management pricing conditions for exemptions. Those replications are currently applicable only for Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) reporting solution for Italy (CONAI). For more information about maintaining customer and company code exemptions, check the user guide for SAP Responsible Design and Production, chapter Report Category Extension in SAP Help Portal.

apis.Name: SCIMAPI
apis.Title: Identity Management
apis.ShortText: SCIM interface for simplifying Users and Groups management of SAP HANA Cloud instances.
apis.Description: This is the REST API specification of the HANA cloud Identity Management(hc-idm) or SCIM service based on [SCIM](http://www.simplecloud.info/). SCIM, which stands for System for Cross-domain Identity Management, is an open standard API designed to manage user identities and their attributes across multiple domains, applications, and IT systems. SCIM is particularly useful for organizations that need to manage user identities in a cloud-based environment or across different services. It facilitates user provisioning, de-provisioning, and other identity-related tasks more efficiently and securely. There are multiple endpoints available for creation, updation and deletion of Users and Groups resources.

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_MANAGE_CUSTOMER_QUOTE_IN
apis.Title: Manage Sales Quotes
apis.ShortText: An interface to replicate or create customer quotes from a source system or file to a target system.
apis.Description:
This Web service is used to create, modify, and delete existing customer quotes.

It has the **MaintainBundle** and **CheckMaintainBundle** operations. The **MaintainBundle** is used to update one or more instances of the Customer Quote business object. The **CheckMaintainBundle** is used to check if the one or more instances of the Customer Quote business object can be maintained.

apis.Title: Query Employee Bank Details
apis.ShortText: An interface to query the bank details of the employees.
apis.Description:
The web service interface Query Employee Bank Details In enables you to connect external applications to your SAP Business ByDesign system and to query bank details of the employees in your system.

This web service interface is relevant if external parties or systems want to access bank data from external applications.

The web service interface Query Employee Bank Details In offers the operation Find By Elements.

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_QUERY_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY_IN
apis.Title: Query Outbound Deliveries
apis.ShortText: An interface to execute query on outbound deliveries.
apis.Description:
The web service interface **Query Outbound Delivery In** enables you to connect external applications to your SAP Business ByDesign system and to query and read the information regarding outbound delivery in your system.

This service interface is important if your company wants to access and manage outbound delivery data from external applications.

The web service interface **Query Outbound Delivery In** has the operation **FIND_BY_ELEMENTS**.

Here is an example of sample web service request:
```
<n0:OutboundDeliveryFindByElementsQuery_sync xmlns:n0="http://sap.com/xi/SAPGlobal20/Global">
 <OutboundDeliveryFindByElementsRequestMessageBody>
 <SelectionByID>
 <InclusionExclusionCode>T</InclusionExclusionCode>
 <IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>T</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>
 <LowerBoundaryIdentifier>String 3</LowerBoundaryIdentifier>
 <UpperBoundaryIdentifier>String 4</UpperBoundaryIdentifier>
 </SelectionByID>
 <SelectionByItemID>
 <InclusionExclusionCode>T</InclusionExclusionCode>
 <IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>T</IntervalBoundaryTypeCode>
 <LowerBoundaryIdentifier>String 11</LowerBoundaryIdentifier>
 <UpperBoundaryIdentifier>String 12</UpperBoundaryIdentifier>
 </SelectionByItemID>
 <SelectionByProcessingTypeCode>

apis.ShortText: An interface to query entitlement products.
apis.Description:
The web service interface **Query Entitlement Product In** enables you to connect external applications to your SAP Business ByDesign system and to query entitlement products in your system.

This web service interface is relevant if external parties/system wants to access entitlement product data from external applications.

The web service interface **Query Entitlement Product In** offers the operation **Find By Elements**.

apis.Name: PSM_ISI_R_II_MANAGE_DIR_DEB_MDT_IN
apis.Title: Manage Direct Debit Mandate
apis.ShortText: An interface to manage the direct debit mandates of customers.
apis.Description:
The web service interface **Manage Direct Debit Mandate** offers the operations **MaintainBundle** and **CheckMaintainBundle**.

**MaintainBundle** will execute a save at the end of its process if no errors occur, where as **CheckMaintainBundle** will not persist the changes made.

The operation **MaintainBundle** allows you to adjust the following fields:

* DebtorIdentificationCode 
* Description 
* SingleUseIndicator 
* BlockedIndicator 
* MandateType 
* ValidityPeriod 
* SignatureDate 
* SignatureCity 
* AlternativePayer 

 

It also allows you to change the status of the mandate and to add attachments.

packages.DisplayName: SAP SFTP Employee Data with PGP Encryption-Decryption to SAP HANA
packages.ShortText: This package integrates with SFTP to retrieve CSV files, encrypt specified fields, convert data to JSON, and securely send it to a receiver. It also supports decrypting data on user request, ensuring safe handling of sensitive information for SAP HANA.
packages.Description:
This package automates retrieving a CSV file from an SFTP server, encrypting specific fields, transforming the data into JSON format, and sending it to a defined receiver, such as SAP HANA. It ensures secure handling of sensitive data while converting it into a standardized format for downstream systems.

Key components include:

  • CSV File Pull from SFTP: Retrieves the CSV file, converts it into XML format, and triggers the encryption and conversion flow.

  • Encrypt and Convert XML into JSON & Send to SAP HANA: Encrypts sensitive fields, transforms XML data to JSON, and sends it securely to SAP HANA.

  • Decrypt all data and gather it in XML: Handles decryption on request, ensuring safe access to sensitive information.

This solution streamlines data processing with robust security and full compatibility for downstream systems like SAP HANA.

packages.DisplayName: Word SDK
packages.ShortText: The Word SDK package is a collection of activities allowing you to create automations using Microsoft Word.
packages.Description:
The Word SDK package is composed of activities for accessing and manipulating Microsoft Word files.

The library is structured in different groups of activities called modules.

The Application module for instance contains global activities you use to handle the Word instance (start, stop, release).

As for the Document module, it contains activities allowing you to manipulate MS Word documents (open, save, close…).

The Content module contains activities to work on the text content of MS Word documents (find text, insert text…).

In addition to the modules, the Word SDK package also includes a predefined data type to implement advanced search parameters for Microsoft Word documents.

packages.DisplayName: Vendor AI Vetting and Onboarding
packages.ShortText: Vendor Collaboration Simplified using AI and Automation to simplify the management of new and existing suppliers in SAP S/4 HANA Cloud. Using Business AI every new request is properly appraised and analysed against critical vetting criteria.
packages.Description:
Business Challenge

Harness the power of Business AI to drive your Supplier Onboarding with automated vetting and onboarding for SAP S/4 HANA Cloud.

Value Story

The onboarding and management of suppliers is a critical and time consuming activity in any business. And yet often new suppliers are onboarded without the desired level of checks and/or they are created with incorrect or missing information. The friction in the process is often exacerbated due to the number of internal stakeholders involved and potential disconnects from back-office user who finally creates the record leading to delays in creation or in some cases the processing of Accounts Payable invoices.

Business Benefits

Vendor Vetting & Onboarding using AI and Automation to simplify the management of new and existing suppliers in SAP S/4 HANA Cloud. Using Business AI every new request is properly appraised and analysed against critical vetting criteria (such as credit rating) without the need for manual intervention with an auditable approval process for suspect requests. Once approved simply send a link to your supplier to ensure key information is right first time and any certificates or documentation are uploaded smoothly.

  • Improved Efficiency: leave the manual processes of emails, forms and attachments behind by automating the request, vetting, analysis, approval and creation steps of the supplier onboarding process.
  • Reduce Risk and Exposure: enforce mandatory vetting without the administrative overhead or adding friction to the process using configurable analysis criteria and approval workflow to move from request to vetted and approved supplier effortlessly.
  • Improve Data Accuracy: get supplier details right first time with automated third-party validations combined with seamless self-service functionality for your supplier ensuring they are the guardians of their own data in your business system.
  • Partner with your Suppliers: get off to a great start in your working relationship by automating and expediting their onboarding providing clear and transparent feedback where needed and affording them the chance to manage their data to ensure their first interaction with your Accounts team isn’t a delayed invoice.

packages.DisplayName: Zendesk Adapter for SAP Integration Suite
packages.ShortText: This package includes the Zendesk Adapter and its documentation. The Zendesk Adapter for SAP Integration Suite facilitates and accelerates the implementation time and reduces the complexity of connecting to Zendesk.
packages.Description:
The Zendesk Adapter facilitates and accelerates the implementation time of connecting to Zendesk APIs. The adapter is available only for Standard service plans and above of the SAP Integration Suite. For more information, see SAP Note 3188446.

Zendesk Adapter has the following features:

  • Offers a comprehensive set of Ticketing CRUD (Create, Retrieve, Update, and Delete) operations for Tickets, Attachments, Requests, Tags, etc.
  • Supports secure authentication mechanisms like API Token and OAuth2 Client Credentials.

packages.DisplayName: Federated Master Data Governance with Core Data Owner on SAP S/4HANA
packages.ShortText: The master data process is federated across multiple MDG instances, with SAP Master Data Governance on SAP S/4HANA responsible for core data.​
packages.Description:
The ownership of master data is distributed to several MDG instances, each owning a subset of the master data. This includes the option to activate MDG on operative SAP S/4HANA systems to use them as application data owners. Using the Business Partner as an example, one MDG instance is responsible for core data (for example, name, address, tax numbers, identification numbers), and several other MDG instances can have ownership of application-specific data (for example, master data that controls sales and financials processes). You can define the ownership according to specific landscape needs with the master data orchestration capability of the SAP Master Data Integration service. ​ 

In federated MDG, in addition to a coordinated distribution of data in the landscape, processes are also conducted in a coordinated fashion and can be tracked across system boundaries. Data can be maintained in all MDG instances and master data clients. This data needs to be replicated to the core data owner (for example, MDG on SAP S/4HANA) that evaluates which data has been maintained, and that determines the relevant data owners. These data owners are informed about changes, upon which they revise and verify their data and send the results back to the core data owner. Once the core data owner has received a response from all data owners, it replicates the data to all connected MDG instances and master data clients in the landscape​.​ 

Important IP-relevant Note 

Some of the Business Processes use Business Activities by the APQC Cross-industry Process Classification Framework (“PCF”), or Business Activities derived from APQC Cross-Industry PCF. The APQC Process Classification Framework® (“PCF”) is an open standard developed by APQC, a nonprofit that promotes benchmarking and best practices worldwide. The PCF is intended to facilitate organizational improvement through process management and benchmarking, regardless of industry, size, or geography. To download the full PCF or industry-specific versions of the PCF, as well as associated measures and benchmarking, please visit http://www.apqc.org/pcf

packages.DisplayName: SAP S/4HANA integration with SAP Business Rules Service
packages.ShortText: Reimagining flight booking demo scenario with SAP Business Rules integration to SAP S/4HANA
packages.Description:
SAP Business Rules is a platform service which enable business users & application developers to automate their decisions and enhance their decision-making experience. It offers simplified Fiori-based rule authoring tool & a central rule repository with various deployment options to different runtimes. 


Scenario Description
Travel planning has a huge market potential. With digital innovation rapidly changing the way airline industry is functioning, it becomes important that travel planning is made smarter with reimagined business models, business processes and business rules to improve the travel engagements with the customers.

SAP Flight is an on-premise demo and training courses scenario that is available to all SAP S/4HANA clients. From among various modules, this demo scenario is based on ‘Flight Booking’.  A customer books the flight trip with an airline via the application provided from the travel agency. During the booking, the travel agency suggests promotional offers based various criteria of the chosen airline and customer information. These offers are designed and managed using SAP Business Rules.

The offers are quite volatile and require rules to arrive to offers after processing and analysing millions of data records and trends. If the rules are written inside the ABAP code, then it becomes extremely difficult to make even a small change. It is therefore important to empower the business users so that he can easily modify or extend these rules. Separating application code and business rules logic is the key.


Data Model Overview
Flight booking scenario is based on BC_TRAVEL data model. The flight model gives a simple description of seat bookings in passenger airplanes by flight customers. The booking can be made either at the sales desk of a carrier or at a travel agency. A flight booking is based on the individual flight connections described in the flight schedule. (Image available above)


Artifacts Overview

  1. Flight Booking Rules
    This business rules project contain all the artifacts pertaining to the rules to calculate the discount for the flight bookings made by the customer. Here are the list of available rules:
    • Customer Loyalty Rules
      • Decision Table rules to calculate discounts based on the customer information like type of customer, region and number of bookings made by the customer

    • Discount For Early Bookers
      • Decision Table rules to calculate discount for customers who are booking the flights well in advance. 

    • Current Booking Discount
      • Decision Table rules to calculate discount for customers who are booking the flights on same day or a specific date. 


  2. Flight Scenario Demo Program
    This is a custom ABAP program that will show you how to consume business rules to calculate the discounts for the flight bookings.


Setup Instructions (blog)

  1. SAP Business Rules
    • Activate Business Rules service in your SAP BTP 
    • Assign business rules roles to your user
    • Configure Cloud Connector and Destinations in SAP BTP
    • Configure systems in Business Rules
    • Download and Import Flight Booking Rules project in your Business Rules
    • Activate all the rule models and Deploy the rule services in your S/4HANA


  2. SAP S/4HANA on-premise
    • Register the ERM Gateway Service in S/4HANA system
    • Create an ABAP report with name ZVR_FLIGHTS_DEMO_SCENARIO, copy and paste the content from code-snippets, activate the report and execute the report in your SAP S/4HANA application

packages.DisplayName: Manage Posting Period Approval
packages.ShortText: Enables customers to accelerate the digitalization of their manage posting period approval process in a transparent way and provide flexibility to meet business requirements.
packages.Description:
This content package addresses the need for controlled and time-bound management of posting periods, ensuring compliance with financial governance policies.

The process begins with the requester using an intuitive fiori app to submit a request for managing the posting period. The request specifies the account types and the timeframe for which the posting period needs to be opened. The approval process involves the following steps:

  • First-Level Approval: The request is sent to the accounting manager for initial review and approval.

  • Second-Level Approval: Upon approval by the accounting manager, the request is routed to the control/finance director for final approval.

Upon successful completion of the approval process:

  • The posting period is opened for the specified account types and timeframe.

  • The requestor is notified via email of the approval and activation of the posting period.

  • Once the approved timeframe ends and periods are closed, the system triggers another email to the requestor to confirm the conclusion of the approved posting period for account types.

This package provides:

  • A process that orchestrates the approval process for the business scenario.

  • APIs to perform data related operations with SAP S/4HANA private cloud system.

  • Decisions to determine approvers for tasks.

The package uses following action project for API call:

  • Manage Posting Period Approval - Update Posting Period

packages.DisplayName: Proposed Reclassification of G/L Account Entries (5AK)
packages.ShortText: Proposes journal entries to reclassify G/L account entries from one account to another based on user-defined G/L account mappings.
packages.Description:
Problem:

In the normal course of business, G/L account entries may need to be reclassified from one G/L account to another for more accurate reporting. Oftentimes, it requires review and analysis of postings made to several accounts (often across several company codes) to come up with these detailed reclassification journal entries.

This activity can be time-consuming and error-prone if done manually due to the potentially high volume of transactions involved.

Solution:

The bot generates the proposed journal entries to reclassify G/L entries from one account to another based on user-defined G/L account mappings. The user will need to indicate the origin and the target G/L accounts in the input mapping file. The bot identifies the journal entries for the specified G/L accounts and company codes, and generates an Excel template file populated with the proposed reclassification journal entries.

To upload the proposed reclassification journal entries to the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system, the bot Automated Upload of Manual Entries via API (4CA) can be used.

Note:

This bot was previously known as Automated Generation of G/L Re-class Postings. It has been renamed to Proposed Reclassification of G/L Account Entries.

Comprises 4 API areas designed to answer the loyalty needs for sales channels (e.g. Point-of-sale and eCommerce), digital systems (e.g. apps, websites), decisioning/data/operational systems and business data systems. Capabilities include the management of promotions (availability, settlement), post-sales processing, payments, wallet, clubs, benefits, cards, engagement triggers, transactions and data ingestion

## Authentication

All APIs in this package are protected using OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials via SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS) App-to-App communication.

### Setup

1. Create a new application in your IAS tenant under the `clm-sci-instance` parent application. For details, see: https://help.sap.com/docs/cloud-identity-services/cloud-identity-services/landing-page?version=Cloud

2. Add the `public_api` dependency between your consumer application and the CLM provider application. For details, see: https://help.sap.com/docs/cloud-identity-services/cloud-identity-services/communicate-between-applications?version=Cloud

3. Create a client secret for your application. For details, see: https://help.sap.com/docs/cloud-identity-services/cloud-identity-services/configure-secrets-for-api-authentication?version=Cloud

### Token Request

Use your client credentials to request a Bearer token from your IAS tenant token endpoint. You must include the `resource` parameter to identify the CLM provider application:

```http
POST https://{your-ias-tenant}/oauth2/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
```

| Parameter | Value |
|:-----------|:-------|
| grant_type       | `client_credentials` |
| client_id       | `{your-client-id}` |
| client_secret       | `{your-client-secret}` |
| resource       | `urn:sap:identity:application:provider:name:public_api` |

Use the returned Bearer token in the `Authorization` header for all API calls. For details on the OAuth flow, see: https://help.sap.com/docs/cloud-identity-services/cloud-identity-services/consume-api-from-another-application?version=Cloud

packages.ShortText: Accelerate your journey into SAP Integration Suite with CODE10 CI ACCELERATOR add-on. It provides a ready to use integration architecture and governance to speed the go to market of your Integration Suite interfaces.
packages.Description:
Business Challenge

A new implementation or migration to Integration Suite is a challenging project withing an organization. It requires thorough planning to define a proper integration architecture with design patterns, blueprint integrations, challenges/issue detection and resolution, naming conventions and a strong methodology.

We have seen in large enterprises that this process can last from 1 month to 6 months before kicking off the real Implementation/Migration project.

Many companies and IT departments do not have the time or the knowledge to perform this analysis. Eventually, the lack of discovery and architecture planning results in cost overruns, long lasting implementations, lack of platform governance and at the end the level of satisfaction with Integration Suite it is low.

Value Story

In CODE10, we have a team of expert Integration Architects with large experience in SAP Integration. We have spent a significant amount of time to detect possible GAPs, design integration architecture, build Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and eventually a blueprint template for all possible integration scenarios.

All this knowledge and best practices evolved into the Code10 CI Accelerator. This is more than an accelerator tool:

  • Methodology: Based on SAP Activate it is the road to have a successful project. Risk detection and mitigation in the assessment phase, waves break down to minimize the business impact and `always together` concept for the handover are our signature in all our projects.
  • Tools: Code10 CI Accelerator has two different tools: `the addon` that its integration content to speed up the developments and to solve already detected problems and `the apps` stand alone CAP apps that extends the functionalities of Integration Suite, like a Process monitor, an Integration Cockpit and more.
Governance: One of most important results of applying our Methodology and Tools it’s the composition of rules and guides to avoid ending up with a system where each integration is done in a different way. The final objective it is a harmonization of the integrations and the segregation of duties

This is, in fact, a democratisation of the know-how, in the form of a project execution plan validated by SAP.

Business Benefits

The main benefits of CODE10 CI ACCELERATOR for Business are:

  • Speed up your journey to the SAP Integration Suite. Reduce the Go to Market of your integrations.
  • Accelerate greenfield implementations, new developments.
  • Accelerate migrations, from SAP PI/PO and from other middleware’s.
  • But the most important: Improve quality and governance.

Code10 CI Accelerator tools Overview

Code10 CI Accelerator comprises two parts:

  • Code10 CI Accelerator Apps: are friendly applications to enhance the use of SAP Integration Suite and Code10 CI Accelerator Add-on. Improve the platform governance and monitoring. Applications are developed using SAP CAP and SAP UI5 guidelines to ensure a comprehensible UX and are deployed on your SAP BTP subaccount.
  • Code10 CI Accelerator Add-on: is an integration package consisting of three pillars:
    • Integration Patterns: ready to use artifacts to support different integration use cases (EO, EOIO and BE). Like building blocks, you can copy and reuse our artifacts templates in your real-life scenarios.
    • Alerting and Monitoring tools: artifacts which integrate most widely used ITIL and Messaging Tools
    • Code10 Toolkit: out of the box functionalities as Disaster Recovery, automatise certificate updates and ready to use collection of Groovy scrips and UDFs.

An accrual object contains all the data for an individual business transaction. The various accruals can be calculated and posted from this data. The data is a contract or contract item, and is composed of the following characteristics:

packages.DisplayName: Mass Transfer of Time and Expenses (6NK)
packages.ShortText: Fetches time and expense details for a workforce and transfers the time and expense from one WBS element to another in SAP S/4HANA Cloud
packages.Description:
This template automates the transfer of time and expenses for a workforce in SAP S/4HANA Cloud system. It helps the user to mass transfer the open time entries and expense entries when there is a new WBS element created or change in WBS element is identified. It also provides the approval flow for fetched time and expense entries. Once the entries are validated and approved, they are transferred in S/4HANA system. The template can be run either in scheduled or unscheduled mode.

The following steps are included as a part of mass transfer process:

Fetch operation: A pre-defined excel template file is populated with fetched time and expense entries based on the selection screen input populated by the requestor.

The requestor must manually update the details of the time and expense entries if needed and move it to the ToBeProcessed folder.

Time transfer operation: A task automation to update time entries in SAP S/4HANA Cloud (after optional approval) runs in a predefined scheduled manner, in an unattended mode. This automation fetches the file(s) from the ToBeProcessed folder, groups time entries based on the WBS elements and sends them for (optional) approvals. Upon completion of the task, the time entries are transferred from old WBS element to the new WBS element in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system.

Expense transfer operation: A task automation to update expense entries in SAP S/4HANA Cloud (after optional approval) runs in a predefined scheduled manner, in an unattended mode. This automation fetches the file(s) from the ToBeProcessed folder, groups time entries based on the WBS elements and sends them for (optional) approvals. Upon completion of the task, the expense entries are cancelled for the old WBS element, and a new entry (supplier invoice) is created with the new WBS element reference in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system.

The template uses the following APIs:

API_ENTERPRISE_PROJECT_SRV

API_MANAGE_WORKFORCE_TIMESHEET

API_SUPPLIERINVOICE_PROCESS_SRV

CPD/SC_EXTERNAL_SERVICES_SRV

packages.DisplayName: List of Vendor Line Items (HANA) – FBL1H
packages.ShortText: Automate the list of Vendor line items and download it as an excel file
packages.Description:
Use

This program lists Vendor line items. You can also display the items from more than one Vendor account across company codes in a list. This package is built via Cloud Studio to automate the download of the Vendor line items list according to given input data.

Configuration

The input criteria and system information are maintained in a configuration excel named as DynamicTemplate_FBL1H.xlsx. The configuration excel available within the package should be downloaded and maintained in the given InputPath environment variable.

This excel file contains two sheets;

  • The first sheet contains the system details like the System ID, Client and whether Single Sign-On is enabled. It also contains the Variant name for the program and the output path of the excel file to be downloaded.

  • The username and password for the target ECC system is maintained in the Cloud Factory.

  • The file type of the output file to be downloaded is maintained in “Output File Type” row. It is available in the field “Select from all available formats” in Select Spreadsheet popup window in the target system. Some examples of the file-type include “Excel (in Office 2007 XLSX Format)” or “Excel-Office open XML Format (XLSX)” etc.

  • The second sheet contains input data for the program in the form of parameter and its corresponding value along with a description for the parameter.

Business Benefits

  • Reduce manual effort– an employee can concentrate on the more important tasks

  • Ensure fast download of the required list

  • Eliminate the human error

Key Process Flows

  • The bot reads input criteria from the excel template

  • Automate the Vendor Line Item list

  • Download the list as an Excel file

  • The bot posts differences in physical inventory document using transaction MI07.

  • Reduce manual effort - an employee can concentrate on the more important tasks

  • Ensure fast creation of the document

  • Eliminate the human error

This content package is deprecated. A new template-based version is available at this link:

When a request to cancel Customer Invoice is created in SAP S/4HANA and is configured for external approval, a pre-configured process variant is triggered in SAP Build Process Automation or SAP Workflow Management based on configurable business conditions. packages.DisplayName: Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Outbound
packages.ShortText: This integration package contains the generic outbound integration flow required to setup a Process Integration pipeline on Cloud Integration.
packages.Description:
This integration package is part of a set of integration packages required to setup a Process Integration (PI) pipeline on Cloud Integration for asynchronous and synchronous message processing. The pipeline for Cloud Integration can be seen as a sort of framework providing exactly once delivery, error handling and restart capabilities out of the box.

The new Cloud Integration Pipeline integration packages replace the "Process Integration Pipeline - Generic Integration Flows and Templates" package which has been split up into the following packages to be more flexible in setting up your different pipelines, sender-specific IDoc and XI inbound flows, and receiver-specific outbound flows:

  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Inbound containing generic IDoc and XI inbound flows:
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for Idoc
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for XI
  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Pipelines containing the main pipeline steps:
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Integrated Messaging Runtime Async
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Integrated Messaging Runtime Sync
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Inbound Processing
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step04 - Receiver Determination
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step05 - Interface Determination
  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Outbound (this very package) containing the outbound processing flows:
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step06 - Outbound Processing
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for Idoc
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for XI
  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Templates containing all templates for setting up scenario-specific flows incl. templates for custom extensions as well as the script collection Pipeline v2 - Script Collection.

For setting up the integrated messaging runtime for asynchronous communication (recommended option for asynchronous communication), you need to deploy the following generic integration flows:

  • (Optionally, if you like to use a single entry point for IDoc messages) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for Idoc
  • (Optionally, if you like to use a single entry point for XI messages) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for XI
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Integrated Messaging Runtime Async
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step06 - Outbound Processing
  • (Optionally, if you like to send out IDoc messages) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for Idoc
  • (Optionally, if you like to send out XI messages) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for XI
  • (Optionally, if you like to leverage the provided templates) Pipeline v2 - Script Collection

For setting up the integrated messaging runtime for synchronous content-based-router scenarios, you need to deploy the following generic integration flows:

  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for XI
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Integrated Messaging Runtime Sync
  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for XI
  • (Optionally, if you like to leverage the provided templates) Pipeline v2 - Script Collection

For setting up the fully decoupled pipeline for asynchronous communication, you need to deploy the following integration flows:

  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for Idoc
  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for XI
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Inbound Processing
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step04 - Receiver Determination
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step05 - Interface Determination
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step06 - Outbound Processing
  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for Idoc
  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for XI
  • (Optionally, if you like to leverage the provided templates) Pipeline v2 - Script Collection

The following features are supported:

  • Support for most commonly used Enterprise Integration Patterns such as Point-to-Point, Content-Based-Router, Recipient List, etc.
  • Asynchronous pipeline for asynchronous message processing with decoupling of pipeline steps via limited number of JMS queues
  • Synchronous pipeline for synchronous Content-Based-Router scenarios
  • Generic inbound flows for XI inbound and IDoc inbound scenarios
  • Generic outbound flows for XI outbound and IDoc outbound scenarios
  • Flexible scenario configuration via Partner Directory
  • Retry and error handling capabilities incl. dead letter queue handling
  • Improved monitoring by supporting SAP headers and custom header properties
  • Extension for custom error handling
  • Extension for custom receiver and interface determination
  • Extension for custom exit
  • Option to reuse extended receiver determination mappings from SAP Process Orchestration
  • Support for test mode
  • Supporting different tenant stages, e.g., DEV, QA, PRD

More details on the PI pipeline concept can be found on the Migration Guide for SAP Process Orchestration.

packages.DisplayName: ProcessDirect Adapter for SAP Integration Suite
packages.ShortText: The ProcessDirect adapter establishes fast and direct communication between integration flows within the same tenant by reducing latency and network overhead.
packages.Description:
The ProcessDirect adapter establishes fast and direct communication between integration flows within the same tenant by reducing latency and network overhead.

Features:

  • ProcessDirect receiver adapter and ProcessDirect sender adapter interact with each other.
  • The ProcessDirect receiver adapter sends data to other integration flows. The integration flow that contains the receiver adapter is considered a producer integration flow.
  • The ProcessDirect sender adapter consumes data from other integration flows. The integration flow that contains the sender adapter is considered a consumer integration flow.
  • Multiple ProcessDirect receiver adapters can send data to a single ProcessDirect sender adapter.

Supported Operations:

  • Decompose large integration flows:
    You can split a large integration flow into smaller integration flows and maintain the in-process exchange without network latency.
  • Allow multiple integration developers to work on the same integration flow:
    In some scenarios, integration flows can be large. The ProcessDirect adapter helps you to split a large integration flow into smaller parts that can be owned and managed by multiple integration developers independently. This allows several people to work on different parts of the same integration flow simultaneously.
  • Customize the standard content:
    Integration Suite enables integration developers to customize their integration flows without modifying them entirely. The platform provides plugin touchpoints where integration developers can add custom content. Use the ProcessDirect adapter to connect the plugin touchpoints at a lower network latency.

Since invoices are often received via PDFs or images, data needs to be extracted from those which is tedious work: a person needs to retrieve the data from the document and manually enter it into the target system. When it comes to processing many documents it becomes a huge challenge and requires a lot of time dedicated to this task. Also, manual matching is repetitive and error prone.

This sample content helps users to get started in automating a simple invoice approval process that includes the storage and retrieval of uploaded documents, extraction of data from documents and approval steps required to approve the invoice.

Included in this sample process is the following:

packages.Description:
For this use case, a new template content package based on SAP Build Process Automation is available at    Notify Production of Maintenance Order

The live process package enables sending notifications to the responsible users assigned to the production planners of the affected maintenance orders in the SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance, allowing the production planner to review the dates in the maintenance order and make new proposals.

packages.Description:
Description

Standard integration templates can be used to export data from Talent Intelligence Hub Growth Portfolio of SAP SuccessFactors. The Growth Portfolio export enables you to export the people attributes and their associated proficiency levels. People attributes include attributes such as competencies, skills, or other custom attributes. 

 

Target Deployment Platform

SAP SuccessFactors Integration Center 

1H 2026 Release updates:

Latest ICD File: 

A new Growth Portfolio ICD file is now available (Talent Intelligence Hub Growth Portfolio Export). 

Enhanced Export Capabilities: Sorting and filtering for Growth Portfolio export jobs are now supported. Note that using an outdated ICD file will result in blank values; updating to the latest version is required.

Field Updates: The 'Preference Value' field has been removed. Please use the 'Passionate About' field moving forward.

Enhances role-based permission for importing and exporting Growth Portfolio data have been introduced. Please refer the What's new Viewer Links below- 

1H 2026 What's New Viewer Links - 

Enhancements to Growth Portfolio Data export

 https://help.sap.com/docs/successfactors-release-information/8e0d540f96474717bbf18df51e54e522/d372bc23f3864d398ae29d09abee8e1f.html?locale=en-US

Enhanced Role based permission

https://help.sap.com/docs/successfactors-release-information/8e0d540f96474717bbf18df51e54e522/e63d1d9004ee4c7ca1df8d090c8c4353.html?locale=en-US&q=sorting

About the Template

The template in this package can be used to export data from Talent Intelligence Hub Growth Portfolio. Integration Definition file is provided in the Artifacts tab.

The export file contains the fields mentioned below.

•    Person Id - UUID of the person
•    Person Identifier Type- Currently only supports EXTERNAL_ID of the person maintained in SAP SuccessFactors 
•    Person External Id - External ID of the person maintained in SAP SuccessFactors.  
•    Attribute External Id- External ID of the attribute. 
•    Attribute Name: The name of the attribute.
•    Attribute Type Name: The name of the attribute type for this record (e.g., Skill, Competency).
•    Proficiency Level - Proficiency level of the person for a particular attribute.
•    Proficiency Assigned Date - Proficiency Assigned Date is in the format YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss. This is the date on which the attribute was added to the growth portfolio.
•    Passionate About- Allowed values are True or False. True implies that the person is passionate or highly interested about the Attribute. 
•    Status- Allowed values are I and A.  I for Inactive, A for Active. If marked I, then the attribute will not be visible on the portfolio. It is similar to the Remove functionality in the UI.
•    Last Modified By - Indicates the user who last updated the Growth Portfolio Attribute
•    Last Modified At - Indicates the date and time at which the last update was performed on the Growth Portfolio Attribute
•    Expected Rating - Expected Proficiency level of the person for an attribute which is Role related.
•    Source - Indicates the Source Type from which the Attribute was last modified.

How to consume this template

  • Please download the integration definition file from the Artifacts tab and upload it to SuccessFactors Integration Center. Also refer to Importing Integrations from the Integration Catalog.
  • Configure the SFTP target settings. Maintain the file and folder location of the export file.
  • Schedule the integration to run.

Special considerations

  • Initial Export: When you create a new Integration Center job for Growth Portfolio export, the initial run will extract data for all users. This ensures a complete data transfer to your target system.
  • Subsequent Exports: From the second run onwards, the export job will efficiently extract only the delta changes since the previous run. This means that only the latest updates to user data, such as new skills or updated ratings will be included in the export. This approach significantly reduces the amount of data transferred, improves performance, and optimizes your integration process. Additionally, you can now use the Filtering options with the latest icd file to export specific Growth Portfolio data.
  • Historical Data: There is no support to export historical proficiency data for an attribute. Only the latest (current) proficiency data will be exported. For Historical data - please use the Story reporting in SAP Analytics.

packages.DisplayName: Mass Maintenance of Quality Info Records (6NX)
packages.ShortText: Enables mass creation and update of Quality Info Records.
packages.Description:
Problem

Quality info Record (QIR) influences purchasing functions like limiting maximum order quantity, blocking the order due to quality reasons, or skipping the quality inspection of certain material-supplier combinations; the Quality Info record, therefore, needs to be maintained frequently in view of changing business priorities and relationship with the suppliers. Typically, a Quality Planner performs hundreds of QIR maintenance (create, update, delete) activities manually.

This activity can be time-consuming and prone to error if done manually due to the potentially high volume of transactions involved.

Solution

The bot automatically creates or updates Quality Info Records in the system based on user-provided details in an Excel template. Users need to provide details for Quality Info Records on Planned Quantity and Inspection Requirement for a material-supplier combination via the Excel input template. The bot reads the Quality Info Records operations and corresponding fields from the Excel input template and updates the Quality Info records in the system. The bot generates a log report after execution and sends a communication email to the user.

packages.DisplayName: Sales Order Creation from Local Purchase Order (1C1)
packages.ShortText: This SAP ByDesign intelligent RPA bot automates the process of creating a sales order from a local purchase order received from customers.
packages.Description:
The old content has been depreciated and this is a new content

Problem:

Companies receive Purchase Order (PO) documents from their customers and based on them, the business users will create sales orders in the SAP Business ByDesign application. Typically, user will enter or copy & paste the details from the documents to the system. This manual process is not only time-consuming, but also often prone to errors such as incorrect/missing information.

Solution:

After the previous Automated Business Document Extraction from Emails bot will extract the customer PO from emails, this bot will pick the PO and sent it to the SAP AI Business Services - Document Information Extraction to scan it and identify the information out of it. The extracted details will be passed by the bot to SAP Business ByDesign using ODATA service to create a draft sales order and upload the document to it for business user review. To further automate and improve the accuracy of the Sales Order creation there is also a Master Data Enrichment for AccountID identification bot available, which will help the bot to identify the AccountID based on the scanned information like Supplier Name, Address, Bank Account, etc.

Business Benefits:

  • Reduced user effort by automation of repetitive tasks.

  • Reduced risk of manual errors hence, higher accuracy.

  • Improved work efficiency.

Further Extensions:

This bot can be used as a standalone bot and it can also work in conjunction with Business Document Extraction from Email bot, which will download the files from the Emails and place them in the automatically created folder structure. packages.DisplayName: Safe Deactivation Procedure for Central Finance Replication
packages.ShortText: This template automates the safe deactivation and reactivation of Central Finance Replication to avoid errors resulting from unintended interruption of SLT Transfer Jobs.
packages.Description:
Central Finance uses SAP Landscape Transformation Replication Server (SLT) to transfer data between Source System(s) and the Central Finance system. Deactivating & Reactivating Central Finance Replication is a common activity required during maintenance windows, when applying SAP Note corrections, upgrading Central Finance-delivered Replication Content and error handling/analysis. Unlike typical replication scenarios, e.g., Standard Replication, for which users simply deactivate and reactivate Replication, Central Finance recommends a multi-step procedure, i.e., the Safe De/Re-activation procedure described in SAP Note 2154420 - SAP LT Replication Server for SAP Central Finance. Following this procedure ensures that the processor does not unintentionally interrupt replication jobs resulting in the re-transfer of data to the Central Finance system and creation of duplicate document errors in the Application Interface Framework (AIF).

This automation includes the following capabilities:

  • Identify and safely deactivate / reactivate Central Finance Replication

  • Identify and deactivate / reactivate non-Central Finance Replication

  • Create Execution Log (.XLSX) tracking successes, warnings and errors

  • Send email to specified recipients including Execution Log attachment.

packages.DisplayName: B2B Integration Factory - Transportation Management & 3PL - B2B Scenario
packages.ShortText: Pre-built content for SAP Integration Suite's B2B capabilities Trading Partner Management & Integration Advisor, covering the TM & 3PL B2B scenario with the choreography of message exchange between SAP S/4HANA On-Premise IDOC & GS1XML standards.
packages.Description:
Business Challenge

When using SAP Integration Suite's B2B capabilities, the creation of a Trading Partner Agreement (TPA) for an Order-to-Cash B2B scenario, where the business partner uses GS1XML and the internally supported format is SAP IDOC, requires functional experts with domain knowledge, integration experts to create and enable these TPAs, and above all, it requires time and efforts for implementation. Very often, neither the required knowledge nor the time is available. 

 

Value Story 

The B2B Integration Factory creates this content of B2B scenarios as pre-packaged content in the form of trading partner agreements and the corresponding message implementation and mapping guidelines and makes them available accordingly. This B2B scenario now describes the electronic data exchange of the first set of relevant 3PL business data, such as  

  1. Material Master (Outbound): SAP IDoc MATMAS.MATMAS05    > GS1 XML itemDataNotificationMessage
  2. Inbound Delivery (Outbound): SAP IDoc DESADV.DELVRY07     > GS1 XML warehousingInboundInstructionMessage
  3. Receiving Finished (Inbound): GS1 XML warehousingInboundNotificationMessage > SAP IDoc MBGMCR.MBGMCR03
  4. Outbound Delivery (Outbound): SAP IDoc DESADV.DELVRY07  > GS1 XML warehousingOutboundInstructionMessage 
  5. Product Picked (Inbound): GS1 XML warehousingOutboundNotificationMessage     > SAP IDoc WHSCON.DELVRY07
  6. Customer Return (Outbound): SAP IDoc DESADV.DELVRY07     > GS1 XML warehousingInboundInstructionMessage
  7. Customer Return Receiving Finished (Inbound): GS1 XML warehousingInboundNotificationMessage > SAP IDoc WHSCON.DELVRY07
  8. Outbound Delivery Status Update (Inbound): GS1 XML warehousingOutboundNotificationMessage   > SAP IDoc WHSCON.DELVRY07
  9. Stock Comparison (Inbound): GS1 XML logisticsInventoryReportMessage                > SAP IDoc ZMMSTCOMP.ZMMSTOCK
  10. Goods Movement (Inbound): GS1 XML logisticsInventoryReportMessage > SAP IDoc MBGMCR.MBGMCR03
  11. Inbound Delivery Create (Inbound): GS1 XML warehousingInboundNotificationMessage > SAP IDoc DESADV.DELVRY07.ZDELVRY07
  12. Outbound Delivery Create (Outbound): SAP IDoc DESADV.DELVRY07 > GS1 XML warehousingOutboundInstruction

 

It covers next to the 3PL -IWD B2B Scenarios also the following Transportation Order requests:

  1. Delivery Notification (Inbound): UN/EDIFACT DESADV D.10B > SAP SOAP TransportationOrderGenericRequest 2302
  2. Delivery Notification (Outbound): SAP SOAP TransportationOrderGenericRequest 2302 > UN/EDIFACT DESADV D.10B

As you can see, in this B2B scenario, the enterprise message types are based on SAP IDOC, and the trading partner-related message types are based on GS1XML. For all corresponding message types, the required Message Implementation Guidelines (MIGs) and the Mapping Guidelines (MAGs) are already available. Significantly, the Mapping Guidelines already contain the needed mapping elements between the corresponding nodes as required at a functional level. 

The included MIGs (Message Implementation Guidelines), MAGs (Message Application Guidelines), and TPAs (Trading Partner Agreements) are provided solely as examples to guide users. They can be customised according to specific customer requirements. For the TPAs, this package includes one example TPA per message type as a reference.

 

Business Benefits 

As a user of the SAP Integration Suite's B2B capabilities, you can download the zip files of the design-time artefacts (TPA, MIGs and MAGs) provided on GitHub for your 3PL B2B scenario and import them directly into the Trading Partner Management and Integration Advisor systems of your SAP Integration Suite tenant. This not only saves you a lot of time, but also provides you with high-quality artefacts securing a high level of consistency based on standard conventions and rules. Instead of creating everything from scratch, simply use the B2B scenario and its associated guidelines and adapt them to your trading partners' and your own specific requirements, configure the communication channels, activate the TPAs, test, and finally go live with your trading partners.

packages.DisplayName: Teknoleum Hydrocarbon Quantity Conversion
packages.ShortText: Converts hydrocarbon quantities from ambient to standard conditions
packages.Description:
The Hydrocarbon Quantity Conversion (HQC) solution from Teknoleum provides REST based APIs to convert petroleum quantities under measured conditions into multiple volume and mass units at standard conditions.

Conversion of petroleum quantities from ambient to standard conditions or vice-versa & between volume and mass is a key industry requirement to ensure equability in commercial transactions. The volume of hydrocarbon materials varies with temperature and pressure and as these move across different ambient conditions through the supply chain, accurate quantity calculation at standard conditions is imperative to ensure correct reporting, not just to track the real inventory volumes, but also to ascertain the correct inventory value and profits and to comply with commercial and tax regulations.

HQC API converts observed volume or mass into other units of measure at standard conditions like Barrels at 60 Fahrenheit to Litres at 15 Celsius or Litres at 20 Celsius. The API helps application developers to focus on the core functions of their applications as it delivers accurate, out-of-the-box calculations as per industry standards.

The API takes the material quantity as input along with the ambient temperature, ambient pressure, test density and test conditions. It returns the quantity converted into a set of standard volume and mass units. Thus allowing the developers to embed hydrocarbon quantity conversion logic into their applications. The conversion is compliant with Manual of Petroleum Measurement Standards Chapter 11.1 published by the American Petroleum Institute (API), which is the most widely used standard in the industry.

It supports conversion of quantities for:
  • Crude Oils
  • Refined Products
  • Lubricating Oils
  • Special Applications

    • Contact Details:www.teknoleum.com/hqcsales@teknoleum.com

packages.DisplayName: Cross Model Add-On for Integrated Financial Planning
packages.ShortText: Add-On for the package Integrated Financial Planning and provides integration to other planning packages and SAP sources.
packages.Description:
Cross Model Add-On for Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA covers the following topics:

Overview
This content package is an Add-On for the package Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA and provides integration to other planning packages and SAP sources. Currently available are the integration to the packages Operational Workforce Planning, Portfolio Financial Planning, Commercial Planning, Consumer Products (CP) Sales Planning, Commercial Planning and integration to the SAP source SAP Integrated Business Planning (IBP) and integration to the SAP source SAP Sustainability Footprint Management.
The Add-on package can be imported after the content packages Operational Workforce Planning, Portfolio Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition, Commercial Planning, and Consumer Products Sales Target Planning have been imported.
If you do not want to use all of the related content packages you need to deselect the respective objects in the Import Options before starting the Import. Details can be found in the package documentation.

Copy Expenses and FTE from Workforce Planning
Workforce Planning for SAP S/4HANA content is integrated with SAP SuccessFactors allowing you to plan resources and calculate personnel expenses. These expenses can be transferred to the cost center planning model within Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA content. FTE totals can be transferred to the financial statement planning model to generate workforce KPIs.

Copy Demand from IBP
During the monthly Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process in SAP IBP, the supply chain planners determine the quantity of the consensus demand plan. The financial planner imports the quantity of the consensus demand plan from SAP IBP to profitability planning within Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA content. Based on the input received from SAP IBP, the net revenue and the costs of goods sold are calculated in SAP Analytics Cloud. These values can be transferred back to SAP IBP for further review.

Copy Quantities from CP Sales Planning
The Consumer Products (CP) Sales Planning business content enables top-down planning of sales targets. The resulting planned quantities can be transferred to the sales and profitability planning model within Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA content.

Copy Quantities and Net Revenue from Commercial Planning
The Commercial Planning (CXCP) business content enables top-down planning of sales targets. The resulting planned quantities and net revenue can be transferred to the sales and profitability planning model within Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA content.

Copy project amounts from Portfolio Financial Planning
The Portfolio Financial Planning business content supports the financial planning process for project investments. It aligns the bottom-up budget requests on the individual project level with the top-down strategic planning along the portfolio hierarchy. The approved project amounts can be transferred to the center planning model within Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA content.

Copy Raw material factors (CO2e per component unit) from SAP Sustainability Footprint Management
The SAP Sustainability Footprint Management solution enables you to calculate footprints for your cradle-to-gate scenarios, including the product acquisition, production, and transport stages of the value chain. The raw material factors (CO2e per component unit) can be transferred to the product cost model within Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA content.

packages.DisplayName: Supplier Invoice File Extraction from Email and Upload to SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management (6JX)
