packages.Description:
Problem

Note: The bot has been replaced by the Configure Inbound Email application in SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management and is now deprecated.

Companies often receive supplier invoices in different formats (e.g., PDF, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, and XML) as file attachments to emails. The Accounts Payable clerks or Shared Services Center employees would then need to process these emails manually, save the email attachment invoice files into a specific folder, and upload the supplier files to SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management to create the Supplier Invoices manually. This is a time-consuming process and requires a lot of effort.

Solution

The bot automatically uploads supplier invoice files to SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management to create draft invoices. The bot scans incoming emails to extract supplier invoice files based on the accepted formats (i.e., JPEG, PNG, PDF, TIFF, XML). The bot then uploads the supplier invoices to the SAP Ariba Central Invoice Management system for further processing.

packages.Description:
Consensus Net Revenue Planning covers the following topics:

Facilitating Cross Functional Revenue Planning
Arriving to a consensus on planned revenues is a critical step in the Extended Integrated Business Planning process. Finance, Supply Chain, and Commercial functions must align on the unconstrained demand that will be used in the subsequent supply chain planning activities.

Revenue Scenario Planning
The ability to compare multiple scenarios of planned revenues, as well as their impact on profitability, is crucial to the process. This content provides a story to adjust the gross revenue on 3 distinct scenarios, calculate the adjusted gross margin and analyse the variances between the scenarios.

Revenue and Margin Analysis
The different functions involved in the process must have a way to easily view the variances between their own functional plan and the consensus scenarios. This content provides a story for each function to compare the consensus scenarios to their own functional plans and financial targets.

packages.DisplayName: SAP S/4HANA Access Request Integration with SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance
packages.ShortText: SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG) Access Request Integration from SAP S/4HANA leveraging Business Rules and SAP Cloud Identity Authentication Service (IAS)
packages.Description:
This integration package enables the integration with your S/4HANA HR systems to enable changes in employee status (HR triggers) to initiate access requests via SAP Cloud Identity Access Governance (IAG). 

Integration Process:
- An Abap Proxy within S/4HANA replicates the created/changed/terminated employee data to SAP Cloud Integration. 
- Cloud Integration will verify if the user exists in SAP Identity Authentication Service (IAS).
   If the user does not exist, the user will be created.
- Cloud Integration will verify if the manager exists in SAP IAS.
  If manager does not exist, a default manager will be used.
- Cloud Integration will perform a new and previous position lookup against configured Business Rules.
- Cloud Integration will create position based access request in SAP IAG and returns the status back to the Abap Proxy.

This package can also be customized for other input HR formats, if required.

A business generates product or feature ideas internally or receives them through feedback mechanisms from customers or business partners. A product or feature improvement idea could, for example stem from a maintenance technician who shares her / his request for product improvement. Engineers then translate an idea into product requirements and system concepts for a new or redesigned product. They also create product designs and evaluate the financial impact of the changes they made before handing over the information to manufacturing.
This solution variant comprises a modular set of solutions for a hybrid deployment, i.e. SAP S/4HANA on-premise seamlessly integrated with other SAP public cloud and business network solutions.

Important IP-relevant Note

Some of the Business Processes use Business Activities by the APQC Cross-industry Process Classification Framework (“PCF”), or Business Activities derived from APQC Cross-Industry PCF. The APQC Process Classification Framework® (“PCF”) is an open standard developed by APQC, a nonprofit that promotes benchmarking and best practices worldwide. The PCF is intended to facilitate organizational improvement through process management and benchmarking, regardless of industry, size, or geography. To download the full PCF or industry-specific versions of the PCF, as well as associated measures and benchmarking, please visit http://www.apqc.org/pcf

packages.Description:
Problem statement

Companies receive many business documents through e-mail from vendors and customers, such as local purchase orders, signed proof of deliveries, and payment advice. Users typically need to scan through their e-mails, download the documents, and categorize them based on the document type and the company code before creating relevant objects in SAP Business One. This manual process takes a significant amount of the user's daily time.

Solution

The Business Document Extraction from E-Mail bot automatically scans relevant e-mails, downloads the attachments, and categorizes them based on the document type and company code. This automation reduces users effort and sets the stage for further intelligent business process automation.

Business Benefits

  • Reduces user effort

  • Reduces the risk of manual errors

  • Improves work efficiency

Further Extensions

The Business Document Extraction from E-Mail bot is designed to be the first automation in the end-to-end automation processes, which can work with the following best practices for process automation project templates for SAP Business One:

  • Sales Order Creation from Local Purchase Order

  • Supplier Invoice Upload for Intelligent Invoice Scanning

In this smart process application, built using SAP Operational Process Intelligence, you will see how a logistics manager, in logistics services company, can get real time insights into shipments and contract logistics process thus enabling him to work with multiple departments and ensure improved turnaround time for deliveries.

Key Process Flows

packages.DisplayName: List Open Activities of Terminated Employees (4JF)
packages.ShortText: Identifies all open project activities, including open projects, purchase requisitions and purchase orders, of terminated employees in a project.
packages.Description:
Problem

When employees leave the company or the Project, a number of recurring or one-time activities of the employee continue to exist in the system. The Project Manager needs to identify and update the open projects activities for which the employee was staffed as well as manage the purchase requisitions and purchase orders which were created by the employee for the project.

In addition, during the course of the project, additional activities may come up with actions required from terminated employees. The Project Manager is responsible to identify and manage these tasks.

Typically, these are manual tasks carried out by the Project Manager and have a risk of being missed and the project being delayed if not addressed on a timely basis.

Solution

packages.DisplayName: Shopping Cart Promotional Rules
packages.ShortText: The business logic to determine discount and shipping rate is expressed as business rules which can be changed by directly by business users.
packages.Description:
This is a demo content which enables custom applications to consume SAP Business Rules service.

SAP Business Rules is a platform service which enable business users & application developers to automate their decisions and enhance their decision-making experience. It offers simplified Fiori-based rule authoring tool & a central rule repository with various deployment options to different runtimes. 


Scenario Description
Sales Promotions are common in business. It is offered to customers by providing coupons, free trails, discounts, to name few. Discounts are one the most used techniques for sales promotion.It helps the business by attracting new customers, increasing sales and gaining reputation. To meet strong competition among the suppliers, there are discounts offered in various categories of the products. The discount percentage varies based on the customer’s demand, festivals, clearance and many such factors.

Complex rules are involved to calculate the discounts and have the frequent need to change them based on the market trends. It, therefore, becomes extremely necessary for the suppliers to have an agile rules platform which gives them flexibility to author and manage rules in most effective manner.

In this demo scenario, you will see how business rules authored and deployed from SAP Business Rules can be consumed in Shopping Cart custom application.


Artifacts Overview

  1. Shopping Cart Promotion Rules
    This business rules project contain all the artifacts pertaining to the rules to calculate the discount and derive shipping information for a shopping cart. Here are the list of available rules:
    • Discount Rules
      • Decision Table rules to calculate discounts based on the category and quantity of the products added in the shopping cart by the customer.
      • Text rule to calculate additional seasonal discount based on the date when the order is placed
    • Shipping Rules
      • Decision Table rules to determine shipping information based on the category and seller of the products added in the shopping cart. 


  2. Shopping Cart Application
    This is a custom application that will consume business rules to calculate the discount and derive shipping information for the products selected in the shopping cart.


Setup Instructions

  1. Activate SAP Business Rules service in SAP Business Technology Platform
  2. Assign business rules roles to your user for Cloud Foundry (help documentation) and for Neo (help documentation)
  3. Import Shopping Cart Promotion Rules project in your Manage Rule project application (help documentation) from SAP API Business Hub
  4. Activate all the artefacts in the Project and Deploy the rule services (help documentation)
  5. Import and Activate Shopping Cart application as HTML5 application in your SAP Business Technology Platform account (help documentation)

    • Variant class along with associated characteristic groups and characteristics

packages.DisplayName: Urgent Payments Request Approval
packages.ShortText: Enables customers to accelerate the digitalization of their Urgent Payment Request Approval process in a transparent way and provide flexibility to meet business requirements. It includes process, decisions and visibility scenario content.
packages.Description:
This process optimizes high-priority payments that require immediate attention, reducing the risk of delays and errors. The process begins with the requestor using a Fiori app built on SAP BTP to create an urgent payment request, specifying the type of payment as one of the following:

  • Vendor Payment: Payments to external suppliers for goods or services.

  • Customer Payment: Refunds or payments to customers.

  • G/L Account: Ad-hoc payments requiring manual creation in the system.

Once the request is submitted, it goes through a three-level approval process:

  • Project Manager Approval: The request is first reviewed and approved by the Project Manager, ensuring alignment with project objectives and priorities.

  • Finance Controller Approval: The Finance Controller validates the request and approves.

  • Accountant Approval: At the final stage, the accountant creates the Free Form Payment request in the system and updates the request number in the approval workflow to confirm completion and once approved it will be released for the payment.

Throughout the process, the system sends email notifications to the respective approvers, prompting them to act either approve or reject. packages.DisplayName: Dunning Run - F150 (ECC)

packages.Description:
Use

This program is used for executing a Dunning Run. Here, we are automating Dunning Run using transaction F150.

Configuration

The input criteria and system information are maintained in a configuration excel named as Dunning Run_F150(ECC).xlsx.

This excel file contains two sheets:

  • The first sheet contains the system details like the System ID, Client, FileType, Output Path and whether Single Sign-On is enabled.

  • The username and password for the target ECC system is maintained in the Cloud Factory.

  • The second sheet contains input data for the program in the form of parameter and its corresponding value.

The e-mail configuration is contained in an excel file named as EmailConfiguration.xlsx. The configuration files available within the package should be downloaded and maintained in the given InputPath and EmailConfigPath environment variables.

Key Process Flows

  • The bot gets a bunch of e-mails which have a specified subject line.

  • The e-mails are moved to a specified subfolder in the mailbox.

  • The bot reads each mail, extracts relevant data and creates a job for each of them.

  • Automates Dunning Run using the input data.

  • Logs the status in the job log in the Cloud Factory and sends the same as a reply to the mail

Business Benefits

  • Reduce manual effort an employee can concentrate on the more important tasks

  • Ensure fast creation of the document

  • Eliminate the human error

To do so, the user should create a mapping definition and eventually a job using the graphical interface, then through the API precise the job to be run. packages.Description:
This package provides a structured approach to discontinue business relationships with customers, addressing various financial scenarios. The process begins with the requestor creating a discontinuation request for a customer in the Start UI application. The request then progresses through a multi-level approval process with email notifications sent to respective approvers at each stage. Depending on the financial status of the customer, the following scenarios are handled:

Zero Balance: Post approval, open items are cleared automatically in the SAP system.

The Requestor/Finance department manually confirms the clearance completion.

Debit Balance: An automatic email is triggered to the customer requesting settlement of their balance amount.

Credit Balance: Customer Refund Request will be created in the system:

  1. Manual Customer Refund Request: An automatic email is sent to the finance department to initiate a refund process. Manage Customer Refund Request app triggers an automatic email to the finance department to process an outgoing payment to the customer as a refund. The Requester/Finance department manually confirms the initiation of the refund process.

  2. Automatic Customer Refund Request: The transfer of special general ledger (Spl.Gl) items into the normal ledger performed through the process flow. Finance user confirmation is not required.

Throughout the process, approvers are notified via email at each level and can approve or reject through the My Inbox app.

This package provides:

  • Process that orchestrates the approval process for the business scenario

  • Automation to perform the required scripting relevant for the business scenario

  • APIs to perform data related operations with SAP S/4HANA

  • Decisions to determine approvers for tasks

packages.DisplayName: SAP Cloud Integration
packages.ShortText: Simplify end-to-end process integration across cloud-based and on-premise applications.
packages.Description:
SAP Cloud Integration supports end-to-end process integration by enabling you to access and manage entities that are relevant when developing and executing an integration scenario.
It provides a core runtime for processing, transformation, and routing of messages to be exchanged between the involved systems. Various options are there to connect (Cloud Integration) to different systems through protocols such like HTTP(S), SFTP, and OData (for example). A Web environment allows integration experts to model and design integration scenarios as well as to monitor those at runtime. Furthermore, you can access the integration service through an application programming interface(API).
Message processing at runtime is performed by a cluster of virtual machines running on SAP Business Technology Platform. Here, the platform ensures that data related to different customers connected to Cloud Integration is isolated. This is important, for example, when using Cloud Integration for business-to-business scenarios. Various features such as content encryption and certificate - based communication allow you to make sure that data processed by Cloud Integration is protected to a maximum level.
For more information, check out the SAP Cloud Integration product documentation on SAP Help Portal.
This API is implemented based on OData version 2 specification.

packages.DisplayName: SAP Audit Log Service
packages.ShortText: Read audit logs stored by SAP services on your behalf and manage retention period
packages.Description:
An audit log, also called an audit trail, is essentially a record of events and changes. SAP software creates logs based on events. Audit logs are records of these event logs, typically representing security-relevant chronological records that provide documentary evidence for an event or activity. Audit logs can look very different depending on the business scenario they have been created for. The SAP Audit Log service is giving the opportunity to SAP internal services to write audit logs on behalf of the customer. After that the customers can view and read their audit logs.

One important aspect of audit logs is that they have a retention period - a period of time defined by legal authorities or regulators, on the length of time the specified data must be stored. The customers can specify this period by using an API for the Neo environment or by creating a support ticket to component BC-CP-CF-SEC-AUDITLG for the Cloud Foundry environment.

The SAP Audit Log service stores audit logs representing different actions taken over your account and/or data. There are predefined audit categories which represent such kind of actions:

  • audit.data-access - read-access logging records for access to sensitive personal data;
  • audit.data-modification - data modification logging records for sensitive personal data.
  • audit.security-events - logging of general security events like login, logout, and other;
  • audit.configuration - logging of security critical configuration changes.

See Change Logging and Read-Access Logging for more information.

This package contains SAP Audit Log service REST API documentation that you can use.

All APIs require a global account and a subaccount. See Getting Started.

Each of these APIs also requires you to have the corresponding roles and permissions. See API Documentation.

The bot also sends an email notification to the user.

Note:

The bot requires projects to be existing and "In Execution" status.

packages.DisplayName: SAP LeanIX Integration with SAP Integration Suite
packages.ShortText: Integrate SAP LeanIX with the SAP Integration Suite's Integration Assessment capability to efficiently replicate Applications, Instances, Providers and Interfaces Requests between SAP LeanIX and Integration Assessment.
packages.Description:
This integration package is designed to synchronize data between SAP LeanIX and Integration Assessment, focusing primarily on the synchronization of Applications, Vendors and Interface Requests. Utilizing the SAP Integration Suite, this synchronization process ensures a seamless, secure, and up-to-date data flow. This enhances the accuracy and efficiency of IT integration strategies, providing comprehensive insights for integration assessments.

 

Note: Due to the equivalence of 'Vendors' in Integration Assessment to 'Providers' in SAP LeanIX for simplicity and clarity, 'vendor' is used as the uniform term throughout the package.

 

The package comprises four distinct integrations, each serving unique functions and designed to operate independently. Users can select and deploy any iFlow according to their specific requirements and needs:

 

  1. Fullsync Integration Assessment Vendors: Synchronizes all vendors (providers) from SAP LeanIX to Integration Assessment. This interface is triggered manually and operates once per trigger.
  2. Fullsync Integration Assessment Applications: Synchronizes all applications from SAP LeanIX to Integration Assessment. This includes optional synchronization of application instances (on-premise/public-cloud/private-cloud). This interface is also manually triggered and operates once per trigger.
  3. Create Integration Assessment Vendor: Activated whenever a factsheet of type 'provider' is created in SAP LeanIX. This event triggers the creation of a new vendor in Integration Assessment, ensuring real-time data updates.
  4. Create Integration Assessment Application: Similar to the vendor creation interface, this is activated when a factsheet of type 'application' is created in SAP LeanIX. It triggers the creation of a new application in Integration Assessment, including the synchronization of application instances (on-premise/public-cloud/private-cloud) if applicable. This interface also requires manual triggering and operates once per trigger.
  5. Create SAP LeanIX Interface Factsheet: Synchroniz a SAP LeanIX Interface Fact Sheet from Integration Assessment Interface Requests at a configurable interval. Applications selected in the Interface Request will also be referenced in the Fact Sheet, provided they have been synced by this package.


Please refer to the documentation for the exact details regarding the configuration.

The library is structured in different groups of activities called modules:

  • the Application module contains mandatory activities to drop when automating MS Excel instances (open, close or release)
  • the Workbook module contains activities allowing you to work on MS Excel workbooks (activate, open, close…)
  • the Worksheet module is a set of activities to read (get) or write (set) cells with different options
  • the Enumeration module contains the MS Excel constants
  • the Excel Helper module contains a dedicated activity called Excel Cloud Link to retrieve the cell range values from a specified worksheet. A dedicated configuration screen is then available in order to map the values from the worksheet to a data type.

packages.DisplayName: Mass Creation of Customer Returns (4HT)
packages.ShortText: Enables mass creation of customer return orders based on details entered in the Excel input template.
packages.Description:
Problem

Return Clerks often receive return requests as email Excel file attachments. The Return Clerk must then individually and manually identify the corresponding sales order and transfer the data in the return requests to the system to create a return.

This process is tedious, time-consuming, and adds unnecessary effort.

Solution

The bot automates the creation of return orders based on details in the completed return Excel input file saved in a predefined folder on the local desktop.

The Return Clerk either completes the Excel input file with the customer's return request details or asks the customer to complete it. The Return Clerk saves the completed files in the predefined folder. The bot then extracts and processes the data in the Excel input files and creates the return order in the system. The bot sends a notification to specified stakeholders with details of the return orders created.

packages.DisplayName: Handle Tenant Move In Date Changes
packages.ShortText: This package contains the required artifacts that automatically updates the Owner Move-Out date and the start date of Service Order when Tenant changes the Move-In date.
packages.Description:
This content package enables business experts to handle date changes for owner move-out, and updating the service order based on changes to tenant move-in date.

When the Move-In date is changed for a tenant a workflow will be triggered to handle Move-Out for Owner. The workflow checks if there is an existing Tenant-Owner relationship based on the Move-Out Document Number.

If there is no tenant-owner relationship, the service order of the tenant is updated with Move-In date.
In case tenant-owner relationship exists, Move-Out date of the owner is changed and then the corresponding service order of the tenant is also updated with the Move-In date.

Move-Out date of owner happens one day prior to the Tenant Move-In date.

This live process content can be consumed in SAP Build Process Automation (click here to know-how) or SAP Workflow Management (click here to know-how).

packages.DisplayName: Service Confirmation Notification
packages.ShortText: Enables customer to accelerate the digitalization of their Service Confirmation Notification approval process in a transparent way and provide flexibility to meet business requirements. It includes process, decisions and visibility scenario content.
packages.Description:
This package automates and streamlines the handling of service confirmations in SAP S/4HANA. Events triggered by service confirmation creation or updates initiate workflows in SAP Event Mesh. The process evaluates confirmations against predefined rules for automatic approval or routes them for manual review via the "My Inbox" app. Final status updates and notifications ensure efficient handling and stakeholder visibility.

Key Features of the Service Confirmation Notification Process:
1. Automated Process Trigger: Initiates process upon service confirmation creation or updates in SAP S/4HANA via SAP Event Mesh.
2. Automatic Approval: Configurable rules evaluate confirmations for auto-approval based on criteria like gross amount, service type, and priority.
3. Manual Task Assignment: Tasks requiring review are routed to customer service managers in the "My Inbox" application.
4. Seamless Integration: Updates service confirmation statuses directly in SAP S/4HANA after approvals or reviews.
5. Stakeholder Notifications: Sends email updates or task notifications to relevant parties for transparency and accountability.
6. Process Visibility: Real-time monitoring and analysis of processes through SAP Process Visibility capabilities.
7. Flexible Rule Management: Allows dynamic configuration of business rules to adapt to organizational needs.

The package uses the following action projects for API calls:
- Service Confirmation Notification - Update Service Info Action
- Service Confirmation Notification - Get User Details Action
- Service Confirmation Notification - Get Gross Price Action
- Service Confirmation Notification - Get Service Order Action
- Service Confirmation Notification - Get Service Info Action
- Process Actions

packages.DisplayName: Google Pub/Sub Adapter for SAP Integration Suite
packages.ShortText: This package includes the GooglePubSub Adapter and its documentation. The GooglePubSub adapter is an adapter available on SAP Integration Suite that facilitates message publishing and subscription via Google Pub/Sub.
packages.Description:
The GooglePubSub adapter facilitates and accelerates the implementation time of connecting to Google Pub/Sub. The adapter is available only for Standard service plans and above of the SAP Integration Suite. For more information, see SAP Note 3188446.

  • Receiver adapter allows reliable publishing of messages to Google Pub/Sub. It offers single message (Basic) and multiple message publishing (Advanced) capabilities.
  • Support for listing Topics with pagination using Page Token.
  • Allows you to modify the acknowledgement deadline of a message using the Modify Acknowledgement Deadline operation.

  • Support for On-Premise Connectivity.
  • Offers secure authentication via OAuth2 Service Account option (uses Key Pair authentication) and Workload Identity Federation.
  • Support for decoding data for incoming messages in Sender Adapter (REST variant only).

packages.DisplayName: SD Worx Quick Apply
packages.ShortText: Extension for SuccessFactors to optimise the recruitment process
packages.Description:
Business Challenge

Would you like a simple and fast recruitment process at your company? Do you need a solution that allows candidates to apply quickly, easily, and conveniently? Do you want to prevent candidates from abandoning job applications due to a complicated data registration process?

If so, then try our easy-to-use SD Worx Quick Apply add-on, seamlessly integrated with SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting. With our app, candidates can swiftly apply without needing to remember another password. With our solution, you won't lose any valuable candidates and will maintain the full functionality of the SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting system. Say hello to efficiency and goodbye to missed opportunities!

The SD Worx Quick Apply functionality is created for companies that are constantly recruiting new employees and want a quick and transparent recruitment process for candidates, at every step. It is designed for organisations seeking a simplified process, eliminating unnecessary steps to encourage candidates who might otherwise abandon the application. Additionally, SD Worx Quick Apply is aimed at companies who want simple and intuitive tools to enhance the candidate experience and build a positive company image - one that uses applicant-friendly solutions and makes work better.

Value Story

During a job search, a candidate usually creates accounts on recruitment portals and, upon finding an interesting offer, wants to apply quickly. In SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting, the candidate must create another account and fill in a complex form to apply. Having already gone through this process multiple times, candidates may find the repetition to be a waste of time.

SD Worx Quick Apply allows candidates to apply for a job offer quickly and easily without filling out complex, lengthy forms or logging into SAP SuccessFactors. By completing a short form with essential information, candidates can apply with attachments in just a few minutes.

Built on the SAP Business Technology Platform, SD Worx Quick Apply fully integrates with the SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting module. The candidate's application is automatically recognised in SAP SuccessFactors and linked to a job offer. Additionally, the candidate's account is created automatically, allowing them to set a password and fully utilise the recruitment module. Candidates can easily track the recruitment process, update their personal data, or contact a recruiter.

Business Benefits

  • Ease and speed of application: Apply without logging in or completing an extensive form
  • Order: All candidate applications are linked to one account
  • Transfer of attachments: Attach multiple files, including a 'Drag & Drop' option
  • Maintaining all SuccessFactors functionality: Track application status, receive automatic notifications, pre-screening of candidates based on the additional questions etc.
  • Privacy policy differentiated by country
  • Google reCAPTCHA security
  • Solution fully integrated with SuccessFactors Recruting and in accordance with GDPR

Solution

The bot retrieves a list of employees from SAP Success Factors Employee Central whose contract is terminating within a specified time range. Once this task is complete, the bot sends a report listing all employees identified to the Project Manager via email.

packages.DisplayName: WIP Clearing (SAP Business ByDesign)
packages.ShortText: Automate WIP Clearing for Multiple Companies 24/7
packages.Description:
Running WIP clearing is a manual task in SAP Business Bydesign but is a critical step for production processing and Financials.

Work-in-process (WIP) clearing runs are periodic tasks that are usually performed at regularly scheduled times or during period closing to correct and clear the work in process account. A run selects all production lots that have the corresponding status and reduces the associated work-in-process inventory to zero.

For materials with the Standard perpetual cost method, differences are posted to Price Differences. By default, this account is assigned to the Cost of Sales item in the income statement. This ensures that the amount affects reported earnings.

For materials with the Moving Average perpetual cost method, differences are allocated to inventory in proportion to the inventory quantity at the time of the clearing run and the total goods received quantity of the order. This allocation can affect the moving average cost and thus the inventory value.

By running this Bot guarantees that the WIP clearing is done mutiple times a day and will be a reliable automated practice moving forward

packages.DisplayName: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
packages.ShortText: Automate the process to provide information on frequent asked questions using Compromise NLP Module via email
packages.Description:
Use

This bot will read the question sent by a user via email and fetch the answer from an FAQ document maintained in MS-Excel format. This answer will be sent as a response to that email.

Key Process Flows

  • The bot reads the emails with the specified subject (specified in Config file).

  • From each email the body is extracted.

  • From each body the questions are extracted using the delimiter. (Delimiter is ? or .)

  • FAQ document is read.

  • For each question sent via email, Nouns are extracted and matched against the questions available in the FAQ file to calculate the confidence percentage.

  • Where the confidence percentage is above the threshold (fetched from config file) the question and answer from the FAQ file kept in a list.

  • For each email, the reply is sent with the corresponding question(s) and answer(s). If confidence percentage for all the questions in FAQ file is below threshold, then the whole FAQ document is sent as an attachment. Attachments are taken from the attachment folder maintained in the configuration template. This way, there is a flexibility to attach FAQ in a different format.

  • Once the email is responded to, it is moved to another folder in outlook to avoid duplicate processing of the email. This is also maintained in the configuration excel.

packages.Description:
Use

This program lists Customer line items. You can also display the items from more than one Customer account across company codes in a list. This package is built via Cloud Studio to automate the download of the Customer line items list according to given input data.

Configuration

The input criteria and system information are maintained in a configuration excel named as DynamicTemplate_FBL5N.xlsx. The configuration excel available within the package should be downloaded and maintained in the given InputPath environment variable.

This excel file contains two sheets;

  • The first sheet contains the system details like the System ID, Client and whether Single Sign-On is enabled. It also contains the Variant name for the program and the output path of the excel file to be downloaded.

  • The username and password for the target ECC system is maintained in the Cloud Factory.

  • The file type of the output file to be downloaded is maintained in “Output File Type” row. It is available in the field “Select from all available formats” in Select Spreadsheet popup window in the target system. Some examples of the file-type include “Excel (in Office 2007 XLSX Format)” or “ExcelOffice open XML Format (XLSX)” etc.

  • The second sheet contains input data for the program in the form of parameter and its corresponding value along with a description for the parameter.

Business Benefits

• Reduce manual effort– an employee can concentrate on the more important tasks

• Ensure fast download of the required list

• Eliminate the human error

Key Process Flows

• The bot reads input criteria from the excel template

• Automate the Customer Line Item list

• Download the list as an excel file

  • Get Supplier Details - To fetch Supplier details
  • Get Delayed Purchase Orders - To fetch delayed purchase orders

It also consists on an Agent which filters delayed purchase orders for the specified supplier and returns the relevant purchase orders with overdue delivery dates.

packages.DisplayName: Assignment Management & Time Tracking Reports in SAP CATS
packages.ShortText: Automation which simplifies mass assignment creation for consultants, optimizing project allocation. This solution mproves efficiency, minimizes manual effort, and ensures precise time tracking within SAP Cross-Application Time Sheet (CATS)
packages.Description:
This learning content template streamlines project assignments for consultants and enhances utilization reporting within SAP Cross-Application Time Sheet (CATS).

Automation begins with feature selection, enabling users to either create assignments from a predefined template or generate a consolidated report using excel data. The system processes the uploaded excel sheet and executes the SAP program REP_FIORI_CATS_ASSIGNMNTS to facilitate bulk assignment creation. To ensure security and session management, the automation handles SAP login at initiation and logs out automatically upon completion. Once assignments are generated, consultants receive automated email notifications, ensuring timely communication of project details.

For Cost Object Owners, the automation also generates consolidated reports that compare planned versus actual hours recorded, offering insights into consultant utilization. These reports include key details such as PERNR, Cost Object Type, Identifier, Total CATS Hours, Start Date, and End Date.

Additionally, a technical trace feature logs each step of the automation process, storing records in a designated folder for transparency and traceability. This solution significantly improves efficiency, minimizes manual effort, and ensures precise time tracking within SAP Cross-Application Time Sheet (CATS).

packages.DisplayName: Automation of Open and Close Periods (2F2)
packages.ShortText: Automation of Open and Close Periods
packages.Description:
Problem:

The manual opening and closing periods across both company codes and sets of books can become incredibly time consuming as the number of company codes and set of books increase. This can lead to errors as periods and combinations of books are skipped.

Solution:

Bot enables the automation of opening and / or closing of periods on a regular recurring basis that both fit the needs of financial operations and enable adherence to best practices. The bot also checks to make sure that no gaps are present in the open/close periods before proceeding. Bot reads fiscal year, Company Code and Set of Books and type of operation from the configuration file. Bot automatically opens period and closes it for the defined Company Codes and Set of Books. New period for the next month for the defined Company Codes and Set of Books is automatically open. Upon execution results and error messages are stored in log file.

Business Benefits:

  • Reduced user effort by automation of opening and closing periods

  • Time saved by not having to click through every combination of Company Code and Set of Books

  • Reduced human errors thank to Company Code and Set of Books combinations being edited programmatically.

Further Extensions:

This bot can be used as a standalone bot and it can also work in conjunction with

Automation of Creation of a new Closing Cockpit List bot that will create a new Closing Cockpit through the copy of the previous month template and provided parameters for the defined Company Code and Set of Books.

Automation for the Closing Cockpit bot that will execute Mass Data Runs activities from the Closing Cockpit.

Updating the Status Activities bot that will assign the completion mark to the activity in the Closing Cockpit.

The corresponding bots are also available in the Store.

Challenges that deter customers from taking up their integration migration journey.

  • Selection of the Right Future Platform - If the Customer has a heterogenous Integration systems, evaluating & selecting the right platform needs thorough understanding of the business & IT requirements planned for the future.
  • Legacy Landscape Assessment - Building and understanding of the legacy landscape, the interface complexities, documenting the relevant configurations including custom developments is quite cumbersome and time taking.
  • No Automated Migration - Each interface needs to be created manually in the target cloud integration platform - high efforts translating to high costs Reuse vs Redesign – Finding a balance between an as-is migration vs a redesign approach.

Value Story

Strategy, selection, migration & consolidation of Enterprise Integration Platform as a Service (EiPaaS).

  • iVolve’s Integration Platform Recommendation Tool - Gain rapid insight into potential marketplace integration platforms that solves your as-is/to-be integration vision, styles & use cases.
  • iVolve’s Vector Sprint - A fixed priced, time bound discovery sprint evaluating a target platform against integration vision, use cases, styles, patterns, domains & modernization demands. Detailed outcome driven workshops drive insight & artifacts for implementation.
  • iVolve Migration Automation Framework - Automated & Accelerated integration re-platforming to the cloud. Leverage accelerators & assets on the framework to engage your transformation with guidance & delivery from our integration competence center.

Business Benefits

  • Decluttering the decision making in enterprise integration platform investments.
  • Reduce the inertia by leveraging our platform selection tool as a starting point.
  • The tool continuously source several best of breed platform information including inputs from key experts in the integration space (practitioners, architects, customers and advisors) to provide an initial subset of platform recommendation based on customer inputs.
  • Building absolute clarity for the future platform Vector Sprint is a 4-5 weeks multiple workshops driven approach to improve the clarity, evaluating deeply every aspect of enterprise integration needs of your organization, and delivering a comprehensive integration strategy outcome for confidently embarking on integration transformation engagements.
  • Moving to cloud from setting up the cloud environment, developing interfaces and setting up the governance process to migrate and consolidate existing legacy integration landscapes, automation including a plethora of tools and accelerators to deliver early RoI while lowering the total cost of migration significantly.
  • Reduce discovery & migration efforts by 40% to 80% (based on the legacy middleware SAP vs Non-SAP).

packages.DisplayName: Mass Update Asset Master Data (57O)
packages.ShortText: Automates Mass Update of Asset Master data based on user pre-filled Excel input files.
packages.Description:
Notes: This bot is deprecated and will be retired in a future release

Problem

Companies tend to buy assets like mobile phones, office furniture, and computers in bulk. Asset Accountants need to update newly acquired assets in the system with additional information for depreciation or specific identifiers to facilitate asset tracking (e.g., serial or inventory number, IMEIs for mobile phones, etc.). Due to this task’s high volume and frequency, it proves to be very resource—and time-intensive if carried out manually.

Solution

packages.DisplayName: Post Submission Rules for SAP Complaint Handling
packages.ShortText: This project contains the post submission rules that can be executed after the customer complaint is submitted.
packages.Description:
The Post Submission Rules for SAP Complaint Handling contains all the post submission rules that needs to be executed during the customer complaint submission process. Further, based on the rule output, workflow will be triggered, and approval mails will get triggered to the approvers in My Inbox.

The decision accepts data, either through manual edits or through excel upload, to the decision tables (defined as reusable rules) that are created to validate each of the post submission rules. The ruleset (collection of rules) validates whether the input data meets the required criteria and returns the result derived out of the ruleset accordingly.

The workflow takes the Sales Org as input and level of approval, based on which current Approval User Groups assigned for that sales org is determined (using decision table). Again, based on the User Group (maintained in Identity Provider (IDP)), the email IDs of the list of users are fetched via Action (from external system such as Integration Suite). On approval of the last approver, an action is called to update the complaint status back to Complaint Handling (CMH) application (via CMH API).

Further, the complaints that require manual investigation, can be tracked via Visibility Scenario dashboard, where the user can see the pending, completed and cancelled complaints.

packages.Description:
Business Challenge

Our solution, Enhanced Supply Chain Efficiency through SmartATP, is designed to significantly improve the reliability of Available to Promise (ATP) commitments through advanced integration of Gen AI and narrow AI technologies.

Specifically tailored for ETO (Engineer-to-Order) and MTO (Make-to-Order) industries, it addresses the critical challenge of ensuring timely order fulfillment amidst dynamic demand fluctuations across regions. These complexities are often compounded by external factors such as natural calamities, geopolitical uncertainties, or logistical disruptions. SmartATP excels at assessing and mitigating delays caused by such variables, leveraging Gen AI's analytical capabilities to optimize operations.

Value Story

The implementation of Gen AI empowers organizations to anticipate potential delays from suppliers or vendors well in advance. This foresight enables the revision of production and sales plans, allowing for timely action to minimize disruptions. Gen AI can also trigger advanced notifications to planners and sales teams, ensuring proactive measures are taken to mitigate delays effectively.

Business Benefits

The SmartATP solution offers numerous advantages, particularly for the planner persona:

  • Intimation of potential delays to ensure on-time delivery.
  • Severity-based alerts powered by Gen AI predictions.
  • Notifications to planners and sales teams to preempt delivery delays.
  • Mitigation of financial risks.
  • Dashboards to monitor high-value purchase orders.
  • Enhanced customer satisfaction.
  • Evaluation of supplier performance through Narrow AI.

packages.DisplayName: Process Step Completion Approval for SAP IBP
packages.ShortText: Enables gated processes in SAP Integrated Business Planning. The process moves to the subsequent steps only after gaining the necessary approvals from the reviewers of the finished process step.
packages.Description:
This content package enables you to ensure good quality for supply chain planning processes in SAP IBP by providing you with an approval process for process step completion there. The package includes a workflow process, decisions, and approval form, enabling SAP IBP customers to implement the principle of dual control without the need for coding (low-code / no-code approach).

The content package enables: * Automatic start of a workflow process when the end conditions of a process step in SAP IBP are met. * Good quality for supply chain planning processes executed in SAP IBP by introducing the principle of dual control. * Approval or rejection of the completion of a process step by reviewers using the **Planner Workspaces** app in SAP IBP, or **My Inbox** application of SAP Build Process Automation or **Task Center**. * Option for reviewers to add their feedback about what needs to be reworked to provide satisfactory results if they reject the workflow. * Continuation of the process if reviewers approve the workflow. This content package can be deployed in SAP Build Process Automation and connected to a process in SAP IBP.
In the **Manage Process Templates** app in process management, the SAP IBP administrator creates the process template, defines a custom end condition for the process step, and specifies the workflow required along with the names of the reviewers.

For more information, see [Configuring SAP Build Process Automation](https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_INTEGRATED_BUSINESS_PLANNING/feae3cea3cc549aaa9d9de7d363a83e6/2178ba26dd064454bdd1396cdc5a230e.html).

packages.ShortText: This bot is an SAP Business ByDesign offering. This bot picks up the Proof of Delivery documents from the folder and uploads the documents to SAP Business ByDesign system, as an attachment to the Outbound Delivery (OD).
packages.Description:
Problem:

Proof of delivery (POD) notes are acknowledgments from the customers when they receive goods. The delivery person sends a scanned copy of these notes to the company/user per e-mail. Business users will download these scanned PODs and upload them manually to each Outbound Delivery /Invoice in the SAP Business ByDesign application to have the proof that the goods were delivered, and that they can be paid then. This manual process takes a significant amount of time and is often prone to errors.

Solution:

After the previous Automated Business Document Extraction from Emails bot will extract the POD from e-mails, this bot will pick the file and send it to the SAP AI Business Services - Document Information Extraction to scan it and identify the Delivery Note Number from it. Based on this information, the bot will connect to SAP Business ByDesign using ODATA/SOAP services and upload the file to the relevant delivery note. Later an internal workflow will identify the linked invoice and replicate the POD also to it. The data is exposed for Analytics so the business user can create a report on it using the SAP Business ByDesign plugin for Excel.

Business Benefits:

•  Reducing repetitive tasks.

•  Improved work efficiency.

•  Reduced risk of manual errors.

Further Extensions:

This bot can be used as a standalone bot and it can also work in conjunction with Business Document Extraction from Email bot, which will download the files from the Emails and place them in the automatically created folder structure. packages.DisplayName: Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Inbound
packages.ShortText: This integration package contains the generic inbound integration flows required to setup a Process Integration pipeline on Cloud Integration.
packages.Description:
This integration package is part of a set of integration packages required to setup a Process Integration (PI) pipeline on Cloud Integration for asynchronous and synchronous message processing. The pipeline for Cloud Integration can be seen as a sort of framework providing exactly once delivery, error handling and restart capabilities out of the box.

The new Cloud Integration Pipeline integration packages replace the "Process Integration Pipeline - Generic Integration Flows and Templates" package which has been split up into the following packages to be more flexible in setting up your different pipelines, sender-specific IDoc and XI inbound flows, and receiver-specific outbound flows:

  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Inbound (this very package) containing generic IDoc and XI inbound flows:
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for Idoc
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for XI
  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Pipelines containing the main pipeline steps:
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Integrated Messaging Runtime Async
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Integrated Messaging Runtime Sync
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Inbound Processing
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step04 - Receiver Determination
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step05 - Interface Determination
  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Outbound containing the outbound processing flow:
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step06 - Outbound Processing
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for Idoc
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for XI
  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Templates containing all templates for setting up scenario-specific flows incl. templates for custom extensions as well as the script collection Pipeline v2 - Script Collection.

For setting up the integrated messaging runtime for asynchronous communication (recommended option for asynchronous communication), you need to deploy the following generic integration flows:

  • (Optionally, if you like to use a single entry point for IDoc messages) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for Idoc
  • (Optionally, if you like to use a single entry point for XI messages) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for XI
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Integrated Messaging Runtime Async
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step06 - Outbound Processing
  • (Optionally, if you like to send out IDoc messages) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for Idoc
  • (Optionally, if you like to send out XI messages) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for XI
  • (Optionally, if you like to leverage the provided templates) Pipeline v2 - Script Collection

For setting up the integrated messaging runtime for synchronous content-based-router scenarios, you need to deploy the following generic integration flows:

  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for XI
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Integrated Messaging Runtime Sync
  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for XI
  • (Optionally, if you like to leverage the provided templates) Pipeline v2 - Script Collection

For setting up the fully decoupled pipeline for asynchronous communication, you need to deploy the following integration flows:

  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for Idoc
  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for XI
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Inbound Processing
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step04 - Receiver Determination
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step05 - Interface Determination
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step06 - Outbound Processing
  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for IDoc
  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for XI
  • (Optionally, if you like to leverage the provided templates) Pipeline v2 - Script Collection

The following features are supported:

  • Support for most commonly used Enterprise Integration Patterns such as Point-to-Point, Content-Based-Router, Recipient List, etc.
  • Asynchronous pipeline for asynchronous message processing with decoupling of pipeline steps via limited number of JMS queues
  • Synchronous pipeline for synchronous Content-Based-Router scenarios
  • Generic inbound flows for XI inbound and IDoc inbound scenarios
  • Generic outbound flows for XI outbound and IDoc outbound scenarios
  • Flexible scenario configuration via Partner Directory
  • Retry and error handling capabilities incl. dead letter queue handling
  • Improved monitoring by supporting SAP headers and custom header properties
  • Extension for custom error handling
  • Extension for custom receiver and interface determination
  • Extension for custom exit
  • Option to reuse extended receiver determination mappings from SAP Process Orchestration
  • Support for test mode
  • Supporting different tenant stages, e.g., DEV, QA, PRD

More details on the PI pipeline concept can be found on the Migration Guide for SAP Process Orchestration.

Problem:

Companies, which want to organize their suppler invoice PDFs for upload in different folders (one folder per company) cannot use the SAP Collaboration Window (since the company is determined by the logged in user). However, many customers would like to have one user who can scan all the invoices irrespective of the Company Code.

Solution:

After the previous Automated Business Document Extraction from Emails bot which extracts the Supplier Invoice from e-mails, this bot will pick the invoice and the company code to SAP Business ByDesign using an ODATA service, which would upload the invoice document into the Intelligent Invoice Scanning Staging area. From this point on, the standard Intelligent Invoice Scanning feature takes over and will continue processing the document.

Business Benefits:

•  Reduced user effort by automation of repetitive tasks

•  Improved work efficiency and business flexibility

Further Extensions:

This bot can be used as a standalone bot and it can also work in conjunction with Business Document Extraction from Email bot, which will download the files from the Emails and place them in the automatically created folder structure. In this scenario, the Supplier Invoice Upload for Intelligent Invoice Scanning bot will work in the second part in the end-to-end automation process.

This package contains integration flows and required documentation for integration between SAP S/4HANA Vehicle Management System and SAP Digital Vehicle Hub.

This integration is applicable for S/4HANA on-premise systems with 2020 version or above.

The integration process includes replication of the following from SAP S/4HANA Vehicle Management System to SAP Digital Vehicle Hub:

  • Replication of classification artefacts such as: 
    • Characteristics
    • Variant class along with associated characteristic groups and characteristics   
  • Replication of vehicle location information 
  • Replication of vehicle status information 
  • Replication of vehicles and related information to such as: 
    • Vehicle Configuration 
    • Vehicle Location 
    • Vehicle Status 
    • Vehicle Purchase Order 
    • Vehicle Sales Order 
    • Vehicle Incoming and Outgoing Invoice    

The integration flows are as follows:

  • Vehicle Replication

    • Replicate vehicle(s) from SAP S/4HANA Vehicle Management System to SAP Cloud Integration JMS Queue
    • Transfer vehicle(s) from SAP Cloud Integration JMS Queue to SAP Digital Vehicle Hub

  • Characteristic Replication

    • Replicate characteristic(s) from SAP S/4HANA Vehicle Management System to SAP Cloud Integration JMS Queue
    • Transfer characteristic(s) from SAP Cloud Integration JMS Queue to SAP Digital Vehicle Hub

  • Variant Class Replication

    • Replicate variant classes from SAP S/4HANA Vehicle Management System to SAP Cloud Integration JMS Queue
    • Transfer variant classes from SAP Cloud Integration JMS Queue to SAP Digital Vehicle Hub

  • Vehicle Location Replication

    • Replicate vehicle location(s) from SAP S/4HANA Vehicle Management System to SAP Cloud Integration JMS Queue
    • Transfer vehicle location(s) from SAP Cloud Integration JMS Queue to SAP Digital Vehicle Hub

  • Vehicle Status Replication

    • Replicate vehicle statuses from SAP S/4HANA Vehicle Management System to SAP Cloud Integration JMS Queue
    • Transfer vehicle statuses from SAP Cloud Integration JMS Queue to SAP Digital Vehicle Hub

The integration process leverages the capabilities on JMS adapter in SAP Cloud Integration for message processing via queues and retry mechanisms during errors.

packages.DisplayName: SuccessFactors Talent Intelligence Hub Library Export Templates
packages.ShortText: Standard integration templates can be used to export data from Talent Intelligence Hub Library of SAP SuccessFactors.  Export templates are provided for Attributes, Tags, Behaviors, Attribute and Tag Mapping, Attribute and Behavior Mapping.
packages.Description:
Description

Standard integration templates can be used to export data from Talent Intelligence Hub of SAP SuccessFactors. This package provides export templates for Attributes, Tags, Behaviors, Attribute and Tag Mapping, Attribute and Behavior Mapping. 

Target Deployment Platform

SAP SuccessFactors Integration Center

About the Templates

The templates in this package can be used to export data from Talent Intelligence Hub Library entities listed below. Integration Center Definition files are provided in the Artifacts tab. 

1. Attributes

Attributes in Talent Intelligence Hub are characteristics that define the area of interest or growth opportunities. Skills and competencies are the predefined attribute types supported in Talent Intelligence Hub. You can also create a custom attribute type and define attributes within the custom attribute type. There are 2 templates provided for export.

1.1 Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Export: Export basic data such as external ID, id, name, and description in a default language. The Export file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • default Locale - Locale in which this attribute is created.
    • external ID - External ID of the attribute
    • name - Name of the attribute
    • description - Description of the attribute
    • type - External ID of the attribute type such as Skill/Competency
    • status - values are I and A.  I for Inactive, A for Active.
    • id - Internal ID of the attribute.

To export, use the Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Export" in the Artifacts tab.

1.2 Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Text Export: Export the attributes in multiple languages available in your instance. The export file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • external ID - External ID of the attribute
    • locale - Locale for the attribute translation
    • name - Name of the attribute in the locale
    • description - Description of the attribute in the locale
    • type- External code of the attribute type

To export, use the Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Text Export" in the Artifacts tab.

2. Tags

Tags are keywords that can be used for labeling different attributes. Organizations can define tags that can be associated with attributes. Core, Critical, and Trending are the predefined tags in Talent Intelligence Hub.

There are 2 templates provided.

 2.1 Talent Intelligence Hub Tag Export: Export basic data such as external code, name, and description in a default language. Export file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • external ID - External ID of the attribute
    • default Locale – Locale in which this tag is created.
    • status - values are I and A.  I for Inactive, A for Active
    • tag Value - Name of the Tag
    • tagType -  values are S and C. S for Standard, C for Custom
    • tag Description – Description of the Tag.

To export, use the Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Tag Export" in the Artifacts tab.

 2.2 Talent Intelligence Hub Tag Text Export: Export the Tags in multiple languages available in your instance. Export file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • external ID - External code of the tag
    • locale - Locale of tag translation
    • tag Value - Name of the Tag
    • tag Description - Description of the Tag

To export, use the Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Tag Text Export" in the Artifacts tab.

 

3. Behavior

Behaviors are a set of characteristics that help to measure an attribute of type competency. Behaviors help to assess if an individual possesses qualities that are required by employers and are also used as benchmarks.

There are 2 templates provided.

3.1 Talent Intelligence Hub Behavior Export: Export basic data such as external code, name, and description in a default language. The Export file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • external ID - External code of the behavior
    • default Locale - Locale in which this behavior is created.
    • attribute Name - Name of the behavior.
    • attribute Description - Description of the behavior.
    • attribute Status – status of the behavior. I for Inactive, A for Active.
    • wsm id - Internal ID of the behavior

 

To export, use the Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Behavior Export" in the Artifacts tab.

 

3.2 Talent Intelligence Hub Behavior Text Export: Export the behaviors in multiple languages available in your instance.

    • external ID - External code of the behavior
    • default Locale - Locale of behavior translation
    • attribute Name - Name of the behavior.
    • Attribute Description - Description of the behavior

To export, use the Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Behavior Text Export" in the Artifacts tab.

4. Attribute and Behavior Mapping

Attributes of type Competency can be associated with behaviors. A behavior can only be associated with one competency. There is 1 template provided to export this mapping.

 4.1 Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Behavior Mapping Export: Using this template, export the mapping of attributes and behaviors. The Export file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • attribute external ID: external code of the attribute
    • behavior external IDs: comma delimited external code of the behavior(s). Multiple behaviors mapped to a single attribute will be enclosed in "".

To export, use the Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Behavior Mapping Export" in the Artifacts tab.

5. Attribute and Tag Mapping

Attributes can be associated with one or more tags. There is 1 template provided to export this mapping.

 5.1 Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Tag Mapping Export: Using this template, export the mapping of attributes and tags. The Export file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • attribute external ID: external code of the attribute

packages.DisplayName: Automation of Open and Close Periods (2F2)
packages.ShortText: This bot is a SAP Business ByDesign BPA bot that enables the automation of opening and/or closing of periods on a regular recurring basis using the fiscal year, company code and set of books
packages.Description:
Problem:

The manual opening and closing periods across both company codes and sets of books can become incredibly time consuming as the number of company codes and set of books increase. This can lead to errors as periods and combinations of books are skipped.

Solution:

Bot enables the automation of opening and / or closing of periods on a regular recurring basis that both fit the needs of financial operations and enable adherence to best practices. The bot also checks to make sure that no gaps are present in the open/close periods before proceeding. Bot reads fiscal year, Company Code and Set of Books and type of operation from the configuration file. Bot automatically opens period and closes it for the defined Company Codes and Set of Books. New period for the next month for the defined Company Codes and Set of Books is automatically open. Upon execution results and error messages are stored in log file.

Business Benefits:

•  Reduced user effort by automation of opening and closing periods

•  Time saved by not having to click through every combination of Company Code and Set of Books

•  Reduced human errors thank to Company Code and Set of Books combinations being edited programmatically.

Further Extensions:

This bot can be used as a standalone bot and it can also work in conjunction with

Automation of Creation of a new Closing Cockpit List bot that will create a new Closing Cockpit through the copy of the previous month template and provided parameters for the defined Company Code and Set of Books.

Automation for the Closing Cockpit bot that will execute Mass Data Runs activities from the Closing Cockpit.

Updating the Status Activities bot that will assign the completion mark to the activity in the Closing Cockpit.

The corresponding bots are also available in the Store.

packages.DisplayName: SuccessFactors Integration Center - Microsoft Active Directory
packages.ShortText: The following SuccessFactors integration center templates available for integrating SuccessFactors with Microsoft Active Directory via file based uploads with PowerShell.   Active Directory - Create, Active Directory - Change and Active Directory -Disable
packages.Description:
The following SuccessFactors integration center templates available for integrating SuccessFactors with Microsoft Active Directory via file based uploads with PowerShell.  

- Active Directory - Create.  SuccessFactors integration center templates and example PowerShell upload scripts.  This template outputs new hired employees from SuccessFactors and creates active directory users

- Active Directory - Change.  SuccessFactors integration center templates and example PowerShell upload scripts.  This template outputs employee information from SuccessFactors and updates active directory user information

- Active Directory - Disable.  SuccessFactors integration center templates and example PowerShell upload scripts.  This template outputs terminated employees from SuccessFactors and disables active directory users

 

Target Deployment Platform:

SuccessFactors integration center: enables HR business analysts to build, deploy, and monitor simple file-based outbound integrations

 

About the template:

The Microsoft Active Directory templates can be used to integrate SuccessFactors to Microsoft Active Directory via file based uploads within PowerShell.  Please note that the standard integration templates are to help customers start from a template to save time and effort.   Customization of the integration center templates and active directory PowerShell scripts are required to cater for customer specific requirements. 

 

Prerequisites:

- Microsoft Active Directory server setup and configured

- Access to the Microsoft Active Directory server and PowerShell

- SuccessFactors integration center setup and configured

- SFTP access for SuccessFactors integration center to write integration output flat files

- Correct security and connection setup between SFTP server and Microsoft Active Directory server 

- Microsoft Active Directory PowerShell does not include SFTP software by default and therefore a SFTP client needs to be installed to enable automatic download the integration center files from SFTP to the Microsoft Active Directory server

 

How to consume this template:

- Please download the integration definition files from the Artifacts tab below and upload them to SuccessFactors Integration Center. The PowerShell scripts are available for download in the Documents tab.

 

SuccessFactors integration center steps:

- Make relevant customization to the SuccessFactors Integration Center template for customer specific requirements.  This includes selecting the correct filters to select the correct employees and selecting mandatory field checks to ensure mandatory active directory fields are filled

- Configuration SFTP destination settings

- Schedule the integration to run on a periodic basis.  The integrations need to be scheduled to run in the following sequence to avoid problems with duplications between files.  1) Create integration 2) Change integration 3) Disable integration

 

Microsoft Active Directory steps:  

- Schedule PowerShell SFTP client to download integration center files

- Load example active directory PowerShell upload scripts to active directory

- Make relevant changes to the example PowerShell upload scripts for customer specific requirements 

- Schedule PowerShell upload scripts to run on a periodic basis

 

Known limitations:

- Example PowerShell scripts have been designed to process one file at a time per integration.

packages.DisplayName: SAP HANA integration with SAP Business Rules Service
packages.ShortText: Achieve analytical decisions making with SAP Business Rules integration to SAP HANA
packages.Description:
SAP Business Rules is a platform service which enable business users & application developers to automate their decisions and enhance their decision-making experience. It offers simplified Fiori-based rule authoring tool & a central rule repository with various deployment options to different runtimes. 


Scenario Description
Telecommunications industry has grown dramatically over past few decades driven mainly by power of internet, digitisation of various forms of communication and by risings demands of communication as key enabling technology. Besides, telecommunication companies often face unique set of challenges due to its ever-changing combinations of devices, plans, and payment models. These can quickly complicate things.

Communication service providers are in constant search for new and innovative ways of offering responsive services to achieve customer satisfaction and increase revenues. One way to accomplish this is to recommend personalised offers to the customers based on their plan and usage.

The offers are quite volatile and require complex rules to arrive to a personalised recommendation for a customer, after processing and analysing millions of data records and trends. To author and manage such business logics, SAP offers SAP Business Rules service on SAP HANA Classic. Telecom IT department can build the rules on the cloud and deploy them to native SAP HANA, and operators can utilize the in-memory computing and processing capabilities to derive offers in real-time for their customers.

 

Artifacts Overview

  1. Offer Management Rules
    This business rules project contain all the artifacts pertaining to the rules to calculate the offers in the telecommunication industry based on the tariff plans and contract of the customer. Here are the list of available rules:
    • Potential Churn Rules
      • Text rules to propose offers to the customers who have active contract which will expire in next 4 weeks

    • Loyal Customer Rules
      • Text rules to give special offers to the customers who have active contract for past 4 years without being defaulters anytime. 

    • No Repair Contract Rules
      • Text rules to advice customers to have repair contract who have mobile phones with good tariff plans. 

    • Offer Bundle
      • Decision table rules to provide a list of recommended offers to privileged customers based upon their credit rating and contract status


  2. Offer Management Data Models
    This is a package that contains HANA data models on which business rules would be written. (Image available above)

 

Setup Instructions (blog)

  1. SAP HANA
    • On premise SAP HANA 1.0 SP12 or above or SAP HANA 2.0
    • XSA enabled in your HANA setup
    • Extract, import and activate the schema and tables in Data Models package (note: these tables will be used for modelling rules in SAP Business Rules)
    • Setup Rules HANA Connector in your SAP HANA system


  2. SAP Business Rules
    • Activate Business Rules service in your SAP BTP
    • Assign business rules roles to your user
    • Configure Cloud Connector and Destinations in SAP BTP
    • Download and Import Offer Management Rules project in your Business Rules
    • Activate all the rule models and Deploy the rule services in your SAP HANA system

packages.DisplayName: NetSuite Adapter for SAP Integration Suite
packages.ShortText: This package include the NetSuite Adapter and its documentation. The NetSuite adapter facilitates and accelerates the implementation time of connecting to NetSuite.
packages.Description:
The NetSuite adapter facilitates and accelerates the implementation time of connecting to NetSuite. The adapter is available only for Standard service plans and above of the SAP Integration Suite. For more information, see SAP Note 3188446. 

Feature highlights:

  • Support for multiple API versions: NetSuite supports multiple API versions with an editable API version field enabling users to input the latest supported version.
  • Secure authentication based on Tokens: The NetSuite adapter supports the Token-Based Authentication (TBA) mechanism which increases overall system security. Every call between NetSuite and SAP Cloud Integration is secured by Tokens.
  • Support for multiple NetSuite operations: The NetSuite adapter supports various operations like Add, Attach, Add List, Get, Get List, Delete, Get All, Get Saved Search, Async Add List, Update, Update List, Upsert List, etc.
  • Querying and searching: In addition to all the operations that the NetSuite Adapter offers, the Adapter allows the querying of data from your NetSuite tenant.
  • Dynamic configuration with headers and properties: Assigning dynamic values to different properties allows enhanced flexibility to your integration flows. You can also refer to dynamic parameters using SAP Cloud Integration exchange headers and properties. 
  • Processing more than one record at a time: Some operations can be performed on one or more new instances of a record in NetSuite. In most cases, these operations contain the word List in them. As an example, the addlist operation can be used to add one or more new instances of a record to NetSuite.
  • Processing more than one record of data asynchronously: Some operations can be performed on one or more new instances of a record in NetSuite in an asynchronous manner. In general, for asynchronous operations, bulk records are sent to NetSuite without the need to wait for a response.
  • XSD Generator: To help speed up the integration, an XSD generator in the form of an Eclipse Plug-in is provided alongside the adapter. With this Eclipse Plug-in/Workbench, it is possible to generate an XSD which includes the structure of an Account Record. The generated XSD can then be imported into Cloud Integration and used for mapping purposes.
  • Full integration support for Custom Records and Fields: In addition to supporting all the standard NetSuite Records (or entities), the Adapter integrates with all the Custom Objects in NetSuite, providing support for custom fields in the objects as well.
  • Support for RESTlet: Enables access to NetSuite via REST calls to RESTlet which exposes APIs created with SuiteScript.

Documentation:

All documentation, including the User Guide, and Release Notes are included in the documentation tab of this package.

Download Location:

To download the SAP NetSuite Adapter's Eclipse Plug-In or Workbench, navigate to: https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/softwarecenter >> SUPPORT PACKAGES & PATCHES By Alphabetical Index (A-Z) >> C >> look for “SAP CP IS ADAPTER ADVANCE PACK”.

Alternatively, you can directly go to:

  • SAP CP IS ADAPTER ADVANCE PACK

Please note that the content of the package is the Eclipse Plug-In or Workbench. To install the Adapter, refer to the Adapter Guide located in the Documents tab.
