packages.DisplayName: Supplier Invoice Upload for Intelligent Invoice Scanning (2R1)
packages.ShortText: This bot is an SAP Business One offering. This bot automates the process of creating of supplier invoice draft by extracting document information from local invoice files.
packages.Description:
Problem statement

The supplier invoice is a common document received by companies. A user in the procurement department typically needs to enter or copy and paste the details from the documents to the system. This manual process is not only time-consuming but also prone to errors such as incorrect or missing information.

Solution

The Supplier Invoice Upload for Intelligent Invoice Scanning (2R1) bot automates the process of uploading supplier invoices to the Document Information Extraction service (part of SAP AI Business Services), which scans and extracts the information from the documents. The extracted information is passed by the bot to SAP Business One using the Open Data protocol to create a record in the SAP Business One database. From this point on, you can use the Electronic Document Import Wizard functionality in SAP Business One to import the documents and generate a draft invoice.

Note: The Document Information Extraction service license is part of the SAP Process Automation license. If an SAP Business One customer already uses intelligent automation for their business, this bot makes it possible to consume the Intelligent Invoice Scanning functionality available in SAP Business One at no extra costs.

Business Benefits

  • Reduces user effort

  • Reduces the risk of manual errors

  • Improves work efficiency and business flexibility

packages.DisplayName: Sales Order Creation from Local Purchase Order (1C1)
packages.ShortText: This SAP ByDesign intelligent RPA bot automates the process of creating a sales order from a local purchase order received from customers.
packages.Description:
Problem:

Companies receive Purchase Order (PO) documents from their customers and based on them, the business users will create sales orders in the SAP Business ByDesign application. Typically, user will enter or copy & paste the details from the documents to the system. This manual process is not only time-consuming, but also often prone to errors such as incorrect/missing information.

Solution:

After the previous Automated Business Document Extraction from Emails bot will extract the customer PO from emails, this bot will pick the PO and sent it to the SAP AI Business Services - Document Information Extraction to scan it and identify the information out of it. The extracted details will be passed by the bot to SAP Business ByDesign using ODATA service to create a draft sales order and upload the document to it for business user review. To further automate and improve the accuracy of the Sales Order creation there is also a Master Data Enrichment for AccountID identification bot available, which will help the bot to identify the AccountID based on the scanned information like Supplier Name, Address, Bank Account, etc.

Business Benefits:

  • Reduced user effort by automation of repetitive tasks.

  • Reduced risk of manual errors hence, higher accuracy.

  • Improved work efficiency.

Further Extensions:

This bot can be used as a standalone bot and it can also work in conjunction with Business Document Extraction from Email bot, which will download the files from the Emails and place them in the automatically created folder structure. In this scenario, the Sales Order Creation from a Local Purchase Order bot will work in the second part in the end-to-end automation process.
The corresponding bot is also available in the Store.

Seven integration flows:

  • Replicate Customer from SAP ERP: IDOCs of type DEBMAS06 which contains application object data are mapped to an OData service of SAP Logistics Business Network to create and update master data of business partner within customer type.
  • Replicate Vendor from SAP ERP: IDOCs of type CREMAS06 which contains application object data are mapped to an OData service of SAP Logistics Business Network to create and update master data of business partner within vendor type.
  • Replicate Address from SAP ERP: IDOCs of type ADRMAS06 which contains application object data are mapped to an OData service of SAP Logistics Business Network to create and update master data of business partner containing both customer and vendor.
  • Replicate Location from SAP ERP: IDOCs of type DEBMAS06/CREMAS06/ADRMAS06 which contains application object data are mapped to an OData service of SAP Logistics Business Network to create and update master data of location.
  • Replicate Product from SAP ERP: IDOCs of type MATMAS05 which contains application object data are mapped to an RESTful service of SAP Logistics Business Network to create and update master data of product.
  • Replicate Business Partner and Product from SAP ERP: IDOCs of type DEBMAS06/CREMAS06/ADRMAS06/MATMAS05 which contains application object data are mapped to an RESTful service of SAP Logistics Business Network to create and update master data of business partner and product.

packages.DisplayName: SAP Master Data Integration
packages.ShortText: Synchronize master data across your landscape.
packages.Description:
Use the generic replication API of Master Data Integration to keep a consistent view on master data by sending change requests and fetching change events.

Systems send change requests to inform Master Data Integration about local changes in a specific master data entity instance. Master Data Integration asynchronously processes the change request. If it does not reject the change request, Master Data Integration changes its own copy of the master data accordingly and provides a change event to connected systems, including the system that originally sent the change request.

Master Data Integration provides change events to inform systems about changes in the master data visible to the system. Which systems sees which change events is governed by the distribution model configured by the customer. To keep a consistent view on master data, systems should regularly poll for change events of relevant master data entity types in a background thread.

packages.DisplayName: Sales Quotation Expiry Assistant
packages.ShortText: This business content is a custom Joule agent for ‘Sales Quotation Expiry’ that fetches sales quotations nearing expiry from the SAP S/4HANA backend system.
packages.Description:
This process outlines how the Agent retrieves and presents sales quotations approaching their expiration date. When a user initiates a request—such as asking for “quotations expiring this week”—the Agent first interprets the intent and verifies whether a specific time period has been provided. If the duration is missing, the Agent prompts the user to supply the required timeframe to ensure an accurate query.

Upon receiving a valid duration, the Agent activates the Retrieve Expiring Quotations skill. As part of this execution, the skill invokes the Business User Details action to identify the logged in user and subsequently leverages the API_SALES_QUOTATION_SRV service to fetch relevant quotation data from the SAP S/4HANA backend. The system extracts all sales quotations associated with the user that are due to expire within the specified period.

The Agent then delivers the results in a structured, business friendly format, highlighting the most critical information for decision-making, including Quotation ID, Customer Name, Expiry Date, Net Value, and Status. This streamlined interaction enables users to quickly identify expiring quotations and take timely follow-up actions.

packages.ShortText: Supports target setting and bottom-up planning processes including P&L by Profit Center, P&L by Partner, balance sheet and balance sheet by partner planning
packages.Description:
Group Financial planning covers the following topics:

Overview
Group Financial Planning supports target setting and bottom-up planning processes including P&L by Profit Center, P&L by Partner, balance sheet and balance sheet by partner planning. In the end, a complete group reporting plan P&L and balance sheet are derived.

Group Financial Planning
This content provides profit and loss planning with revenues, costs, and expenses and balance sheet planning with assets, liabilities, and owner's equity both with the possibility to drill down on profit center and transaction type. Reporting stories provide insights into the financial statement data by functional area, transaction type, profit center and partner consolidation unit.

Data Connectivity
Group Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA is based on the SAP S/4HANA data model and fully integrated with it. Master data and transaction data from SAP S/4HANA can be loaded. The complete integration is part of the content delivery and is available out of the box.

packages.Description:
Use

This program is used to transfer Asset value within a Company Code. Here, we are automating the transfer of an Asset within a Company Code using transaction ABUMN.

Configuration

The input criteria and system information are contained in a configuration excel named as AssetTransferWithinCompanyCode_ABUMN(ECC).xlsx. This excel file contains the system details like the System ID, Client and whether Single Sign-On is enabled. It also contains the details necessary to create an Asset Value transfer within a Company Code. The username and password for the mentioned system are stored as variables in the Cloud Factory.

Key Process Flows

  • The bot reads input criteria from the excel template

  • Automate the transfer of an Asset within a Company Code using the input data

  • Write the created document number back into the excel template

Business Benefits

  • Reduce manual effort an employee can concentrate on the more important tasks

  • Ensure fast creation of the document

  • Eliminate the human error

packages.Description:

This package contains use case details for real-time asset health check via digital twin and end to end equipment maintenance planning & execution. It helps to understand how the different processes in disparate systems have been rewired using SAP Workflow Management for plant maintenance order execution, which reduces a lot of manual configuration and monitoring effort and speed up the in-house asset maintenance process with end-to-end performance visibility.

It integrates the following business transactions & approval requirements:

  • SAP S/4HANA: Automatic maintenance order creation, Order cost review and release Maintenance order.
  • SAP Business Technology Platform:  Microservices (UI Module, HANA Cloud, Node.js Module) for Digital Handover, Digital Twin Dashboard, Maintenance process execution related business logic for Workflow Management Service including business rules and process visibility.
  • SAP Predictive Asset Insights: Asset Model, Machine Learning Data set for automatic failure prediction.
  • SAP Internet of Things: Holds digital twin, asset monitoring parameters and its real time value, triggers workflow.
  • Workflow in SAP Workflow Management: Intelligent workflow for automatic Maintenance order execution process.
  • Business Rules in SAP Workflow Management: Holds the rule for Maintenance Order cost limit for additional approval and Asset parameter limits to initiate Maintenance Notification.
  • Process Visibility in SAP Workflow Management: Provide visibility to end-to-end business process.

Features:

Sender:

  • Consume Direct (non-persistent) messages using a Topic Subscription

  • Adapter-level message retry properties

Connection with advanced event mesh broker:

packages.DisplayName: Mass Upload of Payment Advices (48Q)
packages.ShortText: Extracts payment advice file attachments from emails and uploads the payment advice.
packages.Description:
Problem

An accounts receivable accountant frequently receives emails with unstructured payment advice files, which help to match invoices with payments. The accounts receivable accountant needs to download these files from the emails and upload the files individually to the system. The user must also check the files to ensure the format is correct and there is no missing information. If done manually, this process is repetitive, tedious, and time-consuming.

Solution

The bot automates the (1) extraction of payment advice files from emails, and (2) upload of these files to the system.

The bot first scans the inbox of the accounts receivable accountant for emails with specified keywords in the subject line and downloads the payment advice file attachments from the relevant emails. The bot then uploads these files to the Manage Payment Advices Fiori app. The bot works in tandem with the scope item 1MV (Cash Application Integration), which automates the extraction of payment advice details from PDF files into the system.

After execution, the bot sends specified recipients an Excel file containing payment advice numbers, statuses, and a notification to confirm payment advice.

Note

The scope item 1MV (Cash Application Integration) is required to be activated.

packages.DisplayName: SAP Troubleshooter Agent
packages.ShortText: SAP Troubleshooter Agent enables Basis admins, developers, and IT teams to diagnose and resolve SAP issues instantly via Joule, delivering expert-level root cause analysis with authoritative references and reducing MTTR.
packages.Description:
Problem Statement
SAP issues like ABAP dumps, Fiori errors, authorization failures, integration faults and cost hours of manual log analysis, SAP Notes searching, and expert escalation. SAP Troubleshooter Agent resolves this with one conversational query in Joule.

Solution

  • Eliminates manual log analysis across SM21, ST22, and SLG1 transactions
  • Removes time-consuming cross-referencing of SAP Notes and fragmented documentation
  • Reduces dependency on senior Basis or development experts for issue diagnosis
  • Lowers Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) for critical SAP system incidents

Business Value

  • Delivers expert-level root cause analysis and step-by-step remediation in seconds
  • Accelerates onboarding junior team members get senior-level guidance instantly
  • Ensure consistent, structured responses that mirror SAP support engineer output
  • Every answer includes 2–4 authoritative source links (SAP Help Portal, SAP Support Launchpad, SAP Community) for full transparency

Technical Highlights

  • Platform: Built on SAP Build Process Automation, deployed as a custom Joule Agent & Skill (sapTroubleshootSkill)
  • Integration: Connects to Tavily AI diagnostic engine via a CAP OData service on SAP BTP Cloud Foundry (/talkwithagent endpoint)
  • Connectivity: Configured via SAP BTP Destination (capservice) supporting No Authentication or OAuth2ClientCredentials
  • Interface: Delivered natively through SAP Joule so no separate UI or tooling required
    Coverage: Spans ABAP, S/4HANA, HANA, Fiori/Gateway, Basis, Security, PI/PO, CPI, BTP, and ECC environments
  • Response Format: Structured 4-section output - Problem Context, Root Cause Diagnosis, Remediation Steps, and Operational Considerations
  • Graceful Fallback: Provides most-probable SAP-based explanation when search data is insufficient and never fabricates technical details

packages.DisplayName: [DEPRECATED] Process Integration Pipeline - Generic Integration Flows and Templates
packages.ShortText: [DEPRECATED] This integration package has been deprecated and replaced by four new integration packages, see package overview.
packages.Description:
NOTE: This integration package has been deprecated and replaced by four new integration packages. The package has been split into the four new integration packages which allows you more flexibility in setting up your different pipelines, sender-specific IDoc and XI inbound flows, and receiver-specific outbound flows, if required.

The following four new integration packages replace this integration package:

  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Inbound
  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Pipelines
  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Outbound
  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Templates

If you've been using the previously provided package, switch to the new packages as soon as possible. To do so, perform the following steps:

  • Undeploy all generic flows from the deprecated package. In the new Cloud Integration packages, the name and IDs of the integration flows have the addition "v2". It's important that the old integration flows and the new integration flows must not be deployed together because they compete on reading from the same JMS queues.
  • Configure and deploy the required generic flows (depending on which pipeline you use, see Pipelines) provided by the new Cloud Integration pipeline packages.
  • If you've used scripts from the script collection in your scenario-specific flows, replace them with local scripts. You can find the local scripts in either the generic flows or the new templates. As long as you haven't replaced all scripts, it's still recommended to run the script collection. Once you're done, you can then also undeploy the script collection.

More details on the Pipeline for Cloud Integration can be found on the Migration Guide for SAP Process Orchestration.

packages.DisplayName: IBP Demand Planning Agent
packages.ShortText: The IBP Demand Planning Agent enables demand planners to verify sales history readiness through natural language interactions, ensuring accurate forecasts and faster planning decisions by automating data validation and team notifications.
packages.Description:
Problem Statement

Accurate demand forecasting in SAP IBP relies on complete and up to date historical sales data. Missing or outdated data leads to forecast errors, impacting production, procurement, and supply chain execution. Manual checks are time consuming and prone to oversight.

Key Capabilities

  • Validates availability and completeness of the latest sales history data
  • Notifies teams via automated email when data issues are detected
  • Reduces manual effort in forecast preparation

Business Value

  • Saves planner time by automating routine data validation
  • Accelerates demand planning and forecasting cycles
  • Reduces downstream supply chain disruptions caused by poor data quality

Technical Highlights

Integrations

  • SAP IBP via secure SAP BTP Destinations

Core Skills

  • getsaleshistory – Retrieves and validates sales history status
  • sendemail – Sends automated notifications to stakeholders

Architecture

  • SAP Joule Agent built using SAP Joule Studio
  • CAP-based backend service developed using SAP Build Code

Backend & Services

  • SAP BTP
  • CAP Service exposed through BPA endpoints

Security

  • Destination-based authentication for backend connectivity

Best Practices.

  • Design skills around clear planner intents (e.g., data validation, notifications) to ensure fast and accurate responses
  • Use secure SAP BTP Destinations for all backend connectivity to maintain data integrity and compliance. 
  • Monitor sales history validation regularly to catch data issues early and avoid downstream forecast inaccuracies

In addition, the integration package "e-Filing of Employees' Payments and Deductions for UK- FPS, EPS, EYU & EXB: XXXX-XX" must be deployed.
packages.Description:
This integration package is one of the two packages for reporting Employees' Payments and Deductions to HMRC for the United Kingdom. These two integration packages enable electronic communication with the government gateway via SAP Cloud Integration. Employers based in the United Kingdom (including UK subsidiaries of overseas organizations) must operate Pay As You Earn (PAYE) as part of their payroll. PAYE is the Her Majesty's Revenue & Customs (HMRC) system for collecting income tax and national insurance from employers. Every employer must electronically report the employees’ payments and deductions to HMRC on or before each payday, in real-time, for each payroll run.

This package consists of two integration flows that will not change annually unless there is a legal change announced by the government. The integration flows are:

  • Data Provisioning Service (DPS) – Retrieval of Tax Code and Student Loan notification from HMRC. (NB General Notifications are not supported)
  • Polling


In addition to this package, you must also deploy all the integration flows of package e-Filing of Employees' Payments and Deductions for UK - FPS, EPS, EYU & EXB: XXXX-XX for the e-Filing of Employees' Payments and Deductions for the United Kingdom to work.

Business Benefits

Reduction in procurement cost and non-compliant procurement attributed to improved tracking, governance and auditability.

packages.DisplayName: Mass Maintenance Of Billing Blocks In Sales Orders
packages.ShortText: Fetches sales orders and updates billing blocks from a template file into SAP S/4HANA Cloud
packages.Description:
This template automates the fetching of sales orders and update on sales order billing blocks in SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

As billing blocks need to be updated or deleted ad-hoc, on-demand, it is less time-consuming for a sales representative to complete and upload an excel template with the necessary data using a bot, instead of performing it individually for each sales order in SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

The following steps are included as a part of Mass Maintenance of Billing Blocks In Sales Orders template:

Fetch operation: A pre-defined excel template file is populated with fetched sales order & billing block records based on the selection screen input populated by the sales representative.

The sales representative must manually update billing blocks in this file and move it to the ToBeProcessed folder.

Update operation: A task automation to update sales order billing blocks in SAP S/4HANA Cloud (after optional approval) runs in a predefined scheduled manner, in an unattended mode. This automation fetches the file(s) from the ToBeProcessed folder, groups sales orders with their items and sends them for (optional) approvals. upon completion of the task, the sales order and its items are updated in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system

The template uses the API_SALES_ORDER_SRV API for read and update operations.

The template can also work in collaboration with the Business Document Extraction from Email (70U) bot available in the SAP Build Store.

packages.DisplayName: Proof of Delivery Note Upload in the Outbound Delivery and the Invoice (2S1)
packages.ShortText: This bot is an SAP Business One offering. This bot picks up the ‘Proof of Delivery’ documents from a local folder and uploads the documents to SAP Business One system, as an attachment to the Outbound Delivery and the related Invoice.
packages.Description:
Problem statement

A proof of delivery (POD) note is an acknowledgment from customers that goods or services have been received or completed, and that the customer can be billed for the goods or services. Typically, an electronic POD is sent to the company as a scan through e-mail. Business users need to download the PODs and manually upload them to each outbound delivery or invoice in SAP Business One. This manual process takes a significant amount of time and can be prone to errors.

Solution

The Proof of Delivery Note Upload in the Outbound Delivery and the Invoice (2S1) bot sends a POD file to the Document Information Extraction service (SAP AI Business Services) to scan it and identify the delivery note number. Based on this information, the bot connects to SAP Business One using the Open Data Protocol and uploads the file to the relevant delivery note. If a linked invoice is also identified, the bot replicates the POD to the invoice as well.

Business Benefits

  • Reduces repetitive tasks

  • Reduces the risk of manual errors

  • Improves work efficiency

Further Extensions

This bot can be used as a stand-alone bot or it can work with the Business Document Extraction from E-mail bot, which downloads files from e-mails and places them in an automatically created folder structure. In this scenario, the Proof of Delivery Note Upload in the Outbound Delivery and the Invoice bot works in the second part in the end-to-end automation process.

The above mentioned Business Document Extraction from E-mail bot is also available in the Store.

packages.DisplayName: Streamlined Custom Table Maintenance
packages.ShortText: Simplifying SAP Custom Table Maintenance — Efficiency at Your Fingertips.
packages.Description:
Business Challenge

Our solution, running on SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), streamlines SAP custom table maintenance by enabling business and external users to manage data without requiring full system access. With granular privilege control, users can only modify data they’re authorized to, ensuring security and compliance. Ideal for SAP BW and custom tables, our platform reduces errors, boosts efficiency, and integrates seamlessly into your existing SAP environment — all while leveraging the power and scalability of BTP.

Value Story

The application is based on an ABAP back end deployed in an SAP BW/4HANA system and offers odata services to connect to the front end. The app is a kind of framework that makes it possible to manage data in tables as desired. With granular privilege control (SAP Standard Authorization objects), users can only modify data they're authorized to, ensuring security and compliance. Ideal for SAP BW and custom tables, our platform reduces errors, boosts efficiency, and integrates seamlessly into your existing SAP environment — all while leveraging the power and scalability of BTP for optimal performance. By implementing a locking concept, we ensure the consistency of table maintenance. The app can be customized through SAP Business Application Studio or SAP Build Code and is deployed to the SAP Build Workzone and Cloud Foundry. With our expertise, we can adjust this basic application to customers’ needs and can extend this solution to an entire CAP application that can manage SAP Datasphere tables.

Business Benefits
  • Improved user experience with enhanced search results
  • Lower implementation and maintenance costs
  • Reduced issues with file format settings
  • Decreased IT involvement

packages.DisplayName: b+ dgtal Observability for SAP Integration Suite
packages.ShortText: b+ dgtal Observability extends SAP Integration Suite adding extra functionalities such as automatic and central monitoring. It provides a global vision of the status of all the integrations scenarios via custom dashboards in ELK or Splunk.
packages.Description:
In the business digital environment, the proper functioning of integration scenarios between systems is fundamental for business continuity. However, the necessary tasks of reviewing the operation of integration platforms, as well as reporting and correcting errors, involve manual tasks that do not add adequate value to organizations.

Furthermore, generally, this effort is proportional to the number of integration platforms that exist and the number of integration scenarios implemented on these platforms, so 'the more integrations there are, the more effort is required,' especially for IT departments that have limited resources to perform this task correctly.

Avvale b+dgtal SAP Integration Suite Observability is a tool designed to automate the monitoring tasks of SAP integration platforms, both for its Cloud version (SAP Integration Suite) and its onPremise version (SAP PO).

This solution retrieves information from integrators and generates 100% exploitable and indexed information through observability tools, such as ELK (Elastic Search Kibana) or Splunk, maintaining a linear effort in platform operation. Each of the newly deployed integration scenarios is automatically incorporated into the monitoring process performed with these tools.

 

Main Features

  • Centralization of the monitoring of integration scenarios regardless of the number of SAP Integration Platforms, both Cloud (SAP Integration Suite: Messages, Artifacts, and Certificates) and On-Premise (SAP PO: Messages, Channels, Jobs, BPMs, and certificates), providing a global view of the status and simplifying maintenance tasks.

 

  • Integrates the status of integration scenarios into observability platforms (such as ELK, Splunk, ...) through a predefined set of ready-to-use dashboards.

 

  • Contains historical data of the operation on integration scenarios that allow IT managers to define and measure KPIs, to evaluate the service provided to business areas using integration platforms, as well as monetize or distribute the cost of their usage.

 

  • Adds monitoring functionalities not included as standard in SAP integration platforms, such as the validation control of communication certificates.

 

  • Based on the functionalities of observability platforms (ELK, Splunk), it allows automation for sending alerts and status reports of SAP Integration Suite and SAP PO integration platforms.

 

Benefits

All benefits stem from the automation of monitoring tasks:

  • Maintenance of the operating cost of integration platforms as the deployed integration scenarios grow on them.

 

  • Early detection of errors and assistance in decision-making for platform improvement based on useful extracted information, thereby improving IT departments' KPIs/SLAs.

 

  • The availability of historical data allows measuring the evolution of the quality of integration service offered by IT departments.

packages.DisplayName: SuccessFactors Talent Intelligence Hub Growth Portfolio Import Template
packages.ShortText: Leverage the standard integration template to seamlessly transfer Growth Portfolio data, including attributes and associated ratings, into SAP SuccessFactors' Talent Intelligence Hub.
packages.Description:
Description

Standard integration templates can be used to import data into Talent Intelligence Hub Growth Portfolio of SAP SuccessFactors. You can import attributes and associated proficiency levels for individuals using the Growth Portfolio import template.

 

Target Deployment Platform

SAP SuccessFactors Integration Center

 

About the Template

Integration Center Definition file is provided in the Artifacts tab. Sample import file representing the file format is provided in the Documents tab for reference.

The import file contains the fields mentioned below.

  • Attribute external Id- External ID of the attribute. (Mandatory)
  • Person external Id- External ID of the person.  (Mandatory)
  • Person Identifier Type- Currently supports type maintained as EXTERNAL_ID (Mandatory)
  • Proficiency Level - Proficiency level of the person for a particular attribute.
  • Status- Allowed values are I and A.  I for Inactive, A for Active. If marked I, then the attribute will not be visible on the portfolio. (Mandatory)
  • Preference Value - Allowed values are 0 or 1. 1 implies that the person is passionate or highly interested about the attribute. (Mandatory)
  • Proficiency Assigned Date - Proficiency Assigned Date is in the format YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00.000Z. This field indicates the date when the proficiency level for the attribute was assigned. In majority of the cases, this will be the system date, corresponding to the time displayed on the latest timeline card in the Growth Portfolio user interface.  (Mandatory).

 

How to consume this template

  • Please download the integration definition files from the Artifacts tab and upload them to SuccessFactors Integration Center. Also refer to Importing Integrations from the Integration Catalog.
  • Sample import file is provided to represent the file format in the Documents tab. Use the file format and maintain the actual data for import.
  • Configure the SFTP target settings and maintain the import file name and folder.
  • Maintain the import file with relevant data for import in the SFTP folder mentioned above.
  • Schedule the integration to run.

Special considerations

  • There is no support to purge or delete existing Growth Portfolio data. 
  • There is no support to import Historical data into the Growth Portfolio. Only the latest proficiency ratings can be imported.
  • Person Identifier Type in the import file should be maintained as "EXTERNAL_ID"

packages.DisplayName: B2B Integration Factory - Purchase-to-Pay B2B Scenario
packages.ShortText: Pre-built content for SAP Integration Suite's B2B capabilities Trading Partner Management & Integration Advisor, covering the Purchase-to-Pay B2B scenario with the choreography of message exchange between SAP S/4HANA On-Premise IDOC & SOAP messages.
packages.Description:
Business Challenge

When using SAP Integration Suite's B2B capabilities, the creation of a Trading Partner Agreement (TPA) for a Purchase-to-Pay B2B scenario, where the business partner uses SOAP and the internally supported format is SAP IDoc, requires functional experts with domain knowledge, integration experts to create and enable these TPAs, and above all, it requires time and efforts for implementation. Very often, neither the required knowledge nor the time is available. 

 

Value Story 

The B2B Integration Factory creates this content of B2B scenarios as pre-packaged content in the form of trading partner agreements and the corresponding message implementation and mapping guidelines and makes them available accordingly. This B2B scenario now describes the electronic data exchange of the first set of relevant Purchase-to-Pay business data, such as

  • Purchase Order Request (Outbound): SAP IDOC ORDERS.ORDERS05 > SAP SOAP OrderRequest
  • Purchase Order Response (Inbound): SAP SOAP OrderConfirmationRequest > SAP IDOC ORDRSP.ORDERS05
  • Delivery Notification (Inbound): SAP SOAP DeliveryRequest > SAP IDOC DESADV.DELVRY07
  • Invoice (Inbound). SAP SOAP InvoiceRequest > SAP IDOC INVOIC.INVOIC02

As you can see, in this B2B scenario, the enterprise message types are based on SAP IDOC, and the trading partner-related message types are based on SAP SOAP. For all corresponding message types, the required Message Implementation Guidelines (MIGs) and the Mapping Guidelines (MAGs) are already available. Significantly, the Mapping Guidelines already contain the needed mapping elements between the corresponding nodes as required at a functional level. 

The included MIGs (Message Implementation Guidelines), MAGs (Message Application Guidelines), and TPAs (Trading Partner Agreements) are provided solely as examples to guide users. They can be customised according to specific customer requirements. For the TPAs, this package includes one example TPA per message type as a reference.

 

Business Benefits 

As a user of the SAP Integration Suite's B2B capabilities, you can download the zip files of the design-time artefacts (TPA, MIGs and MAGs) provided on GitHub for your Purchase-to-Pay B2B scenario and import them directly into the Trading Partner Management and Integration Advisor systems of your SAP Integration Suite tenant. This not only saves you a lot of time, but also provides you with high-quality artefacts securing a high level of consistency based on standard conventions and rules. Instead of creating everything from scratch, simply use the B2B scenario and its associated guidelines and adapt them to your trading partners' and your own specific requirements, configure the communication channels, activate the TPAs, test, and finally go live with your trading partners.

packages.DisplayName: List of Purchase Requisitions (ECC) – ME5A
packages.ShortText: Automate the list of Purchase Requisitions for a given criteria and download it as an excel file
packages.Description:
Use

This program lists Purchase Requisitions according to several selection criteria e.g. material, plant etc. This package is built via Cloud Studio to automate the download of the list of Purchase Requisitions according to given input data.

Configuration

The input criteria and system information are maintained in a configuration excel named as DynamicTemplate_ME5A.xlsx. The configuration excel available within the package should be downloaded and maintained in the given InputPath environment variable.

This excel file contains two sheets;

• The first sheet contains the system details like the System ID, Client and whether Single Sign-On is enabled. It also contains the Variant name for the program and the output path of the excel file to be downloaded.

• The username and password for the target ECC system is maintained in the Cloud Factory.

• The file type of the output file to be downloaded is maintained in “Output File Type” row. It is available in the field “Select from all available formats” in Select Spreadsheet popup window in the target system. Some examples of the file-type include “Excel (in Office 2007 XLSX Format)” or “Excel-Office open XML Format (XLSX)” etc.

• The second sheet contains input data for the program in the form of parameter and its corresponding value along with a description for the parameter.

Business Benefits

• Freeing up end user to refocus on high-value tasks

• Simplify the process of getting list of Purchase Requisitions

• Automate the repetitive tasks by maximizing productivity

Key Process Flows

• The bot reads input criteria from the excel template

• Automate the Purchase Requisitions list according to defined input criteria

• Download the list as an excel file

packages.DisplayName: Account Payable Automation – Gate to Pay
packages.ShortText: Customer's Account Payable processes faced challenges in terms of data inflow points, manual handling of thousands of invoices daily, delays in the Material Invoice Receipt
packages.Description:
Business Challenge

The customer was looking to improve productivity procurement through the automation of manual, repetitive tasks as part of digital transformation.

  • Preparation of vendor invoice templates and it's scanning as per pre-defined rules for extracting the data for automation.
  • BOT to create gate entry goods receipt, printing of digital stamp, automated document saved in SAP DMS repository, account payable transactions like credit invoice parking and posting.
  • BOT to send and receive mail for credit note for supplier.
  • Deploying bar-Code based digital stamp to automate store processes like Docking, Undocking and Material Receipt.
  • Eliminating manual intervention by automating the custom transactions.

Value Story

Customer's Account Payable (AP) processes faced challenges in terms of data inflow points, manual handling of thousands of invoices daily, delays in the Material Invoice Receipt Order (MIRO) parking, and the need for a streamlined approach to invoice data publishing for settlements.

The implementation of intelligent bots with SBPA resulted in:

  • Smart and automated AP process
  • Improved efficiency
  • Reduced manual efforts
  • Enhanced accuracy in data entry
  • Streamlined communication with vendors and stakeholders
  • Standardized and consistent approach
  • More efficient and reliable AP workflow

Business Benefits

  • Eliminated discrepancies 80% quicker and efficiently as compared to manual processes.
  • Streamlined AP processes by removing redundant paths, which improves performance, and incurs substantial cost savings by 50%.
  • 95% automated verification of incoming documents which helps in process-driven decision making.
  • 100% digitization of end-to-end processes leading to quickening of strategical & technological advancement resulting in efficient resource reallocation.
  • Reduced the enterprise's carbon footprint by 90% by digitizing and automating previously paper based manual tasks.

Solution Overview:

  • The solution is built with SAP Build Process Automation and the default OCR/DOX service is bundled with it.
  • For Goods Receipt attended BOTs are deployed which is triggered by the operator once the scanning of invoice is complete.
  • Information is extracted from the OCR and punched into S/4 system using UI automation.
  • The BOT prints digital stamp for the invoice and uploads invoice to SAP DMS.
  • The Information stored during GRN is further used in AP verification.

  • share company’s own data while onboarding to Catena-X network and later if there are any changes
  • curate and enrich customer and supplier data, even if these business partners are not members of the Catena-X network (consent required)

Both use cases aim to improve data quality for business partner data in the network and in the enterprise.

BPDM as a business case in Catena-X is explained here.

This integration package establishes a bi-directional connection between MDG and the BPDM. It uses two capabilities of the SAP Integration Suite, which act as middleware component: Cloud Integration transforms and routes the business partner messages, Data Space Integration (Beta) establishes the secure, and self-sovereign data exchange by automatically negotiating upload and download contracts.

Note that (despite the high version number) the Catena-X BPDM APIs that this integration package uses are still in an experimental beta stage. This is why this package is marked as beta, too.

packages.DisplayName: Process Integration Pipeline Extension - Restart via Data Store
packages.ShortText: Implementation of extension to the Process Integration Pipeline to enable custom error handling with retries from the Data Store as a reprocessing layer
packages.Description:
The package consists of five Integration Flows and one central Script Collection:

  • Pipeline DS Retry - Custom Error Handling with Data Stores. This Integration Flow implements Custom Error Handling for exceptions occurring in the generic steps of the Process Integration Pipeline. It leverages the public Pipeline extension exit, as described in the Custom Exception Handling documentation. Its primary function is to determine whether retries should continue through the JMS persistence layer or, if all configured JMS retries are exhausted, to move the message out of the queue into the Data Store while capturing all necessary restart attributes and forming the Data Store entry body.
  • Pipeline DS Retry - Restart Executor from Data Store to JMS. This Integration Flow handles message reprocessing by moving messages from the Data Store back to the source JMS processing queue, allowing the JMS layer to manage the actual retry process. It is triggered via Process Direct and requires XML input specifying the source Data Store, maximum retry count, and the retry subject – either a list of Data Store entry names or an Interface PID for dynamically retrying all associated Data Store entries.
  • Pipeline DS Retry - Template - Restart Job. This Integration Flow represents a Restart Job that automatically reprocesses messages from the Data Store based on assigned restart configuration profiles. Execution is scheduled using a Start Timer event. Provided as a template, this Integration Flow allows for the creation of multiple customized copies in a custom package, with different Job Profiles maintained in the Partner Directory.
  • Pipeline API - Data Store Manage Retries (Optional). This Integration Flow enables on-demand restart operations via API clients like Postman. It exposes an HTTP endpoint to trigger restarts for specified Data Store entries or based on selection criteria. Additional operations allow users to retrieve a list of Data Stores in the tenant, fetch entries from a specific Data Store, and move entries between Data Stores (e.g., transferring entries from the “Retry” Data Store to the “NoRetry” Data Store to prevent automatic retriggering).
  • Pipeline API - Data Store Manage Entries (Optional). This Integration Flow provides API-based management of Data Store entries, separate from the "Manage Retries" API, to enforce role-based access. It allows users to read messages from a selected Data Store, delete messages (individually or based on query conditions), and add messages to the Data Store (this capability can be disabled at the Integration Flow level).

More details on the PI pipeline concept can be found on the Migration Guide for SAP Process Orchestration.

packages.DisplayName: PDF SDK
packages.ShortText: The SAPUI5 PDF package is a collection of activities allowing you to create automations using PDF.
packages.Description:
The PDF SDK package is composed of activities for extracting information from PDF documents.

The library is structured in different groups of activities called modules.

The PDF Core module for instance contains mandatory activities to work on PDF documents (open, close). It also groups a set of “Get” activities to retrieve specified information from PDF documents.

Other modules contain various activities:

  • more complex activities to search and retrieve specified information
  • activities to create filters and work on specific parts of a PDF document
  • dedicated activities for PDF invoices

In addition to the modules, the PDF SDK package also contains two predefined data types that apply to PDF documents. A data type is an artifact describing a data structure that can be used as an input or output parameter in your automations.

packages.DisplayName: SAP Feature Flags Service
packages.ShortText: Dynamically distribute, tune and rollout features among application consumers.
packages.Description:
The SAP Feature Flags service allows enabling or disabling new features without redeploying or restarting the application. The service implements a common agile development concept that allows:
- delivery of latent code
- synchronized rollout of features that require changes in several different components or microservices
- fast rollback of features.
The concept of having a central synchronization point for releasing microservice-based features is common for cloud development best practices. The need comes from the fact that some business functionalities require development in several microservices that run in separate containers and need to be released in a synchronized way.
The SAP Feature Flags service offers a dedicated dashboard for managing individual flags. Every SAP Feature Flags service instance is displayed separately in the dashboard. Once you create a service instance in a space of your Cloud Foundry environment in the Actions section of the service instance, you will find the Open Dashboard button for accessing the Feature Flags dashboard for that service instance.
To be able to switch on and off functional parts of your application, you need to wrap the respective source code in a toggle point (for example, an if-else statement) related to a particular feature flag. In the toggle point you access the service instance using the environment variables generated for your application and specify the feature flag name. Depending on the evaluation result of the feature flag (active, or inactive), your application serves the functionality in this specific toggle point.

packages.Description:
This process outlines how the Agent retrieves and presents open sales orders for the logged-in user from the SAP S/4HANA, public cloud edition system. When a user initiates a request—such as asking for “my open sales orders” or “open sales orders for a speciifc customer ”—the Agent first interprets the intent and verifies whether the required customer information has been provided. If the customer details are missing, the Agent prompts the user to provide the customer name or ID to ensure an accurate query.

Upon receiving the required input, the Agent activates the Retrieve Open Sales Orders skill. As part of this execution, the skill invokes the Business User Details action to identify the logged-in user and subsequently leverages the relevant SAP S/4HANA service or API to fetch sales order data. The solution leverages SAP Build Process Automation for agent and skill configuration, SAP Cloud Integration for backend connectivity and logic handling, and SAP SuccessFactors as the data source. packages.DisplayName: Automated Release of Supplier Invoice upon Customer Payment (6PA)
packages.ShortText: Automatically removes the payment block of the relevant vendor invoice upon receipt of full payment for the related customer invoice.
packages.Description:
Problem:

A company sometimes enters into contractual agreements with its suppliers (or subcontractors) where the terms of payment in a project depend on when the company actually receives the payment from the customer to whom the services or goods are delivered. This payment clause is sometimes referred to as "Pay when Paid (PWP)" or "Pay if Paid (PIP)".

This kind of agreement requires matching of supplier invoices with the related customer invoices, tracking of customer payments received, and subsequent release of the related supplier invoices. This task can be very time-consuming and error-prone if done manually.

Solution:

The bot automatically unblocks a supplier invoice so it can be processed for payment when full payment is received for the corresponding customer invoice. The bot performs the following actions:

  • Matches the supplier invoices with the related customer invoices;

  • Tracks the receipt of full payments received from customers;

  • Removes the payment block of the corresponding supplier invoice that was matched with the fully paid customer invoice.

The bot is limited to the following scope:

  • Project Type : Customer Projects

  • Billing Type: Time and Expense

Users can define some exceptions by using the Excel template downloaded from the bot store.

  • If the column "Release This Supplier Invoice" is marked as "Y", the payment block on the supplier invoice will be removed, even if customer payment is not received.

  • If the column "Release This Supplier Invoice" is marked as "N", the payment block on the supplier invoice will not be removed, even if full customer payment is received.

The following scope items must be activated:

  • Customer Project Man-agreement - Project-Based Services (J11)

  • Service and Material Pro-curement - Project-Based Services (J13)

  • Sales Order Processing - Project-Based Services (J14)

  • Project Billing - Project-Based Services (4E9)

Prerequisite process steps for running this bot:

  • Optional: Purchase Order

  • Mandatory: Supplier Invoice with Block, Customer Project, Project Billing Request, Billing Document Request, Customer Invoice, AR Payment

  • Optional: Preliminary Billing Document

For better process automation for various data points, it is recommended to have following configurations in place:

  • Specific payment term for PWP supplier

  • Specific invoice type of PWP supplier

packages.DisplayName: Integrated Financial Planning
packages.ShortText: Supports holistic financial planning, encompassing cost centers, product costs, sales & profitability, capital expenses, P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow.
packages.Description:
Integrated Financial Planning covers the following topics:

Overview
Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA supports the integrated financial planning process including cost center, product cost, sales & profitability, capital expense, P&L, balance sheet and cash flow planning. The different planning areas seamlessly play together, e.g. operating expense planning provides the activity cost rates for product cost planning and product cost planning provides the product cost rates for the COGS calculation within profitability planning. In the end a complete plan P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement are derived. Greenhouse gas emission planning extends integrated financial planning by the carbon dimension. It evaluates the financial plan with carbon emission factors and calculates the future carbon footprints of the organization.

Process Support
In addition to the core planning functionality Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA also supports planning introduction, preparation and execution. The E2E sample process story provides an overview of the planning content and its interdependencies. Automated planning helps to prepare a consistent plan proposal based on planning assumptions and driver settings. After planning has been finished the simulation cockpit allows stakeholders in management or a central controlling department to perform what-if simulations for sample processes based on changes to drivers, such as sales quantity, raw material prices or personnel expenses.

Data Connectivity
Integrated Financial Planning for SAP S/4HANA is based on the SAP S/4HANA data model in FI-CO and fully integrated with it.

It is based on a business model in which customer demand drives production, and products are later sold and delivered from inventory. 
This solution variant comprises a modular set of solutions for a cloud deployment, i.e. SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition seamlessly integrated with other SAP public cloud and business network solutions.

Important IP-relevant Note

Some of the Business Processes use Business Activities by the APQC Cross-industry Process Classification Framework (“PCF”), or Business Activities derived from APQC Cross-Industry PCF. The APQC Process Classification Framework® (“PCF”) is an open standard developed by APQC, a nonprofit that promotes benchmarking and best practices worldwide. The PCF is intended to facilitate organizational improvement through process management and benchmarking, regardless of industry, size, or geography. To download the full PCF or industry-specific versions of the PCF, as well as associated measures and benchmarking, please visit http://www.apqc.org/pcf

packages.DisplayName: Mass Maintenance of Business Partners (58Z)
packages.ShortText: Enables mass creation of business partners (customers and vendors) based on an Excel input template.  The automation also enables data extraction of business partner master data details to facilitate data quality review.
packages.Description:
Problem

Oftentimes, customers, vendors, and users within the company send emails to request for new business partner records to be created into SAP S/4HANA Cloud system.

The task to create new master records into the system is often manual, time-consuming, and prone to error. This results in process inefficiencies, delays, and data inconsistencies that can impact other business process areas like procurement and sales.

Solution

The automation performs mass creation of business partner records into the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system. It also automates business partner data retrieval to facilitate data quality checks and to identify missing and/or erroneous data.

The automation monitors incoming emails by scanning the Inbox based on a Subject keyword. It then extracts the email file attachment (completed input template) and saves in a specified folder.

The automation then processes each completed input template saved in the specified folder. It performs basic data checks on the file and correspondingly creates/retrieves the business partner master data if there are no data issues.

After the task is complete, the automation sends an email to the user with the output status.

Note

Activate the following scope items in SAP S/4HANA Cloud, public edition:

- Create Customer master (BND)

- Create Supplier Master (BNE)+C2

packages.DisplayName: Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Pipelines
packages.ShortText: This integration package contains the main generic integration flows required to setup a Process Integration pipeline on Cloud Integration.
packages.Description:
This integration package is part of a set of integration packages required to setup a Process Integration (PI) pipeline on Cloud Integration for asynchronous and synchronous message processing. The pipeline for Cloud Integration can be seen as a sort of framework providing exactly once delivery, error handling and restart capabilities out of the box.

The new Cloud Integration Pipeline integration packages replace the "Process Integration Pipeline - Generic Integration Flows and Templates" package which has been split up into the following packages to be more flexible in setting up your different pipelines, sender-specific IDoc and XI inbound flows, and receiver-specific outbound flows:

  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Inbound containing generic IDoc and XI inbound flows:
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for Idoc
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for XI
  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Pipelines (this very package) containing the main pipeline steps:
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Integrated Messaging Runtime Async
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Integrated Messaging Runtime Sync
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Inbound Processing
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step04 - Receiver Determination
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step05 - Interface Determination
  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Generic Outbound containing the outbound processing flows:
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step06 - Outbound Processing
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for Idoc
    • Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for XI
  • Cloud Integration Pipeline - Templates containing all templates for setting up scenario-specific flows incl. templates for custom extensions as well as the script collection Pipeline v2 - Script Collection.s.

For setting up the integrated messaging runtime for asynchronous communication (recommended option for asynchronous communication), you need to deploy the following generic integration flows:

  • (Optionally, if you like to use a single entry point for IDoc messages) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for Idoc
  • (Optionally, if you like to use a single entry point for XI messages) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for XI
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Integrated Messaging Runtime Async
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step06 - Outbound Processing
  • (Optionally, if you like to send out IDoc messages) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for Idoc
  • (Optionally, if you like to send out XI messages) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for XI
  • (Optionally, if you like to leverage the provided templates) Pipeline v2 - Script Collection

For setting up the integrated messaging runtime for synchronous content-based-router scenarios, you need to deploy the following generic integration flows:

  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for XI
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Integrated Messaging Runtime Sync
  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for XI
  • (Optionally, if you like to leverage the provided templates) Pipeline v2 - Script Collection

For setting up the fully decoupled pipeline for asynchronous communication, you need to deploy the following integration flows:

  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for Idoc
  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step01 - Inbound Processing for XI
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step02 - Inbound Processing
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step04 - Receiver Determination
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step05 - Interface Determination
  • Pipeline v2 Generic Step06 - Outbound Processing
  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for Idoc
  • (Optionally) Pipeline v2 Generic Step08 - Outbound Processing for XI
  • (Optionally, if you like to leverage the provided templates) Pipeline v2 - Script Collection

The following features are supported:

  • Support for most commonly used Enterprise Integration Patterns such as Point-to-Point, Content-Based-Router, Recipient List, etc.
  • Asynchronous pipeline for asynchronous message processing with decoupling of pipeline steps via limited number of JMS queues
  • Synchronous pipeline for synchronous Content-Based-Router scenarios
  • Generic inbound flows for XI inbound and IDoc inbound scenarios
  • Generic outbound flows for XI outbound and IDoc outbound scenarios
  • Flexible scenario configuration via Partner Directory
  • Retry and error handling capabilities incl. dead letter queue handling
  • Improved monitoring by supporting SAP headers and custom header properties
  • Extension for custom error handling
  • Extension for custom receiver and interface determination
  • Extension for custom exit
  • Option to reuse extended receiver determination mappings from SAP Process Orchestration
  • Support for test mode
  • Supporting different tenant stages, e.g., DEV, QA, PRD

More details on the PI pipeline concept can be found on the Migration Guide for SAP Process Orchestration.

packages.DisplayName: SAP SuccessFactors Integration with the BMC Remedy

packages.Description:
The BMC Remedy ITSM (IT Service Management) is a service management tool that automates the ITIL (IT Infrastructure Library) process in the modern era.

Employees can modify their details at any time in SAP SuccessFactors. This integration flow then fetches the updated or modified employee data from SAP SuccessFactors and updates it in the BMC Remedy System.

Typical Process Steps: 
• Employee modifies details at any time in SAP SuccessFactors.
• SAP Cloud Integration fetches the modified data by calling the SuccessFactors API based on the last run of the integration flow, date or time, and location. For example, fetching data of employees who belong to the ‘Head office’ location. 
• The fetched records are organized based on user ID. 
• SAP Cloud Integration splits each employee record and concatenates the first and last name of the employee into one field.
• Integration Flow adds the authentication details in the header to access the BMC Remedy system and posts the data into the target system. 
• The last step is reading the date or time of the integration flow after a successful run and writing it into the variables to compare employee modification time for the next run.

  • Improved Efficiency on both HR and IT teams in automating manual housekeeping.

packages.DisplayName: SuccessFactors Talent Intelligence Hub Library Import Templates
packages.ShortText: Streamline Talent Intelligence Hub setup through standardized import processes for attributes, tags, and behaviors.
packages.Description:
Description

Standard integration templates can be used to import data into Talent Intelligence Hub of SAP SuccessFactors. This package provides Import templates for Attributes, Tags, Behaviors, Attribute and Tag Mapping, Attribute and Behavior Mapping, Attribute Proficiency Level Description.

Target Deployment Platform

SAP SuccessFactors Integration Center

About the Templates

The templates in this package can be used to import data into Talent Intelligence Hub Library Entities listed below. Integration Definition files are provided in the Artifacts tab. Sample import files representing the file formats are provided in the Documents tab for reference.

 

1H 2026 release updates:

A) Attributes import - Use Latest ICD File - Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Import. It now includes a new Source field. You may leave the source name blank (blank will consider WSM as the default source) or provide a specific source name from Manage Data Sources. 

B) Standardization import - Use Latest ICD File - Skills Standardization Import. We’ve streamlined the Standardization Import! You can now reuse your exported files as import templates without needing to reformat the data.

 

Refer the respective sections below for more detailed information.

1. Attributes

Attributes in Talent Intelligence Hub are characteristics that define the area of interest or growth opportunities. Skills and Competencies are the predefined attribute types supported in Talent Intelligence Hub. You can also create a custom attribute type and define attributes within the custom attribute type. 

 

There are 2 templates provided for import.

1.1 Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Import: Import basic data such as external code, name, and description in a default language. 

1H 2026 Updates: Use Latest ICD File - Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Import

The new import file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • default Locale - Locale in which this attribute is created.
    • external ID - External ID of the attribute
    • name - Name of the attribute
    • description - Description of the attribute
    • type - External ID of the attribute type such Skill/Competency
    • status - Allowed values are I and A.  I for (Inactive); A for Active
    • source - Allowed values are blank (internally it is considered as default WSM) and additional registered sources from Manage Data sources which is optional only if you have registered any skills partner. 

To import, use the Integration Center Definition file "Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Import" in the Artifacts tab with the "Sample Attribute Import" file in Documents tab.

1.2 Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Text Import: Import the attributes in multiple languages available in your instance. The Import file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • external ID - External ID of the attribute
    • locale - Locale for maintaining the attribute translation.
    • name - Name of the attribute in the locale
    • description - Description of the attribute in the locale

To import, use the Integration Center Definition file "Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Text Import" in the Artifacts tab with the "Sample Attribute Text Import" file in Documents tab.

2. Tags

Tags are keywords that can be used for labeling different attributes. Organizations can define tags that can be associated with attributes. Core, critical, and trending are the predefined tags in Talent Intelligence Hub.

There are 2 templates provided.

2.1 Talent Intelligence Hub Tag Import: Import basic data such as external code, name, and description in a default language. The Import file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • external ID - External ID of the attribute
    • default Locale - Locale in which this attribute is created.
    • status - Allowed value I and A.  I for (Inactive); A for Active
    • tag Value - Name of the Tag
    • tag Description - Description of the Tag. If it contains text such ', then enclose it within double quotes - "Tag's Description".

To import, use Integration Center Definition file "Talent Intelligence Hub Tag Import" in the Artifacts tab with the "Sample Tag Import" file in Documents tab.

2.2 Talent Intelligence Hub Tag Text Import: Import the Tags in multiple languages available in your instance. Import file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • external ID - External code of the tag
    • locale - Locale of tag translation
    • tag Value - Name of the Tag
    • tag Description - Description of the Tag. If it contains text such ', etc. then enclose it within double quotes - "Tag's Description".

To import, use the Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Tag Text Import" in the Artifacts tab with the "Sample Tag Text Import" file in documents tab.

3. Behaviors

Behaviors are a set of characteristics that help to measure an attribute of type competency. Behaviors help to assess if an individual possesses qualities that are required by employers and also used as benchmarks.

There are 2 import templates provided.

3.1 Talent Intelligence Hub Behavior Import: Import basic data such as external code, name, description in a default language. Import file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • external ID - External code of the behavior
    • default Locale - Locale of behavior translation
    • attribute Name- Name of the behavior.
    • attribute Description - Description of the behavior. If it contains text such ', etc. then enclose it within double quotes. Example: "behavior's Description".
    • attribute Status - status of the behavior. Allowed values are I for Inactive, A for Active

To import, use the Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Behavior Import" in the Artifacts tab with the "Sample Behavior Import" file in documents tab.

3.2 Talent Intelligence Hub Behavior Text Import: Import the behaviors in multiple languages available in your instance. Import file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • external ID - External code of the behavior
    • default Locale - Locale of behavior translation
    • attribute Name - Name of the behavior.
    • attribute Description - Description of the behavior

To import, use Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Behavior Text Import" in the Artifacts tab with the "Sample Behavior Text Import" file in documents tab.

4. Attribute and Behavior Mapping

Attributes of type Competency can be associated with behaviors. A behavior can only be associated with one competency. There is 1 template provided to import this mapping.

4.1 Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Behavior Mapping Import: Associate attributes with one or more behaviors using this import template. The Import file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • attribute External ID: external code of the attribute
    • behavior External IDs: comma delimited external code of the behavior(s). Multiple behaviors for a single attribute are enclosed in"". Example "behaviorCode1,behaviorCode2"

To Import, use the Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Behavior Mapping Import" in the Artifacts tab with the "Sample Attribute and Behavior Mapping Import" file in documents tab.

5. Attribute and Tag Mapping

Associate attributes with one or more tags. There is 1 template provided to import this mapping.

5.1 Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Tag Mapping Import: Associate an attribute with one or more tags using this import template. The Import file contains the fields mentioned below.

    • attribute External ID: external code of the attribute
    • tag External IDs: comma delimited external code of the tag(s). Example- Core,1014,2312,22-Critical.

To Import, use the Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Tag Mapping Import" in the Artifacts tab with the "Sample Attribute and Tag Mapping Import" file in documents tab.

6. Attribute Proficiency Level Description

Attribute Proficiency Level Description Import. A standardized template is provided for bulk uploading proficiency level descriptions for attributes.

6.1 Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Proficiency Level description:This feature enables importing proficiency level descriptions in multiple languages. The import file requires the following fields:

  • locale - Locale for the Proficiency Level Description.
  • external ID - External ID of the attribute
  • attributeName - Name of the attribute
  • level 1 to 10 description - Description for the corresponding Proficiency Levels.
    • Note: If Attribute Type is of  Scale 0-4, you need to add the description values from Level 1 to 4. 
    • Note: If Attribute Type is of  Scale 1-6, you need to add the description values from Level 1 to 6. 

To Import, use the Integration Center Definition file " Talent Intelligence Hub Attribute Proficiency Level description" in the Artifacts tab with the "Sample Attribute Proficiency Level Import" file in documents tab.

7. Skills Standardization Import

Use the Skills Standardization Import to standardize skill names in the Attributes Library to standard names in the SAP skills taxonomy. You can now use the same template for both exports and imports within the Standardization Import tool, ensuring full data compatibility. 

1H 2026 Updates: Use Latest ICD File - Skills Standardization Import

A new Standardization import file is now available when you run the TIH Skills Standardization job.

To run TIH Skills Standardization job for exporting data- please refer the following guide info 

https://help.sap.com/docs/successfactors-platform/using-talent-intelligence-hub/enabling-ai-assisted-skills-standardization-setting

7.1 Talent Intelligence Hub Skills Standardization: This feature enables importing Standardization values. The import file obtained after running the TIH Skills Standardization job contains following fields - 

When importing this file, only the standardization_status field requires a value from the user.

  • standardization_status- Supported values for Standardization 
    • STANDARD - Standardize the name to the name from SAP skills taxonomy. This will overwrite your existing Skill name and will have a mapping to the name from SAP skills taxonomy.
    • STD_WITH_CUST_LABEL - Standardize with your custom name to the name from SAP skills taxonomy. This will retain your existing name but will have a mapping to the name from SAP skills taxonomy.
    • CUSTOM - Retain your skill name as custom without any mapping to the SAP skills taxonomy.

Note: Leaving the standardization_status blank will result in an import error. If you prefer not to standardize certain skills, simply exclude them from the file. These skills will remain "Custom" and will not be mapped to the SAP Skills Taxonomy.

All other fields as shown below should be part of the import file and must be provided as-is, without modifications.

  • external ID - External ID of the Skill in attribute library
  • default Locale - Locale in which this skill is created.
  • name - Name of the attribute
  • created_type - Confirmed, Manual, Inferred
  • proposed_name - The name for the skill in the SAP SuccessFactors universal skills taxonomy.
  • remark - will show if there are any errors
  • status - Active or Inactive

packages.DisplayName: MAO Supervisor Agent
packages.ShortText: A Joule-powered multi-agent warehouse assistant for SAP EWM that resolves Empty Bin Exceptions through guided, confirmation-based inventory lookup and logistics execution, reducing manual transaction handling and speeding up issue resolution.
packages.Description:
Problem Statement

In SAP EWM warehouse operations, Empty Bin Exceptions occur when a picker reaches a designated bin and finds no stock available. Resolving these exceptions today requires warehouse staff to manually navigate multiple SAP transactions, verify stock across storage locations, execute bin-to-bin transfers or putaway tasks, and release picking waves. This process is slow, fragmented, and heavily dependent on experienced personnel, increasing Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR) and disrupting fulfilment SLAs.

Solution

  • Provides a single conversational interface in Joule for end-to-end Empty Bin Exception resolution without opening any SAP EWM transaction
  • Orchestrates two child agents (Inventory Agent and Logistic Agent) in a strict, stateful sequence controlled by the Supervisor Agent
  • Automatically executes the BIDF action to refresh bin state before fetching live stock data from EWM, ensuring decisions are based on current inventory
  • Presents available stock details in a structured grid and requires explicit user confirmation before triggering any logistics operation
  • Resolves exceptions via two automated paths based on Storage Type:
    • Y910 (Reserve Storage): Putaway task creation, putaway confirmation, wave release and HANA status update
    • Y151 (Alternate Active Bin): Wave release, picking creation, and HANA status update

Business Value

  • Reduces MTTR for Empty Bin Exceptions by eliminating manual EWM transaction navigation
  • Lowers dependency on experienced warehouse staff for exception handling
  • Prevents duplicate warehouse task creation through single-execution safety controls
  • Keeps fulfilment records accurate with real-time HANA status updates upon resolution
    Improves pick-line efficiency and helps maintain warehouse fulfilment SLAs

Technical Highlights

  • Platform: Built on SAP Joule Studio (Agent Builder) with a three-agent hierarchy (MAO_Supervisor_A01, MAO_Inventory_A02, MAO_Logistic_A03)

  • Integration: Connects directly to SAP EWM via OData services for BIDF execution,

    stock retrieval, warehouse task creation, putaway confirmation, and wave release

  • Skill: MAO_Supervisor_A01_J01 (supervisor orchestration)

  • Child Agents: MAO Inventory Agent (MAO_Inventory_A02) for stock lookup and BIDF execution, MAO Logistic Agent (MAO_Logistic_A03) for warehouse task execution and wave release

  • OData Entities: ZMAO_WAVE_relaseSet, ZMAO_WAVE_Release_EBSet

  • Persistence: SAP HANA DB updated on resolution to set record status to Ready for Picking

  • Interface: Delivered through the SAP Joule conversational UI; no separate tool or UI required

  • Confirmation Gate: Every logistics action is gated behind an explicit YES/NO user confirmation; no action is ever inferred or skipped

  • State Management: Supervisor Agent preserves full conversation state across all child agent interactions; session remains open until the user explicitly closes it

packages.DisplayName: Creation of Closing Cockpit (2F1)
packages.ShortText: Automation in the Closing Cockpit – Updating Status of Mass Data Runs Activities
packages.Description:
Problem:

Each period, financial user must copy the period-end close template along with its activities to ensure that the closing process is the same from period to period. This activity becomes time consuming as it must be done for each combination of company code and set of books.

Solution:

The automation carries out the creation of new period-end closes on behalf of the user using the existing template for closing activities. Bot reads fiscal year and month, Company Code, Set of Books and type of operation from the configuration file. Bot opens automatically period closing UI in SAP Business ByDesign based on configuration. Automatically creates New Closing Cockpit template through the copy of the previous period-end template and provided parameters for the defined Company Codes and Set of Books. Upon execution results and error messages are stored in log file.

Business Benefits:

  • Reduced user effort by automating the period-end closing process

  • Time saved by not having to click through every combination of Company Code and Set of Books

  • Reduced human errors thank to Company Code and Set of Books combinations being edited programmatically.

Further Extensions:

This bot can be used as a standalone bot and it can also work in conjunction with

Automation of Opening & Closing Periods bot that will close the previous accounting period and will open a new accounting period.

Automation for the Closing Cockpit bot that will execute Mass Data Runs activities from the Closing Cockpit.

Updating the Status Activities bot that will assign the completion mark to the activity in the Closing Cockpit.

The corresponding bots are also available in the Store.

packages.DisplayName: Smart Requisitioning
