packages.Description:
Business Challenge

Not every colleague in the organisation is a core SAP user. Many of the extended user population are critical to the purchasing of the organisation and yet feel overwhelmed, daunted or simply don’t have the confidence to navigate an SAP application to effectively. Enabling these requisitioners in the wider business to procure materials and services simply, on catalogue and for the best price is a delicate combination of subject matter knowledge, user experience and utilisation of central resources such as contracts and catalogues.

Value Story

This use case benefits large organizations with a diverse workforce, particularly noncore SAP users involved in procurement and requisitioning. The main challenge addressed is empowering non-core SAP users to effectively procure materials and services without feeling overwhelmed or lacking confidence. Customers can expect to unblock projects by enabling easier procurement, leverage Business AI for item recommendations, increase control over contracts and catalogues, integrate seamlessly with S/4 HANA Cloud for visibility, and reduce maverick spending by simplifying authorized purchasing channels.

Business Benefits

Unblock projects: by enabling requisitioners in the wider organisation to secure the items they need to deliver. Don’t start with a blank page: for complex scenarios utilise Business AI to recommend a schedule of items based on your goals. Increase control: optimise the use of contracts and catalogues within the extended organisation through improved UX. Integrate seamlessly: with S/4 HANA Cloud ensuring complete visibililty across the organisation of purchasing. Reduce maverick spend: with simpler channels for authorised spending preventing the temptation to buy now, expense later.

packages.DisplayName: Creation of Closing Cockpit (2F1)

packages.Description:
Problem:

Each period, financial user must copy the period-end close template along with its activities to ensure that the closing process is the same from period to period. This activity becomes time consuming as it must be done for each combination of company code and set of books.

Solution:

The automation carries out the creation of new period-end closes on behalf of the user using the existing template for closing activities. Bot reads fiscal year and month, Company Code, Set of Books and type of operation from the configuration file. Bot opens automatically period closing UI in SAP Business ByDesign based on configuration. Automatically creates New Closing Cockpit template through the copy of the previous period-end template and provided parameters for the defined Company Codes and Set of Books. Upon execution results and error messages are stored in log file.

Business Benefits:

•   Reduced user effort by automating the period-end closing process

•   Time saved by not having to click through every combination of Company Code and Set of Books

•   Reduced human errors thank to Company Code and Set of Books combinations being edited programmatically.

Further Extensions:

This bot can be used as a standalone bot and it can also work in conjunction with

Automation of Opening & Closing Periods bot that will close the previous accounting period and will open a new accounting period.

Automation for the Closing Cockpit bot that will execute Mass Data Runs activities from the Closing Cockpit.

Updating the Status Activities bot that will assign the completion mark to the activity in the Closing Cockpit.

The corresponding bots are also available in the Store.

packages.DisplayName: SAP Master Data Integration Adapter for SAP Integration Suite
packages.ShortText: The SAP Master Data Integration adapter synchronizes your master data from SAP applications like SAP ECC and other third-party applications with SAP Master Data Integration service.
packages.Description:
The SAP Master Data Integration adapter synchronizes your master data from SAP applications like SAP ECC and other third-party applications with the SAP Master Data Integration service.

Features:

  • The adapter connects to an SAP Master Data Integration (MDI) system in the receiver channel.
  • The adapter is available only for certain service plans of the SAP Integration Suite. For more information, see SAP Note 2903776.

Supported Operations:

  • Leverage the Requests API of SAP MDI to submit change requests to your master data objects.
  • Leverage the Events API of SAP MDI to fetch the changes made to your master data objects.
  • Use the message mapping feature in Cloud Integration to map incoming data from third-party applications in different formats to the equivalent One Domain Model (ODM) entity that MDI understands.
  • Send converted data to SAP MDI for further operations.

packages.DisplayName: SAP Marketing Cloud Integration with Large Volume File Based AWS S3 Data Load
packages.ShortText: This package contains integration flows to migrate large volume of data from AWS S3 Bucket via SFTP to the SAP Marketing Cloud Tenants.
packages.Description:
This package contains Iflows to migrate large volume of Contacts and Interaction records from Source systems to SAP Marketing Cloud Tenants and reconcile the data between Source systems and SAP Marketing Cloud with full audit and error logging information in either HANA DB or AWS S3 Buckets.

This package is an extension of SAP Standard package to migrate Large Volume of data with Extensive Error Handling, Logging and Reconciliation Capability between Source systems and SAP Marketing Cloud tenants.

  • https://api.sap.com/package/SAPHybrisMarketingCloudfilebaseddataload?section=Artifacts
  • https://blogs.sap.com/2019/10/31/data-migration-cpi-customer-flow-design-specification-robust-audit-error-handling/


This Integration Package consists of following AWS S3 to SAP Marketing Cloud Data Migration Flows:

  • Migration of data from/to Source systems to SAP Marketing Cloud tenants which logs the success and failure of each OData packet (2000/5002) in AWS SFTP server
  • Migration of data from Source systems from/to Marketing Cloud tenants using HANA Logs which logs the success and failure of each OData packet (2000/5002) in a table on SAP BTP HANA Instance
  • Splitting Utility which splits 1 Million files into 100k files for optimized throughput in SAP Cloud Integration and SAP Marketing Cloud tenants.
  • Splitting Utility which 1 split Million order files into 100k files that ensures that same order is not split across multiple files for optimized throughput in SAP Cloud Integration and SAP Marketing Cloud tenants.
  • IFLOW to reconcile the customer data between SAP Marketing Cloud tenants and Source Systems.

Please contact us if you want to accelerate SAP Marketing Cloud Data migration and check out our capabilities in SAP Marketing to understand why we bring unique value to your SAP Marketing Cloud Projects.

packages.DisplayName: SuccessFactors HCM Suite Onboarding with SAP ERP HCM
packages.ShortText: Integrate your SAP SuccessFactors Onboarding with SAP ERP Human Capital Management & SAP Human Capital Management for SAP S/4HANA
packages.Description:
This package enables you to integrate SAP SuccessFactors HCM Onboarding with SAP HCM private cloud edition. You can import applicant data from SuccessFactors Onboarding to SAP ERP HCM. Based on the transferred data, you can perform a personnel action in SAP ERP HCM to hire the candidates as employees and/or update existing employees.

In general the data transfer via API is always initiated from the SAP backend, regardless of the direction.

The connected services are:

  1. BeginSession: This process is used to establish session with SuccessFactors Onboarding System.
  2. CancelSession: This process is used to cancel session with SuccessFactors Onboarding System.
  3. GetNewHireRecord: This process is used to fetch Onboarding data form SuccessFactors using HRDataID.
  4. SFSFOnboardingCanidateInfo: This process is used to get all the candidates and corresponding HRDataID which are ready to be hired.
  5. Send Confirmation to SuccessFactors Onboarding: This process is used to send confirmation to SuccessFactor Onboarding after candidate is hired in SAP ERP HCM.
  6. Trigger Onboarding for an Employee: This process is used to trigger onboarding for an Employee.
  7. Trigger Offboarding for an Employee: This process is used to trigger Offboarding for an Employee. 
  8. Delete On-/Offboarding Data: This process is used to delete onboarding/Offboarding data.
  9. Get Offboard User Record: This process is used to get employee data for an offboarded employee.
  10. Get New Hire Record By Export Id: This process is used to get Onboarding data from SuccessFactors Onboarding based on the data dictionary tag "SAPHCM-Onboarding". You can use either "GetNewHireRecord" or "Get New Hire Record By Export Id" to fetch onboarding data. Our recommendation is to use "Get New Hire Record By Export Id"

Every employer (including AU subsidiaries of overseas organization) that uses its own payroll software, must electronically report employees' payments and deduction to Australian taxation Office (ATO) on or after each pay day, in real time, for each payroll run. 

This package consists of two I-flows: Data submission for STP reporting; Receiving Response for STP Submission. These I-flows will not change annually, unless there is a Legal Change announced by the Australian government. 

You must deploy all the I-flows published as part of this package to get the complete set of changes for Single Touch Payroll (STP) reporting. 

Supported for ERP 6.0 and higher releases.

Business Challenge

The solution aims to allow tax department to calculate the corporate taxes with the help of a structured and fully configurable tool. The tool cover the process to determine the local taxes from the data gathering, through the mapping of the variations and their impact on taxes.

Value Story

The use case encompasses the evaluation of Corporate Income Taxes, including IRES and IRAP for Italian markets, and others based on individual country requirements, along with Deferred Tax Assets and Deferred Tax Liabilities in alignment with local and IFRS Gaap. The system utilizes SAP Analytics Cloud capabilities to automatically gather data from source systems, including GL, HR, and assets, with the option to upload necessary data through an Excel file. Employing a pre-designed form, the tax department can manually adjust data at various stages of the process, ensuring complete and accurate traceability during data collection and after variation impact calculation. Automatic rules facilitate the association of GL Accounts with Tax Variations and the assessment of their impact on corporate income tax. • The second sheet contains input criteria for the program in the form of parameter and its corresponding value along with a description for the parameter.

Business Benefits

  • Freeing up end user to refocus on high-value tasks

  • Ensure fast download of the required list

  • Automate the repetitive tasks by maximizing productivity

Key Process Flows

  • The bot reads input criteria from the excel template

  • Automate the G/L account Line Item list

  • Download the list as an excel file

packages.DisplayName: Fixed Asset Transfer Approval
packages.ShortText: Enables customers to accelerate the digitalization of their fixed asset transfer approval process in a transparent way and provide flexibility to meet business requirements.
packages.Description:
In this content package, the process begins when a user initiates a fixed asset transfer request via the SAP BTP fiori app. The user specifies the transfer type (Intracompany or Intercompany) and chooses whether the asset values should be transferred to an existing asset or a new asset.

There are two types of asset transfer operations:

  • Intracompany fixed asset transfer: The asset is transferred within the same company code, but between different cost centers. The values can either be posted to an existing asset or to a new asset created for the receiver.

  • Intercompany asset transfer: The asset is transferred between different company codes. Like intracompany transfers, values can be posted to either an existing asset or a new asset.

Approval process goes through four levels of approval:

  • Level 1- sender cost center owner: The sender's cost center owner reviews the transfer request to submit or rework.

  • Level 2 - sender company code finance manager: The finance manager of the sender company code ensures the financial accuracy and click on submit or rework.

  • Level 3 - receiver cost center owner: The receiver's cost center owner validates that the asset transfer is appropriate for the receiving cost center and click on submit or rework.

  • Level 4 - receiver company code finance manager: The finance manager of the receiver company code ensures financial accuracy and click submit or rework.

At each approval level, an automated email notification is sent to the respective approver, informing them about the pending task. This keeps all approvers informed and ensures that each level of the approval process is completed efficiently.

After final approval, the system posts the asset values to either the existing asset or a newly created asset in SAP S/4HANA private cloud and final email notification is sent to the user, confirming the successful transfer of asset values.

This package provides:

  • APIs to perform data related operations with SAP S/4HANA private cloud.

  • Decisions to determine approvers for tasks.

packages.DisplayName: Aging Analysis of Supplier Invoices with Pay-When-Paid Terms (70H)
packages.ShortText: Generates an aging report of supplier invoices with pay-when-paid terms that are open but still blocked for payment.
packages.Description:
Problem

A company sometimes enters into contractual agreements with its suppliers (or subcontractors) where the terms of payment in a project depend on when the company actually receives the payment from the customer to whom the services or goods are delivered. This payment clause is sometimes referred to as "Pay when Paid (PWP)" or "Pay if Paid (PIP)".

In scenarios where customer payments are not received on a timely basis, it is especially important for accounts payable accountants to continuously monitor the status of such supplier invoices to ensure that appropriate and timely action is taken to protect supplier relationship or to comply with contractual terms.

Solution

The bot generates an aging report of supplier invoices with pay-when-paid terms that are outstanding but still blocked for payment. The bot first identifies supplier invoices in your SAP S/4HANA Cloud system that meet criteria specified in an input template file. The bot then calculates the age in days of the matching supplier invoices.

After execution, the bot generates an aging report in the Excel format that lists all the matching records, together with their supplier, customer, project, and billing information and sends an email together with this report to the specified stakeholders.

The aging report generated by the bot facilitates exception management as it enables the accounts payable accountant to easily identify and prioritize past due supplier invoices that need to be paid, even if customer payment has not been received yet.

Note

The following scope items need to be activated to use the 70H bot for SAP S/4HANA Cloud:

  • Customer Project Management - Project-Based Services (J11)

  • Service and Material Procurement - Project-Based Services (J13)

  • Sales Order Processing - Project-Based Services (J14)

  • Project Billing - Project-Based Services (4E9)

The 70H bot can be used in conjunction with another bot, Automated Release of Supplier Invoice upon Customer Payment (6PA), to automate release of relevant supplier invoices.

With SAP Insurance Sales Assistant, SAP provides a native iOS app for iPads to support insurance sales agents to manage their sales activities and an integration package to connect to back-end systems.

SAP Insurance Sales Assistant allows users to:

  • View and process customer data, appointments, and tasks in SAP CRM
  • Get an overview of the customer's submissions created in SAP Underwriting for Insurance (FS-QUO)
  • Get an overview of the customer's insurance policies created in SAP Policy Management (FS-PM)

  • FS-PM 5.3 SP02
  • FS-QUO 3.0 SP03 ( also known as FP2 )

For information about SAP Insurance Sales Assistant, see https://help.sap.com/viewer/product/SAP_INSURANCE_SALES_ASSISTANT/1.1/en-US

The Shopify to SAP S/4HANA Integration Package is a comprehensive solution designed to seamlessly connect your e-commerce and ERP systems. It leverages webhooks for real-time data synchronization, enhancing operational efficiency and data accuracy.

The package includes the following key integration flows:

  • Shopify to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Customer Creation: Automates the transfer of customer data from Shopify to SAP S/4HANA Cloud, ensuring that customer information is consistently up-to-date across both platforms.

  • Shopify to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Sales Order Creation: Facilitates the real-time creation of sales orders in SAP S/4HANA Cloud directly from Shopify events, streamlining the order management process.

  • SAP S/4HANA to Shopify Stock from MRPArea: Synchronizes inventory levels from SAP S/4HANA's Material Requirements Planning (MRP) areas to Shopify, providing accurate and current stock information.

  • SAP S/4HANA to Shopify Stock from StorageLocation: Updates Shopify with inventory levels from specific storage locations in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring detailed and location-specific stock visibility.

Currently, the 'S4HANA to Shopify Stock from MRP Area' integration flow is the only one that has been made publicly available. Please contact Flexso for access and customization of the additional scenarios.

packages.DisplayName: Project Activity Trigger - Terminate Active Processes Action
packages.ShortText: Action to retrieve and modify the process instances.
packages.Description:
This API uses the process capability of SAP Build Process Automation and will start new process instances and work with tasks.

Note: These APIs are designed for loosely coupled clients. This means:

- If SAP Build Process Automation adds fields to responses, the API version number does not increase.

- The order of fields in responses and of entries in arrays may change. This applies unless the API provides an explicit means to specify the desired order.

The following API call are used in the project:

GET - The purpose of this API is to retrieve process instances by parameters. If no parameters are specified, all RUNNING, or ERRONEOUS instances are returned. Parameters for different attributes of the instance are evaluated using the logical 'and' operator.

PATCH - The purpose of this API is to modify the properties of a given process instance, for example, sets its status to CANCELED or RUNNING. Status changes may not take effect immediately, due to asynchronous processing of the request.

packages.DisplayName: Innovative Real-Time Forecasting Process
packages.ShortText: Cover the forecasting process with the help of SAP HANA Cloud and SAP Analytics Cloud.
packages.Description:
Business Challenge

This solution has been built to cover the forecasting process with the help of SAP HANA Cloud and SAP Analytics Cloud. Actual data, coming from several different source systems, are ingested and processed in real-time inside SAP HANA Cloud and then uploaded inside SAP Analytics Cloud. This project was one of the first project in Italy, implementing SAP HANA Cloud together with SAP Analytics Cloud.

Value Story

This project harnesses the real-time computing capabilities of SAP HANA Cloud to seamlessly integrate and standardize data from diverse sources, including both cloud and non-cloud systems, as well as SAP and non-SAP environments. Leveraging SAP Analytics Cloud, an integrated model has been created to facilitate financial and managerial planning. Through automated processes called data actions, essential calculations are performed efficiently. The final step involves presenting the processed data on tailor-made dashboards, providing a comprehensive and insightful view for informed decision-making.

packages.DisplayName: AS4 Adapter for SAP Integration Suite
packages.ShortText: The AS4 adapters use the AS4 message exchange protocol to securely process incoming business documents using Web services.
packages.Description:
The AS4 adapters use the AS4 message exchange protocol to securely process incoming business documents using Web services.

Features:

  • The AS4 adapters are based on the ebMS specification that supports the ebMS handler conformance profile.
  • The AS4 sender adapter works on the sender channel in three different flavors - ebMS3 Pull, ebMS3 Push, and ebMS3 Receipt.
  • The AS4 receiver adapter works on the receiver channel in two different flavors - Push Message Protocol and Pull Message Protocol.

Supported Operations:

  • The adapter supports message pushing for sending MSH (Messaging Services Handler) and selective message pulling for receiving MSH.
  • The adapter uses secure SAML tokens for authentication and authorization between two MSHs.
  • All types of message payloads are supported. AS4 is a payload-agnostic protocol.

  • TRADACOMS to SAP SOAP or to IDoc - Inbound - Integration flow template for building inbound TRADACOMS (EDI) to SAP SOAP or IDoc integration scenarios using SAP IA

For outbound direction:

packages.DisplayName: Free Form Payment Approval Process
packages.ShortText: Enables customer to accelerate the digitalization of their Free Form Payment Approval process in a transparent way and provide flexibility to meet business requirements. It includes process, decisions and visibility scenario content.
packages.Description:
This process ensures a way for handling free-form payment requests, reducing processing time and improving transparency in payment operations.
1. **Process Flow:**
* The process starts when a requestor creates a "Free Form Payment" using the SAP S/4HANA Fiori app. The app captures the payment details.
* Upon submission, the workflow is triggered in SAP BTP, automatically routing the request to designated approvers based on pre-defined business rules.
2. **Approval Stages:**
* **Level 1 Approval:**
* **Role:** Cash Specialist
* **Action:** Reviews the request for validity, verifies the payment details, and either Posts or Reverses the Free Form Payment request.
* **Outcome:** If approved, the Free Form Payment Request is **posted** in SAP S/4HANA. If rejected, the requestor is notified via email with the reason for rejection.
* **Level 2 Approval:**
* **Role:** Accounting Manager
* **Action:** Reviews the posted request to ensure compliance with financial policies and validates the payment.
* **Outcome:** If approved, the Free Form Payment is **released and cleared** in SAP S/4HANA. A notification is sent to the requestor informing them of the payment status. If reversed, the requestor is notified via email.
3. **Notification Mechanism:**
* At each approval stage, approvers receive an Outlook email with details of the pending task.
* Approvers can access their tasks through the **SAP BTP My Inbox app**, which provides an intuitive interface for approving or rejecting the tasks.
* Upon completion of the approval process, the requestor is notified via email about the final status of their payment request.
This package provides
* A process that orchestrates the approval process for the business scenario
* APIs to perform data related operations with SAP HANA Cloud, Private Edition
* Decisions to determine approvers for tasks
The package uses the following action projects for API calls
* Free Form Payment - Update Payment Processing Status Action
* Free Form Payment - Fetch Payment Details Action

packages.DisplayName: Plant Maintenance Order Date Change Notification
packages.ShortText: Respond to delayed delivery of non-stock parts needed for maintenance orders using automatic/manual decisions
packages.Description:
For this use case, a new template content package based on SAP Build Process Automation is available here:    Plant Maintenance Order Date Change Notification

The live process package enables maintenance planners to react to delays in the delivery of components required for plant maintenance orders. When an update to the Purchase Order happens, the workflow checks if there is a scheduling conflict (e.g. delivery date of vendor confirmation for a component is later than the start date of the maintenance order).In case of conflict, the maintenance planner is informed so that a decision can be taken to replan the maintenance order or request a supplier change or accept the delay.

The workflow automatically determines the procurement responsible based on the responsibility management and also automatically helps in replanning the maintenance order based on the availability date of the parts, taking into account the material goods receipt duration.

This live process content can be consumed in SAP Process Automation (click here to know-how) or SAP Workflow Management (click here to know-how).

SAP Workflow Management offers capabilities to digitize workflows, automate processes and decisions logic, gain end-to-end visibility along with key process performance indicators and accelerate business process transformation with Live Process Content and low-code/no-code tools to manage changes in your processes and decisions.

The sample capital expenditure approval workflow is started when a capital expenditure funding request is raised. The request is then reviewed and approved or rejected. There is also a sample visibility scenario in this package which helps you to understand how an end-to-end operational view of the process with sample KPIs is achieved.

packages.DisplayName: SAP Digital Vehicle Hub Business Events
packages.ShortText: Provides business events for SAP Digital Vehicle Hub for triggering follow-up processes in other applications.
packages.Description:
SAP Digital Vehicle Hub Business Events is a system-wide standardized event mechanism for a vehicle in SAP Digital Vehicle Hub. The events are produced whenever a vehicle is either created, changed, deleted, modified, and replicated. Events are also produced when vehicles are purged or whenever a vehicle alert is created.

SAP Digital Vehicle Hub Business Events can be consumed through subscription of SAP Event Mesh application to connect to applications, services, and systems across different landscapes. The events are produced and published to topics in SAP Event Mesh. You must subscribe to these topics to obtain the event information. Based on the business application of SAP Digital Vehicle Hub you have subscribed to, following are the topics:

  • For SAP Digital Vehicle Hub and SAP Digital Vehicle Hub Preview subscription:
    1. sap/dmo/dvhsvc/vehicleCreate
    2. sap/dmo/dvhsvc/vehicleUpdate
    3. sap/dmo/dvhsvc/vehicleDelete
    4. sap/dmo/dvhsvc/vehicleAlert
    5. sap/dmo/dvhsvc/vehicleReplicate
    6. sap/dmo/dvhsvc/vehicleModify
    7. sap/dmo/dvhsvc/vehiclePurge
  • For SAP Digital Vehicle Hub Test subscription:
    1. sap/dmo/dvhtestsvc/vehicleCreate
    2. sap/dmo/dvhtestsvc/vehicleUpdate
    3. sap/dmo/dvhtestsvc/vehicleDelete
    4. sap/dmo/dvhtestsvc/vehicleAlert
    5. sap/dmo/dvhtestsvc/vehicleReplicate
    6. sap/dmo/dvhtestsvc/vehicleModify
    7. sap/dmo/dvhtestsvc/vehiclePurge

Disclaimer: All Business Events Definitions that are part of this package are relevant only for SAP Digital Vehicle Hub

packages.DisplayName: Change and Innovation Approval Process - Sample
packages.ShortText: This sample content helps users to get started in streamlining and digitalizing a process for requesting and approving innovations and changes to existing solutions to speed up the process and increase transparency.
packages.Description:
There is often a lack of transparency for requests for new solutions or changes to existing solutions raised by the business that IT needs to provide a solution for since those are commonly raised and managed manually and across different channels and stakeholders. On the one hand the business does not know what happened with their request and on the other hand the IT is lacking an overview on how many requests are received, from whom, what evaluation has been done already etc. This often leads to increased processing times.

This sample content helps users to get started in streamlining and digitalizing a process for requesting and approving innovations and changes to existing solutions to speed up the process and increase transparency.

Included in this sample process is the following:

  • A sample form used to collect relevant information about the requested change or innovation.

  • A review and effort estimation form to review and evaluate the request.

  • A condition to root requests depending on the strategic fit.

  • An approval form to review the information and decide for approval.

  • Confirmation and rejection mail tasks to notify the requester about the decision.

packages.DisplayName: Automated supplier invoice upload (1R1)
packages.ShortText: This bot is an SAP Business ByDesign Intelligent RPA offering. It fetches the invoice documents from the specified folder and uploads them to the SAP Business ByDesign system, using the OData service for scanned invoice upload.
packages.Description:
Problem:

Companies, which want to organize their suppler invoice PDFs for upload in different folders (one folder per company) cannot use the SAP Collaboration Window (since the company is determined by the logged in user). However, many customers would like to have one user who can scan all the invoices irrespective of the Company Code.

Solution:

After the previous Automated Business Document Extraction from Emails bot which extracts the Supplier Invoice from e-mails, this bot will pick the invoice and the company code to SAP Business ByDesign using an ODATA service, which would upload the invoice document into the Intelligent Invoice Scanning Staging area. From this point on, the standard Intelligent Invoice Scanning feature takes over and will continue processing the document.

Business Benefits:

  • Reduced user effort by automation of repetitive tasks

  • Improved work efficiency and business flexibility

Further Extensions:

This bot can be used as a standalone bot and it can also work in conjunction with Business Document Extraction from Email bot, which will download the files from the Emails and place them in the automatically created folder structure. In this scenario, the Supplier Invoice Upload for Intelligent Invoice Scanning bot will work in the second part in the end-to-end automation process. 
The corresponding bot is also available in the Store.

packages.DisplayName: Collection and Update of Dispute Case Information  (5JL)
packages.ShortText: Collects information from customers on dispute cases and updates the system with information received from customers.
packages.Description:
Problem

Accounts receivable accountants frequently receive information collection forms from customers via email to settle dispute cases. They must then assess the information and transfer the data manually and individually to SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

This activity is time-consuming and error-prone, especially considering the high volume of dispute cases to settle.

Solution

The bot automates the exchange of information between the accounts receivable accountant and the customer for newly created dispute cases. It does so through two scenarios:

  • Send Email Inquiries to Customers: The bot searches for dispute cases with a specific reason, following the criteria set by the accounts receivable accountant. It then sends an information collection form to the corresponding customers via email to obtain more information regarding the case.

  • Collect Email Responses: The bot scans for unread emails containing a Case ID and the information collection form as an attachment. It then transfers the data collected in each form to the dispute case corresponding to the Case ID in SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

    After each scenario is executed, a log file is sent to specified recipients.

packages.DisplayName: List of G/L Account line Items (ECC) – FAGLL03
packages.ShortText: Automate the list of G/L Account Line Items and download it as an excel file
packages.Description:
Use

This program lists G/L account line items. You can also display the items from more than one G/L account cross-company code in a list. The difference from FBL3H is that FAGLL03 can display entry view as well as the General ledger view. Here, we are automating the download of the G/L account line item list according to given input criteria.

Configuration

The input criteria and system information are contained in a configuration excel named as DynamicTemplate_FAGLL03.xlsx. This excel file contains two sheets;

  • The first sheet contains the system details like the System ID, Client and whether Single Sign-On is enabled. It also contains the Variant name for the program and the output path of the excel file to be downloaded.The username and password for the target ECC system is maintained as a variable in the Cloud Factory.The file type of the output file to be downloaded is maintained in “Output File Type” row. It is available in the field “Select from all available formats” in Select Spreadsheet popup window in the target system. Some examples of the file-type include “Excel (in Office 2007 XLSX Format)” or “Excel-Office open XML Format (XLSX)” etc.

  • The second sheet contains input criteria for the program in the form of parameter and its corresponding value along with a description for the parameter.

Business Benefits

  • Reduce manual effort– an employee can concentrate on the more important tasks

  • Ensure fast download of the required list

  • Eliminate the human error

Key Process Flows

  • The bot reads input criteria from the excel template

  • Automate the G/L account Line Item list

  • Download the list as an excel file

packages.ShortText: Automates receipt of maintenance plans from service providers and approvals for execution plan.
packages.Description:
This Asset Maintenance Sample content enables customers to automate the receipt of the maintenance plans from service providers and send for necessary approval of the plan for execution.

Here is the quick overview of the process flow:

  • Service provider sends maintenance plan in an excel file attachment in email to the manufacturer.

  • On the Manufacturers side, Microsoft Outlook is monitored constantly for such incoming email with attachment and search criteria defined to download such attachment and upload to the SAP BTP Document Management Service and create a public share link for the attachment.

  • Approval Workflow is called to get the approval of the maintenance plan from the manager on the manufacturers side.

  • Approver(s) accesses My Inbox to view the task, review the document and choose one of the following decisions.

    • Approve: Upon selecting Approve option, the maintenance notification and maintenance order creation starts and is appended to the excel sheet by the bot

    • Reject: Upon selecting Reject option, Requester (and Watcher if specified) are notified via email about rejection of the request and the process is terminated.

  • Once the entire excel sheet is processed the Execution Complete mail is sent to the service provider.

packages.DisplayName: Proof of Delivery Note Upload in the Outbound Delivery and the Invoice (1S1)
packages.ShortText: This bot is an SAP Business ByDesign offering. This bot picks up the ‘Proof of Delivery’ documents from the folder and uploads the documents to SAP Business ByDesign system, as an attachment to the Outbound Delivery.
packages.Description:
Description

Problem:

Proof of delivery (POD) notes are acknowledgments from the customers when they receive goods. The delivery person sends a scanned copy of these notes to the company/user per e-mail.  Business users will download these scanned PODs and upload them manually to each Outbound Delivery /Invoice in the SAP Business ByDesign application to have the proof that the goods were delivered, and that they can be paid then. This manual process takes a significant amount of time and is often prone to errors.

Solution:

After the previous Automated Business Document Extraction from Emails bot will extract the POD from e-mails, this bot will pick the file and send it to the SAP AI Business Services - Document Information Extraction to scan it and identify the Delivery Note Number from it. Based on this information, the bot will connect to SAP Business ByDesign using ODATA/SOAP services and upload the file to the relevant delivery note. Later an internal workflow will identify the linked invoice and replicate the POD also to it. The data is exposed for Analytics so the business user can create a report on it using the SAP Business ByDesign plugin for Excel.

Business Benefits:

  • Reducing repetitive tasks.

  • Improved work efficiency.

  • Reduced risk of manual errors.

Further Extensions:

packages.Description:
This content package is deprecated. A new template-based version is available at this link:    
Project Activity Trigger

Large-scale projects, such as constructing a complete plant, and smaller projects, such as organizing a trade fair, require precise planning of numerous detailed activities. The person in charge of the project must ensure that the project is carried out on schedule, within budget, and in line with performance, and must provide the necessary resources and funding in the best possible way. However, there is no automated trigger to inform about upcoming activities.


This package enables sending notifications to the responsible users assigned to elements in the SAP Project System. The notification can be triggered when there is any change in WBS elements, project definitions, and network activities. The notification can be started immediately based on configurable user or system status values or based on the configured date and lead time. It is possible to configure the lead time before the configured start date of the elements. The responsible person gets a notification about upcoming activities in advance to plan effectively.

This live process content can be consumed in SAP Build Process Automation (click here to know-how) or SAP Workflow Management (click here to know-how).

BAPI is a standard interface to the business object model in SAP products. BAPIs are the primary methods through which customer code and third-party applications interact with SAP products.

An Action Group is collection of actions that once executed, return some response. BAPI is part of an Action Group whose actions help you to construct the parameters to execute the BAPI module and return the BAPI response.

Description

Problem:

Business users customize the SAP Business ByDesign reports available in the SAP Business ByDesign plugin for Excel. These reports are saved in users local/shared folder. These reports take a considerable amount of time to refresh with the latest data from the application. Users had to wait for a long time to access the latest data if required.

Users can schedule these bots to run depending on their specific requirements. Users will have access to the latest data without any manual interference to refresh as they are refreshed in the background.

  • Improved work efficiency

packages.DisplayName: Master Data Enrichment for Business Partner Identification (3C1)
packages.ShortText: This SAP Business One SAP Process Automation bot automates the process of enriching the Document Information Extraction service with customer/account master data.
packages.Description:
Problem statement

As master data is subject to change, business users need to perform several manual steps on a regular basis to enrich the master data extracted by the Document Information Extraction service. Enriching the Document Information Extraction service manually requires multiple steps: creating a report in SAP Business One with specific columns, extracting the values, uploading them to the Document Information Extraction service API, and activating the service.

Solution

The Master Data Enrichment for Business Partner Identification (3C1) bot automates the manual steps required in updating the Document Information Extraction service API whenever business partner master data is modified. The bot retrieves the business partner list from SAP Business One, deletes the existing master data in the Document Information Extraction API, creates the business entity, and activates the business partner master data for use by the Document Information Extraction service.

Business Benefits

  • Reduces user effort

  • Reduces the risk of manual errors

  • Improves work efficiency

Further Extensions

The bot is designed to work with the Sales Order Creation from Local Purchase Order bot in an end-to-end automation process. When using the Sales Order Creation from Local Purchase Order bot, the Master Data Enrichment for Business Partner Identification bot can further improve the accuracy of the sales order creation by helping to identify the business partner code based on the business partner name, address, bank account, and other details scanned by the service from the purchase order document.

The mentioned Sales Order Creation from Local Purchase Order bot is also available in the Store.

packages.ShortText: Automate the entering of Incoming Invoices using transaction MIRO.
packages.Description:
Use

This program is used to enter an Incoming Invoice. Here, we are automating the entering of Incoming Invoices using transaction MIRO.

Configuration

The input criteria are received as a PDF file from an e-mail. System details like the System ID, Client, Username, Password and whether Single Sign-On is enabled are stored as variables in the Cloud Factory.

Key Process Flows

  • The bot gets a bunch of PDF files from e-mails which have a specified subject line.

  • The e-mails are moved to a specified subfolder in the mailbox.

  • The bot reads each PDF from the source path, extracts headers and items and creates a job for each of them. The PDFs are then moved to destination path after extraction.

  • Automates entering an incoming invoice via transaction MIRO using the input data extracted from each PDF.

  • Logs the created document number in the job log in the Cloud Factory.

Business Benefits

  • Reduce manual effort an employee can concentrate on the more important tasks

  • Ensure fast creation of the document

  • Eliminate the human error

packages.ShortText: Enables mass update of details of existing G/L journal entries without impacting financial postings.
packages.Description:
Problem

Customers may require updating G/L journal entry details without impacting existing financial postings for compliance, reporting, operational reasons, and localization-specific purposes. This action may also need to be executed in bulk to reduce manual efforts and minimize data entry errors.

Solution

The bot supports two scenarios:

  1. Retrieve G/L Journal Entries That Need Updating

    The bot returns G/L journal entries that match user-specified criteria and saves in the Excel input template format. The user has the option to edit this file or use "as is" for mass update in scenario 2.

  2. Mass Update G/L Journal Entry Details

    The bot updates the details of journal entries (headers and line items of journal enties with specific attribute values such as Normal Document) without impacting financial postings, based on a completed Excel input template from the user.

After each scenario is executed, an email notification with the bot run results is sent to specified recipients.

Note

To use the 6RT bot for SAP S/4HANA Cloud, the following scope items must be activated:

  • Accounting and Financial Close (J58)

  • Accounts Receivable (J59)

  • Accounts Payable (J60)

packages.DisplayName: List of Customer Line Items (HANA) - FBL5H

packages.Description:
Use

This program lists Customer line items. You can also display the items from more than one Customer account across company codes in a list. This package is built via Cloud Studio to automate the download of the Customer line items list according to given input data.

Configuration

The input criteria and system information are maintained in a configuration excel named as DynamicTemplate_FBL5H.xlsx. The configuration excel available within the package should be downloaded and maintained in the given InputPath environment variable.

This excel file contains two sheets;

  • The first sheet contains the system details like the System ID, Client and whether Single Sign-On is enabled. It also contains the Variant name for the program and the output path of the excel file to be downloaded.

  • The username and password for the target ECC system is maintained in the Cloud Factory.

  • The file type of the output file to be downloaded is maintained in “Output File Type” row. It is available in the field “Select from all available formats” in Select Spreadsheet popup window in the target system. Some examples of the file-type include “Excel (in Office 2007 XLSX Format)” or “Excel-Office open XML Format (XLSX)” etc.

  • The second sheet contains input data for the program in the form of parameter and its corresponding value along with a description for the parameter.

Business Benefits

  • Reduce manual effort– an employee can concentrate on the more important tasks

  • Ensure fast download of the required list

  • Eliminate the human error

Key Process Flows

  • The bot reads input criteria from the excel template

  • Automate the Customer Line Item list

  • Download the list as an excel file

As sales contract need to be updated or created ad-hoc, on-demand, it is more time-efficient for the users to provide excel template with the necessary data using a bot, instead of performing it individually in SAP S/4HANA system. This template provides the approval flow for sales contract data & covers the capability to retrieve required sales contract data and update or creation of sales contract in SAP S/4HANA public cloud system.

The following steps are included as a part of Mass Maintenance of template:

Fetch operation: A pre-defined excel template file is populated with fetched sales contract records based on the selection screen input populated by the sales representative.

The sales representative must manually update sales contract details in this file and move it to the ToBeProcessed folder.

Update operation: A task automation to update sales contracts in SAP S/4HANA Cloud (after optional approval) runs in a predefined scheduled manner, in an unattended mode. This automation fetches the file(s) from the ToBeProcessed folder, groups sales contracts with their items and sends them for (optional) approvals. upon completion of the task, the sales contract header and its items are updated in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system

Create operation: A task automation to create sales contract in SAP S/4HANA Cloud(after optional approval) based on the template data file available in the ToBeProcessed folder.

The template uses the API_SALES_CONTRACT_SRV API for read, create and update operations.

The template can also work in collaboration with the Business Document Extraction from Email (70U) bot available in the SAP Build Store.

packages.DisplayName: Customer Business Discontinuation Accounts Receivable
packages.ShortText: Enables the automation of business discontinuation approvals in a flexible and transparent manner. It provides a controlled and systematic approach to discontinuing business relationships with customers, tailored to various business scenarios.
packages.Description:
This package provides a structured approach to discontinue business relationships with customers, addressing various financial scenarios. The process begins with the requester creating a discontinuation request for a customer in the BTP fiori app. The request then progresses through a multi-level approval process with email notifications sent to respective approvers at each stage. Depending on the financial status of the customer, the following scenarios are handled:

Zero Balance: Post approval, open items are cleared automatically in the SAP system. The Requester/Finance department manually confirms the clearance completion.

Debit Balance: An automatic email is triggered to the customer requesting settlement of their balance amount.

Credit Balance: Customer Refund Request will be created in the system:

  1. Manual Customer Refund Request: An automatic email is sent to the Finance Department to initiate a refund process. Manage Customer Refund Request app triggers an automatic email to the Finance Department to process an outgoing payment to the customer as a refund. The Requester/Finance department manually confirms the initiation of the refund process.

  2. Automatic Customer Refund Request: The process calls integration suite, internally consuming BAPIs, to The transfer of special general ledger (Spl.Gl) items into the normal ledger performed through the process flow. Finance user confirmation is not required.

Throughout the process, approvers are notified via email at each level and can to approve or reject through the BTP My Inbox app.

This package provides

  • A process that orchestrates the approval process for the business scenario

  • An automation to perform the required scripting relevant for the business scenario

  • APIs to perform data related operations with SAP HANA Cloud

  • Decisions to determine approvers for tasks

The package uses the following action projects for API calls

-        Customer business discontinuation -Create Discontinuation Action

-        Manage Customer Refund Request - Start instance action

packages.DisplayName: Audit Document Review Process
packages.ShortText: Collaboratively review audit documents using SAP Workflow Management and SAP Jam
packages.Description:
SAP Workflow Management allows you to build, run, and manage workflows, from simple approvals to end-to-end processes that can span across different organizations and applications. With an inbox application and custom-built user interfaces, you involve end-users in business processes for decision making and data entry. 

The Audit Document Review Process is part of a critical assets management process in the company's account and control framework. It is a process to review and agree on accounting for significant or complex transactions, changes in policies or guidance, and overall strategy and plan proposed by the group engagement team. A group audit involves auditors other than the group engagement team. But, a process which requires multiple users from different geographical locations to come together has some problems:

  • A manual audit process lacks collaboration among reviewers and approvers.
  • Exchange of feedback via emails causes multiple version of the in-process document which is difficult to collate and maintain.
  • Status of the document is not transparent.

To overcome such a problem, use SAP Workflow Management to orchestrate the whole process and SAP Jam for document management and collaboration.

Automating such a document-centric process will help line of business users to avoid excessive manual work and exchange of ideas or comments through email. A business user responsible for triggering this document review workflow could invite the accountable business users as reviewers/contributors based on a business rule.  The users could work in parallel, and they could review and update the document and share their comments. These comments are visible to other task owners who are taking part in this review. The reviewers could invite other business users who could contribute content or comments to this document without forwarding/delegating their workflow task. This will enable collaboration across business users working in different locations. After completion of the review, the document is sent to the responsible managers and auditors for final review. The reviewers could send this document back to the initiator and request for additional information

Vendor onboarding in SAP S/4HANA private or public cloud streamlines the vendor creation process using SAP Build Process Automation. It automate approvals, ensuring compliance and efficiency while allowing vendors or internal teams to input necessary details. Configurable process steps based on vendor type, account group, and department. The system provides real-time process visibility, multi-step approvals, automated notifications, and seamless integration into SAP S/4HANA private or public cloud for enhanced vendor management.
**Key Features of Vendor onboarding:**
1. **End-to-End Process Automation:** Automates vendor onboarding from request submission to final approval and creation in SAP S/4HANA private or public cloud.
2. **Task Management with only Task Center:** Enable approvers and stakeholders to review and process tasks.
3. **Role-Based Approvals:** Assign tasks dynamically to procurement, finance, and IT teams using decisions.
4. **Process Visibility & Monitoring:** Real-time tracking and dashboards to monitor vendor onboarding status and key KPIs.
5. **Automated Notifications & Alerts:** Sending email and system alerts to notify users of pending approvals and task completions.
6. **Low-Code/No-Code Customization:** Allow businesses to easily modify process, approval steps, and data validation rules without coding.
7. **Vendor Self-Service Option:** Enables vendor to directly enter their details via start UI form, reducing manual effort.
8. **Seamless SAP ERP Integration:** Ensures vendor data is accurately created and updated in SAP S/4HANA private or public cloud upon approval.

It then fetches existing leads assigned to the sales employees to determine their current load and organize them for round robin lead assignment.

  • Automations to build the excel file report and send it to the defined users. By default, a mail is sent to the sales organization manager.

packages.DisplayName: Process Visibility on Invoice Management
packages.ShortText: Take complete control of payment by gaining real time visibility into accounts payable process and avoid late payment fees.
packages.Description:
In the accounts payable process, a shared services group of a telecom company receives and validates all incoming invoices that arrive from multiple channels (EDI, email, fax…). Processing these invoices are cumbersome because of transmission errors, duplicate invoices, incomplete invoices, and erroneous invoices. The invoices are then posted to ERP and the payment process is triggered which involves reviews and approvals.

In this smart process application, built using SAP Operational Process Intelligence, you will see how a large telecom company can gain real time insights into the accounts payable process, can track the performance of the shared services group which processes invoices and is able to take advantage of early payment discounts and avoid late payment fees.

Experience the demo
Click on the Evaluate option in the Documents tab and for more information and detailed steps read the User Guide.

Interested in productive usage  
License SAP Operational Process Intelligence by visiting https://www.sap.com/products/business-process-operational-intelligence.html and build similar content.

packages.DisplayName: Create a Lead in Salesforce with Automation Anywhere
packages.ShortText: This Business Processes demonstrate how to create a lead in Salesforce using SAP Build Process Automation and Automation Anywhere.
packages.Description:
The Lead Creation template automates the steps required to create a new Lead record within Salesforce, allowing you to pass in all required attributes for the new Lead.

The automation follows a flow given the actions provided and is intended to be fully customizable to meet the needs of your business and the customizations you may have applied to your own Salesforce instances. A Form is provided within the SAP Build Process Automation template which captures input data to the process. That data is then encapsulated and sent to the target Automation Anywhere Control Room which will will deploy the task automation to complete the work wihtin Salesforce. The outcome of the automation is pulled from the Automaiton Anywhere Control Room and can be viewed in the monitoring output which SBPA provides

packages.DisplayName: Inactive Vendor Mark for Blockage or Deletion
packages.ShortText: Identification of inactive vendors in SAP S/4HANA system and mark for deletion or blockage.
packages.Description:
Inactive vendor in the system creates issues related to incorrect shipping/receiving, wrong billing and payment, incorrect invoice generation. Inactive vendor also has shown inconsistency in data quality and future application migration.

The automation helps to retrieve vendor data from SAP S/4HANA system, transform it into an excel template, apply excel rules to identify inactive vendors based on specified criteria. Once inactive vendors are listed, workflow is triggered for approval. Upon approval, vendors are marked for deletion or as blocked based on user input. Log report is prepared, and updates are shared with stakeholders.

SAP S/4HANA is a solution built on the SAP HANA platform, fully designed with the SAP Fiori user experience and bringing the simplicity of SAP’s global cloud. SAP S/4HANA also includes our existing cloud solutions for lines of business, such as solutions from SAP SuccessFactors.

Please be aware: Precondition of this integration package is preconfigured systems following SAP Best Practices, done by SAP.

As a precondition for this package employees from SAP Success Factors Employee Central System must already be transferred to SAP S/4HANA. (You can achieve this by setting up the Employee integration iFlow which is available within the CPI integration package SuccessFactors Employee Central Integration with SAP S/4HANA Cloud.

For all other integration scenarios, please contact SAP.

This integration package contains the following integration flow:

Employee availability integration flow:

Name: Replicate Workforce Availability to S4HANA PCE

Description:

Employee availability information is transferred from Employee Central to SAP S/4HANA systems.

a. SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central can be used as only system of records for the maintenance of time interval, supplement data(e.g. work schedule, holiday calendar, absent times like vacation). 

b. The availability data gets transferred to SAP S/4HANA On-Premise/Private Cloud and can be used for subsequent processes like project staffing or will be shown on the employee time sheet.

packages.DisplayName: Azure Adapter for SAP Integration Suite
packages.ShortText: Azure Adapter facilitates integration of four different Azure storages - Blob, File, Queue and Table - with SAP Cloud Integration.
packages.Description:
SAP provides Azure adapter, which offers various types of API based operations to integrate Azure storage.The adapter is available only for certain service plans of the SAP Integration Suite. For more information, see SAP Note 3188446

Product Features:  

• Azure Blob Storage:

  • Create Container in the storage
  • List the Containers from the storage
  • Delete a Container from the storage
  • Upload Block Blob into the Container
  • Upload Append Blob into the Container
  • Upload a Blob from URL of another Container into the specified Container
  • List the Blobs in the Container
  • Get the specified Blob properties
  • Get or Set the Metadata for the Blob
  • Download Blob from the Container
  • Delete a Blob from the Container  

• Azure File Storage: 

  • Create Share in the storage
  • List Share from the storage
  • Delete Share in the storage
  • Get Share Properties in the storage
  • Upload File in the Directory or Share in the storage
  • List Directories and Files in the Share
  • Delete Directory in the Share
  • Download File from the Directory or Share
  • Get File properties of the File from the Directory or Share
  • Get or Set Metadata for the File  

• Azure Queue Storage:

  • Create Queue in the storage
  • List Queues in the storage
  • Delete Queue from the storage
  • Create Message in the Queue
  • Get Message(s) or Peek Message(s) from the Queue
  • Update Message in the Queue
  • Delete Message from the Queue
  • Get or Set Metadata for the Queue  

• Azure Table Storage:

  • Create Table in the storage
  • List the tables from the storage
  • Delete Table from the storage
  • Add entity to the table
  • Get entity(ies) from the table
  • Update entity in the table
  • Delete entity from the table                        

Key Features:  

  • Shared Access Signature token-based authorization
  • Shared Access Key based authorization
  • Dynamic header and property support in the receiver adapter.
  • Desired response type from Azure (JSON/XML)
  • Post processing File handling

packages.DisplayName: Business Partner Payment Data Change Process
packages.ShortText: Automates the process of updating a business partner's bank account information. It establishes a process allowing a processor to retrieve the payment details for a business partner and initiate a workflow for any changes to the bank data.
packages.Description:
The package enables customers to accelerate the digitalization of their business partner payment data change approvals in a transparent way and provide flexibility to meet business requirements. It includes processes, decisions and visibility content to address the requirement of the scenario.

Payment information of business partners is maintained and used for automated payment runs at the end of the month. Since the pay-outs are fully automated, they could potentially be used for fraud by changing the bank information on a business partner to a different bank account. To prevent any misuse, the process is used to ensure a four-eye principle by enabling an approval process for every payment data change in the SAP S/4HANA backend system.

This package provides

  • A process that orchestrates the approval process for the business scenario

  • An automation to perform the required scripting relevant for the business scenario

  • Combination of Standard whitelisted APIs and Custom APIs to perform data related operations with SAP S/4HANA

  • Decisions to determine approvers for tasks

The package uses the following action projects for API calls

Business Partner Payment Data Changes Action

packages.DisplayName: Editable, AI Assisted Document Generation in Sales and Service
packages.ShortText: Seamlessly generate, manage, and customise Word documents with AI assisted content for every sales, service, or HR interaction.
packages.Description:
Business Challenge

Organisations face a common set of pain points when creating critical documents such as quotes, proposals, service reports, and HR letters:

  • Time-Consuming Manual Processes: Repetitive copy-pasting from CRM into Word slows down productivity and increases the chance of errors.
  • Inconsistent Branding and Compliance: Without standardised templates, documents often fail to meet corporate branding and legal requirements.
  • Underutilised AI Capabilities: Crafting personalised, context-aware content is difficult without integrated AI support.
  • Fragmented Systems: Sales and service data, template libraries, and AI tools are typically siloed, making cohesive document creation cumbersome.
  • Scalability Limitations: Updating and maintaining document templates across departments is labour-intensive without centralised tools.
Value Story

To solve these challenges, Prezien’s AI-assisted Document Generator introduces a powerful, CX-integrated solution leveraging SAP technology (SAP BTP Integration Suite, GenAI Hub, CAP) that works seamlessly with Sales & Service Cloud, and Enterprise Service Management (ESM):

  • End-to-End Automation: With just a few clicks, users can generate complete documents—including CRM data and AI-generated narratives—directly within SAP Sales or Service Cloud.
  • Integrated Template Management: Word templates stored in a document repository like SharePoint Online are centrally maintained, ensuring version control and consistency.
  • Smart Content Generation: SAP GenAI Hub produces dynamic text (e.g., summaries, disclaimers) tailored to each transaction.
  • Real-Time Data Fetching: Structured CRM data is retrieved instantly through SAP Integration Suite.
  • Seamless Assembly & Output: SAP BTP and CAP services merge CRM data, AI text, and static template content into a polished, editable Word document.
  • Flexible Editing: Users can fine-tune the final document in Word before sharing it with the customer.

This process empowers users across departments—sales, service, HR and others —to create professional documents quickly, consistently, and securely.

Business Benefits

Prezien’s AI-assisted Document Generator delivers measurable value by improving operational efficiency, enhancing document quality, and streamlining user experience across the organisation:

  • Increased Productivity: Reduces the manual effort required to create and finalise documents.
  • Faster Turnaround: Speeds up document preparation and delivery for external and internal stakeholders.
  • Improved Accuracy and Consistency: Minimises errors through standardised templates and automated data insertion.
  • Scalable Across Functions: Easily adaptable to additional use cases in various departments without extensive rework.
  • Better Engagement: Supports faster, clearer communication that enhances interactions with customers and employees.

packages.DisplayName: e-Filing of Employees' Payments and Deductions for UK- FPS, EPS, EYU & EXB: 2020-21

Integration package used for e-Reporting to HMRC. FPS, EPS, EYU, EXB to be updated & deployed annually.
Integration Package: "Payroll e-Filing of Employees' Payments and Deductions for United Kingdom - DPS & Polling" must be deployed additionally.
packages.Description:
This integration package is one of the two packages required for reporting Employees' Payments and Deductions electronically to HMRC for the United Kingdom. These two integration packages enable electronic communication with the government gateway via SAP Cloud Integration. Employers based in the United Kingdom (including UK subsidiaries of overseas organizations) must operate Pay As You Earn (PAYE) as part of their payroll. PAYE is the His Majesty's Revenue & Customs (HMRC) system for collecting income tax and national insurance from employers. Every employer must electronically report the employees’ payments and deductions to HMRC on or before each payday, in real-time, for each payroll run.

This package consists of four integration flows that you must update and redeploy every year. The integration flows are:

  • Full Payment Submission (FPS) (Including Full Payment Submission Adjustment (FPSA))
  • Employer Payment Summary (EPS)
  • Earlier Year Update (EYU)
  • Expenses And Benefits (EXB)

In addition to this package, you must also deploy all the integration flows of the package Payroll e-Filing of Employees' Payments and Deductions for United Kingdom - DPS & Polling for the complete process for electronic reporting of Employees' Payments and Deductions for the United Kingdom to work. This Integration package is used to electronically retrieve data from HRMC.

Employers based in the United Kingdom (including UK subsidiaries of overseas organizations) must operate Pay As You Earn (PAYE) as part of their payroll. Every employer that uses its own payroll software rather than HMRC's system must electronically report the employees’ payments and deductions to HMRC on or before each payday, in real time, for each payroll run.

packages.DisplayName: SAP Document and Reporting Compliance: Electronic Invoicing for South Korea
packages.ShortText: Set up this integration package to enable communication with application service providers in South Korea.
packages.Description:
This integration package enables you to exchange electronic tax invoices with the National Tax Service (NTS) of South Korea by integrating SAP Document and Reporting Compliance and an application service provider.

Notes:

  • This integration package applies to SAP S/4HANA Cloud and SAP S/4HANA.
  • Currently, this integration package supports the application service provider SmartBill only.

If you play the supplier role, you can use this package to do the following:

  • Send electronic tax invoices to the NTS, including self-billing tax invoices that your customers create
  • Send electronic tax invoices to the NTS immediately in emergencies, including self-billing tax invoices that your customers create
  • Get processing statuses of electronic tax invoices, including processing statuses of self-billing tax invoices that your customers create
  • Cancel electronic tax invoices, including self-billing tax invoices that your customers create
  • Reject self-billing tax invoices that your customers create
  • Send notification emails to your customers, asking them to review tax invoices that you issue to them
  • Send notification emails to your customers, asking them to review self-billing tax invoices that you return to them
  • Get self-billing requests from your application service provider
  • Get and delete self-billing requests from a datastore on SAP Integration Suite or SAP Cloud Integration

If you play the customer role, you can use this package to do the following:

  • Send electronic, self-billing tax invoices to your suppliers
  • Get processing statuses of self-billing tax invoices
  • Cancel self-billing tax invoices
  • Get supplier tax invoices from your application service provider
  • Get and delete supplier tax invoices from a datastore on SAP Integration Suite or SAP Cloud Integration

packages.DisplayName: e-Filing of Employees' Payments and Deductions for UK- FPS, EPS & EXB: 2021-22
packages.ShortText: Integration package used for e-Reporting to HMRC. FPS, EPS, EXB to be updated & deployed annually.
packages.Description:
This integration package is one of the two packages required for reporting Employees' Payments and Deductions electronically to HMRC for the United Kingdom. Additionally, the Integration Package: "Payroll e-Filing of Employees' Payments and Deductions for United Kingdom - DPS & Polling" must be deployed. These two integration packages enable electronic communication with the government gateway via SAP Cloud Integration. Employers based in the United Kingdom (including UK subsidiaries of overseas organizations) must operate Pay As You Earn (PAYE) as part of their payroll. PAYE is the His Majesty's Revenue & Customs (HMRC) system for collecting income tax and national insurance from employers. Every employer must electronically report the employees’ payments and deductions to HMRC on or before each payday, in real-time, for each payroll run.

This package consists of four integration flows that you must update and redeploy every year. The integration flows are:

  • Full Payment Submission (FPS) (Including Full Payment Submission Adjustment (FPSA))
  • Employer Payment Summary (EPS)
  • Expenses And Benefits (EXB)

In addition to this package, you must also deploy all the integration flows of the package Payroll e-Filing of Employees' Payments and Deductions for United Kingdom - DPS & Polling for the complete process for electronic reporting of Employees' Payments and Deductions for the United Kingdom to work. This Integration package is used to electronically retrieve data from HRMC

packages.DisplayName: SAP Logistics Management Integration with SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition
packages.ShortText: Integration between S/4HANA and SAP Logistical Management for Delivery
packages.Description:
Description

This package enables the integration of business processes between SAP Logistics Management and SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition. The integration scope includes the following functionalities:

Outbound delivery process

•    Receive outbound delivery data from SAP S/4HANA to create logistical demands in SAP Logistics Management

•    Receive goods issue posting data for SAP Logistics Management to post goods issue in SAP S/4HANA

•    Receive goods issue reversal data for SAP Logistics Management to reverse goods issue in SAP S/4HANA

•    Receive goods issue reversal confirmation data from SAP S/4HANA to reverse goods issue in SAP Logistics Management

•    Receive outbound delivery decline data from SAP Logistics Management to cancel outbound delivery in SAP S/4HANA

Inbound delivery process

•    Receive inbound delivery data from SAP S/4HANA to create logistical demands in SAP Logistics Management

•    Receive goods receipt posting data for SAP Logistics Management to post goods receipt in SAP S/4HANA

•    Receive goods receipt reversal data for SAP Logistics Management to reverse goods receipt in SAP S/4HANA

•    Receive goods receipt reversal confirmation data from SAP S/4HANA to reverse goods receipt in SAP Logistics Management

•    Receive inbound delivery decline data from SAP Logistics Management to cancel inbound delivery in SAP S/4HANA

For more information, see the help document at: https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_LOGISTICS_MANAGEMENT.

packages.DisplayName: Mass Upload of Bank Statement Files (4X2)
packages.ShortText: Extracts file attachments of bank statements from emails or predefined folders and uploads into the Manage Incoming Payment Files Fiori app.
packages.Description:
Problem

Cash Management Specialists often receive bank statement files as email attachments. To process them, the Specialist must upload each statement manually and individually to the system.

This task is incredibly tedious, repetitive, and slow if done manually. This is especially true as the Cash Management Specialist receives more bank statement files.

Solution

The bot scans unread emails based on specified keywords in the subject line, extracts the bank statement file attachments from these emails, and uploads directly into the Manage Incoming Payment Files Fiori app.

The bot also uploads bank statement files saved in a predefined folder directly into the Manage Incoming Payment Files Fiori app.

After the runs, the bot generates a log file and sends an email notification to the relevant stakeholders.

Note

The scope item 1EG (Manage Bank Statements) needs to be activated.

packages.DisplayName: List of Purchasing Documents (ECC)– ME2N
packages.ShortText: Automate the list of Purchasing Documents for a given criteria and download it as an excel file
packages.Description:
Use

This program lists purchasing documents according to several selection criteria e.g. purchasing org, plant, document date etc. Here, we are automating the download of the list of Purchasing Documents.

Configuration

The input criteria and system information are contained in a configuration excel named as DynamicTemplate_ME2N.xlsx. This excel file contains two sheets;

  • The first sheet contains the system details like the System ID, Client and whether Single Sign-On is enabled. It also contains the Variant name for the program and the output path of the excel file to be downloaded.Username and password are taken from Cloud Factory. Please maintain a credential variable named ‘LoginCredentialsME2N’ with the username and password.

The file type of the output file to be downloaded is maintained in “Output File Type” row. It is available in the field “Select from all available formats” in Select Spreadsheet popup window in the target system. Some examples of the file-type include “Excel (in Office 2007 XLSX Format)” or “Excel-Office open XML Format (XLSX)” etc.

  • The second sheet contains input criteria for the program in the form of parameter and its corresponding value along with a description for the parameter.

Business Benefits

  • Freeing up end user to refocus on high-value tasks

  • Simplify the process of getting list of purchasing documents

  • Automate the repetitive tasks by maximizing productivity

Key Process Flows

  • The bot reads input criteria from the excel template

  • Retrieves SAP UserID and Password from the Cloud Factory if corresponding indicator is set to Global

  • Automate the Purchasing Documents’ list according to defined input criteria

  • Download the list as an excel file

The Coupa adapter provides the following features:

  • Secure authentication with OAuth 2.0: Connecting Coupa with other applications is securely achieved by employing OAuth 2.0 authentication process. Every REST call between Coupa and SAP Cloud Integration is secured by specific authorization flows.
  • Supports all Coupa operations: Our Adapter has support for all Coupa operations including Create, Get, Modify, Query, and Update Resource operations.
  • Auto Pagination: You can query efficiently with our integrated pagination support. Coupa adapter supports querying of all records of a resource using Auto Pagination.
  • Dynamic configuration with headers and properties: Assigning dynamic values to different properties allows enhanced flexibility to your integration flows. You can also refer to dynamic parameters using SAP Cloud Integration exchange headers and properties.

This template provides the approval flow for sales quotation data & covers the capability to retrieve required sales quotation data and update or creation of sales quotation in SAP S/4HANA public cloud system.

The following steps are included as a part of Mass Maintenance of template:

Fetch operation: A pre-defined excel template file is populated with fetched sales quotation records based on the selection screen input populated by the sales representative.

The sales representative must manually update sales quotation details in this file and move it to the ToBeProcessed folder.

Update operation: A task automation to update sales quotations in SAP S/4HANA Cloud (after optional approval) runs in a predefined scheduled manner, in an unattended mode. This automation fetches the file(s) from the ToBeProcessed folder, groups sales quotations with their items and sends them for (optional) approvals. upon completion of the task, the sales quotation header and its items are updated in the SAP S/4HANA Cloud system

Create operation: A task automation to create sales quotation in SAP S/4HANA Cloud(after optional approval) based on the template data file available in the ToBeProcessed folder.

The template uses the API_SALES_QUOTATION_SRV API for read, create and update operations.

The template can also work in collaboration with the Business Document Extraction from Email (70U) bot available in the SAP Build Store.

Business Challenge

The use case leverages the capabilities offered by SAP AI Core to apply artificial intelligence into budget & forecasting process. Instead of using old techniques to determine the forecast, the use case applies machine learning to auto determine the best algorithm that will produce the optimal forecast based on historical data provided.
