packages.DisplayName: Sales Order Creation from a Local Purchase Order (2C1)
packages.ShortText: This bot is an SAP Business One offering. This bot automates the creation of Sales Order drafts from local Purchase Order files received from the customer.
packages.Description:
Problem statement

Companies regularly receive purchase order documents from their customers. These external documents are referred by business users to create sales orders in SAP Business One. Typically, a user enters or copies the details from the documents to the system. This manual process is often prone to errors such as incorrect or missing information.

Solution

The Sales Order Creation from a Local Purchase Order (2C1) bot sends a purchase order to the Document Information Extraction service (SAP AI Business Services) to scan the information. The extracted details are passed by the bot to SAP Business One using the Open Data Protocol to create a draft sales order and upload the document to the draft for business user review.

Business Benefits

  • Reduces user effort by automating repetitive tasks

  • Reduces the risk of manual errors, resulting in higher accuracy

  • Improves work efficiency

Further Extensions

This bot can be used as a stand-alone bot or work with the Business Document Extraction from E-mail bot, which extracts customer purchase orders from e-mails and places the files in an automatically created folder structure. To further automate and improve the accuracy of the sales order creation, users can use the Master Data Enrichment for Business Partner Identification bot, which helps the bot to identify the business partner code based on the scanned information such as the business partner name, address, and bank account.

The above mentioned automation bots, Business Document Extraction from Email and Master Data Enrichment for Business Partner Identification, are also available in the Store.

packages.ShortText: This package contains the required artifacts that automatically cancels the service order of tenant and reverses the move-out document of the owner when tenant move-in document is reversed.
packages.Description:
This package is deprecated

This content package enables business experts to handle cancellation of service order of tenant and reversal of move-out document of the owner based on tenant move-in document reversal.

When a tenant contacts a utility company to cancel the future dated move-in, the user agent initially performs validation if the tenant has a contract and a valid owner existing (in the case of tenant-owner relationship) for a particular contract. Once the move-in is canceled for a tenant, the system will trigger a workflow to cancel service order. If the tenant-owner relationship exists, the move-out document of the owner is reversed.

The service order needs to be canceled before the tenant's move-in date, and the move-out document needs to be reversed before the move-out date of the owner.

This live process content can be consumed in SAP Build Process Automation (click here to know-how) or SAP Workflow Management (click here to know-how).

packages.Description:
This integration package is one of the two packages required for reporting Employees' Payments and Deductions electronically to HMRC for the United Kingdom. These two integration packages enable electronic communication with the government gateway via SAP Cloud Integration. Employers based in the United Kingdom (including UK subsidiaries of overseas organizations) must operate Pay As You Earn (PAYE) as part of their payroll. PAYE is the His Majesty's Revenue & Customs (HMRC) system for collecting income tax and national insurance from employers. Every employer must electronically report the employees’ payments and deductions to HMRC on or before each payday, in real-time, for each payroll run.

This package consists of four integration flows that you must update and redeploy every year. The integration flows are:

  • Full Payment Submission (FPS) (Including Full Payment Submission Adjustment (FPSA))
  • Employer Payment Summary (EPS)
  • Earlier Year Update (EYU)
  • Expenses And Benefits (EXB)

In addition to this package, you must also deploy all the integration flows of the package Payroll e-Filing of Employees' Payments and Deductions for United Kingdom - DPS & Polling for the complete process for electronic reporting of Employees' Payments and Deductions for the United Kingdom to work. This Integration package is used to electronically retrieve data from HRMC.

packages.DisplayName: Integration Flow Design Guidelines - Use the Partner Directory Appropriately
packages.ShortText: This integration package contains integration flows to illustrate the design guidelines for Partner Directory. More details can be found on SAP Help Portal.
packages.Description:
The Partner Directory is used in integration scenarios where you establish a communication network between many communication partners. In such kind of scenarios, you build one or a few integration flows which are parametrized by partner-specific information. The parametrized components in the integration flow read the partner-specific information from the Partner Directory. The Partner Directory contains for each partner parameters, like

  • the Authorized User which is authorized to call inbound endpoints of the integration flow(s),
  • the HTTP addresses needed for making outbound calls to the partner systems.

With the Partner Directory, it is possible to add new communication partners without downtime and without changing or redeploying the integration flows. The tenant administrator or Partner Directory configurator can enter entries of a new partner into the Partner Directory via an OData API while the message processing for the existing partners is ongoing.

Check out the SAP Help Portal for a description of the Partner Directory capabilities.

Get a detailed description of the Partner Directory API on SAP API Business Hub.

 

In the Documents section you will find some useful Postman Collections.

Advantages of using these collections and the environment structure are as follows:

  • Switch easily between tenants, you can use the same environment for both postman collections.
  • A standardized and easy way to use CSRF token for the APIs that use POST, PUT, DELETE methods.

Getting Started

  • Download the postman collections and the postman environment files
  • Import the postman collections (import button on the top-left corner) and the postman environment (environment settings on the top-right corner)
  • Duplicate the environment template for each SAP Cloud Integration tenant you use (and rename collections accordingly) and enter the specific tenant details
  • Choose the environment you defined earlier and start using collections
  • Before you do any operation you need to fetch a CSRF token. Call Get CSRF request once before using e.g. POST methods in the collections

This documentation explains how to work with the Postman collection attached to this integration package in general.

More details on the guidelines covered in this integration package can be found on SAP Help Portal.

packages.ShortText: Automate change of Material BOM using transaction CS02
packages.Description:
Use

This program is used for changing Material BOM. Here, we are automating change of Material BOM using transaction CS02.

Configuration

The input criteria and system information are maintained in a configuration excel named as Material_BOM_Change_CS02(ECC).xlsx. The configuration excel available within the package should be downloaded and maintained in the given InputPath environment variable.

This excel file contains three sheets:

  • The first sheet contains the system details like the System ID, Client, Variant Name, Output Path and whether Single Sign-On is enabled.

  • The username and password for the target ECC system is maintained in the Cloud Factory.

  • The second and third sheet contain input data for the program in the form of parameter and its corresponding value.

Key Process Flows

  • The bot, during first run, reads BOM Header data from the excel template.

  • Fetch the available BOM details using transaction CS03 and update the excel template.

  • The bot, during second run, reads all the input data from the excel template.

  • Automate change of Material BOM using transaction CS02.

  • Write the status back into the excel template

Business Benefits

  • Reduce manual effort - an employee can concentrate on the more important tasks

  • Ensure fast creation of the document

  • Eliminate the human error

packages.DisplayName: Mass Transfer of Time and Expenses from One WBS to Another for Internal Projects (4W1)
packages.ShortText: Enables mass transfer of relevant time records and expenses from one WBS element to another.
packages.Description:
Problem

Project Managers may need to transfer time and expenses postings from one WBS element to another due to a variety of reasons (e.g., incorrect postings, changes in project scope or direction, etc.). When this occurs, the Project Manager must manually identify these required entries and transfer them to a new WBS element. Manual mass transfer of these entries from one WBS element to another can be very tedious and time-consuming.

Solution

The bot automates mass transfer of time and supplier invoice entries from one WBS element to another by reversing these entries from the incorrect WBS element and reposting to the correct WBS element.

The bot can run in two ways:

  • Test Run of Time & Expenses to be Transferred: The bot fetches the timesheets and/or supplier invoices entries based on a given set of filter criteria.

  • Time Transfer & Expense Transfer: The bot fetches the timesheet and/or supplier invoice entries based on a given set of filter criteria, reverses these entries from the current WBS element they are posted to and reposts to the another WBS element.

After the bot runs, an email is sent to specified recipients containing the log output files.

Note

Activate the following SAP S/4HANA Cloud scope items:

  • Internal Project Management - Project-Based Services (1A8)

  • Time Recording - Project-Based Services (J12)

  • Service and Material Procurement - Project-Based Services (J13)

  • Time Recording (1Q4)

packages.DisplayName: Call Agent Product AI Assistant
packages.ShortText: Understands the requirement, knows your catalogue and understands the wider context of compatibility, similar products on the market or principles of engineering.
packages.Description:
Business Challenge

Customer Service Call Agents are normally not technical, but your customers often are. Technical products have multiple technical attributes and long form descriptions making search complex. In addition to these challenges, when selling directly or indirectly your best opportunity to sell or upsell is with an inbound product request, yet because of these challenges often the Call Agent lacks the knowledge to do so resulting in lost revenue.

Value Story

Call Agent Product AI Assistant creates and consumes a GenAI model grounded in your full product catalogue.
The model can be built with any major LLM provider depending on relative performance for your use case. Once created your Product GenAI model powers a dynamic agent able to use the power of pre-trained models to understand, investigate and respond to enquiries whilst having all the context of your business to make an informed recommendation.
Interoperable with popular chat interfaces such as SAP Joule or Microsoft Teams as well as configurable for extended use cases like mailbox monitoring and response drafting with Microsoft Outlook or Gmail.

packages.DisplayName: Goods Receipt Inspection Lot Supplier Negotiation
packages.ShortText: This content package for SAP S/4HANA and SAP S/4HANA Cloud enables to automate the negotiation process with Supplier and move the material from Blocked stock to Unrestricted stock in a flexible and transparent way.
packages.Description:
For this use case, a new template content package based on SAP Build Process Automation is available at    Goods Receipt Inspection Lot Supplier Negotiation

This content package will enable SAP S/4HANA customers to automate the identification of rejected Goods Receipt Inspection Lots, negotiation of rejected lot quantity with the Supplier and submit for Approval without additional development in SAP S/4HANA system. It provides flexibility in choosing process variants depending on attributes like Company Code, Plant, Purchasing Organization etc.

The workflow is automatically triggered in SAP BTP when a Goods Receipt Inspection Lot is rejected in SAP S/4HANA. The Procurement Team negotiates with the Supplier via online or offline mode. Once the negotiation is finalized, Procurement Team will Submit it for Approval. Approver can finally Accept, Return to Vendor or Write-off.  On Accept, the relevant materials are moved from Blocked stock to Unrestricted stock in SAP S/4HANA.

This live process content can be consumed in SAP Build Process Automation (click here to know-how) or SAP Workflow Management (click here to know-how).

packages.DisplayName: Treasury Payment Request Approval
packages.ShortText: Enables customer to accelerate the digitalization of their treasury payment request creation process in a transparent way and provide flexibility to meet business requirements.
packages.Description:
The treasury payment request approval process integrates SAP GUI and SAP BTP process to automate and monitor payment request approvals. The process begins with the creation of a treasury payment request using the transaction code "FTR_CREATE." Once created, the transaction is settled using the transaction code "FTR_EDIT." This action triggers a process in SAP BTP, requiring approvals at two hierarchical levels:

Level 1: Treasury specialist who is responsible for initial review and approval.

Level 2: Treasury manager who is responsible for final review and approval.

Approvers receive task notifications in their "My Inbox" in SAP BTP, where they can approve or reject the request. Upon successful approval at both levels, the treasury payment request is created in SAP S/4HANA. Additionally, the original requestor receives an email notification confirming the successful processing of the request.

This package provides:

  • A process that orchestrates the approval process for the business scenario.

  • APIs to perform data related operations with SAP S/4HANA private cloud.

  • Decisions to determine approvers for tasks.

The package uses the following action project for integration iflows:

  • Treasury Payment Request Creation Approval - Create Action.
